translations.source: "We now have 4-month-old mice that are non-diabetic that used to be diabetic," he added.
translations.reference: "Manje sinamagundane anezinyanga ezingu-4 angenawo ushukela ayenoshukela," wanezela.
translations.hypothesis: "Manje sinama-mouse ane izinyanga ezine ubudala, ayona amanye ayingcolile, kodwa ngaphambilini ayenganolazana." wengeza.

translations.source: Dr. Ehud Ur, professor of medicine at Dalhousie University in Halifax, Nova Scotia and chair of the clinical and scientific division of the Canadian Diabetes Association cautioned that the research is still in its early days.
translations.reference: UDkt. Ehud Ur, usolwazi wezokwelapha eNyuvesi yaseDalhousie eHalifax, eNova Scotia kanye nosihlalo womnyango wezokwelapha nowesayensi weCanadian Diabetes Association uxwayise ngokuthi ucwaningo lusanda kuqala.
translations.hypothesis: UDkt. Ehud Ur, umfundisi wezokwelapha eNyuvesi yase-Dalhousie e-Halifax, eNova Scotia, kanye nomphathi womkhakha wezokwelapha kanye nezici zesimo sezulu we-Canadian Diabetes Association, uxwayise ukuthi ucwaningo usasengumbusheni.

translations.source: Like some other experts, he is skeptical about whether diabetes can be cured, noting that these findings have no relevance to people who already have Type 1 diabetes.
translations.reference: Njengezinye izazi, unokungabaza ukuthi isifo sikashukela singalashwa, ephawula ukuthi lokhu okutholakele akubathinti asebevele benesifo sikashukela soHlobo loku-1.
translations.hypothesis: Njengoba kunjalo kwezinye izazi, unokungabaza ukuthi ukugula komhlaza kungalaphethwa yini, futhi uqaphela ukuthi lezi zibonelelo azinazo izimo zabantu abangasebenza ngempela ngobuhlungu bomhlaza obuhlukumezayo (Type 1 diabetes).

translations.source: On Monday, Sara Danius, permanent secretary of the Nobel Committee for Literature at the Swedish Academy, publicly announced during a radio program on Sveriges Radio in Sweden the committee, unable to reach Bob Dylan directly about winning the 2016 Nobel Prize in Literature, had abandoned its efforts to reach him.
translations.reference: NgoMsombuluko, uSara Danius, unobhala wesikhathi sonkeweKomidi leNobel for Literature eSwedish Academy, umemezele obala phakathi nohlelo lomsakazo eSveriges Radio eSweden ikomiti, njengoba lingakwazi ukufinyelela kuBob Dylan ngokuqondile mayelana nokunqoba Umklomelo weNobel weZincwadi ka-2016, liyeke imizamo yokumfinyelela.
translations.hypothesis: Ngolundi, uSara Danius, umsekeli omkhulu weKomidi leNobeli lezincwadi e-Swedish Academy, uthe ngokushesha ngesikhathi ohlele umdlalo wamakhadi kumsakazo we-Sveriges Radio eSweden ukuthi, ngoba bekungakwazi ukuxhumana noBob Dylan ngqo mayelana nokufakwa kwakhe kwiNobeli lezincwadi ka-2016, ikomidi lishiye imizamo yalo yokuxhumana naye.

translations.source: Danius said, "Right now we are doing nothing. I have called and sent emails to his closest collaborator and received very friendly replies. For now, that is certainly enough."
translations.reference: UDanius wathi, “Okwamanje asenzi lutho. Sengishayele ucingo ngaphinde ngathumela ama-imeyile kwabasondelene naye kakhulu asebenzisana nabo futhi ngathola izimpendulo ezinobungane. Okwamanje, lokho ngokuqinisekile kwanele.”
translations.hypothesis: UDanius uthe, "Njengamanje, asikwenzi lutho. Ngibhalele futhi ngithumele i-imeyili kumlingani wakhe ocishe kakhulu futhi ngithole impendulo enhle kakhulu. Okwamanje, lokho kufanele kube ngokwanele."

translations.source: Previously, Ring's CEO, Jamie Siminoff, remarked the company started when his doorbell wasn't audible from his shop in his garage.
translations.reference: Phambilini, isikhulu esiphezulu sakwa-Ring, u-Jamie Siminoff, sathi le nkampani yaqala ngenkathi kungezwakali ukuthi kukhona ongqongqozayo emnyango uma esesitolo sakhe esisegalaji lakhe.
translations.hypothesis: Ngaphambilini, uJamie Siminoff, umphathi omkhulu we-Ring, uthe inkampani yaqala ngesikhathi okuthi umkhosi wakhe wendawo yangaphakathi engasetshenziswa kahle ngaphandle, ngakho-ke engakuzwa kusukela esitolo sakhe esinalabhishi.

translations.source: He built a WiFi door bell, he said.
translations.reference: Wakhe insimbi yasemnyango yeWiFi, washo.
translations.hypothesis: Uzakhela isilingi seliyogi elisebenza nge-WiFi, njengoba etshe.

translations.source: Siminoff said sales boosted after his 2013 appearance in a Shark Tank episode where the show panel declined funding the startup.
translations.reference: USminoff uthe izintengo zanyuka ngemva kokuvela kwakhe embukwisweni we-Shark Tank ngo-2013 lapho iphaneli yohlelo yenqaba ukusekela ibhizinisi ngezimali.
translations.hypothesis: USiminoff uthe ukuthengiswa kukhuliswe ngemuva kokuboniswa kwakhe ngonyaka ka-2013 endizini ethi "Shark Tank," lapho iqembu lebhuku le-tv lwenqaba ukuxhasa leli bhizinisi elisha.

translations.source: In late 2017, Siminoff appeared on shopping television channel QVC.
translations.reference: Ekupheleni kuka-2017, iSiminoff savela ohlelweni lokuthengisa lukamabonakude iQVC.
translations.hypothesis: Ngasekupheleni kuka-2017, uSiminoff ubonise kulo chwepheshe lwethelevishini elidayisela impahla, elithi QVC.

translations.source: Ring also settled a lawsuit with competing security company, the ADT Corporation.
translations.reference: U-Ring wabuye waxazulula icala nenkampani ancintisana nayo yezokuphepha, i-ADT Corporation.
translations.hypothesis: URing uphinde wuxazulule udlulelo olwalwa nenkampani enhle kakhulu yezokuvikela, i-ADT Corporation.

translations.source: While one experimental vaccine appears able to reduce Ebola mortality, up until now, no drugs have been clearly demonstrated suitable for treating existing infection.
translations.reference: Nakuba umjovo wokulinga ubonakala ukwazi ukunciphisa ukufa okubangelwa yi-Ebola, kuze kube manje, ayikho imithi eboniswe ngokucacile ukuthi ifanelekela ukulapha isifo esikhona.
translations.hypothesis: Nakuba kukhona igama elinye lezivini eziluhlaza ezibonakala zilungele ukunciphisa ukufa okuphathelwe yi-Ebola, kuze kube manje, akukhozi izidakamizwa ezibonakalise ngokucacile ukuthi zifanele ukwelashwa kwezifo ezikhona.

translations.source: One antibody cocktail, ZMapp, initially showed promise in the field, but formal studies indicated it had less benefit than sought in preventing death.
translations.reference: I-cocktail eyodwa nje emzimbeni, ZMapp, ekuqaleni ibonakale ithembisa ensimini, kodwa ngokocwaningo kubonisa ukuthi inomthelela omncane kunalowo obucatshwangwa ekuvimbeleni ukufa.
translations.hypothesis: Enye inhlelo yezithasiselo zamazinyo, i-ZMapp, ekuqaleni ibonise ukuthi ingasetshenziswa, kodwa izifundo ezisemthethweni zibonise ukuthi yayinokuba nezinzuzo ezincane kakhulu ekulwiseni ukufa kuneze okubalulwe.

translations.source: In the PALM trial, ZMapp served as a control, meaning scientists used it as a baseline and compared the three other treatments to it.
translations.reference: Ekuhloleni kwe-PALM, i-ZMapp yasebenza njengesifaniso, okusho ukuthi ososayensi bayisebenzisa njengesiqalo sokuqhathanisa futhi baqhathanisa amanye amakhambi amathathu okwelapha nayo.
translations.hypothesis: Kuhlelo lokuhlola i-PALM, i-ZMapp yayisetshenziswa njengento yokulinganisa, okusho ukuthi ososayensi bayisebenzise njengengxenye yokuqala futhi baqhathanise ezinye izindlela zokwelapha ezintathu nayo.

translations.source: USA Gymnastics supports the United States Olympic Committee's letter and accepts the absolute need of the Olympic family to promote a safe environment for all of our athletes.
translations.reference: I-USA Gymnastics isekela incwadi yeKomiti lama-Olimpiki laseMelika futhi kwamukela isidingo esiphelele sokuba umndeni wama-Olimpiki ukhathaze indawo ephephile yabadlali bethu bonke.
translations.hypothesis: I-USA Gymnastics isekela incwadi ye-United States Olympic Committee futhi yamukela ukuthi kubalulekile kakhulu umndeni we-Olympic ukukhuthaza indawo ephephile kubo bonke abadlali bethu.

translations.source: We agree with the USOC's statement that the interests of our athletes and clubs, and their sport, may be better served by moving forward with meaningful change within our organization, rather than decertification.
translations.reference: Sivumelana nesitatimende se-USOC ukuthi izintshisekelo zabadlali kanye namaqembu, kanye nemidlalo yabo, zingakhonzwa kangcono ngokuyaphambili ngoshintsho olunenjongo phakathi kwenhlangano yethu, kunokuthathelwa izitifiketi.
translations.hypothesis: Siyavumelana nombiko we-USOC othi izintshisekelo zabadlali bethu kanye namaqembu abo, kanye nomdlalo abawudlala, zingase zithuthukiswe kangcono ngokwenza izinguquko ezibalulekile ngaphakathi kohlelo lwethu, kunokuthi silimale.

translations.source: USA Gymnastics supports an independent investigation that may shine light on how abuse of the proportion described so courageously by the survivors of Larry Nassar could have gone undetected for so long and embraces any necessary and appropriate changes.
translations.reference: I-USA Gymnastics isekela uphenyo oluzimele olungaveza ukukhanya  ngokuhlukunyezwa kwenxenye echazwe ngesibindi yilabo abasinde kuLarry Nassar obekungenzeka kungabonwa ngayo isikhathi eside kangaka futhi yamukela noma iziphi izinguquko ezidingekayo nezifanele.
translations.hypothesis: I-USA Gymnastics isekela uphindiswe lwophenyo oluzimele olungase usize ukuchaza ukuthi ukuhlukunyezwa okuchazwe ngobuhlakani ngabantu abaphilile ukuhlukunyezwa kukaLarry Nassar kungabe kuyatholakala kangakanani, futhi yamukela noma yimiphi izinguquko ezidingekayo nezifanele.

translations.source: USA Gymnastics and the USOC have the same goal — making the sport of gymnastics, and others, as safe as possible for athletes to follow their dreams in a safe, positive and empowered environment.
translations.reference: I-USA Gymnastic kanye ne-USOC zinomgomo ofanayao — ukwenza umdlalo wezokuzivivinya komzimba, kanye neminye, iphephe ngangokunokwenzeka ukuba abadlali balandele amaphupho wabo endaweni ephephile, enhle kanye nenika amandla.
translations.hypothesis: I-USA Gymnastics kanye ne-USOC zinezinhloso ezifanayo—ukwenza umdlalo we-gymnastics, kanye neminye imidlalo, ube nomlingo omkhulu ngangokunokwenzeka ukuze abadlali bakwazi ukuqhubeka neziphozo zabo endaweni ephephile, ekhuthazayo, futhi enempumela.

translations.source: Throughout 1960s, Brzezinski worked for John F. Kennedy as his advisor and then the Lyndon B. Johnson administration.
translations.reference: Kuyo yonke iminyaka yawo-1960, uBrzezinski wasebenzela uJohn F. Kennedy njengomeluleki wakhe bese uhulumeni kaLyndon B. Johnson.
translations.hypothesis: Ngozikhathi zama-1960, uBrzezinski wasebenzela uJohn F. Kennedy njengomeluleki wakhe, bese wadlala indima ekuphathweni kukaLyndon B. Johnson.

translations.source: During the 1976 selections he advised Carter on foreign policy, then served as National Security Advisor (NSA) from 1977 to 1981, succeeding Henry Kissinger.
translations.reference: Phakathi nokhetho luka-1976 waluleka uCarter ngemithetho yakwamanye amazwe, bese wasesebenza njenge-National Security Advisor (NSA) kusuka ngo-1977 kuya ku-1981, ethatha isikhundla sikaHenry Kissinger.
translations.hypothesis: Ngalesi sikhathi sokuqokwa ngonyaka ka-1976, ube nomsebenzi wokumncenga uCarter mayelana nezinqubomgomo zamazwe ngamazwe, bese wadlala indima kaMphathisa Wezokuvikeleka Kazwelonke (NSA) kusukela ngo-1977 kuya ku-1981, esalandela uHenry Kissinger.

translations.source: As NSA, he assisted Carter in diplomatically handling world affairs, such as the Camp David Accords, 1978; normalizing US–China relations thought the late 1970s; the Iranian Revolution, which led to the Iran hostage crisis, 1979; and the Soviet invasion in Afghanistan, 1979.
translations.reference: Njenge-NSA, usize uCarter ngokuphatha izindaba zezwe ngokusemthethweni, njenge-Camp David Accords, 1978; ukwenza kube nobudlelwane obuvamile phakathi kweMelika neShayina ekupheleni kwawo-1970; Ushintsho lwase-Iran, olwaholela enhlekeleleni yezithunjwa zase-Iran, ngo-1979; kanye nokuhlasela kweSoviet e-Afghanistan, ngo-1979.
translations.hypothesis: Njengomphathi wezokuvikela kazwelonke (NSA), usize uCarter ekulungiseni izindaba zamazwe ngamazwi ahlanzekile, njengokuxoxwa kwe-Camp David ngo-1978; ekwenzeni ukuthi ubudlelwane phakathi kwe-US ne-China buphinde buhle ngasekupheleni kuka-1970; nasekuvikelweni kweRevolushini yase-Iran, okubangela ingxabano yabo abagulwa base-Iran ngo-1979; kanye nokuhlaselwa kwe-Soviet e-Afghanistan ngo-1979.

translations.source: The movie, featuring Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone, received nominations in all major categories.
translations.reference: Ifilimu, eno-Ryan Gosling noEmma Stone, ikhethelwe ukuwina kuzo zonke izigaba ezinkulu.
translations.hypothesis: Ifilimu, egxile ku-Ryan Gosling kanye no-Emma Stone, ithole ukubekwa phakathi kwefilimu eziningi ezinkulu.

translations.source: Gosling and Stone received nominations for Best Actor and Actress respectively.
translations.reference: U-Gosling no-Stone bathole ukuqokwa kwe-Best Actor no-Actress ngokulandelana kwabo.
translations.hypothesis: UGosling kanye noStone bathole ukubhaliselwa kumklomelo wabadlali abahle kakhulu, uGosling ngomdlalo wabafana noStone ngomdlalo wabafazi.

translations.source: The other nominations include Best Picture, Director, Cinematography, Costume Design, Film-editing, Original Score, Production Design, Sound Editing, Sound Mixing and Original Screenplay.
translations.reference: Abanye abakhethiwe bahlanganisa neSithombe Esihle Kakhulu, Umqondisi Webhayisikobho, Umklami Wezimpahla, Umhleli-wefilimu, Umculo, Umklamo Womkhiqizo, Ukuhlelwa Komsindo, Ukuhlanganiswa Komsindo kanye Nombhalo weFilimu Wangempela.
translations.hypothesis: Eminye yezigaba ezifakazelwe zifaka i-"Best Picture" (Umfilimu Ongcono Kakhulu), umqondisi, ukudlala ngamefuleyithi, ukuklama izingubo, ukuhlela umfilimu, umculo owenziwe ngqo, ukuklama kokukhiqizwa, ukuhlela umsindo, ukuhlanganisa umsindo kanye nenombolo yefilimu ehlanganisiwe.

translations.source: Two songs from the movie, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) and City of Stars, received nominations for best original song. Lionsgate studio received 26 nominations — more than any other studio.
translations.reference: Izingoma ezimbili ezivela kwifilimu, i-Audition (The Fools Who Dream) kanye ne-City of Stars, zithole ukuqokelwa kwengoma yangempela ehamba phambili. Isitudiyo se-Lionsgate sikhethwe izikhathi ezingu-26 — ukudlula noma esiphi Isitudiyo.
translations.hypothesis: Izinsolo ezimbili ezivela kwi-movie, i-"Audition" ("The Fools Who Dream") kanye ne-"City of Stars," zithole ukubekwa phakathi kwezinto ezihlonishwa kakhulu ezinkulumweni zomsindo, ngakho-ke zifike nezibuyekezo zokuba yizingosi ezihamba phambili. I-studio yase-Lionsgate ithole izibuyekezo ezingu-26 — eziningi kunazo zonke ezinye i-studio.

translations.source: Late on Sunday, the United States President Donald Trump, in a statement delivered via the press secretary, announced US troops would be leaving Syria.
translations.reference: Ntambama ngeSonto, uMongameli waseMelika u-Donald Trump, esitatimendeni esikhishwe unobhala wephephandaba, umemezele ukuthi amasosha aseMelika azoshiya elaseSiriya.
translations.hypothesis: Ngobusuku obuqala ngoMgqibelo, iPhrezidenti yase-United States, uDonald Trump, ngomlayezo oboniswe ngomphathiabezindaba, uthe amasosha ase-United States azokhiya iSiria.

translations.source: The announcement was made after Trump had a phone conversation with Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.
translations.reference: Isimemezelo senziwa ngemva kokuba u-Trump eshayele uMongameli waseTheki uRecep Tayyip Erdoğan ucingo.
translations.hypothesis: Lesi mngcwango wamenyezwa ngemuva kokuba uTrump ube nomkhuba wefoni nomphrezidenti waseTurkey, uRecep Tayyip Erdoğan.

translations.source: Turkey would also take over guarding captured ISIS fighters which, the statement said, European nations have refused to repatriate.
translations.reference: ITheki izophatha ukugada amasosha we-ISIS athunjiwe lawo, ngokwesitatimende, amazwe waseYurophu anqabe ukuwalanda.
translations.hypothesis: I-Turkey nayo izothatha indima yokuvikela abaxhasi be-ISIS abathathwe, okuthi, ngokusho kophapheme, amazwe aseYurophu wenze ukuthi angabuyisi.

translations.source: This not only confirms that at least some dinosaurs had feathers, a theory already widespread, but provides details fossils generally cannot, such as color and three-dimensional arrangement.
translations.reference: Lokhu akugcini nje ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi okungenani amanye ama-dinosaur ayenezimpaphe, inkolelo-mbono ebanzi kakade, kepha inikezela imininingwane imivubukulo engayinikezi ngokujwayelekile, njengombala nokuhleleka kwezinhlangothi ezintathu.
translations.hypothesis: Lokhu akubeka nje kuphela ukuthi okungenani ezinye izilo zama-dinosa zazinamathayi, okuyinto eyaziwayo, kodwa futhi linikeza imininingwane engasetshenziswa ngamakhambi, njengoba amakhambi amaningi awanikezi, njengoba kungumbala kanye nokuhlelwa kwazo kwezimpawu ezintathu.

translations.source: . Scientists say this animal's plumage was chestnut-brown on top with a pale or carotenoid-colored underside.
translations.reference: . Ososayensi bathi iplamu lalesi silwane lalinesifuba esinsundu ngaphezulu siphaphathekile nokumibalabala emaceleni.
translations.hypothesis: Abafundi bezokomoya bathi ingxenye yangaphezulu yombala walesi silwane yayingumbala obomvu okhanyayo, kanti ingxenye yangaphansi yayinombala ohlanzekile noma inombala ohlotshisiwe.

translations.source: The find also grants insight into the evolution of feathers in birds.
translations.reference: Ucwaningo lunikeza nokuqonda ngokuvela kwezimpaphe ezinyonini.
translations.hypothesis: Lokho okutholwe nakho kunikeza ulwazi mayelana nokuthuthuka kwamathayi ezinyoni.

translations.source: Because the dinosaur feathers do not have a well-developed shaft, called a rachis, but do have other features of feathers — barbs and barbules — the researchers inferred the rachis was likely a later evolutionary development that these other features.
translations.reference: Ngenxa yokuthi izimpaphe zama-dinosaur aziso isiqu esikhule kahle, osibizwa ngokuthi i-rachis, kodwa zinezinye izici zezimpaphe — izindlendla kanye nama-barbule — abacwaningi baphethe ngokuthi i-rachis cishe bekungukwakheka kokuziphendukela kunalezinye izici.
translations.hypothesis: Ngoba izinwele zama-dinosaur azinayo ingxenye egcwele, ebizwa ngokuthi i-rachis, kodwa zinomunye umthamo wezinwele—ama-barbs nama-barbules—abacwaningi bathole ukuthi i-rachis kwakuyinto eyathuthuka ngemuva kulezi zinto eziningi, njengengxenye yendlela yobuluntu.

translations.source: The feathers' structure suggests that they were not used in flight but rather for temperature regulation or display. The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.reference: Ukwakheka kwezimpaphe kusikisela ukuthi bezingasetshenziselwa ukundiza kodwa kunalokho ukulawula ukushisa kanye nokuzibonakalisa. Abacwaningi basikisela ukuthi, nakuba lona kungumsila we-dinosaur encane, isampula liveza izimpaphe zendala futhi hhayi isihluphe somntwanyana.
translations.hypothesis: Ubukhakazelo bezintambo zombhaca kubonisa ukuthi azasetshenziswa ekundleni, kodwa kungasetshenziswa ukulawula izinga lokushisa noma ukubonisa. Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi, nakuba leli kuyiqenya lenyoka yendulo encane, lesi sampula ibonisa izintambo zombhaca zombunjwa, hhayi izintambo zombhaca zenyanga encane.

translations.source: The researchers suggested that, even though this is the tail of a young dinosaur, the sample shows adult plumage and not a chick's down.
translations.reference: Abacwaningi basikisela ukuthi, ngisho noma lona kungumsila we-dinosaur, isampula liveza izimpaphe zendala futhi hhayi isihluphe somntwanyana.
translations.hypothesis: Abacwaningi bathise ukuthi, nakuba leli yingxenye yentambo yendlovukazi encane, lesi sampula ibonisa izinwele zendlovukazi elindala, hhayi izinwele ezincane zendlovukazi encane.

translations.source: A car bomb detonated at police headquarters in Gaziantep, Turkey yesterday morning killed two police officers and injured more than twenty other people.
translations.reference: Ibhomu esemotweni eqhume esikhungweni samaphoyisa eGaziantep, eTheki izolo ekuseni ibulale amaphoyisa amabili futhi yalimaza abantu abanye abangaphezu kweshumi nambili.
translations.hypothesis: Iphunga lezimoto elilodwa luhlaziywe esikhumulweni samaphoyisa e-Gaziantep, eTurkey, kusihlwa ngaphambi kukaMsombuluko, futhi lokhu kubambe iqembu labaphoyisa ababili kanye nalabo abangaphezu kweshumi nambili abalambile.

translations.source: The governor's office said nineteen of the injured were police officers.
translations.reference: Ihhovisi lombusi lithe abayishumi nesishiyagalolunye babengamaphoyisa.
translations.hypothesis: Ihhovisi likaGuvernari lithe kubalwa abathintekayo, kunama-nineteen abayiphulisi.

translations.source: Police said they suspect an alleged Daesh (ISIL) militant of responsibility for the attack.
translations.reference: Amaphoyisa athi asola osolwa ngokuba isosha leDaesh (ISIL) elinesikhundla ngenxa yalokhu kuhlasela.
translations.hypothesis: Amapholisa bathi banokuthi umuntu ongumholi weqembu elithi Daesh (ISIL) kungenzeka ukuthi yena owayeyilunga leqembu labo, ubhekene nendima yokuhlaselwa.

translations.source: They found the Sun operated on the same basic principles as other stars: The activity of all stars in the system was found to be driven by their luminosity, their rotation, and nothing else.
translations.reference: Bathole ukuthi ilanga lisebenza ngezimiso eziyisisekelo njengezinye izinkanyezi: umsebenzi wezinkanyezi zonke ohlelweni kutholakale ukuthi uqondiswa ukukhanya kwazo, ukuphenduka kwazo, futhi hhayi okunye.
translations.hypothesis: Bafunde ukuthi i-Sun iyasebenza ngemithetho eyisisekelo efanayo neyezinkanyezi eziningi: Kwakutholakale ukuthi ukusebenza kwayo yonke inkanyezi kuleli sistema kuhlanganiswe ukukhanya kwayo, ukujikeleza kwayo, futhi akukho okunye ngaphandle kwalokho.

translations.source: The luminosity and rotation are used together to determine a star's Rossby number, which is related to plasma flow.
translations.reference: Ukukhanya nokuphenduka kusetshenziswa ndawonye ukuthola inombolo yeRossby yenkanyezi, ehlobene nokugeleza kwe-plasma.
translations.hypothesis: Ukukhanya kanye nokujikeleza kuzosetshenziswa ndawonye ukuze kutholwe inombolo ka-Rossby yinkanyezi, okuyinto ehlobene nokuhamba kwegesi elisha (plasma).

translations.source: The smaller the Rossby number, the less active the star with respect to magnetic reversals.
translations.reference: Uma i-Rossby inenombolo encane, inkanyezi ayibi namandla ngokuphathelene nokuhlehla kazibuthe.
translations.hypothesis: Ngenani eliphansi le-Rossby, umsebenzi wenyanga kakhulu ngokuphathelene nokuguquka kwemagneti uyoba mncane.

translations.source: During his trip, Iwasaki ran into trouble on many occasions.
translations.reference: Phakathi naloluhambo, u-Iwasaki wahlangabezana nezinkinga kaningi.
translations.hypothesis: Ngalesi nhlango wakhe, u-Iwasaki ubhekane nezinkinga eziningi kakhulu.

translations.source: He was robbed by pirates, attacked in Tibet by a rabid dog, escaped marriage in Nepal and was arrested in India.
translations.reference: Ubanjwe inkunzi yizigcwelegcwele zasolwandle, wahlaselwa yinja enesifo sobuhlanya e-Tibet, wabalekela umshado e-Nepal bese waboshwa eNdiya.
translations.hypothesis: Ubelwa ngabantu abayizigebengu olwandle, ugatshwe nginja ebilambile eTibet, uphunyisile ukushadikwa eNepal, futhi wagxekwa ngaphambili ngaphakathi e-India.

translations.source: The 802.11n standard operates on both the 2.4Ghz and 5.0Ghz frequencies.
translations.reference: Isimiso se-802.11n sisebenza kuwo womabili amafrikhwensi angu-2.4Ghz no-5.0Ghz.
translations.hypothesis: Istandarda ye-802.11n isebenza kokubili kwi-frequency ye-2.4Ghz kanye ne-5.0Ghz.

translations.source: This will allow it to be backwards compatible with 802.11a, 802.11b and 802.11g, provided that the base station has dual radios.
translations.reference: Lokhu kuzoyivumela ukuthi ihambisane nezinhlelo zakudala ze-802.11a, i-802.11b kanye ne-802.11g, uma nje isikhungo sesiteshi sinemisakazo emibili.
translations.hypothesis: Lokhu kuzovumela ukuthi isebenzisane nezinhlelo ezindala ezifana ne-802.11a, i-802.11b kanye ne-802.11g, uma isiteshi esiyisiqalo sinezindlela zokuxhumana ezimbili.

translations.source: The speeds of 802.11n are substantially faster than that of its predecessors with a maximum theoretical throughput of 600Mbit/s.
translations.reference: Ijubane lika-802.11n liphezulu kakhulu kunelangaphambili elaligcina ejubaneni elingu-600Mbit/s.
translations.hypothesis: Amagugu e-802.11n aphezulu kakhulu kunezamodeli ezedlule, ngamakhulu angu-600Mbit/s njengomkhakha omkhulu ongatholakala ngokutheoretiki.

translations.source: Duvall, who is married with two adult children, did not leave a big impression on Miller, to whom the story was related.
translations.reference: UDuvall, oshadile nonezingane ezimbili ezindalaa, akazange ahlabe u-Miller umxhwele, lowo otshelwe indaba.
translations.hypothesis: UDuvall, oshadile futhi unemizwa emibili emakhulu, akazange angene kakhulu enhliziyweni kaMiller, okubalulekile ukuthi le ndaba yayikhulunywa kuye.

translations.source: When asked for comment, Miller said, "Mike talks a lot during the hearing...I was getting ready so I wasn't really hearing what he was saying."
translations.reference: Lapho ecelwa ukuthi aphawule, u-Miller uthe, “U-Mike ukhuluma kakhulu phakathi nokuthethwa kwecala...bengizilungiselela ngakho angikuzwanga ayekusho.”
translations.hypothesis: Ngesikhathi ebuzwa ngalokhu, uMiller uthe, "UMike uthetha kakhulu ngesikhathi komhlangano...Ngiqale ukulungiselela, ngakho ngangingizwa kahle ukuthi uthi ini."

translations.source: "We will endeavour to cut carbon dioxide emissions per unit of GDP by a notable margin by 2020 from the 2005 level," Hu said.
translations.reference: Sizophumelela ukunciphisa inani lomoya ongcolile ngesikali se-GDP ngezinga eliphawulekayo ngo-2020 ukusuka esilinganisweni sango-2005, kusho u-Hu.
translations.hypothesis: "Sizama ukunciphisa ukukhishwa kwe-carbon dioxide ngamanye amayunitsi e-GDP ngobubanzi obukhulu ngokuqeda kuka-2020, uma kuqhathaniswa nezinga lama-2005," kusho uHu.

translations.source: He did not set a figure for the cuts, saying they will be made based on China's economic output.
translations.reference: Akazange abeke izibalo zokuncishiswa, ethi zizokwenziwa ngokomphumela womnotho waseShayina.
translations.hypothesis: Akazange anikeze inombolo mayelana nokunciphiswa, wathi ukunciphiswa kuzokwenziwa ngokuya ngempumelelo yezezomnotho yaseChina.

translations.source: Hu encouraged developing countries "to avoid the old path of polluting first and cleaning up later."
translations.reference: UHu ukhuthaze amazwe athuthukayo "ukugwema indlela yakudala yokugcolisa kuqala bese uhlanza kamuva."
translations.hypothesis: U-Hu ukhuthaze izifunda ezithuthukayo "ukuthi zigweme indlela endala yokudala ukungcola kuqala bese zizama ukulilungisa ngemuva."

translations.source: He added that "they should not, however, be asked to take on obligations that go beyond their development stage, responsibility and capabilities."
translations.reference: Wanezela ukuthi “akumelwe, nokho, bacelwe bathathe ukuzibophezela okungaphezu kwesigaba sabo sentuthuko, imithwalo yemfanelo kanye namakhono.”
translations.hypothesis: Uthe, "kodwa-ke, akufanele kubuzwe ukuthi bayithathe imithwalo engaphezu kakhulu kuleli zikhathi zokukhula, umthwalo wabo kanye namakhono abo."

translations.source: The Iraq Study Group presented its report at 12.00 GMT today.
translations.reference: IQembu Locwaningo lase-Iraq lethule umbiko walo ngo-12,00 GMT namuhla.
translations.hypothesis: Iqembu elithi "Iraq Study Group" selithumele umbiko wayo namuhla ngomhlaka-12:00 ngesikhathi saseGreenwich.

translations.source: It warns No one can guarantee that any course of action in Iraq at this point will stop sectarian warfare, growing violence, or a slide toward chaos.
translations.reference: Iyaxwayisa Akekho ongaqinisekisa ukuthi nanoma iyiphi inkambo e-Iraq okwamanje izoqeda impi yamahlelo, ubudlova obukhulayo, noma ukuthambekela ebuxakalaleni.
translations.hypothesis: Kuyazisa ukuthi akukho muntu ongahluleka ukuthi noma yiluphi uhlelo lokusebenza e-Iraq ngaleso sikhathi kuzoqinisa ukuthi kuzoqweda ukulwa phakathi kwezizinda, ukukhuliswa kobufakazi, noma ukuthi kuzoqinisa ukuthi kuzoqweda ukungqubuzana.

translations.source: The Report opens with plea for open debate and the formation of a consensus in the United States about the policy towards the Middle East.
translations.reference: UMbiko uvula ngesicelo senkulumo-mpikiswano evulekile kanye nokwenziwa kokuvumelana eMelika ngesimiso saseNingizimu ePhakathi.
translations.hypothesis: Lolu hlelo luyiqala ngokucela ukuthi kube nombuzo ovulekile kanye nokwakhiwa kwengxenye yokubambisana e-United States mayelana nenqubomgomo eya eMpumalanga Ephakathi.

translations.source: The Report is highly critical of almost every aspect of the present policy of the Executive towards Iraq and it urges an immediate change of direction.
translations.reference: Umbiko ugxeka kakhulu cishe zonke izici zesimiso samanje sesiGungu sase-Iraq futhi ucela ukuba kube noshintsho olusheshayo lwenkambo.
translations.hypothesis: Lolu hlelo lixwayisa kakhulu cishe kuzo zonke izici zenqubomgomo yamanje yombusho mayelana ne-Iraq, futhi lukhuthaza ukuguqulwa okusheshayo kwendlela.

translations.source: First among its 78 recommendations is that a new diplomatic initiative should be taken before the end of this year to secure Iraq’s borders against hostile interventions and to re-establish diplomatic relations with its neighbors.
translations.reference: Okokuqala phakathi kokutusa kwayo okungu-78 ukuthi isinyathelo sokuxhumana kumelwe sithathe ngaphambi kokuphela kwalonyaka ukuvikela imingcele yase-Iraq ekungeneleni konya kanye nasekumiseni kabusha ubuhlobo bokuxhumana nomakhelwane bayo.
translations.hypothesis: Phakathi kwezincomo zayo ezingu-78, okokuqala ukuthi kufanele kuthathwe umzamo omusha wezindaba zangaphandle ngaphambi kokuphothulwa kwalo nyanga ukuze kuvikeleke imingeni yase-Iraq ekuhlaselweni, futhi ukuvuselelwa ubudlelwano bezindaba zangaphandle nezilimi zwayo eziseduze.

translations.source: Current senator and Argentine First Lady Cristina Fernandez de Kirchner announced her presidential candidacy yesterday evening in La Plata, a city 50 kilometers (31 miles) away from Buenos Aires.
translations.reference: Ilungu lesigele lamanje kanye noNkosikazi kaMongameli wase-Argentina uCristina Fernandez de Kirchner umemezele ukungenela kwakhe ukhetho lokuba umongameli izolo ntambama eLa Plata, idolobha elingamakhilomitha angu-50 (amamayela angu-31) kusuka eBuenos Aires.
translations.hypothesis: UMhlali wamanje weSenate kanye nomfazi kaMongameli wase-Argentina, uCristina Fernandez de Kirchner, uthembise ukuthi uzophikisela kwiwokhasana lokuphathwa kwezwe ngomhlakulo wesonto ebusuku eLa Plata, idolobha elinamakhilomitha angu-50 (amayimitha angu-31) ukusuka eBuenos Aires.

translations.source: Mrs. Kirchner announced her intention to run for president at the Argentine Theatre, the same location she used to start her 2005 campaign for the Senate as member of the Buenos Aires province delegation.
translations.reference: UNkk. Kirchner umemezelo inhloso yakhe yokukhankasela ukuba umongameli eThiyetheni yase-Argentina, indawo efanayo ayisebenzisele ukuqala umkhankaso wakhe wokuba ilunga leSigele njengelunga lamanxusa esifunda sase-Buenos Aires.
translations.hypothesis: UNksz. Kirchner uthe wazisa ukuthi uzophinde azama ukuba ngumongameli, kulo ndawo edume ngokuthi i-Argentine Theatre, eyona ndawo ayayisebenzisa ngaphambilini xa eqala umkhankaso wakhe ka-2005 ukuze athole isikhundla senhlalakahle eSenate, njengelungu lephini lephrovinsi yaseBuenos Aires.

translations.source: The debate was sparked by controversy over spending on relief and reconstruction in the wake Hurricane Katrina; which some fiscal conservatives have humorously labeled "Bush's New Orleans Deal."
translations.reference: Inkulumo-mpikiswano idalwe ukuphikisana ngokuchitha imali eningi yokusiza kanye nokwakha kabusha ngemva kokudlula kweSiphepho iKatrina; leyo abesikhwama sezwe abadla ngoludala abayibize sakudlala ngokuthi "Bush's New Orleans Deal."
translations.hypothesis: Ingxoxo iqale ngenxa yengxabano mayelana nokusetshenziswa kwemali yokunciphisa umthelela kanye nokulungiswa ngemuva kwephunga i-Hurricane Katrina; okuthi abanye abagxile ekulawulweni kwezimali bayibiza ngendlela ejabulisayo njenge-"Isivumelwano sika-Bush e-New Orleans."

translations.source: Liberal criticism of the reconstruction effort has focused on the awarding of reconstruction contracts to perceived Washington insiders.
translations.reference: Ukugxekwa okukhulu komzamo wokwakha kabusha kugxile ekuklomeliseni ukuvuselelwa kwezinkontileka ukuze baqonde ezangaphakathi zase-Washington.
translations.hypothesis: Ukugxambukiswa kwezombangazwe mayelana nomzamo wokulungiswa kule ndawo kuhlanganise ngokukhethekile ukuthi izinkontileka zokulungiswa ziyanikezwa kubantu ababonakala njengabaphakathi ezindabeni zaseWashington.

translations.source: Over four million people went to Rome to attend the funeral.
translations.reference: Abantu abangaphezu kwezigidi ezine baya eRoma enkonzweni yomngcwabo eRoma.
translations.hypothesis: Abantu abangaphezu kwezigidi ezine bahambile eRoma ukuze babambelele emkhosini.

translations.source: The number of people present was so large that it was not possible for everybody to gain access to the funeral in St. Peter's Square.
translations.reference: Inani labantu ababekhona lalilikhulu kangangokuba kwakungenzeki ukuba wonke umuntu angene enkonzweni yomngcwabo eSt. Peter's Square.
translations.hypothesis: Inani labantu ababikhona belinamandla kangaka ukuthi kwakungenzeki ukuthi wonke umuntu angene kumkhosi wokugqudulela owayenziwe eSt. Peter's Square.

translations.source: Several large television screens were installed in various places in Rome to let the people watch the ceremony.
translations.reference: Izikrini ezinkulu eziningana zethelevishini zifakiwe ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene eRoma ukwenzela ukuthi abantu babukele umcimbi.
translations.hypothesis: Izikrini ezinkulu eziningi zifakwe ezindaweni ezahlukene eRoma ukuze abantu bakwazi ukubuka umcimbi.

translations.source: In many other cities of Italy and in the rest of the world, particularly in Poland, similar setups were made, which were viewed by a great number of people.
translations.reference: Kwamanye amazwe amaningi waseNtaliyane nasemhlabeni wonke, ngokukhethekile ePoland, ukumiswa okufanayo kwenziwe, okubukwe abantu abaningi kakhulu.
translations.hypothesis: Kwamanye amadolobha amaningi e-Italy kanye nasezilangeni zesikhathi, ikakhulukazi ePoland, kwakwenziwa izinto ezifanayo, ezibukekwe ngabantu abaningi.

translations.source: Historians have criticized past FBI policies for focusing resources on cases which are easy to solve, especially stolen car cases, with the intent of boosting the agency's success rate.
translations.reference: Abezomlando bagxeke imithetho edlule yeFBI ngokugxila emacaleni alula ukuwaxazulula, ikakhulukazi amacala okuntshontshwa kwezimoto, ngenjongo yokukhuphula izinga lokuphumelela le nkampani.
translations.hypothesis: Abafundi bomlando bahlele ukuthi izinqubomgomo zangaphambilini ze-FBI zibekezele izinsiza ezimbalwa ezamaconsini alula ukuxazululwa, ikakhulukazi amaconsi ezimoto eziboliwe, ngomqondo wokukhuthaza impumelelo yalesi nhlangano.

translations.source: Congress began funding the obscenity initiative in fiscal 2005 and specified that the FBI must devote 10 agents to adult pornography.
translations.reference: Ukhongolose waqala ukuxhasa ngezimali uhlelo olungamanyala ngesikhwama sezwe ngo-2005 futhi wachaza ukuthi i-FBI kumelwe inikele ngezisebenzi ezingu-10 ezithombeni ezingcolile zabantu abadala.
translations.hypothesis: UGomende waqala ukuxhasa uhlelo lokulwa nobucayi kuyo yonke imikhakha ngonyaka ka-2005, futhi wanquma ukuthi i-FBI kufanele ahlinzeke ngabameli abayi-10 abazogxilisa emikhakheni yobucayi obukhulu.

translations.source: Robin Uthappa made the innings highest score, 70 runs in just 41 balls by hitting 11 fours and 2 sixes.
translations.reference: U-Robin Uthappa wenze amaphuzu aphezulu kwi-innings, ama-runs angu-70 emabholeni angu-41 kuphela eshaya o-four abangu-11 kanye no-six abangu-2.
translations.hypothesis: URobin Uthappa ugcine umdlalo ngamanani amakhulu, wamukela amaphuzu angama-70 ngamabhola angama-41, wamukile amabhola ayi-11 futhi wamukele amabhola ayi-2.

translations.source: Middle order batsmen, Sachin Tendulkar and Rahul Dravid, performed well and made a hundred-run partnership.
translations.reference: Amadoda ashayayo adlalela phakathi, u-Sachin Tendulkar no-Rahul Dravid, bedlale kahle futhi benza umsebenzisano wokugijima ka-100.
translations.hypothesis: Abadlali ababeziceli phakathi, uSachin Tendulkar noRahul Dravid, badlale kahle futhi baqhuba umdlalo ngokubambisana, befinyelela ezingeni lezimpawa ezingu-100.

translations.source: But, after losing the captain's wicket India only made 36 runs loosing 7 wickets to end the innings.
translations.reference: Kodwa, ngemva kokuba kukhiswhe ukaputeni wayo, iNdiya yenze amaphuzu angu-36 kuphela ilahlekelwa amawikhethi angu-7 kuze kube sekugcineni kwengxenye yomdlalo.
translations.hypothesis: Kodwa, ngemuva kokulahlekelwa ngomdlalo kaqaptini, i-India iphumele ngamaphuzu angama-36 kuphela, ilahlekelwe ngamawiki ayisikhombisa, ngaleyo ndlela iphela umdlalo.

translations.source: U.S. President George W. Bush arrived in Singapore the morning of November 16, beginning a week-long tour of Asia.
translations.reference: UMongameli waseMelika uGeorge W. Bush wafika eSingapore ekuseni ngoLwezi 16, eqalisa uhambo lwakhe lweviki lokuvakashela i-Asia.
translations.hypothesis: UMongameli wase-United States, uGeorge W. Bush, ufike eSingapore ekuseni ngomhlaka zayo-16 kaNovemba, waqala uhambo lwamahhashi ayisikhathi esisodwa e-Asia.

translations.source: He was greeted by Singapore's Deputy Prime Minister Wong Kan Seng and discussed trade and terrorism issues with the Singapore Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong.
translations.reference: Wabingelelwa yiPhini likaNdunankulu wase-Singapore u-Wong Kan Seng futhi baxoxa ngezohwebo kanye nezokuvakasha noNdunankulu waseSingapore uLee Hsien Loong.
translations.hypothesis: Ubuye wahlomiswa nguMongameli osegamatweni waseSingapore, uWong Kan Seng, futhi waxoxa ngamagugu kanye nezinkinga zobhubhane nomongameli waseSingapore, uLee Hsien Loong.

translations.source: After a week of losses in the midterm election, Bush told an audience about the expansion of trade in Asia.
translations.reference: Ngemva kweviki lokulahlekelwa okhethweni lwaphakathi nesikhathi, uBush watshela izilaleli ngokukhulisa kokuhwebelana e-Asia.
translations.hypothesis: Ngemuva kwesonto elilodwa lokunqoba kwezinhlelo zombusho ezisemaphakathi, uBush uthe uxoxa nabafundi mayelana nokwandiswa kwezohwebo e-Asia.

translations.source: Prime Minister Stephen Harper has agreed to send the government's 'Clean Air Act' to an all-party committee for review, before its second reading, after Tuesday's 25 minute meeting with NDP leader Jack Layton at the PMO.
translations.reference: UNdunankulu uStephen Harper uvumile ukuthumela uhulumeni 'Umthetho woMoya Ohlanzekile' ukuba uhlolwe ikomiti lamaqembu onke, ngaphambi kokuba ufundwe okwesibili, ngemva komhlangano wangoLwesibili wemizuzu engu-25 nomhloli weNDP uJack Layton kuyi-PMO.
translations.hypothesis: UMphathisa-Jikelele uStephen Harper uyavuma ukuthi uhulumeni uyothumela umthetho walo othi 'Umthetho Womoya Ocwebile' kumininingwane yamaqembu amaningi ukuze uhlolwe, ngaphambi kokufundwa kwakhe kabusha, ngemuva komhlangano wokumane amaminithi angu-25 owawunomholi we-NDP uJack Layton kwiHhovisi likaMphathisa-Jikelele ngoLwesibili.

translations.source: Layton had asked for changes to the conservatives' environmental bill during the meeting with the PM, asking for a "thorough and complete rewriting" of the Conservative party's environmental bill.
translations.reference: U-Layton ucele kube nezinguquko kumthethosivivinywa wezemvelo we-conservatives ngesikhathi somhlangano nama-PM, ecela kube “nokubhalwa kabusha okuphelele” komthethosivivinywa wezemvelo weqembu le-Conservative.
translations.hypothesis: ULayton ucele ukuthi kwenziwe izinguquko kuleli బిల్li elihlobene nemvelo eliholwa ngama-conservative ngesikhathi somhlangano nomphathi wezwe, efuna "ukubuyekezwa okuphelele nokuguqulelwa kabusha" kuleli బిల్li leli.

translations.source: Ever since the Federal Government stepped in to take over funding of the Mersey hospital in Devonport, Tasmania, the state government and some federal MPs have criticised this act as a stunt in the prelude to the federal election to be called by November.
translations.reference: Kusukela ngesikhathi Uhulumeni Wenhlangano Yamazwe ungenela ekuphatheni uxhaso lwesibhedlela i-Mersey eDevonport, eTasmania, uhulumeni wezwe kanye namanye amalungu kahulumeni wenhlangano yamazwe asola lesi senzo njengesandulela sokhetho lukahulumeni oluzokwenziwa ngoLwezi.
translations.hypothesis: Kusukela ngaleso sikhathi uhulumeni kazwelonke wandlala indima wokunakekela ukuxhaswa kwezimali zesibhedlela i-Mersey e-Devonport, eTasmania, uhulumeni wendawo kanye nalamaPhini ePhalamende kazwelonke abambiqelele ngalokhu, bathi kuyindlela yokuzama ukuthola ukunambitheka ngaphambi kokhelelwa kwekhefu lephalamende elizobanjwa ngoNovemba.

translations.source: But Prime Minister John Howard has said the act was only to safeguard the facilities of the hospital from being downgraded by the Tasmanian government, in giving an extra AUD$45 million.
translations.reference: Kodwa uNdunankulu uJohn Howard uthe umthetho kwakungowokulondoloza izakhiwo zesibhedlela ukuba zingabekwa ezingeni eliphansi uhulumani waseTasmania, ngokunikeza izigidi ezingu-AUD$45.
translations.hypothesis: Kodwa uNdabezinyosi John Howard uthe lo mthetho ufake njalo ukuvikelwa kwezikhungo zalesi sikhungo sezokwelapha ukuthi zingalenziswa ngendlela engcono kakhulu yi-Tasmanian government, ngaphandle kokwengeza imali eyengeziwe engu-AUD$45 million.

translations.source: According to the latest bulletin, sea level readings indicated a tsunami was generated. There was some definite tsunami activity recorded near Pago Pago and Niue.
translations.reference: Ngokwencwajana yezindaba yakamuva, amazinga omthamo olwandle aveze ukuthi i-tsunami yenzekile. Bekune-tsunami ebekhona erekhodwe eduze nePago Pago kanye neNiue.
translations.hypothesis: Ngokubonsela ukubika yakamuva, ukufundwa kwezinga lamanzi kubonise ukuthi ukukhukhuleka kwamanzi okukhulu (tsunami) kuye kwadalwa. Kukhona ukuboniswa kokukhukhuleka kwamanzi okukhulu eduze kwe-Pago Pago kanye ne-Niue.

translations.source: No major damage or injuries have been reported in Tonga, but power was temporarily lost, which reportedly prevented Tongan authorities from receiving the tsunami warning issued by the PTWC.
translations.reference: Awukho umonakalo omkhulu noma ukulimala okubikiwe eTonga, kodwa ugesi ubungekho okwesikhashana, lokho okubikwa ukuthi kuvimebele iziphathimandla zaseTonga ekutholeni isexwayiso setsunami esikhishwe iPTWC.
translations.hypothesis: Akukho umonakalo omkhulu noma izilonda ezibikwe e-Tonga, kodwa ukunikeza kwamandla kuye kwaphazamiseka okwesikhashana, okuthi kubikwa ukuthi kwavimaza amaphakhethi ezikhungo zamaPhondo e-Tonga ukuthi athole isaziso seluhlu olunzulu esikhishwe yi-PTWC.

translations.source: Fourteen schools in Hawaii located on or near coastlines were closed all of Wednesday despite the warnings being lifted.
translations.reference: Izikole eziyishumi nanye eHawaii ezisendaweni noma eziseduze nogu bezivaliwe ngoLwesithathu wonke nangaphezu kokususwa kwesixwayiso.
translations.hypothesis: Izikole ezine-14 e-Hawaii, ezitholakala eduze noma ezindaweni ezilawulwa yamanzi, zivaliwe ngaso zonke izinsuku zangoLwesithathu, noma ngaphandle kokuthi izexwayiso zishiwo.

translations.source: U.S. President George W. Bush welcomed the announcement.
translations.reference: Umongameli waseMelika uGeorge W Bush wasamukela isimemezelo.
translations.hypothesis: UMphrezidenti wase-Amerika, uGeorge W. Bush, uyavumelana nokumemezelo.

translations.source: Bush spokesman Gordon Johndroe called North Korea's pledge "a major step towards the goal of achieving the verifiable denuclearization of the Korean peninsula."
translations.reference: Umkhulumeli kaBush uGordon Johndroe ubize isithembiso seNyakatho Korea "ngesinyathelo esiyinhloko emgomweni wokususwa kwezikhali zenuzi okungafakazelwa enhlonhlweni yaseKorea."
translations.hypothesis: Umkhulumeli kaMongameli Bush, uGordon Johndroe, uthe isithembiso saseNorth Korea "ngenye indlela enkulu eya ngqo ekubuyeni kweqiniso lokuthi i-Korean peninsula izophumelela ekwenzeni ukuthi ingabi amayadi."

translations.source: The tenth named storm of the Atlantic Hurricane season, Subtropical Storm Jerry, formed in the Atlantic Ocean today.
translations.reference: Isiphepho seshumi esinikwe igama senkathi yeziPhepho zase-Atlantic, iSiphepho Sendawo Efudumele uJerry, saqala oLwandlekazini i-Atlantic namuhla.
translations.hypothesis: Namuhla, isiphepho esibi esithi "Subtropical Storm Jerry," esiyisiphepho sesikhombisa esibizwe ngegama kulo nyaka wase-Atlantic, sikhule e-Atlantic Ocean.

translations.source: The National Hurricane Center (NHC) says that at this point Jerry poses no threat to land.
translations.reference: INational Hurricane Center (NHC) ithi kulenkathi uJerry ingaba nosongo ezweni.
translations.hypothesis: I-National Hurricane Center (NHC) ithi, ngaleso sikhathi, uJerry awenzi noma yiluphi usongo ezindaweni ezomile.

translations.source: The U.S. Corps of Engineers estimated that 6 inches of rainfall could breach the previously damaged levees.
translations.reference: I-U.S. Corps of Engineers lilinganise ukuthi ukuna kwemvula engama-intshi angu-6 angafohla uhide lwezindundumela ezimoshekile esikhathini esidlule.
translations.hypothesis: Uhlelo lwezokwakha lase-United States lubalwe ukuthi imvula engamamitha ayisithupha ingadala ukuthi izindonga zokuvikela ezilokhu zonakekile ziphuleke.

translations.source: The Ninth Ward, which saw flooding as high as 20 feet during Hurricane Katrina, is currently in waist-high water as the nearby levee was overtopped.
translations.reference: I-Ninth Ward, elabonakala likhukhuleka ngamagxathu angu-20 phakathi Nesiphepho uKatrina, okwamanje linamanzi asokhalweni njengoba amanzi elweqe ngaphezulu udonga lokuvimba amanzi oluseduze.
translations.hypothesis: I-Ninth Ward, eyayibonakala ngobubi ngesikhathi se-Hurricane Katrina, lapho amanzi ayefinyelela kumamitha ayi-6 (amaphuzu ayi-20) ubude, manje inamanzi afinyelela kumalungwini wabantu ngenxa yokuthi umphongolo osezulwini edolobheni oluseduze ugcwetshwe.

translations.source: Water is spilling over the levee in a section 100 feet wide.
translations.reference: Amanzi ayachitheka ngaphezu kohide lwezindundumela engxenyeni engamafidi angu-100 ububanzi.
translations.hypothesis: Manzi igcwele futhi iyaphuma ngaphandle kwephahla elilindele ukugcina amanzi, endaweni elibanzi engamamitha ayi-100.

translations.source: Commons Administrator Adam Cuerden expressed his frustration over the deletions when he spoke to Wikinews last month.
translations.reference: Umqondisi weCommons u-Adam Cuerden uzwakalise ukukhungatheka kwakhe ngokusulwa ngemva kokukhuluma ne-Wikinews ngenyanga edlule.
translations.hypothesis: Umphathi we-Commons, u-Adam Cuerden, uveze ukuthi ukhungathekile ngokuphumulwa kweminye imininingwane ngesikhathi ekhuluma no-Wikinews ngenyanga edlule.

translations.source: "He [Wales] basically lied to us from the start. First, by acting as if this was for legal reasons. Second, by pretending he was listening to us, right up to his art deletion."
translations.reference: "Yena [uWales] ngokuyisisekelo ukhulume amanga kusuka ekuqaleni. Okokuqala, ngokushaya sengathi lokhu bekungenxa yezizathu ezingokomthetho. Okwesibili, ngokuzishaya sengathi wayesilalele, kuze kube sekususweni kobuciko bakhe."
translations.hypothesis: "U-Wales usikhuniwa kusukela ekuqaleni. Okokuqala, ngokuphimisela ukuthi lokhu kwenziwa ngenxa yezimo zomthetho. Okwesibili, ngokufeza sengathi uyazwa okusho kithi, kuze kube sekuphelelwa ngomculo wakhe."

translations.source: The community irritation led to current efforts to draft a policy regarding sexual content for the site which hosts millions of openly-licensed media.
translations.reference: Ukudineka komphakathi kwaholela emzamweni wamanje wokubhala umthetho ophathelene nezindaba zobulli ezingosini ezihlinzeka izinkulungwane ngezindaba ezigunyaziwe ezisemthethweni.
translations.hypothesis: Ukukhungatheka kwabantu kukhuthaze imizamo yamanje yokuhlela inqubomgomo mayelana nokuqukethwe okuhlobene nezokuxhumana, ngoba lesi site ligcina izimpahla zokusetshenziswa eziningi ezivunyelwe ukusetshenziswa ngokukhululekile.

translations.source: The work done was mostly theoretical, but the program was written to simulate observations made of the Sagittarius galaxy.
translations.reference: Umsebenzi owenziwe bekungowomcabango kakhulu, kodwa uhlelo lubhalelwe ukulingisa okubonwe emthaleni weSagittarius.
translations.hypothesis: Umsebenzi owenziwe wawubukhulu kakhulu obucatshangwa, kodwa uhlelo lwakhiwe ukuze lungenza ukulinganisa okubonwe mayelana negalaksi i-Sagittarius.

translations.source: The effect the team was looking for would be caused by tidal forces between the galaxy's dark matter and the Milky Way's dark matter.
translations.reference: Umphumela iqembu ebeliwulindele ubuzobangelwa amandla adonsayo phakathi kwesigaxa esimnyama somthala nesigaxa esimnyama somthala i-Milky way.
translations.hypothesis: Umphumela ohlosiwe yiqembu wawuqhamuka kwamandla ezinkimbinkimbi phakathi kokudakile komhlaba wonke kanye nodakile lwe-Milky Way.

translations.source: Just like the moon exerts a pull on the earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a force on the Sagittarius galaxy.
translations.reference: Njengoba inyanga idonsa umhlaba, ibangele amagagasi olwandle, kanjalo neMilky Way idonsa umthala weSagittarius.
translations.hypothesis: Njengoba iqhwa ihlasele umhlaba, okubangela ukuguquka kwamanzi, ngaleyo ndlela i-Milky Way ihlasele i-galaxy yase-Sagittarius.

translations.source: The scientists were able to conclude that the dark matter affect other dark matter in the same way regular matter does.
translations.reference: Ososayensi bakwazile ukuphetha ngokuthi izigaxa ezimnyama zithinta ezinye izigaxa ezimnyama ngendlela izigaxa ezijwayelekile ezenza ngayo.
translations.hypothesis: Abasayensi bakwazi ukuthi umthombo ongamakhthizi uyathinta eminye imithombo engamakhthizi ngendlela efanayo naleyo emithombo evamile.

translations.source: This theory says that most dark matter around a galaxy is located around a galaxy in a kind of halo, and is made of lots of small particles.
translations.reference: Isichasiselo sithi okumnyama okuzungeze umthala kuzungeze umthala njengendingilizi yokukhanya yohlobo oluthile, futhi kwenziwe ngezinto ezincane eziningi.
translations.hypothesis: Lo mbiko uthi okuningi kwempahla emnyama edolobhaneni kutholakala eduze kwalelo dolobha, ngendlela efana nombhede, futhi kwenziwe ngamathuba amancane amaningi.

translations.source: Television reports show white smoke coming from the plant.
translations.reference: Imibiko kamabonakude ibonisa intuthu emhlophe iphuma esitshalweni.
translations.hypothesis: Izindaba ethelevishini zibonisa uthuli omhlophe oluvela efasiteleni.

translations.source: Local authorities are warning residents in the vicinity of the plant to stay indoors, turn off air-conditioners and not to drink tap water.
translations.reference: Iziphathimandla zasendaweni zixwayisa abahlali abaseduze nendawo yemboni ukuba bahlale ezindlini, bacime izipholisa-moya futhi bangaphuzi amanzi ompompi.
translations.hypothesis: Izikhungo zamahhovisi zasendaweni zixwayisa abahlali abaseduze kuleli fenda ukuthi bahlale ngaphakathi, bavalise amejaji, futhi bangaphuzi amanzi athwetshulwe.

translations.source: According to Japan's nuclear agency, radioactive caesium and iodine has been identified at the plant.
translations.reference: Ngokwenkampani yenuzi yaseJapan, imisebe yenuzi ye-caesium ne-iodine itholakale endaweni yokusebenzela.
translations.hypothesis: Ngokwencazelo yenhlangano yaseJapani yangobuchwepheshe bomtshina, uketshezi we-caesium kanye ne-iodine obukhulu obunzulu kutholwe efasitelini.

translations.source: Authorities speculate that this indicates that containers holding uranium fuel at the site may have ruptured and are leaking.
translations.reference: Iziphathimandla zicabangela ukuthi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi iziqukathi ebeziqukethe amafutha e-uranium endaweni yokusebenzela kungenzeka ukuthi ziqhumile futhi ziyavuza.
translations.hypothesis: Abaphathi bacabanga ukuthi lokhu kubonisa ukuthi amabhodlela agcina ugesi we-uranium endaweni leyo angase abe yaphuka futhi agqoze.

translations.source: Dr. Tony Moll discovered the Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) in the South African region KwaZulu-Natal.
translations.reference: UDkt. Tony Moll wathola i-Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) esifundeni saseNingizimu Afrika KwaZulu-Natal.
translations.hypothesis: UDkt. Tony Moll uthole ukugula okubizwa nge-Extremely Drug Resistant Tuberculosis (XDR-TB) kuleli dolobha laseNingizimu Afrika elithi KwaZulu-Natal.

translations.source: In an interview, he said the new variant was "very highly troubling and alarming because of the very high fatality rate."
translations.reference: Engxoxweni, uthe okuhlukile okusha "kukhathaza kakhulu futhi kuyethusa ngenxa yezinga eliphezulu lokufa kwabantu."
translations.hypothesis: Nengxoxo, uthe le ndlela entsha yalesi sifo "iyakhathaza kakhulu futhi iyandisa ukukhathazeka ngenxa yomlingo omkhulu wokufa."

translations.source: Some patients might have contracted the bug in the hospital, Dr. Moll thinks, and at least two were hospital health workers.
translations.reference: Ezinye iziguli zithole igciwane esibhedlela, kucabanga uDkt. Moll, futhi okungenani ababili bekuyizisebenzi zempilo zasesibhedlela.
translations.hypothesis: Kungenzeka ukuthi amanye amakhasimende agilele ngalesi sifo esibhedlela, kuthi ngokuqinisekile amanye amakhasimende amabili ayizisebenzi zempilo ezasebhedlela.

translations.source: In one year's time, an infected person may infect 10 to 15 close contacts.
translations.reference: Ngesikhathi sonyaka owodwa, umuntu othelelekile angathelela abantu asondelene nabo abangu-10 kuya ku-15.
translations.hypothesis: Kunyaka owodwa, umuntu ogugile angase asabalalise igciwane kubantu abangu-10 kuya ku-15 abaseduze naye.

translations.source: However, the percentage of XDR-TB in the entire group of people with tuberculosis still seems to be low; 6,000 of the total 330,000 people infected at any particular moment in South Africa.
translations.reference: Nokho, iphesenti le-XDR-TB eningini labantu abaphila nesifo sofuba kubukeka siphansi; u-6,000 wabantu abangu-330,000 abathintekayo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi eNingizimu Afrika.
translations.hypothesis: Nokho, iphesenti yale-TB engaphenduki ngisho nezindlela zokwelashwa eziningi (XDR-TB) kulo lonke uhlu lwabantu abagulwe yi-TB, kubukeka isengaphansi; abantu abangu-6,000 ngabantu abangu-330,000 abagulwe ngalesi sifo ngasinye ngesikhathi ngaseNingizimu Afrika.

translations.source: The satellites, both of which weighed in excess of 1,000 pounds, and traveling at approximately 17,500 miles per hour, collided 491 miles above the Earth.
translations.reference: Amasathelayithi, womabili anesisindo esingaphezu  kwamaphawundi angu-1,000, futhi zihamba cishe ngamamayela angu-17,500 ngehora, zishayisene amamayela angu-491 ngaphezu koMhlaba.
translations.hypothesis: Izinkanyezi ezimbili, ezombili ezinelethini elingaphezu kuka-1000 amaphawundi, futhi ezihamba ngejubane elilinganiselwe ku-17,500 imayili ngewashi, zashayisana ngamamitha angu-491 ngaphezu komhlaba.

translations.source: Scientists say the explosion caused by the collision was massive.
translations.reference: Ososayensi bathi ukuqhuma okudalwe ukushayisana kwakukukhulu.
translations.hypothesis: Osazi esikhathini esiyindaba bathi ukuqhuma okubangelwe ukushaywa phansi kwakukhulu kakhulu.

translations.source: They are still trying to determine just how large the crash was and how the Earth will be affected.
translations.reference: Basazama ukuthola ukuthi kube kukhulu kangakanani ukugqubuzana nokuthi uMhlaba uzothinteka kanjani.
translations.hypothesis: Bayazama ukuthola ukuthi umphimbo wawukhulu kangakanani kanye nokuthi umhlaba uzothintwa kanjani ngalokho.

translations.source: The United States Strategic Command of the U.S. Department of Defense office is tracking the debris.
translations.reference: I-United States Strategic Command yehhovisi loMnyango Wezokuvikela e-U.S. ilandelela le mfucumfucu.
translations.hypothesis: Ihhovisi le-United States Strategic Command, elingaphansi kwe-U.S. Department of Defense, liyalandela ukuthi lezi zingxenye ezilahlwe ziya kuphi.

translations.source: The result of plotting analysis will be posted to a public website.
translations.reference: Imiphumela yokuhlaziya udaba izobhalwa kuyiwebhusayithi.
translations.hypothesis: Imiphumela yohlaziyo ezokhishwa zizofakwa kuwebhusayithi yomphakathi.

translations.source: A doctor who worked at Children's Hospital of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania will be charged with aggravated murder after her mother was found dead in the trunk of her car Wednesday, authorities in Ohio say.
translations.reference: Udokotela owayesebenza eSibhedlela seziNgane sasePittsburgh, ePennsylvania uzobekwa icala lokubulala ngesisihluku ngemva kokuba unina etholakale eshonile endaweni yokubeka izimpahla ngemuva kwemoto yakhe ngoLwesithathu, kusho iziphathimandla e-Ohio.
translations.hypothesis: UDokotela ongumsebenzi eSikhumuleni Sabantwana sasePittsburgh, ePennsylvania, uzobhekana neshwa lezobulawa ngokungathathwa kwesiqu, ngemuva kokuthi umama wakhe utholwe edlule kwi-trunk yomoyimoto yakhe ngoLwesithathu, kusho izikhulu zamaphoyisa e-Ohio.

translations.source: Dr. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, was found in Blue Ash, Ohio, a suburb approximately 15 miles north of Cincinnati lying on the ground beside the road in a T-shirt and underwear in an apparently heavily medicated state.
translations.reference: UDkt. Malar Balasubramanian, 29, utholwe eBlue Ash,  e-Ohio, idolobha elicishe libe amamayela angu-15 enyakatho yeCincinnati elele phansi eceleni komgwaqo ngesikibha kanye nezingubo zangaphansi ebonakala sengathi unikwe imithi eminingi yezinhlungu.
translations.hypothesis: UDkt. Malar Balasubramanian, oneminyaka engama-29, utholwe e-Blue Ash, e-Ohio, endaweni edolobhaneni esiseduze kuka-Cincinnati, esingamamayela ayi-15 enyakatho. Wayegcwele phansi eduze nomgwaqo, egqoke i-T-shirt kanye nezingubo zangaphansi, futhi kubonakala sengathi wayenokwelashwa okukhulu ngemithi.

translations.source: She directed officers to her black Oldsmobile Intrigue which was 500 feet away.
translations.reference: Uqondise izikhulu kuyi-Oldsmobile Intrigue yakhe eyayikude ngamafidi angu- 500.
translations.hypothesis: Uthole amaphoyisa ahambe ngqo kuye emoto yakhe emnyama, i-Oldsmobile Intrigue, eyayivaliwe emidlalweni eyikhilomitha engu-0.15 kude.

translations.source: There, they found the body of Saroja Balasubramanian, 53, covered with blood-stained blankets.
translations.reference: Lapho, bathola umzimba kaSaroja Balasubramanian, oneminyaka engu-53, wembozwe ngezingubo zokulala ezinindwe yigazi.
translations.hypothesis: Lapho, bathole umzimba ka-Saroja Balasubramanian, oneminyaka engu-53, egcwele igazi futhi efakwe ngaphansi kwamaphethini agcwele igazi.

translations.source: Police said that the body appeared to have been there for about a day.
translations.reference: Amaphoyisa athe umzimba ububonakala sengathi ubulapho izinsuku eziningi.
translations.hypothesis: Amapholisa uthe umzimba ubonakala ube khona lapho cishe izinsuku ezimbili.

translations.source: The first cases of the disease this season were reported in late July.
translations.reference: Ukuba khona kwesifo kulenkathi kwaqala ukubikwa ekupheleni uNtulikazi.
translations.hypothesis: Izimo zokuqala zalolu bhubhane kulo suku lonyaka zibikwe ngasekupheleni kaJulayi.

translations.source: The disease is carried by pigs, which then migrates to humans through mosquitos.
translations.reference: Lesi sifo sitholakala ezingulubeni, bese sidlulela ebantwini ngominyane.
translations.hypothesis: Lesi sifo idluliswa ngamaphisi, futhi ngemuva kwalokho lidluliswa kubantu ngamathambeka.

translations.source: The outbreak has prompted the Indian government to undertake such measures as deployment of pig catchers in seriously affected areas, distributing thousands of mosquito curtains and spraying pesticides.
translations.reference: Lolu bhubhane lushukumise uhulumeni waseNdiya ukuba athathe izinyathelo ezinjengokuthumela ababamba izingulube ezindaweni ezithinteke kakhulu, ukusakaza izigidi zamakhethini womiyane kanye nokufutha imithi ebulala izinambuzane.
translations.hypothesis: Ukuchoboza okwenzeke kuye kwenza uhulumende wase-India ukuthi athathe izinyathelo ezifana nokuthumela abantu abaqeqeshiwe ukuba bathabathe izinkomo ezikhulile ezindaweni ezithintekile kakhulu, nokunikeza izinkulungwane zamakhethini ezilwa nezinyamazane, kanye nokusika izinto ezibulala izinambuzane.

translations.source: Several million vials of encephalitis vaccine have also been promised by the government, which will help prepare health agencies for next year.
translations.reference: Izigidi ezimbalwa zamabhodlela womjovo wesifo sobuchopho zithenjiswe uhulumeni, azosiza ukulungiselela izinhlangano zezempilo unyaka ozayo.
translations.hypothesis: Amabhodlela ezinkulungwane eziningi zokudweba kwe-encephalitis aseziqokiwe yi-government, okuyinto ezosiza izikhungo zezempilo ukuthi zilungiselele unyaka ozayo.

translations.source: Plans for vaccines to be delivered to the historically most affected areas this year were delayed due to lack of funds and low prioritisation relative to other diseases.
translations.reference: Izinhlelo zemijovo okumelwe ithunyelwe ezindaweni ezithinteke kakhulu ngokomlando kulonyaka zilibazisiwe ngenxa yokungabi nemali nokungathathwa njengokubalulekile uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izifo.
translations.hypothesis: Izinhlelo zokulethwa kwezivini ezindaweni ezazikhathazekile kakhulu ngaphambilini kulo nyaka zibe nokubambezelelwa ngenxa yokuntuleka kwezimali kanye nokuthi lezi zivini azifakwanga phakathi kwezinto ezibalulekile uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izifo.

translations.source: In 1956 Słania moved to Sweden, where three years later he began work for the Swedish Post Office and became their chief engraver.
translations.reference: Ngo-1956 u-Słania wathuthela e-Sweden, lapho iminyaka emithathu kamuva waqala ukusebenzela iHhovisi lePosi lase-Sweden futhi waba umqophi wabo omkhulu.
translations.hypothesis: Ngo-1956, uSłania wathuthela eSweden, lapho eminyakeni emithathu kamuva waqala ukusebenza kwi-Swedish Post Office futhi waba umphathi wayo omkhulu wokudweba.

translations.source: He produced over 1,000 stamps for Sweden and 28 other countries.
translations.reference: Wenzele iSweden izitembu ezingaphezu kuka-1,000 kanye nezingu-28 zamanye amazwe.
translations.hypothesis: Ukwenze izimpahla zeposi eziningi, ezingaphezu kuka-1000, zama-Sweden kanye namanye amazwe angama-28.

translations.source: His work is of such recognized quality and detail that he is one of the very few "household names" among philatelists. Some specialize in collecting his work alone.
translations.reference: Umsebenzi wakhe ungowekhwalithi eyaziwayo nemininingwane kangangokuthi ungelinye “lamagama aziwayo” phakathi kwabafundi bezitembu. Abanye bangochwepheshe bokuqoqa umsebenzi wakhe wodwa.
translations.hypothesis: Umsebenzi wakhe unekhwalithi nemininingwane ezaziwa kakhulu kangangokuthi ungomunye wabafundi bendawo ezimbalwa "abaziwa kakhulu" phakathi kwabalandeli bezimpaphosti. Abanye bagxile ekukhiqizeni kanye nasekukleletheni umsebenzi wakhe kuphela.

translations.source: His 1,000th stamp was the magnificent "Great Deeds by Swedish Kings" by David Klöcker Ehrenstrahl in 2000, which is listed in the Guinness Book of World Records.
translations.reference: Isitembu sakhe se-1,000 “bekuyiZenzo eZinkulu zamaKhosi waseSweden” ezibabazekayo ezenzwe nguDavid Klöcker Ehrenstrahl ngo-2000, esibhalwe ku-Guinness Book of World Record.
translations.hypothesis: I-stamp yakhe eyayiyi-1000 yayiyi-"Great Deeds by Swedish Kings" kaDavid Klöcker Ehrenstrahl, eyayikhukhumi ngonyaka ka-2000, futhi igunyazwe njengefreyimu e-Guinness Book of World Records.

translations.source: He was also engaged in engraving banknotes for many countries, recent examples of his work including the Prime Ministerial portraits on the front of the new Canadian $5 and $100 bills.
translations.reference: Wayetholakele nasekudwebeni imali eyiphepha yamazwe amaningi, izibonelo zakamuva zomsebenzi wakhe zihlanganisa imifanekiso yoNdunankulu phambi kwemali yephepha yaseCanada engu-$5 kanye no-$100.
translations.hypothesis: Ukwenze nanamabhili ezimali eziningi zezizwe ezahlukene, futhi ezincane zalesi sikhathi zifaka izithombe zikaPhini-Mnu, ezitholakala ngaphambili kwamabhili entsha yama-Canadian ayi-$5 kanye negama-$100.

translations.source: After the accident occurred, Gibson was transported to a hospital but died shortly afterwards.
translations.reference: Ngemva kokuba kwenzeke ingozi, uGibson wayiswa esibhedlela kodwa washona ngokushesha ngemva kwalokho.
translations.hypothesis: Ngemuva kokuphathwa kulelisho, uGibson wathuthelwa esibhedlela kodwa wafa ngokushesha ngemuva kwalokho.

translations.source: The truck driver, who is aged 64, was not injured in the crash.
translations.reference: Umshayeli weloli, oneminyaka engu-64, akalimalanga ekunqubuzaneni.
translations.hypothesis: Umshayeli loli, o eneminyaka engu-64, akulimile kulo mngcwembe.

translations.source: The vehicle itself was taken away from the scene of the accident at approximately 1200 GMT on the same day.
translations.reference: Imoto ngokwayo yasuswa endaweni ingozi eyenzeke kuyo cishe ngo-1200 GMT ngosuku olufanayo.
translations.hypothesis: Imoto yasuswa endaweni yengozi cishe ngo-12:00 ngesikhathi sase-GMT ngosuku olufanayo.

translations.source: A person working in a garage near where the accident occurred said: "There were children waiting to cross the road and they were all screaming and crying."
translations.reference: Umuntu osebenza egalaji eduze nalapho okwenzeke khona inhlekelele uthe: "Bekunezingane ezilinde ukuwela umgwaqo futhi zonke bezimemeza futhi zikhala."
translations.hypothesis: Umuntu osebenzela egcekeni eliseduze lapho igoduka lwenziwe khona uthe: "Kwakukhona izingane ezilinde ukudlula umgwaqo, futhi zonke zazikhala futhi zikhala."

translations.source: They all ran back from where the accident had happened.
translations.reference: Bonke bagijima babuyela lapho ingozi yenzeke khona.
translations.hypothesis: Bonke badlule kule ndawo lapho igoduka beliphile khona.

translations.source: Other subjects on the agenda in Bali include saving the world's remaining forests, and sharing technologies to help developing nations grow in less-polluting ways.
translations.reference: Ezinye izindaba okuzoxoxwa ngazo emhlanganweni eBali zihlanganisa ukuvikela amahlathi womhlaba asele, nokwabelana ngezobuchwepheshe ukusiza amazwe athuthukayo ukuba akhule ngezindlela ezingangcolisi kakhulu.
translations.hypothesis: Eminye yamacala ezinkinga ezazikhulunywa eBali kubalwa ukugcina izinkamba zezitshalo ezisele emhlabeni, kanye nokwabelana ngobuchwepheshe obusiza izizwe ezithuthukayo ukuthi zikhule ngendlela engenzi ukungcolile kakhulu.

translations.source: The U.N. also hopes to finalize a fund to help countries affected by global warming to cope with the impacts.
translations.reference: I-U.N ifuna ukuqedela isikhwama sokusiza amazwe athintwe ukufudumala kwembulunga yonke ukuba abhekane namathonya.
translations.hypothesis: I-Nhlangano Yamazwe Angaphansi Kwezokuthuthukiswa (UN) iphinde ithembele ekugcineni ukusungulwa kwefandi ezosiza amazwe agxekeke ukushintsho kwesimo sezulu ukuthi abhekane nemiphumela yalo.

translations.source: The money could go toward flood-proof houses, better water management, and crop diversification.
translations.reference: Imali ingasetshenziselwa izindlu ezingakhukhuleki, indlela yokuphatha amanzi engcono, kanye nezinhlobonhlobo zezitshalo.
translations.hypothesis: Imali ingasetshenziswa ekwakhiweni kwezindlu ezivikelwe yitimba, ekuthuthukisweni kwemikhakha yamanzi, kanye ekuguquleni kwezinhlobo zezitshalo.

translations.source: Fluke wrote that the efforts by some to drown out women from speaking out about women’s health were unsuccessful.
translations.reference: UFluke ubhale ukuthi imizamo yabanye yokuvimba abesifazane ukuthi bakhulume ngempilo yabesifazane ayiphumelelanga.
translations.hypothesis: UFluuke uthe imizamo yothile yokuvimbela abafazi ukuthi bayalukhuluma ngempilo yamafemu ayiphumelele.

translations.source: She came to this conclusion due to the multitude of positive comments and encouragement sent to her by both female and male individuals urging that contraception medication be considered a medical necessity.
translations.reference: Ufike kulesi siphetho ngenxa yokuphawula okuhle okuningi kanye nesikhuthazo athunyelwe sona kokubili abantu ngabanye besifazane kanye nabesilisa becela ukuthi imithi yokuvimbela inzalo ibhekwe njengesidingo sezokwelapha.
translations.hypothesis: Ufike kulolu qiniso ngenxa yobuningi bemibono emihle kanye nokukhuthazwa abantu abahlukahlukene, bobabili abesifazane nababantu, abayichaza ukuthi izindlela zokuqapha ukukhulelwa kufanele kubhekwe njengento ebalulekile kwezokwelapha.

translations.source: When the fighting ceased after the wounded were transported to the hospital, about 40 of the other remaining inmates stayed in the yard and refused to return to their cells.
translations.reference: Lapho ukulwa kuphela ngemva kokuba abalimele bephuthunyiswe esibhedlela, iziboshwa ezicishe zibe ngu-40 ezisele zihlale egcekeni futhi zenqaba ukubuyela ezitokisini zazo.
translations.hypothesis: Ngemuva kokuthi ukulwa kuyekile, ngemuva kokuthuthelwa kwabagulile esibhedlela, cishe abafundi abangama-40 abasele bahlale endaweni yangaphandle futhi banqaba ukubuyela ezindlini zabo.

translations.source: Negotiators tried to rectify the situation, but the prisoners' demands are not clear.
translations.reference: Abaxoxisanayo bazama ukulungisa isimo, kodwa izikhalazo zeziboshwa azicacile.
translations.hypothesis: Abaxoxisi bazama ukulungisa isimo, kodwa izifiso zabagulagwala azicacile.

translations.source: Between 10:00-11:00 pm MDT, a fire was started by the inmates in the yard.
translations.reference: Phakathi kuka-10:00-11:00 pm MDT, umlilo waqalwa iziboshwa egcekeni.
translations.hypothesis: Phakathi noma ngemuva kuka-10:00 no-11:00 ntambama ngesikhathi sase-MDT, umlilo uqale ukushiswa ngabagxwele endaweni yangaphandle.

translations.source: Soon, officers equipped with riot gear entered the yard and cornered the inmates with tear gas.
translations.reference: Ngokushesha, izikhulu ezihlome ngempahla yokuzivikela kwababhikishayo zangena egcekeni zavimbezela iziboshwa ngesisi esikhipha unyembezi.
translations.hypothesis: Kusenesikhathi, amaphoyisa agqugwe izinto zokulwa zangena endaweni futhi wawuqeda abagulwa ngogesi oludabukisa.

translations.source: Fire rescue crews eventually doused the fire by 11:35 pm.
translations.reference: Izisebenzi ezingabacishi bomlilo zacima umlilo ngo-11:35 ebusuku.
translations.hypothesis: Ochwepheshe bamaphoyisa abalwe umlilo ekugcineni bawususa ngomisa ngomisi ngo-11:35 ntambama.

translations.source: After the dam was built in 1963, the seasonal floods that would spread sediment throughout the river were halted.
translations.reference: Ngemva kokuba kwakhiwe idamu ngo-1963, izikhukhula zenkathi ethile yonyaka ezazisabalalisa inzika emfuleni wonke zamiswa.
translations.hypothesis: Ngemuva kokwakhiwa kwendawo yokugcina amanzi ngonyaka ka-1963, ukugeleza kwamanzi okujwayelekile okubanga ukusasazeka kwezinto ezincane ezindaweni eziningi ngaphakathi komfula kwayeka.

translations.source: This sediment was necessary for creating sandbars and beaches, which served as wildlife habitats.
translations.reference: Lenzika beyidingeka ekwenzeni izindunduma zesihlabathi nezingu, ezisebenza njengendawo yokuhlala yezilwane zasendle.
translations.hypothesis: Lo mthombo wamanzi ubalulekile ekwakhiweni kwezintambo zezilwane ezihlala emanzini kanye nezindawo zama-bhishi, okuyinto eyenzelwe ukuba yindawo yokuhlala kwezilwane eziningi.

translations.source: As a result, two fish species have become extinct, and two others have become endangered, including the humpback chub.
translations.reference: Ngenxa yalokho, izinhlobo ezimbili zezinhlanzi zaqothulwa, futhi ezinye ezimbili zibe sengozini, kuhlanganise ne-humpback chub.
translations.hypothesis: Ngenxa yalokho, izinhlobo ezimbili zezilwane zaselwandle zifezwe, kanye nezinye ezimbili ezithintekile, okubalwa phakathi kwayo i-humpback chub.

translations.source: Although the water level will only rise a few feet after the flood, officials are hoping it will be enough to restore eroded sandbars downstream.
translations.reference: Nakuba izinga lamanzi lizokhuphuka kuphela amafidi ambalwa ngemva kwesikhukhula, iziphathimandla zithemba ukuthi lizokwanela ukuvuselela izindunduma zesihlabathi ezigugulekile ezansi nomfula.
translations.hypothesis: Nakuba izinga lamanzi zizokhuphuka nje amamitha ambalwa ngemuva kwegeva, izikhulu zithule ukuthi lokhu kuzanele ukubuyisela izicubu zensimbi ezilimele ezisendaweni ephansi.

translations.source: No tsunami warning has been issued, and according to the Jakarta geophysics agency, no tsunami warning will be issued because the quake did not meet the magnitude 6.5 requirement.
translations.reference: Akukho isixwayiso sesiphepho esikhishiwe, futhi ngokusho kwesikhungo sezemvelo i-Jakarta, asikho isixwayiso sesiphepho esizokhishwa ngoba lokhu kuzamazama komhlaba akufinyelelanga ubukhulu buka-6.5.
translations.hypothesis: Akukho isigrijane selwandle esikhishwe, futhi ngokusho kwezikhungo zochwepheshe zendalo e-Jakarta, akuzonawo amavimbekelo ezilwandle azokhishwa ngoba umbhazo womhlaba awufuni ukufinyelela ububanzi obuyi-6.5.

translations.source: Despite there being no tsunami threat, residents started to panic and began to leave their businesses and homes.
translations.reference: Yize kwakungekho ukusabisa kwe-tsunami, kodwa abahlali baqala baba nokwethuka base beqala beshiya amakhaya abo nama bhizinisi abo.
translations.hypothesis: Nakuba kwakungekho ingozi yentambozi enkulu, abahlali baqala ukukhathazeka futhi baqala ukushiya amabhizinisi abo kanye namakhaya abo.

translations.source: Although Winfrey was tearful in her farewell, she made it clear to her fans she will be back.
translations.reference: Yize uWinfrey wayekhala ngokuvaleliswa kwakhe, wakubeka kwacaca kubalandeli bakhe ukuthi uzobuya.
translations.hypothesis: Nakuba uWinfrey ube nomuzwa wokudida ngesikhathi esigunyazwe, kodwa wacacisa kubalandeli bakhe ukuthi uzobuya.

translations.source: "This is not going to be goodbye. This is the closing of one chapter and the opening of a new one."
translations.reference: “Lokhu angeke kube okokugcina. Lokhu kuwukuvala isihloko esisodwa bese uvula esinye esisha.”
translations.hypothesis: "Lolu hlelo aluyi ukuthi sihlale siphambana. Lena ukuphela kwengxenye eyodwa kanye nokuvulwa kwengxenye entsha."

translations.source: Final results from Namibian presidential and parliamentary elections have indicated that the incumbent president, Hifikepunye Pohamba, has been reelected by a large margin.
translations.reference: Imiphumela yokugcina yokhetho lukamongameli kanye nephalamende lase-Namibia ibonisa ukuthi umongameli obesesihlalweni, uHifikepunye Pohamba, ukhishwe ngendlela ephawulekayo.
translations.hypothesis: Imiphumela yokugcina ezivotiwe kwiwokwahlukano lwezikhulu kanye nephalamende eNamibiya ibonise ukuthi umphrezidenti okhona, uHifikepunye Pohamba, ugxile kabusha ngobubanzi obukhulu.

translations.source: The ruling party, South West Africa People's Organisation (SWAPO), also retained a majority in the parliamentary elections.
translations.reference: Iqembu elibusayo i-South West Africa People's Organisation (SWAPO) liphinde lavotelwa ngabaningi okhethweni lwasephalamende.
translations.hypothesis: Iqembu elilawulayo, i-South West Africa People's Organisation (SWAPO), nalo igcine inani elikhulu amavoti kwiwokwahlukano lasephalamende.

translations.source: Coalition and Afghan troops moved into the area to secure the site and other coalition aircraft have been sent to assist.
translations.reference: Amabutho ahlangene nawase-Afghanistan aya endaweni ukuyithatha futhi ezinye izindiza zamabutho ahlangene zithunyelwe kuba ziyosiza.
translations.hypothesis: Amabutho e-coalition kanye namabutho ase-Afghanistan afike endaweni ukuze bagcine indawo futhi amanye izindiza e-coalition athunyelwe ukuze basize.

translations.source: The crash occurred high up in mountainous terrain, and is believed to have been the result of hostile fire.
translations.reference: Ukuphahlazeka kwenzeke phezulu endaweni enezintaba, futhi kukholelwa ukuthi kubekhona ngenxa yomlilo onamandla.
translations.hypothesis: Ukungiphazwa kwenzeke endaweni ephezulu kakhulu, ezintabeni, futhi kucatshangwa ukuthi kwaba ngumphumela womiletho ombi.

translations.source: Efforts to search for the crash site are being met by bad weather and harsh terrain.
translations.reference: Imizamo yokufuna indawo yokuphahlazeka iphazanyiswa isimo sezulu esibi kanye nendawo embi.
translations.hypothesis: Imizamo yokufuna indawo lapho okuthile kushaywe khona ihlaselwe yimikhuba emibi kanye nezindawo ezinzima.

translations.source: The medical charity Mangola, Medecines Sans Frontieres and the World Health Organisation say it is the worst outbreak recorded in the country.
translations.reference: Izinhlangano ezisiza abaswele zezokwelapha iMangola, iMedecines Sans Frontieres kanye neWorld Health Organisation zithi ukuqubuka okubi kunakho konke okurekhodiwe ezweni.
translations.hypothesis: Uhlelo lwezempilo Mangola, i-Medecines Sans Frontieres, kanye noHlelo Lwamazwe Ngamazwe Lempilo bathi lesi yinkinga enkulu kakhulu eyabhalwa ezweni.

translations.source: Spokesman for Medecines Sans Frontiere Richard Veerman said: "Angola is heading for its worst ever outbreak and the situation remains very bad in Angola," he said.
translations.reference: Umkhulumeli we-Medecines Sans Frontiere u-Richard Veerman uthe: “I-Angola izobhekana nobhubhane olukhulu futhi isimo siqhubeka sisibi e-Angola,” washo.
translations.hypothesis: Umkhulumeli we-Medecines Sans Frontiere, uRichard Veerman, uthe: "IKunene yase-Angola izophinde ibe nomkhuhlane omubi kakhulu kuleli qembu, futhi isimo esikhona e-Angola sisesimbi kakhulu," kusho yena.

translations.source: The games kicked off at 10:00am with great weather and apart from mid morning drizzle which quickly cleared up, it was a perfect day for 7's rugby.
translations.reference: Imidlalo iqale ngo-10:00 ekuseni ngesimo sezulu esihle futhi ngaphandle komkhemezelo waphakathi nasekuseni onyamalale ngokushesha, kwakuwusuku oluhle lomdlalo weragbhi edlalwa abantu abangu-7 uhlangothi ngalunye.
