translations.hypothesis: Imidlalo iqale ngo-10:00 ekuseni, kwakunesimo sezulu esihle. Ngaphandle kwentambo yamanzi encane enguwedlule ekhaleni, kwakuyilanga eliphelele ngomdlalo webhola lekhisimende we-7.

translations.source: Tournament top seeds South Africa started on the right note when they had a comfortable 26 - 00 win against 5th seeded Zambia.
translations.reference: INingizimu Afrika esesikhundleni esiphezulu emqhudelwaneni iqale kahle lapho iwina ngo-26 -00 kalula lapho idlala neZambia esesikhundleni sesihlanu.
translations.hypothesis: Ithimba laseNingizimu Afrika, elilokhu ligxile kakhulu kulo mdlalo, liqale ngendlela enhle ngempelasonto, ngokuphumelela ngamaphuzu ayi-26 kanti i-Zambia, ethathwe indawo yesihlanu, inganikeza mpela.

translations.source: Looking decidedly rusty in the game against their southern sisters, South Africa however steadily improved as the tournament progressed.
translations.reference: Ibukeka sengathi iyawukhohlwa umdlalo ngokumelene nodadewabo abangaseningizimu, iNingizimu Afrika nokho yaya ngokuya ithuthuka njengoba umncintiswano uqhubeka.
translations.hypothesis: Nakuba kubonakala sengathi iqembu laseNingizimu Afrika belingadlali kahle kulo mdlalo noqembu lwabo olusempumalanga, kodwa kakhulu, baqhubeke nokuphakamisa izinga labo njengoba umdlalo uqhubekayo.

translations.source: Their disciplined defence, ball handling skills and excellent team work made them stand out and it was clear that this was the team to beat.
translations.reference: Isivikelo sabo esihlelekile, amakhono wokuphatha ibhola nokusebenzisana njengeqembu okuhle kwabenza bavelela futhi kwakucacile ukuthi bayiqembu elihamba phambili.
translations.hypothesis: Ukuziphatha kwabo okuhle ngaphakathi, amakhono abo okulawula ibhola kanye nomsebenzi womdlalo ongcono kakhulu kwenze ukuthi baqapheke, futhi kwakuyacaca ukuthi leli iqembu elalidingeka ukuthi libuyiswe.

translations.source: Officials for the city of Amsterdam and the Anne Frank Museum state that the tree is infected with a fungus and poses a public health hazard as they argue that it was in imminent danger of falling over.
translations.reference: Iziphathimandla zedolobha lase-Amsterdam kanye neMnyuziyamu ka-Anne Frank zithi lesi sihlahla singene ukukhunta futhi siyingozi emphakathini njengoba zithi bowusengozini yokuwa ngokushesha.
translations.hypothesis: Abaphathi edolobheni lase-Amsterdam kanye ne-Anne Frank Museum bathi umuthi unesifo esibangelwa ukukhova futhi uyingozi empilweni yomphakathi, njengoba bathi ubesengozini enkulu yokugwila.

translations.source: It had been scheduled to be cut down on Tuesday, but was saved after an emergency court ruling.
translations.reference: Beyihlelelwa ukunqunywa ngoLwesibili, kodwa yasindiswa ngemva kwesinqumo senkantolo sezimo eziphuthumayo.
translations.hypothesis: Bekuholeleke ukuthi kumele kususwe ngoLwesibili, kodwa kwagwinywa ngemuva kokugunyazwa okubalulekile ngengakhosi yezinkundla.

translations.source: All of the cave entrances, which were named "The Seven Sisters", are at least 100 to 250 meters (328 to 820 feet) in diameter.
translations.reference: Yonke iminyango yomhume, eyaqanjwa ngokuthi “The Seven Sisters”, okungenani ingamamitha ayi-100 kuye kwangama-250 (amafidi angama-328 kuye kwangama-820) ububanzi.
translations.hypothesis: Wonke amnyango wezindlu zangaphansi, ayayaziwa ngokuthi "Amakhulu Ayisikhombisa," anobubanzi obungaphakathi kuka-100 kuya ku-250 amamitha (ngamathathu kuya kwama-820 amaphuzu).

translations.source: Infrared images show that the temperature variations from night and day show that they are likely caves.
translations.reference: Izithombe eziveza ukushisa zibonisa ukuthi ukuhlukahlukana kokushisa kwasebusuku nasemini kubonisa ukuthi zifana nomgede.
translations.hypothesis: Izithombe ezithathwe ngesikhathi esincane zibonisa ukuthi ukushintshashintsha kwezimo zokushisa phakathi nosuku nobusuku kubonisa ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthi lezi zindawo ziyizikhithi.

translations.source: "They are cooler than the surrounding surface in the day and warmer at night.
translations.reference: Ipholile kunezindawo ezizizungezile emini futhi ifudumale ebusuku.
translations.hypothesis: "Ngasekuvikelweni, zibanzi kakhulu kunendawo ezungezile ngemini, kodwa zifudume kakhulu ebusuku."

translations.source: Their thermal behavior is not as steady as large caves on Earth that often maintain a fairly constant temperature, but it is consistent with these being deep holes in the ground," said Glen Cushing of the United States Geological Survey (USGS) Astrogeology Team and of Northern Arizona University located in Flagstaff, Arizona.
translations.reference: Ukuziphatha kwayo kokushisa akuzinzanga njengemigede emikhulu eMhlabeni leyo egcina izinga lokushisa cishe elifanayo kaningi, kodwa iyafana nalena ngokuba imigodi ejulile enhlabathini, kwasho uGlen Cushing we-United States Geological Survey (USGS) Astrogeology Team kanye neNorthern Arizona University eseFlagstaff, e-Arizona.
translations.hypothesis: "Ukushintsha kwezimo zokushisa kwazo akulinganiselwa njengezindlu ezinkulu ezitholakala emhlabeni, ezivamise ukugcina izinga lokushisa elilinganayo, kodwa kulungile ngoba lezi zindawo zitholakala ezindaweni ezinkulu ezifihliwe emhlabathini," kusho uGlen Cushing, ongumengameli weqembu le-Astrogeology le-United States Geological Survey (USGS) kanye nomfundi eNyuvesi yaseNorthern Arizona, etholakala e-Flagstaff, e-Arizona.

translations.source: In France, voting has traditionally been a low-tech experience: voters isolate themselves in a booth, put a pre-printed sheet of paper indicating their candidate of choice into an envelope.
translations.reference: E-France, ukuvota kwakuyisiko lobuchwepheshe obuphansi: abavoti bazihlukanisa bodwa ebhokisini, babeka iphepha eliphrintiwe ekuqaleni elibonisa ukhetho lwabo ngaphakathi kwemvilophi.
translations.hypothesis: EFransi, ukuvota ngokuvasolwandle kuhlanganise nendlela engenzi lutho elithakazelisayo: abavoti bahlukanisa ngokwabo endaweni efudumele, bese bayifaka iphepha elishicilelwe ngaphambilini elibonisa umuntu abafuna ukumvota ngaphakathi kothayiphu.

translations.source: After officials verify the voter's identity, the voter drops the envelope into the ballot box and signs the voting roll.
translations.reference: Ngemva kokuba iziphathimandla ziqinisekise ubuqu bomuntu ovotayo, abavotayo balahlela izimvilophu ebhokisini lamaphepha okuvota futhi basayine uhlu lwabavotayo.
translations.hypothesis: Ngemuva kokuthi izikhulu ziqiniseke ngobunikazi bomvoti, umvoti faka iphepha elingaphakathi kakhithi yovoti, bese buyisayina incwadi yovoti.

translations.source: French electoral law rather strictly codifies the proceedings.
translations.reference: Umthetho wokhetho waseFrance kunalokho uhlanganisa ngokuqinile ukuqulwa kwamacala.
translations.hypothesis: Umthetho wezokhetho wasiFrance uqukethe ngokuqinile yonke inqubo yokhetho.

translations.source: Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can witness that no envelopes are present at the start of the vote and that no envelopes are added except those of the duly counted and authorized voters.
translations.reference: Kusukela ngo-1988, amabhokisi amaphepha okuvota kumelwe kube abonisayo ukuze abavoti kanye nezibukeli bafakazele ukuthi azikho izimvilophu ezikhona lapho kuqala ukuvota nokuthi azikho izimvilophu ezifakwayo ngaphandle kwalezo zabavoti ababalwe ngokufanelekile nabagunyaziwe.
translations.hypothesis: Kusukela ngo-1988, amabhokisi okuvota kufanele abe ngobuso olucacile ukuze abavoti kanye nababukeli bakwazi ukubona ukuthi akukho iziphakelo ezikhona ekuqaleni kokuvota, kanye nokuthi akukho iziphakelo ezengezwa ngaphandle kwezazo zabavoti abagunyaziwe kanye ababalwe kahle.

translations.source: Candidates can send representatives to witness every part of the process. In the evening, votes are counted by volunteers under heavy supervision, following specific procedures.
translations.reference: Amakhandidethi angathumela abameli ukuze babone zonke izingxenye zenqubo. Kusihlwa, amavoti abalwa amavolontiya abekwe iso elibukhali, alandela izinqubo ezithile.
translations.hypothesis: Abafundi bangathumela abameleli ukuze babheke wonke amacebo. Kusihlwa, izivoti zibalwa ngabantu abazithandele ukusiza, ngaphansi kokugadazwa okukhulu, ngokusulandela izinqubo ezithile.

translations.source: ASUS Eee PC, earlier launched world-wide for cost-saving and functionality factors, became a hot topic in 2007 Taipei IT Month.
translations.reference: I-ASUS Eee PC, ngaphambili iqalise ukusebenza emhlabeni jikelele ngenxa yezizathu zokonga izindleko nezokusebenza, okwaba wundabamlonyeni ngonyaka ka-2007 ngenyanga yeTaipei IT.
translations.hypothesis: I-ASUS Eee PC, eyethulwe emhlabeni wonke ngaphambilini ngenxa yentengo ephansi kanye nokusebenza okuhle, ibe yinto ebaluleke kakhulu ngonyaka ka-2007 e-Taipei IT Month.

translations.source: But the consumer market on laptop computer will be radically varied and changed after ASUS was awarded in the 2007 Taiwan Sustainable Award by Executive Yuan of the Republic of China.
translations.reference: Kepha abathengi bekhompuyutha ephathekayo bazohluka kakhulu futhi baguquke ngemva kokuba i-ASUS iklomeliswe Eklomelweni Wokulondoloza wase-Taiwan ngo-2007 ilungu lesiGungu uYuan waseRiphabhulikini yaseShayina.
translations.hypothesis: Kodwa-ke, imakethe yabasebenzisi yezikhompyutha ezincwadi izoshintsha kakhulu ngemuva kokuba i-ASUS ithole umklomelo we-Taiwan Sustainable Award ngonyaka ka-2007, okuholwe yi-Executive Yuan yase-Republic of China.

translations.source: The station's web site describes the show as "old school radio theater with a new and outrageous geeky spin!"
translations.reference: Iwebhusayithi yesiteshi ichaza uhlelo "njengomdlalo womsakazo odla ngoludala onokwaziswa okusha kwezobuchwepheshe!"
translations.hypothesis: Iwebhusayithi yalesi sitheshini ichaza lo mbukiso njenge-"ibhokisi lakho lomsakazo lasekuseni, kodwa ngendlela entsha futhi engafanele!"

translations.source: In its early days, the show was featured solely at the long-running internet radio site TogiNet Radio, a site focused on talk radio.
translations.reference: Ngesikhathi lusaqala, lolu hlelo lwalufaka lodwa isikhathi eside emsakazweni we-inthanethi i-TogiNet, lengosi yayigxile emisakazweni ekhulumayo.
translations.hypothesis: Ekuqaleni, lo mbukiso uboniswe kuphela kwi-TogiNet Radio, okuyisayithi lezomlayelo wezomfihlo ye-inthanethi eyayikhona isikhathi eside, kanti leyo sayithi yayigxile kakhulu ezimlayelweni zokuxoxa.

translations.source: In late 2015, TogiNet established AstroNet Radio as a subsidiary station.
translations.reference: Ekupheleni kuka-2015, iTogiNet yamisa i-AstroNet Radio njengesiteshi njengesiteshi esingaphansi kwayo
translations.hypothesis: NgoMgqibelo ka-2015, i-TogiNet yasungula i-AstroNet Radio njengenhlangano ededelwe.

translations.source: The show originally featured amateur voice actors, local to East Texas.
translations.reference: Umdlalo ekuqaleni wawunabalingisi bezwi abangafundile, endaweni yase-East Texas.
translations.hypothesis: Lo mbukiso, ngokuqala, ubonisa abantu abangochwepheshe abanomkhuba wokufundisa izimpilo, abahlala endaweni ye-East Texas.

translations.source: Widespread looting reportedly continued overnight, as law enforcement officers were not present on Bishkek's streets.
translations.reference: Ukugqekeza okugcwele konke kubikwa ukuthi kwaqhubeka ubusuku bonke, njengoba amaphoyisa ayengekho emigwaqweni yaseBishkek.
translations.hypothesis: Kuthiwa ukubhujiswa kwempahla bekuhlala kuqhubeka ebusuku bonke, ngoba amaphoyisa ayikaze afike ezindaweni eziningi edolobheni lase-Bishkek.

translations.source: Bishkek was described as sinking into a state of "anarchy" by one observer, as gangs of people roamed the streets and plundered stores of consumer goods.
translations.reference: IBishkek beyichazwa njengecwila esimweni seziyaluyalu” ngomunye wababukeli, njengoba amaqembu wabantu ayezulazula emigwaqweni futhi bephanga izitolo zezimpahla zabathengi. "
translations.hypothesis: IBishkek ibuyekwe ngomboni omunye njengendawo eyathulelwa "ukungaphathwa," njengoba amaqembu abantu ahamba ezindleleni futhi agweme izitolo ezithengisa impahla.

translations.source: Several Bishkek residents blamed protesters from the south for the lawlessness.
translations.reference: Abahlali abaningana baseBishkek bathwese ababhikishi abasuka eningizimu icala lokwephulwa komthetho.
translations.hypothesis: Abantu abaningi base-Bishkek bathathe ukuthi abagxeki abavela eningizimu abayimbangela yale mali yobulwandle.

translations.source: South Africa have defeated the All Blacks (New Zealand) in a rugby union Tri Nations match at the Royal Bafokeng Stadium in Rustenburg, South Africa.
translations.reference: INingizimu Afrika ihlule ama-All Blacks (iNyuzilandi) emdlalweni we-ragbhi wenyunyoni we-Tri Nations eRoyal Bafokeng Stadium, eRustenburg, eNingizimu Afrika.
translations.hypothesis: I-South Africa ihlulekile i-All Blacks (eNew Zealand) kumanqamu ebhola lebhola e-Tri Nations ebanjwe eRoyal Bafokeng Stadium e-Rustenburg, eNingizimu Afrika.

translations.source: The final score was a one-point victory, 21 to 20, ending the All Blacks' 15 game winning streak.
translations.reference: Imiphumela yokugcina bekuwukuphumelela kwephuzu elilodwa, u-21 ku-20, okwaqeda ukuwina njalo kwama-All Blacks kwemidlalo engu-15.
translations.hypothesis: Isikolo esiphelele sibe ngumdlalo owawinwe ngomkhakha owodwa, ngamaphuzu ayi-21 ku-20, okuyaphusha ukuthi i-All Blacks ilahlekelwe ngomdlalo wayo wesibili olalikhulu ngemuva kwamakhono ayi-15.

translations.source: For the Springboks, it ended a five-match losing streak.
translations.reference: KumaBhokobhoko, lokhu kunqamule ukungaphumeleli emidlalweni emihlanu elandelanayo.
translations.hypothesis: KweSpringboks, lokhu kuqede umkhuba wokuphathwa kabi okwenzelwe imidlalo eyisihlanu.

translations.source: It was the final match for the All Blacks, who had already won the trophy two weeks ago.
translations.reference: Bekuwumdlalo wokugcina wama-All Blacks, asephumelele kakade indebe emavikini ambalwa adlule.
translations.hypothesis: Bekuyimatchi yokugcina ye-All Blacks, abese bephumelele isicoco ezinsukwini ezimbili ezedlule.

translations.source: The final match of the series will take place at Ellis Park in Johannesburg next week, when the Springboks play Australia.
translations.reference: Umdlalo wokugcina womqhudelwano uzokwenzeka e-Ellis Park eGoli ngeviki elizayo, lapho ama-Springbok edlala ne-Australia.
translations.hypothesis: Umklomelo wokugcina waleli qembu uzobanjwa e-Ellis Park eJohannesburg ngesonto ezayo, lapho i-Springboks izodlala ne-Australia.

translations.source: A moderate earthquake shook western Montana at 10:08 p.m. on Monday.
translations.reference: Ukuzamazama komhlaba okuncane kwanyakazisa intshonalanga ye-Montana ngo-10: 08 p.m. ngoMsombuluko.
translations.hypothesis: Umhlabathini omncane udlule kwi-Montana yaseNtshonalanga ngoMsombuluko, ngomisa ka-10:08 ebusuku.

translations.source: No immediate reports of damage have been received by the United States Geological Survey (USGS) and its National Earthquake Information Center.
translations.reference: Ayikho imibiko esheshayo yomonakalo etholwe yi-United States Geological Survey (USGS) kanye ne-National Earthquake Information Center yayo.
translations.hypothesis: Akukho izibalo ezitholwe ngoku okubikwa mayelana nomonakalo ohlwini yi-United States Geological Survey (USGS) kanye ne-National Earthquake Information Center yayo.

translations.source: The earthquake was centered about 20 km (15 miles) north-northeast of Dillon, and about 65 km (40 miles) south of Butte.
translations.reference: Ukuzamazama komhlaba kwakugxile endaweni cishe engama-20 km (amamayela angu-15) enyakatho esempumalanga esenyakatho yeDillon, futhi cishe nama-65 km (amamayela angu-40) eningizimu neButte.
translations.hypothesis: Umhlabathini uqhamuke eduze kwekilomitha engama-20 (amayimila ayi-15) enyakatho-enyakatho yeDillon, kanye namakhilomitha ayi-65 (amayimila ayi-40) eningizimu yeButte.

translations.source: The strain of bird flu lethal to humans, H5N1, has been confirmed to have infected a dead wild duck, found on Monday, in marshland near Lyon in the east of France.
translations.reference: Uhlobo lomkhuhlane wezinyoni olubulalayo ebantwini, i-H5N1, kuqinisekisiwe ukuthi luhlasele idada lasendle, elatholakala ngoMsombuluko, endaweni yamaxhaphozi eduze naseLyon empumalanga neFulansi.
translations.hypothesis: Uhlelo lwegciwane lwegula yezinyoni, i-H5N1, elingabulala abantu, uqinisekiswe ukuthi luyisikhathi esithile luyayithinta inyoni yendlovu yasendle eyifele, etholwe ngoMsombuluko, endaweni yamanzi eduze ne-Lyon, empumalanga yeFrance.

translations.source: France is the seventh country in the European Union to suffer this virus; following Austria, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece and Italy.
translations.reference: IFulansi yizwe lesikhombisa esiGungwini saseYurophu lokuthola leligciwane; ngemva kwe-Austria, iJalimane, iSlovenia, iBulgria, iGrisi kanye neNtaliyane.
translations.hypothesis: EFaransi iyina yesikhombisa emazweni aseYurophu ayoBukhwebo elokhu ethintekwa yileli virus, ngemuva kwezifunda zama-Austria, Germany, Slovenia, Bulgaria, Greece kanye ne-Italy.

translations.source: Suspected cases of H5N1 in Croatia and Denmark remain unconfirmed.
translations.reference: Ubantu okusolakala ukuthi baphethwe i-H5N1 eCroatia naseDenmark abakaqinisekiswa.
translations.hypothesis: Izimo ezikhathazwayo ze-H5N1 e-Croatia naseDenmark azisasetshenziswa njengezimo eziqukethwe yilezi zifo.

translations.source: Chambers had sued God for "widespread death, destruction and terrorization of millions upon millions of the Earth's inhabitants."
translations.reference: I-Chambers yayimangalele uNkulunkulu“ngokwanda kakhulu kokufa, izinhlekelele kanye nokuphekulwa kwezigidi zezigidi zabahlali boMhlaba.”
translations.hypothesis: UChambers ubehlashile uNkulunkulu ngokusho ukuthi ube yimbangela "yobulawa obukhulu, yokulahlwa kanye nokukhungatheka kwabantu abazigidi nezigidi abahlala kulo mhlaba."

translations.source: Chambers, an agnostic, argues that his lawsuit is "frivolous" and "anybody can sue anybody."
translations.reference: UChambers, ongakholelwa kunkulunkulu, uphikisa ngokuthi ukumangalelwa kwakhe "akunanjongo" futhi "noma ubani angahlawulisa noma ubani."
translations.hypothesis: UChambers, ongumuntu ongakholwa, uthi incwadi yakhe yokulalela "ayinalo isizathu esiqinile" futhi "noma ngubani angalala noma ngubani."

translations.source: The story presented in the French opera, by Camille Saint-Saens, is of an artist "whose life is dictated by a love for drugs and Japan."
translations.reference: Indaba evezwe ku-opera yaseFrance, ngu-Camille Saint-Saens, iciko “elikuphila kwalo kwathathwa uthando lwezidakamizwa kanye ne-Japani.”
translations.hypothesis: Indaba ebekwe kulo mbukiso wezingoma waseFrance, owenziwe nguCamille Saint-Saens, ithi ngomculi "okubusa impilo yakhe ukuthanda izidakamizwa kanye neJapan."

translations.source: As a result, the performers smoke cannabis joints on stage, and the theatre itself is encouraging the audience to join in.
translations.reference: Njengomphumela, abaculi babhema amajoyinynti insangu ye-cannabis esiteji, futhi nethiyetha ngokwayo igqugquzela izilaleli ukuba zihlanganyele.
translations.hypothesis: Ngenxa yalokho, abadlali bafuma utshwala (cannabis) esiteji, futhi ithiyetha ngokwawo iyakhuthaza izilaleli ukuthi zibe yingxenye yalokho.

translations.source: Former House Speaker Newt Gingrich, Texas governor Rick Perry, and Congresswoman Michele Bachmann finished in fourth, fifth, and sixth place, respectively.
translations.reference: Umkhulumeli Wendlu uNewt Gingrich, umbusi waseTexas uRick Perry, kanye nelungu lesishaya-mthetho lowesifazane uMichele Bachmann baqede endaweni yesine, yesihlanu, kanye neyesithupha, ngokulandelana.
translations.hypothesis: UMphathisa wangaphambilini weNdlu, uNewt Gingrich, umphathisa waseTexas, uRick Perry, kanye nomlandeli wePhalamende, uMichele Bachmann, bafezeka ezikhundleni zama-4, 5, kanye ne-6, ngokulandelana.

translations.source: After the results came in, Gingrich lauded Santorum, but had tough words for Romney, on whose behalf negative campaign advertisements were aired in Iowa against Gingrich.
translations.reference: Ngemva kokuba kufike imiphumela, uGingrich ubabaze uSantorum, kodwa wayenamazwi anzima kuRomney, lowo owenzelwa umkhankaso wezikhangiso ezimbi e-Iowa ngokumelene noGingrich.
translations.hypothesis: Ngemuva kokufika kwemiphumela, uGingrich ubonge uSantorum, kodwa wakhuluma ngamazwi amakhulu kuRomney, okuyena okubalelwe ukuthi izikhangiso zokukhipha izinto ezimbi mayelana noGingrich zakhishwa e-Iowa.

translations.source: Perry stated that he would "return to Texas to assess the results of tonight's caucus, determine whether there is a path forward for myself in this race", but later said that he would remain in the race and compete in the January 21 South Carolina primary.
translations.reference: U-Perry wathi waye "zobuyela e-Texas ukuyohlola imiphumela yekhokhasi yanamuhla ebusuku, nginqume ukuthi ingabe ikhona yini indlela ephambili yami kulo mjaho", kodwa ngokuhamba kwesikhathi wathi uzohlala emncintiswaneni futhi ancintisane ngoMasingana 21 e-South Carolina primary.
translations.hypothesis: UPerry uthe uzobuyela eTexas ukuze ahlole imiphumela yomhlangano kazwelonke namuhla, futhi athole ukuthi ngabe kukhona indlela yokuthi yena angalandela kulo msebenzi. Kodwa kamuva, uthe uzohlala kulo msebenzi futhi aqhudelane kwi-primary yaseSouth Carolina enguJanuwari 21.

translations.source: Bachmann, who won the Ames Straw Poll in August, decided to end her campaign.
translations.reference: UBachmann, owanqoba i-Ames Straw Poll  ngoNcwaba, wanquma ukuqeda umkhankaso.
translations.hypothesis: UBachmann, owawine i-Ames Straw Poll ngo-Agasti, utshele ukuthi uyeka umzabalazo wakhe.

translations.source: The photographer was transported to Ronald Reagan UCLA Medical Center, where he subsequently died.
translations.reference: Umthwebuli wezithombe wayiswa esiKhungweni sezoKwelapha sikaRonald Reagan UCLA, lapho eshone khona ngokushesha.
translations.hypothesis: Umfotografi uthunjwe esibhedlela i-Ronald Reagan UCLA, lapho wagula khona wafa.

translations.source: He was reportedly aged in his 20s. In a statement, Bieber said "[w]hile I was not present nor directly involved with this tragic accident, my thoughts and prayers are with the family of the victim."
translations.reference: Kuthiwa wayeseminyakeni yawo-20. Esitatimendeni, uBieber uthe "nakuba ngangingekho futhi ngingahilelekile ngokuqondile kulengozi ebuhlungu, imicabango kanye nemikhuleko yami inomndeni wesisulu."
translations.hypothesis: Kuthiwa ubudala bakhe bekuyi-20s. Ngesitatimende, uBieber uthe: "[Nakuba ngingeyena umuntu owaye khona noma engaxoshiwe ngale ngoxolo, imicabango yami nemithandazo yami inobuhle kubafowabo nomndeni walowo owabulawa."

translations.source: Entertainment news website TMZ understands the photographer stopped his vehicle on the other side of Sepulveda Boulevard and attempted to take pictures of the police stop before crossing the road and continuing, prompting the California Highway Patrol police officer conducting the traffic stop to order him back across, twice.
translations.reference: Iwebhusayithi yezindaba zokuzijabulisa i-TMZ iqonda ukuthi umthathi wezithombe wamisa imoto yakhe kolunye uhlangothi lweSepulveda Boulevard futhi wazama ukuthatha izithombe zamaphoyisa ayevimbezele ngaphambi kokuwela umgwaqo futhi aqhubeke, okwashukumisa iphoyisa leCalifornia Highway Patrol elalivimebezele izimoto ukuba limyalele ukuthi a welele emuva, kabili.
translations.hypothesis: Iwebhusayithi yezindaba zokuzijabulisa ethi TMZ iqagela ukuthi umfotografi uphakamise imoto yakhe ngakwesokudla kwe-Sepulveda Boulevard futhi wazama ukuthatha izithombe zomkhakha wamaphoyisa ngaphambi kokugibela umgwaqo futhi aqhubeke, okubangela ukuthi umphathi wamaphoyisa ka-California Highway Patrol, owayesebenzisa umkhakha wamaphoyisa, amucele ukuthi ubuyele ngakwesokudla, kabili.

translations.source: According to police, the driver of the vehicle that hit the photographer is unlikely to face criminal charges.
translations.reference: Ngokusho kwamaphoyisa, cishe akunakwenzeka ukuthi umshayeli wemoto eshayise umthathi wezithombe amangalelwe.
translations.hypothesis: Ngokwamazwi amaphoyisa, kunamathuba amancane ukuthi umshayeli wemoto eyilimele umfotografi uzobhekana nezikhulu zombuso.

translations.source: With only eighteen medals available a day, a number of countries have failed to make the medal podium.
translations.reference: Ngamamedali ayishumi nesishiyagalimbili kuphela atholakalayo ngosuku, amazwe amaningi ahlulekile ukuthola izindondo zamamedali.
translations.hypothesis: Ngokuba kunamagugu ayishumi ayisikhombisa kuphela athengiswa ngosuku ngalinye, izizwe eziningi azikwazile ukufinyelela ezikhundleni zokuqala ezitholayo amagugu.

translations.source: They include the Netherlands, with Anna Jochemsen finishing ninth in the women's standing class in the Super-G yesterday, and Finland with Katja Saarinen finishing tenth in the same event.
translations.reference: Bahlanganisa iNetherlands, ngo-Anna Jochemsen oqede endaweni yesishiyagalolunye esigabeni sabesifazane abamile kuyiSuper-G izolo, neFinland ngoKatja Saarinen oqede endaweni yeshumi emdlalweni ofanayo.
translations.hypothesis: Kulo mqhudelwano, i-Netherlands ibambe iqhaza, futhi u-Anna Jochemsen ufeze umphumela wesikhombisa kwiqembu labafazana abagijima ngaphandle kokusebenzisa izicathulo ezikhethekile kwi-"Super-G" ngomso. Futhi, i-Finland ibambe iqhaza, futhi u-Katja Saarinen ufeze umphumela wesigama kulo mqhudelwano ofanayo.

translations.source: Australia's Mitchell Gourley finished eleventh in the men's standing Super-G. Czech competitor Oldrich Jelinek finished sixteenth in the men's sitting Super-G.
translations.reference: U-Mitchell Gourley wase-Australia uqede esikhundleni seshumi nanye esigabeni sabesilise sabamile se-Super-G. Imbangi yaseCzech u-Oldrich Jelinek uqede esikhundleni seshumi nesithupha esigabeni sabesilisa sabahlezi se-Super-G.
translations.hypothesis: UMitchell Gourley wase-Australia ugcine yesikhombisa kwi-Super-G yabadodana abagijima bemi. UOldrich Jelinek wase-Czech ugcine yesithandathu kwi-Super-G yabadodana abagijima bezihlezi.

translations.source: Arly Velasquez of Mexico finished fifteenth in the men's sitting Super-G. New Zealand's Adam Hall finished ninth in the men's standing Super-G.
translations.reference: U-Arly Velasquez waseMexico uqede endaweni yesishumi nanhlanu kuyiSuper-G yabesilisa abahlezi. UAdam Hall waseNyuzilandi uqede endaweni yesishiyagalolunye kuyiSuper G yabesilisa abamile.
translations.hypothesis: U-Arly Velasquez waseMexico ugcine yesikhombisa kwi-Super-G yabadodana abagibele. U-Adam Hall waseNew Zealand ugcine yesini kwi-Super-G yabadodana abami.

translations.source: Poland's men's visually impaired skier Maciej Krezel and guide Anna Ogarzynska finished thirteenth in the Super-G. South Korea's Jong Seork Park finished twenty-fourth in the men's sitting Super-G.
translations.reference: Umshushuluzi waseqhweni wase-Poland wesigaba sabesilisa abangaboni kahle u-Maciej Krezel nomqondisi u-Anna Ogarzynska uqede endaweni yeshumi nantathu kuyi-Super-G. UJong Seork Park waseNingizimu Korea uqede endaweni yamashumi amabili nesine esigabeni sabesilisa abahlezi se-Super-G.
translations.hypothesis: UMaciej Krezel, umgijimi wasePoland okhubazekile, kanye nomgijimane wakhe u-Anna Ogarzynska, bafeze endaweni yesithathu nanyonane kwi-Super-G. U-Jong Seork Park waseSouth Korea ufeze endaweni yesine nanyonane kwi-Super-G yabadlalayo abahlala ezikhundleni.

translations.source: UN peacekeepers, whom arrived in Haiti after the 2010 earthquake, are being blamed for the spread of the disease which started near the troop's encampment.
translations.reference: Abagcini bokuthula be-UN, abafike eHaiti ngemva kokuzamazama komhlaba kwango-2010, babekwa icala ngokusabalala kwesifo esiqale eduze nakumu lamasosha.
translations.hypothesis: Abasolwandle bezempi baseNingizimu Afrika, abafike e-Haiti ngemuva komhlwazo ka-2010, bagunyazwe ngokuba yimbangela yokusabalala kwalesi sifo esiqalile eduze kwendawo lapho abasolwandle bezempi behlala khona.

translations.source: According to the lawsuit, waste from the UN camp was not properly sanitized, causing bacteria to enter the tributary of the Artibonite River, one of Haiti's largest.
translations.reference: Ngokwecala, ukungcola okuvela ekamu le-UN akukhucululwanga kahle, okwabangela ukuthi amabhakithiliya angene emingeneleni yoMfula i-Artibonite, omunye wemifula emikhulu yaseHaiti.
translations.hypothesis: Ngokwembiko yombango, ukuntuleka okuthile esikhungweni lweNhlangano yamaHlangano Amazwe (UN) akuyihlelwe kahle, okubangela ukuthi amagciwane afake endleleni yamanzi egijima ngaphansi komfula i-Artibonite, omunye wemifula enkulu kakhulu e-Haiti.

translations.source: Prior to the arrival of troops, Haiti had not encountered problems related to the disease since the 1800s.
translations.reference: Ngaphambi kokufika kwamabutho, iHaiti beyingakahlangabezani nezinkinga ezihlobene nesifo kusukela ngawo-1800.
translations.hypothesis: Ngaphambi kokufika kwamabutho, i-Haiti ayikaze ibheke izinkinga ezihlobene nalolu bhubhane kusukela ngemuva kuka-1800.

translations.source: The Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy has referenced independent studies that suggest the Nepalese UN peacekeeping battalion unknowingly brought the disease to Haiti.
translations.reference: Inhlangano yaseHaiti yoKulunga Nombuso Wentando Yeningi icaphune ucwaningo oluzimele olusikisela ukuthi iqembu lamabutho ayinkulungwane le-UN laseNephali lokugcina ukuthula lilethe isifo eHaiti lingazi.
translations.hypothesis: I-Haitian Institute for Justice and Democracy isesikhombiso sezifundo ezimele ezibonisa ukuthi ibathalayin yezehlukene yama-UN yase-Nepal, ngaphandle kokuyazi, iletha lesi sifo e-Haiti.

translations.source: Danielle Lantagne, a UN expert on the disease, stated the outbreak was likely caused by the peacekeepers.
translations.reference: UDanielle Lantagne, isazi se-UN ngisifo, uthe kunamathuba okuthi ukuqubuka kwesifo kubangelwe abagcini bokuthula.
translations.hypothesis: UDanielle Lantagne, umhlabathini wezifo waseNHA, uthe ukuguquka kwalesi sifo kungenzeka kwabangwa ukuthi kubangezwe yabadlali bezindaba.

translations.source: Hamilton confirmed Howard University Hospital admitted the patient in stable condition.
translations.reference: UHamilton uqinisekise ukuthi Isibhedlela saseNyuvesi yaseHoward samukele isiguli sisesimweni esizinzile.
translations.hypothesis: UHamilton uqinisekisile ukuthi ihospitali yaseHoward University yamukele umugesi kanti ubupilo bakhe bebungcono.

translations.source: The patient had been to Nigeria, where some cases of the Ebola virus have occurred.
translations.reference: Isiguli ebesiye eNigeria, lapho kwenzeke khona ezinye izigameko zegciwane le-Ebola.
translations.hypothesis: Umuntu ogulazwe ubesivele waye wafika eNigeria, lapho kukhona izimo ezithile zalesi sifo esibucayi esiyisifo se-Ebola.

translations.source: The hospital has followed protocol for infection control, including separating the patient from others to prevent possible infection of others.
translations.reference: Izibhedlela zilandele imithetho yokulawula ukutheleleka, okuhlanganisa ukuhlukanisa iziguli kwezinye ukuze kugwenywe ukutheleleka.
translations.hypothesis: Isibhedlela silandele imithetho yokulawula ukwelapheka, okubalwa ukuhlukanisa igciwane, okuhlanganisa nokuhlukanisa umakhalekhukhwini kwabanye ukuze kuvikelwe ukuthi abanye bangakhwelwe.

translations.source: Before The Simpsons Simon had worked on several shows in various positions.
translations.reference: Ngaphambi kweThe Simpsons uSimon wayesebenze ezinhlelweni eziningana ezikhundleni ezihlukahlukene.
translations.hypothesis: Ngaphambi kokuba uSimon basebenzise i-"The Simpsons," usebenze ezinyangeni eziningi ezimbalwa ngezikhathi ezahlukene.

translations.source: During the 1980s he worked on shows such as Taxi, Cheers, and The Tracy Ullman Show.
translations.reference: Ngeminyaka yama-1980 wasebenza emibukisweni efana neTaxi, i-Cheers, noMboniso we-Tracy Ullman.
translations.hypothesis: Ngaleso sikhathi sango-1980, usebenze ezibukweni ezifana ne-Taxi, i-Cheers, kanye ne-The Tracy Ullman Show.

translations.source: In 1989 he helped create The Simpsons with Brooks and Groening, and was responsible for hiring the show's first writing team.
translations.reference: Ngo-1989 wasiza ukwakha i-The Simpsons no-Brooks kanye no-Groening, futhi wayenomthwalo wemfanelo wokuqasha iqembu lohlelo lokubhala lokuqala.
translations.hypothesis: Ngo-1989, usizo ekwakhiweni kwe-"The Simpsons" kanye no-Brooks no-Groening, futhi ube yiphini ekubuyiseni ithimba lokuqala lababhali leli shows.

translations.source: Despite leaving the show in 1993 he kept the title of executive producer, and continued to receive tens of millions of dollars every season in royalties.
translations.reference: Ngaphezu kokuyeka uhlelo ngo-1993 ugcine isiqu somdidiyeli wohlelo, futhi waqhubeka nokuthola amashumi wezigidi zamadola isizini ngayinye wemivuzo.
translations.hypothesis: Nakuba ehambile eshow ngo-1993, waqhubeka nokuba ngumphathi omkhulu, futhi waqhubeka nokuthola izigidi eziningi zamaRandi njalo ngonyaka ngemali yokuxhaswa.

translations.source: Earlier the Chinese news agency Xinhua reported a plane to be hijacked.
translations.reference: Ngaphambili, inhlangano yezindaba yaseShayina i-Xinhua yabika ukuthi kunendiza ethunjiwe.
translations.hypothesis: Ngaphambilini, i-ajensi yezindaba yaseChina, i-Xinhua, ibike ukuthi inkundla yombhede yenzelwe ukuthi ibhubhe.

translations.source: Later reports then stated the plane received a bomb threat and was diverted back to Afghanistan, landing in Kandahar.
translations.reference: Imibiko yakamuva yabe isithi indiza ithola ukusongelwa ngebhomu futhi yaphambukiselwa emuva e-Afghanistan, ima e-Kandahar.
translations.hypothesis: Kamashoni, izingxenye zombhalo ezalandelayo zisho ukuthi indiza yabonwa ukuthi ibekwe engozeni futhi yathunyelwa ngemuva e-Afghanistan, lapho landela e-Kandahar.

translations.source: The early reports say the plane was diverted back to Afghanistan after being denied an emergency landing in Ürümqi.
translations.reference: Imibiko yasekuqaleni ithi indiza iphambukiselwe emuva e-Afghanistan ngemva kokwenqatshelwa indawo yokuma yezimo eziphuthumayo e-Ürümqi.
translations.hypothesis: Kuthiwa ekuqaleni ukuthi indiza yagudulela emuva e-Afghanistan ngemuva kokuthi ayivunyelwe ukulandela endaweni yokulanda ngokushesha e-Ürümqi.

translations.source: Air accidents are common in Iran, which has an aging fleet that is poorly maintained both for civil and military operations.
translations.reference: Izingozi zasemoyeni zivamile e-Iran, enezindiza eziningi ezigugile ezingalondolozwa kahle ezisetshenziselwa kokubili izakhamizi ezivamile kanye nempi.
translations.hypothesis: Izilondolo zendiza zivame kakhulu e-Iran, ngoba leli zwe linokutholakala izindiza ezindala kakhulu ezilawulwa kahle, kokubili ezisetshenziselwa ezombusazwe kanye nazo zombusi.

translations.source: International sanctions have meant that new aircraft cannot be purchased.
translations.reference: Ukujeziswa kwamanye amazwe kusho ukuthi indiza entsha ayinakuthengwa.
translations.hypothesis: Izivimbekelo zamazwe ngamazwe zibangele ukuthi izingophelo ezintsha zingathengwa.

translations.source: Earlier this week, a police helicopter crash killed three people and wounded three more.
translations.reference: Ekuqaleni kwaleli viki, ukuphahlazeka kwendiza yamaphoyisa enophephela emhlane kubulale abantu abathathu futhi kwalimaza abanye abathathu.
translations.hypothesis: Kuleli phakathi leli, inkulumo yezindaba yasho ukuthi umoya wamanje wasepholisi uqokezele, wabulala abantu abathathu futhi wamemaza abathathu abanye.

translations.source: Last month Iran saw its worst air disaster in years when an airliner heading to Armenia crashed, killing the 168 on board.
translations.reference: Ngenyanga edlule i-Iran yavelelwa inhlekelele enkulu yezindiza ngemva kweminyaka lapho indiza eyayiphokophele e-Armenia yaphahlazeka khona, yabulala abangu-168 ababekuyo.
translations.hypothesis: Ngenyanga edlule, i-Iran ibhekane nokuba yingozi enkulu kakhulu yezindiza ezingucekile eminyakeni, lapho indiza eyayihamba ngenkatho yayo eya e-Armenia ihlwele, yabulala abantu abangu-168 abayiphakathi.

translations.source: The same month saw another airliner overrun a runway at Mashhad and strike a wall, killing seventeen.
translations.reference: Ngenyanga efanayo indiza idlule lapho umgwaqo wezindiza uphelela khona eMashhad futhi yashayisa udonga, ibulala abayishumi nesikhombisa.
translations.hypothesis: Ngo-Nhlakanipho efanayo, enye indiza yezindiza igcine ingena ngaphandle kwendawo yokulanda e-Mashhad futhi yagxumela embhedeni, yabhulala abantu amashumi amayisipho.

translations.source: Aerosmith have cancelled their remaining concerts on their tour.
translations.reference: I-Aerosmith ikhansele amakhonsathi ayo asele ohambweni lwayo.
translations.hypothesis: Ibhandla i-Aerosmith ilahlele yonke imicimbi yabo eyisele kulo hlelo lokuvakasha.

translations.source: The rock band was due to tour the United States and Canada until September 16.
translations.reference: Iqembu lomculo we-rock bekufanele livakashele eMelika naseKhanada kuze kube nguMandulo 16.
translations.hypothesis: Ibhandla lamabhithi belinde ukuhamba ngezinkundla zase-United States nase-Canada kuze kube ngomhlaka-16 kuMandulo.

translations.source: They have cancelled the tour after lead singer Steven Tyler was injured after he fell off stage while performing on August 5.
translations.reference: Bakhansele uhambo ngemva kokuba umculi oyinhloko u-Steven Tyler elimele ngemva kokuwa esiteji ngenkathi ecula ngoNcwaba
translations.hypothesis: Bese bashushise uhambo lwawo ngemuva kokuba umculi okhulu, uSteven Tyler, wathunjwa ngemuva kokwehla esiteji ngesikhathi ebamba iqembu ngomhlaka 5 kuNdasa.

translations.source: Murray lost the first set in a tie break after both men held each and every serve in the set.
translations.reference: UMurray ulahlekelwe ingxenye yakhe yomdlalo emdlalweni wokubona ukuthi kuwina bani kwabalinganayo ngamaphuzu ngemva kokuthi womabili amadoda ayelingana ezinyeni zawo zomdlalo.
translations.hypothesis: UMurray ulahlekelwe ngokuqala umdlalo ngempelasonto, ngemuva kokuthi bobabili abadlali bagcine ukuhlala ngamaphuzu afanayo kuyo yonke i-set.

translations.source: Del Potro had the early advantage in the second set, but this too required a tie break after reaching 6-6.
translations.reference: UDel Potro wayesesimweni esiyinzuzo ekuqaleni engxenyeni yesibili yomdlalo, kodwa lona nawo ubudinga umdlalo wokubona ukuthi kuphumelela bani kwabalinganayo ngemva kokufika ku-6-6.
translations.hypothesis: UDel Potro ube nomkhakha oqala kuye kulesi sethi yesibili, kodwa nakulo, kwakudingeka ukudlala umdlalo wokulinganisa amaphuzu ngemuva kokufinyelela emazingeni angu-6-6.

translations.source: Potro received treatment to his shoulder at this point but managed to return to the game.
translations.reference: UPotro uthole ukwelashwa ehlombe ngaleso sikhathi kodwa wakwazi ukubuyela emdlalweni .
translations.hypothesis: Kuleli thuba, uPotro utholile ukwelashwa ngengxenye yegazi lakhe, kodwa waphinde wabuyela kulo mdlalo.

translations.source: The program started at 8:30 p.m. local time (15.00 UTC).
translations.reference: Uhlelo lwaqala ngo-8:30 p.m. ngesikhathi sendawo (15.00 UTC).
translations.hypothesis: Uhlelo luyiqale ngomisa manje ngo-8:30 ntambama ngesikhathi sasekhaleni (15:00 UTC).

translations.source: Famous singers across the country presented bhajans, or devotional songs, to Shri Shyam's feet.
translations.reference: Abaculi abadumile ezweni lonke banikela ngama-bhajan, noma izingoma zokuzinikela, ezinyaweni zikaShri Shyam.
translations.hypothesis: Abaculi abaziwayo kulo lonke izwe bayethula ama-bhajan, noma izingoma zokukhuleka, kubafundi kaShri Shyam.

translations.source: Singer Sanju Sharma started the evening, followed by Jai Shankar Choudhary. esented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.
translations.reference: Umculi uSanju Sharma bekunguye oqalile kusihlwa, elandelwa uJai Shankar Choudhary. Unikele nge-chhappan bhog bhajan ngokufanayo. Umculi, uRaju Khandelwala wayehamba naye.
translations.hypothesis: UMculi uSanju Sharma uqale umcimbi, walandelwa nguJai Shankar Choudhary. Ubeklame nangebhajan ethi "chhappan bhog." Umculi uRaju Khandelwal uyamxhumanisa kulo mculo.

translations.source: Then, Lakkha Singh took the lead in singing the bhajans.
translations.reference: Ngakho, uLakkha Singh uholile ekuculeni i-bhajans.
translations.hypothesis: Ngemuva kwalokho, uLakkha Singh uqale ukuhumusha izinsolo zama-bhajan.

translations.source: 108 plates of Chhappan Bhog (in Hinduism, 56 different edible items, like, sweets, fruits, nuts, dishes etc. which are offered to deity) were served to Baba Shyam.
translations.reference: Izitsha ezingu-108 zeChhappan Bhog (ngenkolelo yobuHindu, izinto ezidliwayo ezihlukile ezingu-56, njengamaswidi, izithelo, amantongomane, ukudla njll. Okunikelwa esithixweni) zanikezelwa kuBaba Shyam.
translations.hypothesis: Izitsha ezingu-108 eziqukethe i-Chhappan Bhog (kuHindu, okuyi-56 izinto ezahlukene ezadayo, ezifana namakhukhi, izithelo, ama-nuts, izitsha, njll. ezihlinzekwa kumphiliseli) zihlinzekwe kuBaba Shyam.

translations.source: Lakkha Singh presented the chhappan bhog bhajan as well. Singer, Raju Khandelwal was accompanying him.
translations.reference: U-Lakkha Singh wanikezela ngange-Chhappan bhog bhajan. Umculi, uRaju Khandelwal bekahamba naye.
translations.hypothesis: ULakkha Singh uphinde wanquma incwadi yezinkulumo ethi "chhappan bhog bhajan". Umculi, uRaju Khandelwal, wayemxoshana kulo msebenzi.

translations.source: At Thursday's keynote presentation of the Tokyo Game Show, Nintendo president Satoru Iwata unveiled the controller design for the company's new Nintendo Revolution console.
translations.reference: EsethulwenisangoLwesine esasingumongo se-Tokyo Game Show, umongameli we-Nintendo u-Satoru Iwata wadalula isakhiwo sesilawuli se-Nintendo Revolution sesilawuli esisha senkampani.
translations.hypothesis: Ngomhlangano omkhulu obenziwe ngoLwesine kwi-Tokyo Game Show, uNobhala we-Nintendo, uSatoru Iwata, ubonise umklamo walesi dolobha (controller) elizoshiswa yileli kakhompiyutha entsha ye-Nintendo Revolution.

translations.source: Resembling a television remote, the controller uses two sensors placed near the user's television to triangulate its position in three-dimensional space.
translations.reference: Isilawuli esifana ne-remote yethelevishini, sisebenzisa izinzwa ezimbili ezibekwe duzane nethelevishini ukwenza indawo yayo ibe nezingxenye ezintathu endaweni enezinhlangothi ezintathu.
translations.hypothesis: Lo mdlali, ofana nokulawuli kwe-television, usezinto ezimbili ezifakwe eduze kwe-television yomsebenzisi ukuze athole indawo yakhe endaweni ezintathu.

translations.source: This will allow players to control actions and movements in video games by moving the device through the air.
translations.reference: Lokhu kuzovumela abadlali ukuba balawule izenzo nokunyakaza emdlalweni wevidiyo ngokunyakazisa isisetshenziswa emoyeni.
translations.hypothesis: Lokhu kuzovumela abadlali ukuthi alawule izenzo kanye nokunyakaza ezimdlalweni kagesi ngokuyishayela idivayisi endaweni yangempela.

translations.source: Giancarlo Fisichella lost control of his car and ended the race very soon after the start.
translations.reference: UGiancarlo Fisichella wangakwazi ukuqondisa imoto yakhe futhi waqeda umjaho ngokushesha ngomva kokuba uqale.
translations.hypothesis: UGiancarlo Fisichella ulahlekelwe ukulawula imoto yakhe futhi ugcine ukuyeka umjaho maduze nje ngemuva kokuqala.

translations.source: His teammate Fernando Alonso was in the lead for most of the race, but ended it right after his pit-stop, probably because a badly tucked right front wheel.
translations.reference: Abeqembu lakhe u-Fernando Alonso bebephuma phambili cishe kuwoo wonke umjaho, kodwa kuphele ngokushesha nje ngemva kokupaka endaweni yokulungisa imoto, kungenzeka kungenxa yesondo langaphambili elifakwe kabi.
translations.hypothesis: Umdlali wakhe, uFernando Alonso, ubele phambili kakhulu kulo msebenzi wonke, kodwa ugcine ngemuva ngemuva kokungena kwakhe endaweni yokulungiswa, mhlawumbe ngenxa yendawo ephambili esandleni esidlule eyabe yaguguleka kakhulu.

translations.source: Michael Schumacher ended his race not long after Alonso, because of the suspension damage in the numerous battles during the race.
translations.reference: UMichael Schumacher waqeda umjaho wakhe kungekudala ngemva kuka-Alonso, ngenxa yokulimala kwesimo esigcina imoto iphakeme emishikashikeni eminingi phakathi nomjaho.
translations.hypothesis: UMichael Schumacher ugcine umjaho wakhe ngemuva nje kuka-Alonso, ngenxa yomonakalo owayenziwe kwi-suspension yakhe ngaphakathi kwezimpi eziningi ezazenzeka ngesikhathi somjaho.

translations.source: "She’s very cute and sings quite well, too," he said according to a transcript of the news conference.
translations.reference: "Muhle kakhulu futhi ucula kahle kakhulu, futhi," washo kuya ngamakhophi okukhulunyiwe wenkomfa yabezindaba.
translations.hypothesis: "Umnandi kakhulu futhi uyina kahle kakhulu," kusho yena, njengoba kuboniswe kwi-transkripthi yomhlangano wabezindaba.

translations.source: "I was moved every time we did a rehearsal on this, from the bottom of my heart."
translations.reference: Ngangithinteka ekujuleni kwenhliziyo yami, njalo lapho silungiselela lokhu.
translations.hypothesis: "Ngazizwa ngithakaselwa ngaso ngaso xesha lapho besiphinde-phinde lesi senjini, ngempela enhliziyweni yami."

translations.source: Around 3 minutes into the launch, an on-board camera showed numerous pieces of insulation foam break away from the fuel tank.
translations.reference: Cishe emizuzwini emithathu ngaphambi kokuqalisa, ikhamera esemkhumbini yaveza izingcezu eziningi zogwebu olufudumazayo luphuma ethangini lamafutha.
translations.hypothesis: Ngesikhathi esingamamitha ambalwa ngemuva kokuqaleka, ikhamera engaphakathi kwendawo yabonisa izingcezu eziningi zefomu lokuhlinzwa ezihlukumezile futhi zishiye itanki legesi.

translations.source: However, they are not thought to have caused any damage to the shuttle.
translations.reference: Nokho, akucatshangwa ukuthi zenze noma imuphi umonakalo enqoleni.
translations.hypothesis: Kodwa, akukho mibono ethize ukuthi lezi zinto zidlulele noma zenzile noma yiluphi uhlukemeko kwi-shuttle.

translations.source: NASA's shuttle program chief N. Wayne Hale Jr. said the foam had fallen "after the time we are concerned about."
translations.reference: Isikhulu sohlelo lwemikhumbi-mkhathi luka-NASA u-N. Wayne Hale Jr. uthe igwebu lase liwile "ngemuva kwesikhathi esikhathazekile ngazo."
translations.hypothesis: Umphathi ohleohlulelwe yohlelo lwezikebhe ze-NASA, u-N. Wayne Hale Jr., uthe uphuzi ubilokhu "ngemuva kwesikhathi esikhulu kakhulu esikhathazekayo."

translations.source: Five minutes into the display a wind starts rolling in, about a minute later, the wind is reaching 70km/h... then the rain comes, but so hard and so large that it slaps your skin like a needle, then hail fell from the sky, people panicking and screaming and running over each other.
translations.reference: Imizuzu emihlanu umbukiso uqalile umoya uqala ukungena, cishe ngemva komzuzu, umoya ufinyelela u-70km/h… bese imvula iyeza, kodwa enzima nenkulu kangangokuba ihlaba isikhumba sakho njengenaliti, bese isichotho sawa emkhathini, abantu bayaxhamazela futhi bayamemeza futhi bayagxobana.
translations.hypothesis: Emizuzu emihlanu ngemuva kokuqalisa umbukiso, umoya uqala ukungena, ngeminithi eyodwa kamuva, umoya ufiwa kuze ufike kuma-kilomitha angu-70/h... ngemuva kwalokho, imvula iqala, kodwa iyisimbi kakhulu futhi enkulu kangaka ukuthi ithinta isikhumba sakho njengentambo, bese kugijima ukukhanya, abantu bagcotshwa, basho izinto ezimbi futhi bagijima begxeke.

translations.source: I lost my sister and her friend, and on my way there were two disabled people in wheelchairs, people just jumping over and pushing them," Armand Versace said.
translations.reference: Ngilahlekelwe ngudadewethu kanye nomngane wakhe, futhi endleleni ngilibangise lapho bekunabantu ababili abakhubazekile ababehlezi ezihlalweni ezinamasondo, abantu bebeqa ngaphezulu futhi bebasunduza,” kusho u-Armand Versace.
translations.hypothesis: Ngilahlekelwe ngodadewami kanye nomngane wayo, futhi ngendlela yami, bekukhona abantu ababili abanokukhubazeka ababebezithungi, kanti abanye abantu begeqa nabo futhi bayabashelela. Lokhu kusho u-Armand Versace.

translations.source: NHK also reported that the Kashiwazaki Kariwa nuclear power plant in Niigata prefecture was operating normally.
translations.reference: I-NHK ibike nokuthi isifunda sesikhungo samandla wenuzi iKashiwazaki Karawa eNiigata besisebenza ngokuvamile.
translations.hypothesis: I-NHK iphinde yaqokela ukuthi umfula kagesi ka-Kashiwazaki Kariwa, okwasekuphathweni lase-Niigata, usebenza ngendlela evamile.

translations.source: Hokuriku Electric Power Co. reported no effects from the earthquake and that the Number 1 and 2 reactors at its Shika nuclear power plant were shut down.
translations.reference: IHokuriku Electric Power Co. ayibikanga ukuthinteka okuvela ekuzamazameni komhlaba nokuthi isiphehli Nombolo 1 no-2 esikhungweni sayo samandla enuzi zivaliwe.
translations.hypothesis: I-Hokuriku Electric Power Co. ithembise ukuthi akukho mthelela ovela kule nqubo yomhlaba futhi ukuthi ama-reactor ayi-1 kanye neyi-2 kwi-plant yayo yezindlu kagesi e-Shika ayevaliwe.

translations.source: It is reported that some 9400 homes in the region are without water and approximately 100 without electricity.
translations.reference: Kubikwe ukuthi amakhaya angaba ngu-9400 endaweni awanawo amanzi futhi cishe angu-100 awanawo ugesi.
translations.hypothesis: Kuthiwe cishe amakhaya ayi-9400 kule ndawo ayingenayo amanzi, futhi cishe amakhulu ayi-100 ayingenayo ugesi.

translations.source: Some roads have been damaged, railway service interrupted in the affected areas, and the Noto Airport in Ishikawa prefecture remains closed.
translations.reference: Eminye imigwaqo ibe nomonakalo, imisebenzi yesitimela iphazamisekile ezindaweni ezithintekile, futhi neSikhumulo Sezindiza saseNoto sasesifundazweni sase-Ishikawa sisavaliwe.
translations.hypothesis: Amanye amabhiliyoni amelelwe, izinsizakalo zotshwane zavezwe endaweni ethile, kanye ne-Noto Airport ephakathi i-Ishikawa isalokhu ingavalwa.

translations.source: One bomb exploded outside the governor general's office.
translations.reference: Ibhomu eyodwa iqhume ngaphandle kwehhovisi likandunankulu.
translations.hypothesis: Iphunga elilodwa luhlume ngaphandle kwegumbi likahulumeni.

translations.source: Three more bombs exploded near government buildings in a period of two hours.
translations.reference: Amabhomu amanye amathathu aqhumile eduze nezakhiwo zikahulumeni esikhathini samahora amabili.
translations.hypothesis: Amabhomu amanye amathathu aguqule eduze kwakhaya zombuso ezikhathini ezimbili.

translations.source: Some reports put the official death toll at eight, and official reports confirm that up to 30 were injured; but final numbers are not yet known.
translations.reference: Eminye imibiko ithi inani labafile elisemthethweni isishiyagalombili, futhi umbiko osemthethweni uqinisekisa ukuthi abantu abangaba ngu-30 balimele; kepha izinombolo zokugcina azikaziwa.
translations.hypothesis: Kuthiwa kulo mbiko okuthile ukuthi inani elisemthethweni labantu abashonile ngu-athisikhulu, futhi imibiko esemthethweni iqinisekile ukuthi kufikile ku-mathathu amashumi abalambile; kodwa inani eliqobo mayelana nalokhu akaziwa okwamanje.

translations.source: Both cyanuric acid and melamine were found in urine samples from pets that died after consuming contaminated pet food.
translations.reference: Kokubili i-cynuric acid kanye ne-melamine zitholakele kumasampula omchamo ovela ezilwaneni ezifuywayo ezishne ngemva kokudla ukudla kwezilwane okungcolile.
translations.hypothesis: Kokubalwa ukuthi kokubili i-cyanuric acid kanye ne-melamine zatholakala ezampelungwini zezilwane eziluphekile ngemva kokudla ukudla kwezilwane okubangelwe yintuthuko.

translations.source: The two compounds react with one another to form crystals that may block kidney function, researchers at the university said.
translations.reference: Izakhi ezimbili ziyaxubana ukuze zenze amakristalu angavimba ukusebenza kwezinso, kwasho abacwabingi basenyuvesi.
translations.hypothesis: Okwakudala izinto ezimbili ezihlanganisana ukuze zakhe amakristali angase zivimbele ukusebenza kwethambo. Abacwaningi baseyunivesithi bathi lokhu.

translations.source: The researchers observed crystals formed in cat urine by the addition of melamine and cyanuric acid.
translations.reference: Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi amakristalu enzeka emchamweni wekati ngokunezeleka kwe-milamine kanye ne-cyanuric acid.
translations.hypothesis: Abacwaningi babheke amakristali azenziwe ngamathayi ezinkomo ngemuva kokufakwa kwe-melamine kanye ne-cyanuric acid.

translations.source: The composition of these crystals matches those found in the urine of affected pets when compared by infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).
translations.reference: Ukwakheka kwalamakristalu kufana nalokho okutholakale emchamweni wezilwane ezifuywayo ezithintekile uma uqhathaniswa nge-infrared spectroscopy (FTIR).
translations.hypothesis: Ukuhlotshaniswa kwezikhathi zalezi zinto ezincane kufana nalokho okutholwe ekuphuzeni kwezilwane ezithintekile, njengoba kubonisiwe ngokuhlaziywa ngespectroscopy yama-infrared (FTIR).

translations.source: I don't know if you realize it or not, but most of the goods from Central America came into this country duty-free.
translations.reference: Angazi ukuthi uyakuphawula noma cha, kodwa iningi lezimpahla ezivela eMelika ePhakathi zeza kulelizwe ngaphandle kokukhokhiswa intela.
translations.hypothesis: Angazi ukuba niyazi yini noma cha, kodwa ezinye izinto eziningi ezivela eMelika Ephakathi zingenayo intela uma zifika kuleli zwe.

translations.source: Yet eighty percent of our goods were taxed through tariffs in Central American countries. we treat you.
translations.reference: Nokho amaphesenti ayisishiyagalombili wempahla yethu akhokhiswe intela ngezihlelo zokutheliswa kwempahla engenayo noma ephumayo ezweni emazweni waseMelika ePhakathi. Siyakuphatha.
translations.hypothesis: Kodwa-ke, amaphesenti ayisishumi ayisikhombisa yezimpahla zethu ayaxhaswe ngentela ngama-tarifu ezweni laseCentral America. Siyabazisa.

translations.source: That didn't seem to make sense to me; it certainly wasn't fair.
translations.reference: Lokho bekungenzi ingqondo kimi; bekungalungile nakanjani.
translations.hypothesis: Lokho akubonanga sengathi kuyenzelwe; bekungabukhulu kakhulu.

translations.source: All I say to people is you treat us the way we treat you.
translations.reference: Engikushoyo nje kubantu ngukuthi siphathe ngendlela esikuphatha ngayo.
translations.hypothesis: Konke okungichaza kubantu ukuthi niphathwe ngendlela esiphathwayo ngayo.

translations.source: California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger signed into law a bill that bans the sale or rental of violent video games to minors.
translations.reference: UMbusi waseCalifornia u-Arnorld Schwarzenegger ugunyaze umthetho ovivinywayo ovimbela ukudayisela noma ukuqashisela izingane imidlalo yevidiyo enodleme ukuba ube umthetho.
translations.hypothesis: UMphathisa wephulathwe yaseCalifornia, u-Arnold Schwarzenegger, usayine umthetho owenza ukuntengiselwa noma ukugqokiselwa izingane ezincane amageyimu evidiyo anobungozi kube yinto engamukeleki.

translations.source: The bill requires violent video games sold in the state of California to be labeled with a decal reading "18" and makes their sale to a minor punishable by a fine of $1000 per offense.
translations.reference: Irisidi ebonisa ukudayiswa kwemidlalo yevidiyo embusweni wase-California ephawulwe ngokuthi “18”okwenza umthengisi wayo ahlawuliswe imali engu-$1000 icala ngalinye.
translations.hypothesis: Lo mthetho udinga ukuthi amageyimu evidiyo anobungozi athengiswa kwisifundazwe saseCalifornia afakwe ilebhili elithi "18" kuyo, futhi ukuthengiswa kwawo kubantfwana kufanele kuhlaziywe ngemali yokuhleleka engu-$1000 ngalokho okwenziwe.

translations.source: The Director of Public Prosecutions, Kier Starmer QC, gave a statement this morning announcing the prosecution of both Huhne and Pryce.
translations.reference: UMqondisi wezoKubekwa Kwamacala koMphakathi, uKier Starmer QC, unikeze isitatimende namuhla ekuseni ememezela ukubekwa kwecala kukaHuhne kanye noPryce bobabili.
translations.hypothesis: UMphathi Wezokulwa Izincwadi Zombuso, uKier Starmer QC, wanikeza isitatimende namhlanje ekuseni, wazisa ngokuthi uHuhne noPryce bazobuyiswa ekhosini.

translations.source: Huhne has resigned and he will be replaced in the Cabinet by Ed Davey MP. Norman Lamb MP is expected to take the Business Minister job Davey is vacating.
translations.reference: UHuhne ushiye phansi futhi isikhundla sakhe kuKhabhinethi sizothathwa ngu-Ed Davey MP. UNorman Lamb MP kulindeleke ukuthi athathe umsebenzi wobuNgqongqoshe Wezamabhizinisi lo oyekwe uDavey.
translations.hypothesis: U-Huhne usukile esikhundleni sakhe, futhi u-Ed Davey, umLungu oPhathisiwe wePhalamende, kuzoba umphathi omusha kwiKhabinethi. Kulindeleke ukuthi u-Norman Lamb, umLungu oPhathisiwe wePhalamende, azothatha indima ka-Davey njengomphathi wezeBhizinisi.

translations.source: Huhne and Pryce are scheduled to appear at the Westminster Magistrates Court on February 16.
translations.reference: UHhne kanye noPryce bahlelelwe ukuvela eNkantolo kaMatshi yaseWestminster ngoNhlolanja 16,
translations.hypothesis: U-Huhne no-Pryce bahlelelwe ukuba bavelise enkantolo yama-Magistrates e-Westminster ngomhla ka-16 kuNhlolanja.

translations.source: The fatalities were Nicholas Alden, 25, and Zachary Cuddeback, 21. Cuddeback had been the driver.
translations.reference: Ukufa kukaNicholas Alden, ona-25, kanye noZachary Cuddeback, ona-21. UCuddeback wayengumshayeli.
translations.hypothesis: Abantu abashone kwakuyi-Nicholas Alden, oneminyaka engama-25, kanye no-Zachary Cuddeback, oneminyaka engama-21. U-Cuddeback wayeyiphayisiki.

translations.source: Edgar Veguilla received arm and jaw wounds while Kristoffer Schneider was left requiring reconstructive surgery for his face.
translations.reference: U-Edga Veguilla wathola amanxeba wasengalweni nasemhlathini kuyilapho u-Kristoffer Schneider wasala edinga ukuhlizwa kokwakha kabusha ebusweni.
translations.hypothesis: UMnu Edgar Veguilla uthukuthelwe esandleni nasegatsheni, kanti uMnu Kristoffer Schneider kumele ashise ukuthi uyophathwa ngokusetshenziswa kwezokwelashwa ukuze ubuso bakhe buyakuvikelwa.

translations.source: Uka's weapon failed whilst pointed at a fifth man's head. Schneider has ongoing pain, blindness in one eye, a missing section of skull and a face rebuilt from titanium.
translations.reference: Isikhali sika-Uka sahluleka lapho wayekhombe indoda yesihlanu ekhanda. U-Schneider wayenobuhlungu obungapheli, ukungaboni esweni elilodwa, ingxenye yogebhezi engekho kanye nobuso obakhiwe kabusha nge-titanium.
translations.hypothesis: Ibhidi lika'Uka belokhuphazama ngesikhathi eliqondile ekhanda lomunye umuntu wesihlanu. U-Schneider usaqhubeka nokuba nesikhukhuni, ukungaboni ngombono kuyo yonke into ekukho kuyo, ingxenye engapheli yengxenye yegazi lakhe, kanye nobuso obakhiwe ngengobozi.

translations.source: Schneider testified via videolink from a USAF base in his homeland.
translations.reference: U-Schneider wanikeza ubufakazi ngevidiyo kusuka esikhungweni se-USAF ezweni lakubo.
translations.hypothesis: UShoneka uSchneider ngokuphimiselwa kwevidiyo esikhungweni samasosha sase-USAF endaweni yakubo.

translations.source: Beyond Wednesday's event, Carpanedo competed in two individual races at the Championships.
translations.reference: Ngale kwesehlakalo sangolwesithathu, uCarpanedo uncintisane emijahweni emibili ngayinye yobuShampeni.
translations.hypothesis: Ngaphandle komcimbi kaLwesithathu, uCarpanedo uqhubekile ezimbili zezinketheni ezimakhulu ngomuntu ngamunye kuleli nqhudelwano.

translations.source: Her first was the Slalom, where she earned a Did Not Finish in her first run. 36 of the 116 competitors had the same result in that race.
translations.reference: Umncintiswano wakhe wokuqala bekuyi-Slalom, lapho Engaqedanga khona umncintiswano wakhe wokuqala. Abancintisanayo abangu-36 kwabangu-116 bathole imiphumela efanayo kulowo mncintiswano.
translations.hypothesis: Okokuqala kwakhe kwaba yi-Slalom, lapho athole umphumela "akamuhlelwanga ukugcina" (Did Not Finish) okokuqala. Abafundi abangu-36 kwezingu-116 ababeluthanda bahlulekile ngomphumela ofanayo kulo mdlalo.

translations.source: Her other race, the Giant Slalom, saw her finish in tenth in the women's sitting group with a combined run time of 4:41.30, 2:11.60 minutes slower than first place finisher Austrian Claudia Loesch and 1:09.02 minutes slower than the ninth place finisher Gyöngyi Dani of Hungary.
translations.reference: Omunye umjaho wakhe, i-Giant Slalom, waqeda engoweshumi eqenjini labesifazane elalihlezi nesikhathi esihlanganisiwe esingu-4:41.30, wayesemuva ngo-2:11.60 ku-Austrian Claudia Loesch owathatha indawo yokuqala futhi wayesemuva ngo- 1:09.02 k-uGyöngyi Dani wase-Hungary owaqeda ekwindawo yesishiyagalolunye.
translations.hypothesis: Kuleminye umncintiswano wayo, i-Giant Slalom, ugcine yesikhombisa kwiqembu labafazana abagibele, nangesikhathi sokugijima esihambisene sokuma ku-4:41.30, okwathi kungama-2:11.60 amaminithi ngemuva kuka-Claudia Loesch wase-Austria owawugijima ngesikhathi esikhulu, kanye namaminithi angu-1:09.02 ngemuva kuka-Gyöngyi Dani wase-Hungary owawugijima yesine.

translations.source: Four skiers in the women's sitting group failed to finish their runs, and 45 of the 117 total skiers in the Giant Slalom failed to rank in the race.
translations.reference: Abashushuluza eqhweni abane eqenjini labesifazane abahlezi bahluleke ukuqeda imijaho yabo, futhi abangu-45 kwabangu-117 abashushuluza eqhweni eSlalom eNkulu bahluleke ukuthola izikhundla emjahweni.
translations.hypothesis: Abafundi benzi bezintambo abane kwiqembu labafundi abahlala ezinyathelweni bephuthelwe ukuqeda ukugijima kwabo, futhi abafundi benzi bezintambo abangu-45 kwezingu-117 ezazihlalise kulo mdlalo wase-Giant Slalom bephuthelwe ukuthola izikhundla.

translations.source: The Madhya Pradesh Police recovered the stolen laptop and mobile phone.
translations.reference: Amaphoyisa aseMadhya Pradesh amukele ikhompyutha ephathwayo kanye nomakhalekhukhwini.
translations.hypothesis: Amapholisa ase-Madhya Pradesh bathole i-laptop ne-iphoni eziboliwe.

translations.source: Deputy Inspector General D K Arya said, "We have arrested five persons who raped the Swiss woman and recovered her mobile and laptop".
translations.reference: Iphini loMphenyi oMkhulu uD K Arya uthe, "Sibophe abantu abahlanu abanukubeze ngokocansi owesifazane waseSwitzerland futhi simbuyisele ucingo lwakhe kanye ne-laptop".
translations.hypothesis: UMphathi Omkhulu osegameni lika-D K Arya uthe, "Sithathe abantu abahlanu abayilimele indlovukazi yaseSwitzerland, futhi sathola ucingo lwayo kanye nekhompyutha yayo."

translations.source: The accused are named as Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar and Vishnu Kanjar.
translations.reference: Abasolwa babizwa ngoBaba Kanjar, uBhutha Kanjar, uRampro Kanjar, uGaza Kanjar kanye noVishnu Kanjar.
translations.hypothesis: Abashoshwa bathulwe ngamagama alandelayo: Baba Kanjar, Bhutha Kanjar, Rampro Kanjar, Gaza Kanjar kanye noVishnu Kanjar.

translations.source: Police superintendent Chandra Shekhar Solanki said the accused appeared in court with covered faces.
translations.reference: Umphathi wamaphoyisa uChandra Solanki uthe abasolwa bavele enkantolo bazifihle ubuso.
translations.hypothesis: UMphathi wepolisi uChandra Shekhar Solanki uthe umuntu oshaywe ubonise ekhosini kanti uvalwe izikhathi zakhe ukuze kungabonakali.

translations.source: Although three people were inside the house when the car impacted it, none of them were hurt.
translations.reference: Nakuba bekunabantu abathathu phakathi kwendlu ngenkathi imoto iyishayisa, akekho kubo olimele.
translations.hypothesis: Nakuba kwakunezinhlanhla ezintathu ngaphakathi endlini ngesikhathi imoto yayiphutha, kodwa akukhobungoti obulimale.

translations.source: However, the driver sustained serious injuries to the head.
translations.reference: Noma kunjalo, umshayeli uthole izingozi ezimbi ekhanda.
translations.hypothesis: Kodwa, umshayeli uthukuthelwe kakhulu ekhanda.

translations.source: The road where the crash happened was temporarily closed while emergency services freed the driver from the red Audi TT.
translations.reference: Umgwaqo lapho inhlekelele yenzeka khona wavalwa okwesikhashana ngesikhathi izisebenzi zezimo eziphuthumayo zikhulula umshayeli kuyi-Audi TT ebomvu.
translations.hypothesis: Indlela lapho igoduka khona igoduka yayivaliwe ngesikhathi esithile kanti izinsizakalo zokuphuthumayo zenzelwe ukuthi zikhulule umshayeli owayekho ngaphakathi kwimoto eyi-Audi TT embomvu.

translations.source: He was initially hospitalised in the James Paget Hospital in Great Yarmouth.
translations.reference: Uqale wangeniswa esibhedlela sase-James Paget e–Yarmouth eNkulu.
translations.hypothesis: Ukuqala, wathunyelwa esibhedlela i-James Paget esikulo i-Great Yarmouth.

translations.source: He was subsequently relocated to Addenbrooke's Hospital in Cambridge.
translations.reference: Ngokulandelayo uye watholakala eSibhedlela i-Addenbrooke e-Cambridge.
translations.hypothesis: Ngemuva kwalokho, udluliselwe esibhedlela i-Addenbrooke's e-Cambridge.

translations.source: Adekoya has since been in Edinburgh Sheriff Court charged with murdering her son.
translations.reference: uAdekoya selokhu eseNkantolo ka-Sheriff yas-Edinburgh etheswe icala lokubulala indodana yakhe.
translations.hypothesis: UGqoke u-Adekoya usevele ukhona enkantolo yase-Edinburgh, lapho egxekwa khona ngokubulala ingane yakhe.

translations.source: She is in custody pending indictment and trial, but any eyewitness evidence may be tainted because her image has been widely published.
translations.reference: Uboshiwe njengoba esalinde ukubekwa nokuthethwa kwecala, kodwa noma ibuphi ubufakazi bofakazi bokuzibonela bungonakaliswa njengoba isithombe sakhe sishicilelwe kabanzi.
translations.hypothesis: Uyilowo futhi isalwe, ilindile ukuthi ibuyiswe ekhosini nokuqinisekiswa kwakho. Kodwa-ke, noma yimiphi imininingwane eyobona eyenziwe ngabanye abantu ingase ibe engenalo ukwethembeka ngoba ubuso bayo busetshenzisiwe kakhulu ezindabeni.

translations.source: This is common practice elsewhere in the UK but Scottish justice works differently and courts have viewed publication of photos as potentially prejudicial.
translations.reference: Lena inqubo evamile kwezinye izindawo e-UK kodwa umthetho waseScotland usebenza ngokuhlukile futhi izinkantolo zibone ukushicilelwa kwezithombe njengokungonakalisa.
translations.hypothesis: Lokhu kuyindlela evamile esetshenziswa kwamanye amabhizinisi e-United Kingdom, kodwa uhlelo lwezobulungiswa wase-Scotland lusebenza ngendlela ehlukile, futhi amakhothi abonile ukuthi ukushicilelwa kwezithombe kungaba nomthelela omubi.

translations.source: Professor Pamela Ferguson of the University of Dundee notes "journalists do seem to be walking a dangerous line if publishing photos etc of suspects."
translations.reference: Usolwazi Pamela Ferguson wase Nyuvesi yase-Dundee uyabhala “izintantheli zizibizela amathonsi abanzi ngokushicilela izithombe nokunye kwabasolwa.”
translations.hypothesis: UProfesa Pamela Ferguson yaseNyuvesi yaseDundee uthi: "Kubonakala sengathi abafundisi bezindaba bayengena ezinkingeni uma bashicilela izithombe noma okunye okufanayo mayelana nabasolwa."

translations.source: Crown Office, which is in overall charge of prosecutions, has indicated to journalists that no further comment will be made at least until indictment.
translations.reference: I-Crown Office, okuyiyo ephethe uphenyo, itshele izintatheli ukuthi ngeke iphawule okungenani kuze kube ukuthethwa kwecala.
translations.hypothesis: I-Crown Office, okuyiphini eliqondile kwezocingo, isixwayise abezindaba ukuthi ngeke yenze noma yimiphi imibono eyengeziwe, okungenani kuze kube yilapho kukhishwa umyalelo wokubeka umuntu engalweni.

translations.source: The document, according to the leak, will refer to the borders dispute, which Palestine wants based on the borders before the 1967 Mideast War.
translations.reference: Lo mbhalo, ngokwalokho okuputshukile, uzobhekisa embangweni wemingcele, iPalestine ewufunayo ngokusekelwe emingceleni ngaphambi kweMpi YaseMpumalanga yango-1967.
translations.hypothesis: Ngokubonsisa kwalesi zindaba, lo mbhalo uzokhuluma ngengxabano yemigomo, okuthi iPalestine ifuna ukuthi ibekwe ngokuya ngemigomo yangaphambi komkhankaso wempi wase-Middle East ka-1967.

translations.source: Other topics covered reportedly include the future state of Jerusalem which is sacred to both nations and the Jordan Valley issue.
translations.reference: Ezinye izihloko ezikhona zihlanganisa ikusasa leJerusalema eligcwele kuzo zombili izizwe kanye nenkinga Yesigodi saseJordani.
translations.hypothesis: Ezinye izihloko ezikhulunywe, ngokusho kwamanye amafomu, zifaka ukusetshenziswa kwasekuseni laseJerusalem, okuyindawo engenamakhosi kubomi bomphakathi wabo bobabili, kanye nenkinga yendawo yaseJordan.

translations.source: Israel demands an ongoing military presence in the valley for ten years once an agreement is signed while the PA agrees to leave such presence only for five years.
translations.reference: I-Israyeli ifuna ukuba amasosha aqhubeke ekhona esigodini iminyaka eyishumi uma nje isivumelwano sisayinilwe nakuba i-PA ivuma ukuba amasosha abe khona iminyaka eyisihlanu kuphela.
translations.hypothesis: I-Israel ifuna ukuba kukhona amasosha ngokuphindaphindiwe kuleli dolobha cishe iminyaka eyishumi ngemuva kokuthi kusayine umbutho, kanti i-PA ayavuma ukuthi lawa masosha akhona kuphela iminyaka emihlanu.

translations.source: Shooters in the supplementary pest control trial were to be closely supervised by rangers, as the trial was monitored and its effectiveness evaluated.
translations.reference: Abadubuli esivivinyweni esingeziwe sokulawula izinambuzane kwakufanele bagadwe eduze abaqaphi, njengoba uhlolo lwaluqashwe futhi ukusebenza kwalo kwahlolwa.
translations.hypothesis: Abadlali abayisikhathi esetshenziselwa ukuhlola ukulawulwa kwezinambuzane bezokufakelwa kumele babukelwe ngqo ngabaphathi, ngoba leli hlolo laliqokwe futhi kuhlosiwe ukuthi liyasebenza yini.

translations.source: In a partnership of NPWS and the Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, qualified volunteers were recruited, under the Sporting Shooters Association's hunting program.
translations.reference: Ngokubambisana neNPWS kanye neSporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, amavolontiya afanelekayo abuthwa, ngaphansi kohlelo lokuzingela lweSporting Shooters Association.
translations.hypothesis: Ngenhlanganisela phakathi kwe-NPWS kanye ne-Sporting Shooters Association of Australia (NSW) Inc, abavolontiya abaqeqeshiwe baselethwe, ngaphansi kohlelo lokuhlenga lwe-Sporting Shooters Association.

translations.source: According to Mick O'Flynn, the Acting Director Park Conservation and Heritage with the NPWS, the four shooters selected for the first shooting operation received comprehensive safety and training instruction.
translations.reference: NgokukaMick O’Flynn, Umqondisi Obambele wePaki Lokonga Nefa kanye neNPWS, abadubuli abane abakhethwe ohlelweni lokudubula bathola ukuqeqeshwa okujulile kokuphepha nokuqeqesha.
translations.hypothesis: Ngokwamazwi ka-Mick O'Flynn, oyiSikhulu Esikhulu Esisebenza esikhathini esifushane kwezokulondoloza amapaki kanye nomlando kwi-NPWS, abafana abane abakhethwe ukuba bahlale kulo mbusho wokuqala bathole izifundo eziyinkimbinkimbi mayelana nokuphepha kanye nokuhlaliswa.

translations.source: Martelly swore in a new Provisional Electoral Council (CEP) of nine members yesterday.
translations.reference: UMartelly ufungiise i-Provisional Electora Council (CEP) entsha enamalunga ayisishiyagalolunye izolo.
translations.hypothesis: Ngomso, uMartelly ufake umphakathi omusha onamagqamu ayisishiyagalolunye weBhodi Eliqondile Lokhelelwa (CEP).

translations.source: It is Martelly's fifth CEP in four years.
translations.reference: I-CEP yesihlanu eminyakeni emine ka-Martelly.
translations.hypothesis: Kunguyiphuluzi yesihlanu ka-Martelly kule minyaka emine.

translations.source: Last month a presidential commission recommended the prior CEP's resignation as part of a package of measures to move the country towards new elections.
translations.reference: Ngenyanga edlule ikhomishani yobumongameli ituse ukuyeka isikhundla kwe-CEP kwangaphambili njengengxenye yezinyathelo zokwenza izwe ukuba livote.
translations.hypothesis: Ngenyanga edlule, ikhomishini yezinduna yethule isiphakamiso sokuthi umphathi wangaphambilini we-CEP masikhulelwe, njengengxenye yezinqubomgomo ezihlukahlukene ezihloselwe ukuthi izwe liye ngqo ezinkululelweni ezintsha.

translations.source: The commission was Martelly's response to widespread anti-regime protests that started in October.
translations.reference: Ukwenza bekuwukusabela kukaMartelly ekubhikisheni ngokumelene nohulumeni okusakazekile okuqale ngoMfumfu.
translations.hypothesis: Ikomishini yaba yimpendulo kaMartelly kumaphrotesti amaningi akhishwe abantu abaphikisa ubukhosi, aqalile ngo-Okthoba.

translations.source: The sometimes-violent protests were triggered by failure to hold elections, some due since 2011.
translations.reference: Ukubhikisha okuba nodlame ngezinye izikhathi kususwe ukuhluleka kokuba nokhetho, olunye okwakufanele lube khona kusukela ngo-2011.
translations.hypothesis: Izinkulumo zombango, ezazihlanganisa nezimo zokuhlushwa ngamanye amathuba, ziqukethwe ukwehluleka kokubamba izinkundla zikazwelonke, ezinye ezazimele kusukela ngonyaka ka-2011.

translations.source: Around 60 cases of malfunctioning iPods overheating have been reported, causing a total of six fires and leaving four people with minor burns.
translations.reference: Izigameko ezicishe zibe ngu-60 zama-iPod angasebenzi kahle zibikiwe, ezidale ingqikithi yemililo eyisithupha nokushiye abantu abane beshe kancane.
translations.hypothesis: Imibiko ibalelwe cishe ku-60 mayelana ne-iPod ezimele ezishisayo, okubangela umlilo owodwa kanye nokuthi abanye abantu abane bathinteke kancane ngokushesha.

translations.source: Japan's Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) said that it had been aware of 27 accidents related to the devices.
translations.reference: I-Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI) ithe ibe yazi ngezenzakalo ezingu-27 ezihlobene nale mishini.
translations.hypothesis: UMnyango wezomnotho, wokuhweba kanye nezimboni waseJapane (METI) uthe wayazi ngemithamo engama-27 edluliselwe ngalezi zinto.

translations.source: Last week, METI announced that Apple had informed it of 34 additional overheating incidents, which the company called "non-serious."
translations.reference: Ngeviki elidlule, iMETI imemezele ukuthi i-Apple iyazise ngezigamego zokushisa ngokweqile ezengeziwe ezingu-34, lezo inkampani ezibize ngokuthi "into engeyona enkulu."
translations.hypothesis: Ngeveki edlule, i-METI yathengisa ukuthi i-Apple yayiyenze yazisa ngemikhuba eyishumi ne-34 eyengeziwe yokushisa kakhulu, okuthi inkampani ibize "okungabubufuthe."

translations.source: The ministry responded by calling Apple's postponement of the report "truly regrettable."
translations.reference: Umnyango uphendule ngokubiza ukuhlehlisa kwe-Apple lo mbiko "kuyadabukisa ngempela."
translations.hypothesis: Ihhovisi laphindze liphendule ngokuthi ukubambezelelwa kwephrofayela ka-Apple "kuwubunzulu obungavamile."

translations.source: The eathquake struck Mariana at 07:19 a.m. local time (09:19 p.m. GMT Friday).
translations.reference: Ukuzamazama komhlaba kuhlasele i-Mariana ngo-07:19 ekuseni wesikhathi sakhona (09:19 ntambama ngoLwesihlanu GMT).
translations.hypothesis: Umhlabathini uqhamuke eMariana ngo-07:19 ekuseni ngesikhathi sasekhaya (ngu-09:19 ebusuku ngoLwesihlanu ngesikhathi sase-GMT).

translations.source: The Northern Marianas emergency management office said that there were no damages reported in the nation.
translations.reference: Ihhovisi lokulawula izimo eziphuthumayo laseNyakatho Marianas lithe awukho umonakalo obikiwe ezweni.
translations.hypothesis: Ihhovisi yokuphatha izimo eziphuthumayo e-Northern Marianas ithe akukho umonakalo owodwa obikwe kulo mzantsi.

translations.source: Also the Pacific Tsunami Warning Center said that there was no Tsunami indication.
translations.reference: Futhi i-Pacific Tsunami Warning Agency Center ithe akukho okukhombisa i-Tsunami.
translations.hypothesis: Ngaphandle kwalokho, i-Pacific Tsunami Warning Center ithe ukuthi akukho zinkomba zokusondela kwegwadala elikhulu.

translations.source: A former Filipino policeman has kept Hong Kong tourists hostage by hijacking their bus in Manila, the capital of the Philippines.
translations.reference: Lowo owayeyiphoyisa lasePhilippines uthumbe izivakashi zaseHong Kong ngokuthumba ibhasi lazo eManila, inhlokodolobha yasePhilippines.
translations.hypothesis: Umphathi owayeyisikhulu samaphoyisa ePhilippines uqede ukubamba izivakashi zaseHong Kong, wabagxilise emotweni yabo ngokuwubusa ngamandla eManila, edolobha elikhulu lePhilippines.

translations.source: Rolando Mendoza fired his M16 rifle at the tourists.
translations.reference: URolando Mandoza wadubula isibhamu sakhe se-M16 ezivakashini.
translations.hypothesis: URolando Mendoza udilize irhafu yakhe ye-M16 kubagibeli.

translations.source: Several hostages have been rescued and least six have been confirmed dead so far.
translations.reference: Izithunjwa ezimbalwa zikhululiwe futhi kuqinisekiswe ukuthi okungenani eziyisithupha zishonile kuze kube manje.
translations.hypothesis: Abantu abaningi ababambe iqiniso basekelwe, futhi kuze kube manje, kutholakale ukuthi okungenani abathathu sebefile.

translations.source: Six hostages, including the children and elderly, were released early, as were the Filipino photographers.
translations.reference: Izithunjwa eziyisithupha, kuhlanganise izingane kanye nabakhulile, zikhululwe masinya, kanjalo nangabathathi bezithombe basePhilippines.
translations.hypothesis: Abantu abayisithupha ababoshwe, okubalwa abantwana kanye nabantu abadala, bashoniswe ngokushesha, njengoba nabanikazi bezithombe base-Philippines.

translations.source: The photographers later took the place of an aged lady as she needed the lavatory. Mendoza was gunned down.
translations.reference: Abathathi bezithombe kamuva bathatha indawo yesalukazi njengoba besidinga indlu yangasese. Umendoza wadutshulwa.
translations.hypothesis: Abathwebuli bezithombe kamuva bathatha indawo yomfazi omdala ngoba udinga ukuya egameni. UMendoza udutshulwe ngamabhu.

translations.source: Liggins followed in his father’s footsteps and entered a career in medicine.
translations.reference: ULiggins walandela izinyathelo zikayise futhi wasebenza emkhakheni wezokwelapha.
translations.hypothesis: ULiggins walandela izinyathelo zonyakaziyabo futhi waqala umsebenzi ezindaweni zezokwelapha.
