translations.source: He trained as an obstetrician and began to work at the Auckland's National Women's Hospital in 1959.
translations.reference: Ufundele ukuba udokotela wokubelethisa futhi waqala ukusebenza e-Auckland's National Womens's Hospital ngo-1959,
translations.hypothesis: Ufunde ukuze abe udokotela ochwepheshe kwezokuzala futhi waqala ukusebenza esibhedlela esikhulu sezinsuku zabesifazane e-Auckland ngonyaka ka-1959.

translations.source: While he was working at the hospital Liggins began to investigate premature labor during his spare time.
translations.reference: Ngenkathi esebenza esibhedlela uLiggins waqala ukuphenya imihelo efika singakafiki isikhathi sokubeletha lapho engasebenzi.
translations.hypothesis: Ngenkathi uLiggins etshala emtholampini, waqala ukuhlola ukubeleka okudala ngaphambi kosuku olufanele, ngesikhathi sakhe sengikhululekile.

translations.source: His research showed that if a hormone was administered it would speed up the baby's foetal lung maturation.
translations.reference: Ucwaningo lwakhe lubonise ukuthi uma ihomoni isetshenziswa izokwenza ukuba ukukhula kwamaphaphu wombungu wengane kusheshe.
translations.hypothesis: Ucwaningo lwakhe ubonise ukuthi uma uhomoni ethathwa, kungenza ukuthi impilo yengane esembilini ithuthuke ngokushesha, ikakhulukazi emazingeni emfundo yayo.

translations.source: Xinhua reported that government investigators recovered two 'black box' flight recorders on Wednesday.
translations.reference: I-Xinhua yabika ukuthi abaphenyi bakahulumeni bathola ama-“black box” amabilii okurekhoda izindiza ngoLwesithathu.
translations.hypothesis: I-Xinhua ixashele ukuthi abaphandi kahulumeni bathole amabhokisi amabili "amnyama" ezikhumbuzi zombukiso zendiza ngoLwesithathu.

translations.source: Fellow wrestlers also paid tribute to Luna.
translations.reference: Umdlali we-wrestling naye washo amazwi okuhlonipha uLuna.
translations.hypothesis: Abanye abalingisi bezilwane nabo bakhulekile kwi-Luna.

translations.source: Tommy Dreamer said "Luna was the first Queen of Extreme. My first manager. Luna passed away on the night of two moons. Pretty unique just like her. Strong woman."
translations.reference: UTommy Dreamer wathi “uLuna bekuyiNdlovukazi Yokwedlulele yokuqala. Umphathi wami wokuqala. ULuna washona ngobusuku bezinyanga ezimbili. Kuyingqayizivele njengaye. Owesifazane Onamandla.”
translations.hypothesis: UTommy Dreamer uthe: "U-Luna wayengumfazi wokuqala owayehlanganiswa njenge-'Queen of Extreme'. Wayengumphathi wami wokuqala. U-Luna wahlala ngobusuku obubili bezinyanga. Kwakuyinto eyodwa, njengaye. Wayengumfazi onamandla."

translations.source: Dustin "Goldust" Runnels commented that "Luna was as freaky as me...maybe even more...love her and will miss her...hopefully she's in a better place."
translations.reference: U-Dustin “Thulilwegolide” Runnels waphawula ngokuthi “uLuna wayehlanya njengami...mhlawumbe ukungidlula...ngiyamthanda futhi ngizomkhumbula...ngiyethemba usendaweni engcono.”
translations.hypothesis: UDustin "Goldust" Runnels uthe, "U-Luna wayengumuntu oyingqayizivele njengami...mhlawumbe ngaphezulu...ngiyamthanda futhi ngizomkhumbula...ngiyethemba ukuthi usefundleni elingcono."

translations.source: Out of 1,400 people polled prior to the 2010 federal election, those who oppose Australia becoming a republic grew by 8 per cent since 2008.
translations.reference: Phakathi kwabantu abangu-1,400 abavote ngaphambi kokhetho lukahulumeni 2010, labo ababengavumelani nokuthi i-Australia ibe iriphabhuliki banda ngamaphesenti angu-8 kusukela ngo-2008.
translations.hypothesis: Kwi-1,400 abantu abebuzwe ngaphambi kokhetho kazwelonke ka-2010, labo abathi kufanele i-Australia ingabe iyisiqembu sezizwe (republic) ngaphakathi, inani labo lwandile ngo-8% kusukela ngonyaka ka-2008.

translations.source: Caretaker Prime Minister Julia Gillard claimed during the campaign of the 2010 federal election that she believed Australia should become a republic at the end of Queen Elizabeth II's reign.
translations.reference: UNdunankulu Wokunakekela uJulia Gillard wathi phakathi nomkhankaso wokhetho lwango-2010 wayekholelwa ukuthi i-Astralia kumelwe ibe izwe elibuswa ngentando yeningi ngemva kokubusa kweNdlovukazi uElizabeth II.
translations.hypothesis: UMphathisa-Mnu, uJulia Gillard, uthe ngesikhathi nomkhankaso wephini likahulumeni ka-2010, ukuthi wayengakholelwa ukuthi i-Australia kufanele ibe yi-republiclapho ukubusa kukaMakhosikazi uElizabeth II kuphela.

translations.source: 34 per cent of those in the poll share this view, wanting Queen Elizabeth II to be Australia's last monarch.
translations.reference: Amaphesenti angu-34 walabo abavotayo unalombono, ufuna Indlovukazi u-Elizabeth II ukuba abe umbusi wokugcina wase-Australia.
translations.hypothesis: Amaphesenti angama-34 wabantu ababambe iqhaza kulo mbuzo banokufanisa nalolu mbono, futhi bafisa ukuthi uMbuso kaQueen Elizabeth II ube umbuso wokugcina e-Australia.

translations.source: At the extremes of the poll, 29 per cent of those surveyed believe Australia should become a republic as soon as possible, while 31 per cent believe Australia should never become a republic.
translations.reference: Emananini adlulele wokuvota, amaphesentu angu-29 walabo ababuzwe imibuzo bakholelwa ukuthi i-Australia kumelwe ibe yiriphabhuliki ngokushesha ngangokunokwenzeka, kuyilapho amaphesenti angu-31 akholelwa ukuthi i-Australia akumelwe ibe yiriphabhuliki.
translations.hypothesis: Kwiqiniso elikhulu, amaphesenti angama-29 wabo abubhalwe ngqo kuthi i-Australia kufanele ibe yi-republic ngokushesha okukhulu, kanti amaphesenti angama-31 kuthi i-Australia akufanele nakanjani ibe yi-republic.

translations.source: The Olympic gold medalist was due to swim in the 100m and 200m freestyle and in three relays at the Commonwealth Games, but due to his complaints his fitness has been in doubt.
translations.reference: Lowo owathola indondo yegolide kuma-Olimpiki kwakumelwe ahlanganyele emcintiswaneni wokubhukude we-100m kanye ne-200m wokubhukuda nganoma iyiphi indlela futhi kunemidlalo yokunikezelana eMidlalweni yama-Commonwealth, kodwa ngenxa yokukhalaza kwakhe kuyasolwa ukuthi unamandla ngokomzimba.
translations.hypothesis: Umhlabathi we-olimpiki ogolide wayehlose ukungena ezimbili zezinkundla zokuwimisa, eyi-100m kanye ne-200m, kanye ezinkundleni ezintathu zokuwimisa kweqembu kwi-Commonwealth Games, kodwa ngenxa yezinkinga zakhe, ukuthi ngempela uyazilungiselela ukuncintisana kuye kwaba yinkinga.

translations.source: He has been unable to take the drugs needed to overcome his pain as they are banned from the Games.
translations.reference: Akakwazanga ukuthatha imithi edingekayo yokulwisana nobuhlungu bakhe njengoba ingavunyelwe eMidlalweni.
translations.hypothesis: Akakwazi ukuthatha imithi edingekayo ukuze aluleke ubuhlungu bakhe ngoba le midili ayivunyelwe kulo mdlalo.

translations.source: Curtis Cooper, a mathematician and computer science professor at the University of Central Missouri, has discovered the largest known prime number to date on January 25.
translations.reference: U-Curtis Cooper, usozibalo nophinde abe ngusolwazi wesayensi yamakhompuyutha eNyuvesi yaseCentral Missouri, uthole inombolo enkulu kunazo zonke kuze kube manje ongakwazi ukuyidivayida ngayo ngokwayo ngoMasingina 25.
translations.hypothesis: UMnu Curtis Cooper, umfundi wezibalo kanye nomfundisi wezifundo zobuchwepheshe bekhompyutha eNyuvesi yaseCentral Missouri, uthole inombolo enkulu kakhulu yamanani ayisici esaziwayo kuze kube manje ngomhlaka 25 Januwari.

translations.source: Several people verified the discovery using different hardware and software by the beginning of February and it was announced on Tuesday.
translations.reference: Abantu abaningana baqinisekise okutholakele ngokusebenzisa imishini kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza zamakhompyutha ngasekuqaleni kukaNhlolanja futhi kumenyezelwe ngoLwesibili.
translations.hypothesis: Abantu abaningi baqinisekisile ukutholakala kwalokhu ngokusetshenziswa kwezinto ezahlukene kanye nokusetshenziswa kwesoftware ezahlukene ngokuqala kaFebruwari, futhi lesi simemezelo senziwe ngoLwesibili.

translations.source: Comets may possibly have been a source of water delivery to the earth along with organic matter that can form proteins and support life.
translations.reference: Amatshe awayo esuka emkhathini kungenzeka ukuthi ayengumthombo wamanzi athunyelwe emhlabeni kanye nezinsalela zezinto eziphilayo ezingakha amaphrotheni futhi zisekele ukuphila.
translations.hypothesis: Amakhomethi angase kube yindlela yokulethwa kwamanzi emhlabeni, kanye nezinto zombili ezisetshenziselwa ukwakheka kwamaprotein kanye nokuxhasa impilo.

translations.source: Scientists hope to understand how planets form, especially how the Earth formed, since comets collided with the Earth long ago.
translations.reference: Ososayensi banethemba lokuqonda indlela amapulanethi akheka ngayo, ikakhulukazi indlela uMhlaba owakheke ngayo, njengoba amatshe asuka emkhathini eshayisene noMhlaba kudala.
translations.hypothesis: Osazi esifazane bathemba ukuthi bazofunda ukuthi amaplanethi akhiqwa kanjani, ikakhulukazi ukuthi umhlaba wakhiqwa kanjani, ngoba kade kwaba nezinkumbulo ezithongile emhlabeni.

translations.source: Cuomo, 53, began his governorship earlier this year and signed a bill last month legalizing same-sex marriage.
translations.reference: UCuomo, oneminyaka engu-53, waqala ukubusa ekuqaleni kulo nyaka futhi wasayina umthetho ovivinywayo ngenyanga edlule ogunyaza ukushada kwabantu bobulili obufanayo.
translations.hypothesis: U-Cuomo, oneminyaka engama-53, uqale ukuba ngumphathisikazi kuleli hhovisi ekuqaleni kolwaka futhi ngenyanga edlule, usayine umthetho oqinisa ukuthi abantu abafana bangashada.

translations.source: He referred to the rumors as "political chatter and silliness".
translations.reference: Ubhekisele emahlebezini ngokuthi "ingevu yepolotiki kanye nobuthutha".
translations.hypothesis: Uthe lezi zindaba zidlule njenge-"ingxoxo yezombusazwe kanye nokungcolile."

translations.source: He is speculated to make a run for president in 2016.
translations.reference: Kufuniselwa ukuthi uzokhankasela ukuba umongameli ngo-2016.
translations.hypothesis: Kuthiwa kungenzeka ukuthi azophinde azama ukuba ngumongameli ngonyaka ka-2016.

translations.source: NextGen is a system the FAA claims would allow aircraft to fly shorter routes and save millions of gallons of fuel each year and cut carbon emissions.
translations.reference: I-NextGen indlela i-FAA ethi izovumela indiza ukuba indize imizila emifishane futhi yonge izigidi zamagalani wamafutha unyaka ngamunye futhi inciphise i-carbon ekhishwa emkhathini.
translations.hypothesis: I-NextGen iyinhlelo elikholelwe yi-FAA ukuthi ingenza izindiza zihamba ngemigwaqo emfushane futhi zisindise izigidi zezilinda zefulethi ngonyaka, futhi futhi ilwe nomthelela wegesi carbhon.

translations.source: It uses satellite-based technology as opposed to older ground-radar-based technology to allow air traffic controllers to pinpoint aircraft with greater precision and give pilots more accurate information.
translations.reference: Isebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusekelwe esiphuphuthekini kunobuchwepheshe bakudala obusekelwe kuyi-radar yaphansi ukuvumela abalawuli bezinto ezihamba emoyeni ukuthola indawo indiza ekuyo ngokunemba okukhulu nokunika abashayeli bezindiza ukwaziswa okunembe kakhudlwana.
translations.hypothesis: Lusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusekelwe kusathelayithi, ngokuphindaphindiwe notshwalothishwa obuqinile obusebenziswe ngaphambilini, ukuze abalawuli bomoya bakwazi ukuthola izindiza ngokushelela kakhulu futhi banikeze abashayeli izindiza ulwazi oluqinile kakhulu.

translations.source: No extra transport is being put on and overground trains will not stop at Wembley, and car parking and park-and-ride facilities are unavailable at the ground.
translations.reference: Azikho izinto zokuthutha ezibekwayo futhi izitimela ezihamba phezulu ngeke zime eWembli, futhi ukupaka izimoto kanye nezindawo zokupaka nokugibela azitholakali enkundleni.
translations.hypothesis: Akukho amabhasi ayengeziwe ezokuthutha, futhi izitimela ezihamba ngaphandle ngegesi zizophuma ngaphandle kokuma e-Wembley. Ukupaka izimoto kanye nezindawo zokupaka ezinezitimela azitholakali endaweni yomdlalo.

translations.source: Fears of lack of transportation raised the possibility that the game would be forced to play behind closed doors without the team's supporters.
translations.reference: Ukwesaba kokungabi khona kwezinto zokuthutha kwenze ukuthi kube nokwenzeka ukuthi umdlalo uphoqelelwe ukudlalwa ngasese ngaphandle kwabathandi beqembu.
translations.hypothesis: Ukukhathazeka ngokuthi kungaba khona ukuntuleka kwezokuthutha kuye kwenza kube nokuthi umdlalo kungase kube nomdlalo ongabuki, ngaphandle kwabadlali abaxhasayo.

translations.source: A study published on Thursday in the journal Science reported on formation of a new bird species on the Ecuadorean Galápagos Islands.
translations.reference: Ucwaningo olushicilelwe ngoLwesine kumagazini weSayensi lubike ngokwakhiwa kwezinhlobo ezintsha zezinyoni eZiqhingini zase-Ecuadore eGalápagos.
translations.hypothesis: Incwadi eyayikhishwe ngoLwesine kwi-journal ethi "Science" ibike ngokuwela kwezinhlobo ezintsha zezinyoni ezweni lase-Ecuador, ezweni elithi i-Galápagos.

translations.source: Researchers from Princeton University in the United States and Uppsala University in Sweden reported the new species evolved in just two generations, though this process had been believed to take much longer, due to breeding between an endemic Darwin finch, Geospiza fortes, and the immigrant cactus finch, Geospiza conirostris.
translations.reference: Abacwaningi abavela eNyuvesi yasePrinceton eMelika kanye naseNyuvesi yase-Uppsala eSweden babike ukuthi izidalwa ezintsha ziziphendukele ngezizukulwane ezimbili kuphela, nakuba lenqubo bekukholelwa ukuthi ithatha isikhathi eside, ngenxa yokuzalela phakathi kwezintaka zika-Darwin ezitholakala kuleyo ndawo kuphela, ama-Geospiza fortes, kanye nezintaka ze-cactus ezithuthele lapho, ama-Geospiza conirostris.
translations.hypothesis: Abacwaningi baseNyuvesi yase-Princeton e-United States kanye neNyuvesi yase-Uppsala eSweden bathole ukuthi lelihlaziyo elisha lathuthuka ngaphakathi kwamakhulula amabili nje, nakuba kwakucatshangwa ukuthi le nqubo ithatha isikhathi eside kakhulu, ngenxa yokuhlanganiswa kwezinhlobo ezimbili zezinyoni: i-Darwin finch endaweni ethile, i-Geospiza fortes, kanye ne-cactus finch, i-Geospiza conirostris, eyayizimele.

translations.source: Gold may be worked into all sorts of shapes. It can be rolled into tiny shapes.
translations.reference: Igolide lingenziwa libe noma isiphi isibumbeko. Lingagingqwa libe yizibumbeko ezincane..
translations.hypothesis: Igolide lingasetshenziswa ukwenza izimo ezahlukene. Lingagobolwa ukuze kwenziwe izimo ezincane kakhulu.

translations.source: It can be pulled into thin wire, which can be twisted and plaited. It can be hammered or rolled into sheets.
translations.reference: Ingadonswa ibe ucingo oluncinyanyane, olungasontwa noma lulukwe. Lungabethelwa noma lugoqwe lube amashidi.
translations.hypothesis: Ingasetshenziswa ukwenza utshani oluncane, olungagwinyazwa futhi lungagwinyazwa. Ingasetshenziswa ukushaywa noma ukugubungela ukwenza amaphepha.

translations.source: It can be made very thin, and stuck onto other metal. It can be made so thin that it was sometimes used to decorate the hand-painted pictures in books called "illuminated manuscripts".
translations.reference: Ingenziwa ibe ncane kalula, bese inamathiselwa kwenye insimbi. Ingenziwa ibe ncane kangangokuthi kwesinye isikhathi yayisetshenziselwa ukuhlobisa izithombe ezidwetshwe ngesandla ezincwadini ezibizwa ngokuthi "illuminated manuscripts".
translations.hypothesis: Ingasetshenziswa ukwenza into encane kakhulu, futhi ingabandeka kwenye impahla yensimbi. Ingasetshenziswa kakhulu kakhulu kuye ngesimo lapho ngabe ngabe kusetshenziswa ukuhlobisa izithombe ezibhalwe ngesandla ezincwadi ezibizwa "ama-illuminated manuscripts".

translations.source: This is called a chemical's pH. You can make an indicator using red cabbage juice.
translations.reference: Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-pH yekhemikhali. Ungenza inkomba ngokusebenzisa ujusi weklabishi ebomvu.
translations.hypothesis: Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi i-pH yomucu. Ungenza into ebonisayo ngokusebenzisa isiqephu sombhaxabhaxa ombovu.

translations.source: The cabbage juice changes color depending on how acidic or basic (alkaline) the chemical is.
translations.reference: Ijusi yeklabishi ishintsha umbala kuye ngokuthi ikhemikhali ino-asidi noma i-alikhali engakanani.
translations.hypothesis: Isiphuzu selenganelisha siguquka umbala ngokuya ngokuphindaphindiweka noma ukungaphendi (ukuba nokukhanya) kwesakhiwo sezakhamisa.

translations.source: The pH level is indicated by the amount of Hydrogen (the H in pH) ions in the tested chemical.
translations.reference: Izinga le-pH likhonjwa inani lama-ion weHydrogen (i-H ku-pH) kuyikhemikhali elihlolwayo.
translations.hypothesis: Izinga le-pH liyakhombiswa ububanzi bamathayi e-Hydrogen (i-H ekuphakelweni kwe-pH) afumanekayo kule kimika eluhlaziywa.

translations.source: Hydrogen ions are protons that had their electrons stripped off them (since Hydrogen atoms consist of one proton and one electron).
translations.reference: Ama-ion e-hydrogen amaphrothoni lawo ekususwe ama-elektroni wawo kuwo (njengoba ama-athomu weHydrogen enziwa iphrothoni elilodwa kanye ne-elektroni elilodwa).
translations.hypothesis: Ama-athomu e-hydrogen anama-proton, okuyizinto ebaluleke kakhulu, kodwa amanye ama-elekthrono ayo ayisusiwe. (Ngokweqiniso, i-athomu ye-hydrogen inama-proton ayi-odwa kanye nama-elekthroni ayi-odwa.)

translations.source: Swirl the two dry powders together and then, with clean wet hands, squeeze them into a ball.
translations.reference: Yaluzisa izimpuphu ezimbili ezomile bese, ngezandla ezihlanzekile ezimanzi, uzicindezele zibe yindingiliza.
translations.hypothesis: Hlanganisa amapowda amabili ayofulathisi ndawonye, bese, ngesandla esihlanzekile nelimanzi, cishe wona bese uyawenza kube yiphini.

translations.source: The moisture on your hands will react with the outer layers, which will feel funny and form a sort of shell.
translations.reference: Umswakamo osezandleni zakho uzohlangana nongqimba olungaphandle, okuzoba nomuzwa oxakayo futhi kwenze uhlobo lwegobongo.
translations.hypothesis: Umphahla ongamanzi ezandleni zakho uzobambisana nezinto zangaphandle, okubalulekile ukuthi kuzozizwa kabi futhi kudale uhlobo lwesikhwama.

translations.source: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system.
translations.reference: Amadolobha waseHarappa kanye naseMohenjo-daro ayenedlu yangasese eshaywayo cishe kuzo zonke izindlu, ehlanganiswe nendlela eyinkimbinkimbi yokuthutha indle.
translations.hypothesis: Amadolobha e-Harappa ne-Mohenjo-daro ayena izindlu eziningi ezinalo itoyilethi elihlanzekile, elixhunywe ohlelweni oluthuthukisiwe lokuhlanzwa kwamanzi.

translations.source: Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece.
translations.reference: Insalela yamapayipi athutha indle itholakele ezindlini zamadolobha wase-Minoan waseKhrithi nase-Santorini eGreece.
translations.hypothesis: Izikhathi ezithile zefu lokuhlanzeka zitholwe ezindlini zamadolobha ase-Minoan e-Crete nase-Santorini, e-Greece.

translations.source: There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.
translations.reference: Zazikhona izindlu zangasese eGibhithe, e, kanye naseShayina yamandulo. Empucukweni yaseRoma, izindlu zangasese kwesinye isikhathi kwakuyingxenye yezindlu zokugezela zomphakathi lapho abasilisa nabesifazana babehlangana ndawonye.
translations.hypothesis: Kwakunemikhakha yokuhlanzwa emakhaya wasendulo eGibhithe, e-Persia nase-China. Esizukulweni samaRoma, amakhambi okuhlanzwa amanye amabe yingxenye yezindawo zokugeza zomphakathi, lapho amadoda namabhokwe behlangana khona.

translations.source: When you call someone who is thousands of miles away, you are using a satellite.
translations.reference: Uma ushayela ucingo umuntu othile okude ngamamayela ayinkulungwane, usebenzisa isiphuphutheki.
translations.hypothesis: Uma ushayela umuntu okude kakhulu, ngamakhilomitha ayizinkulungwane, usebenzisa isikhungo sezulu.

translations.source: The satellite in space gets the call and then reflects it back down, almost instantly.
translations.reference: Isiphuphutheki esisemkhathini sithola ucingo bese siluthumela emuva ezansi, cishe ngaleso sikhathi.
translations.hypothesis: Isathishini esendleleni yomkhathi sithola uphawu, bese kucutshungulwa futhi kubuyiswe phansi, cishe ngokushesha.

translations.source: The satellite was sent into space by a rocket. Scientists use telescopes in space because the Earth’s atmosphere distorts some of our light and view.
translations.reference: Isethilayithi ithunyelwe emkhathini kusentshenziswa irokhethi. Ososayensi basebenzise izibona kude ezisemkhathini ngoba umkhathi uphazamisa okunye kokukhanya kwethu kanye nokubona.
translations.hypothesis: I-satellite yathunyelwa esikhungweni sasezulwini ngesikhathi esithile. Ososayensi basebenzisa ama-telescope esikhungweni sasezulwini ngoba umoya womhlaba uyenza ukuthi okukhanyisiwe kanye nokubukwa kwethu kushintshe.

translations.source: It takes a giant rocket over a 100 feet high to put a satellite or telescope in space.
translations.reference: Kudingeka irokhethi enkulu engaphezu kwamafidiangu-100 ukuphakama ukubeka isiphuphutheki noma ithelisikobho emkhathini.
translations.hypothesis: Kudingeka irhokethi enkulu, engaphezu kwamamitha ayi-100 ubude, ukuze kuthunyelwe isathishini noma iteleskophu esikhungweni sama-sini.

translations.source: The wheel has changed the world in incredible ways. The biggest thing that the wheel has done for us is given us much easier and faster transportation.
translations.reference: Isondo seliguqule umhlaba ngezindlela ezimangalisayo. Into enkulu ukuthi isondo elisenzele yona ukusinika indlela yokuthutha elula neshesha kakhulu.
translations.hypothesis: Isondo selishintshe umhlaba ngezindlela ezimangalisayo. Okukhulu kakhulu okwenziwe yisondo kithi ukuthi kusiholele ekuthutheni okulula futhi okusheshayo kakhulu.

translations.source: It has brought us the train, the car, and many other transportation devices.
translations.reference: Isilethele isitimela, imoto, kanye nezinye izisetshenziswa zokuthutha.
translations.hypothesis: Lolu hlelo lubenzele ithilamu, imoto, kanye nezinye izinto eziningi zokuhamba.

translations.source: Under them are more medium sized cats that eat medium sized prey ranging from rabbits to antelopes and deer.
translations.reference: Ngaphansi kwazo kukhona amakati amancanyana ngobukhulu adla inyama ebanjelwa ukudliwakusuka kunogwaja kuya ezinyamazaneni.
translations.hypothesis: Ngezansi kwabo kukhona izingulube ezincane eziningi ezidla izilwane ezincane ezahlukahlukene, kusukela ezinkukwini kuya kwezinkomo nezilwane ezinkulu ezifana nezinqa.

translations.source: Finally, there are many small cats (including loose pet cats) that eat the far more numerous small prey like insects, rodents, lizards, and birds.
translations.reference: Ekugcineni, kunamakati amaningi amancane (kuhlanganise namakati afuywayo azizulelayo) adla izilwanyane ezizingelwayo eziningi kakhulu njengezinambuzane, izilwane eziququdayo, izibankwa, kanye nezinyoni.
translations.hypothesis: Ekugcineni, kunemilwane emincane eminingi (efaka nezilwane ezifuywayo ezikhululiwe) ezidla izilwane ezincane eziningi kakhulu, ezifana nezilwane ezincane, izinja, izilwane ezincane, nezinyoni.

translations.source: The secret to their success is the concept of the niche, a special job each cat holds that keeps it from competing with others.
translations.reference: Imfihlo yempumelelo yabo umcabango wesikhundla, umsebenzi okhethekile ikati ngalinye elinawo olenza lingancintisani namanye.
translations.hypothesis: Impumelelo yabo incike kulokhu: umqondo wokuthi ngamunye umfana unomsebenzi okhethekile, okumvimbela ukuthi ancintane nabanye.

translations.source: Lions are the most social cats, living in large groups called prides.
translations.reference: Amabhubesi angamakati anobudlelwane kakhulu, aphila ngamaqembu amakhulu abizwa ngokuthi umhlambi.
translations.hypothesis: Amaliona ngamahlwane ezilwane ezinkulu ezihlala ndawonye, futhi zihlala ezihlotsheni ezinkulu ezibizwa ngokuthi "amakhosi."

translations.source: Prides are made up of one to three related adult males, along with as many as thirty females and cubs.
translations.reference: Imihlambi yakhiwa iduna elilodwa noma amathathu ahlobene, ngokufanayo nezinsikazi ezintathu kanye namawundlu.
translations.hypothesis: Amagqubu amadoda ayiwa ku-1 kuya ku-3, ayo nomfana kanye namakhulu angu-30 noma ngaphezulu, kufaka phakathi izimane nezinkomo ezincane.

translations.source: The females are usually closely related to each other, being a large family of sisters and daughters.
translations.reference: Abesifazane ngokuvamile bahlobene, okuwumndeni omkhulu wodadewabo noma amadodakazi.
translations.hypothesis: Izindoda ezifana nazo zivamise ukuhlobene kakhulu, njengomndeni omkhulu ogcwele izodwa nezindodakazi.

translations.source: Lion prides act much like packs of wolves or dogs, animals surprisingly similar to lions (but not other big cats) in behavior, and also very deadly to their prey.
translations.reference: Ivuyo lamabhubesi liziphatha njengomhlambi wamanketshane, izilwane ezifana namabhubesi ngokumangalisayo (kodwa hhayi amanye amakati amakhulu) ngokuziphatha, kanye futhi nokuba yingozi ezilwaneni ezizizingelayo.
translations.hypothesis: Amagumbi ezinkomo zisebenza ngendlela efanayo namagumbi ezilwane ezinkomo noma amabhulunkulu, ezilwane ezifana kakhulu nezinkomo (kodwa hhayi ezinye izilwane ezinkulu ezifana nazo) ngohlela zihlale, futhi ziyingozi kakhulu ezilwaneni azidlulisa.

translations.source: A well rounded athlete, the tiger can climb (though not well), swim, leap great distances and pull with five times the force of a strong human.
translations.reference: Umgadli ophelele, ihlosi lingakhuphuka (yize lingakwazi kahle), libhukude, ligxume amabanga amade futhi lidonse ngamandla womuntu onamandla aphindwe kasihlanu.
translations.hypothesis: Umnyama, umdlali onamandla, uyakwazi ukuklimba (kodwa akwenzanga kahle), ukubhukuda, ukugxumela kude kakhulu, futhi ukudonsa ngamandla engu-limi ezinkulu kakhulu kunamandla lomuntu oqinile.

translations.source: The tiger is in the same group (Genus Panthera) as lions, leopards, and jaguars. These four cats are the only ones who can roar.
translations.reference: Ithayiga lisesigabeni esifanayo (Genus Panthera) njengamabhubesi, izingwe, kanye nama-jaguar. Lawa makati amane yiwo kuphela akwazi ukubhonga.
translations.hypothesis: Impisi iyigama elingafani nezilwane ezifana nezinkomo, izinkomo ezincane, kanye nezinkomo ezinkulu. Lezi zilwane ezine kuphela ezikwazi ukukhala.

translations.source: The tiger's roar is not like the full-voiced roar of a lion, but more like a sentence of snarly, shouted words.
translations.reference: Ukubhonga kwehlosi akufani ncamashi nokubhonga kwengonyama, kodwa kucishe kufane nomusho wamagama entukuthelo, amenyezwayo.
translations.hypothesis: Ukukhala kwengulube akufani nokukhala okukhulu kwebhubesi, kodwa kufana kakhulu nokukhuluma amagama amancane, afushane futhi akhulunywe ngobuhlungu.

translations.source: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is.
translations.reference: Ama-ocelots athanda ukudla izilwane ezincane. Azobamba izimfene, izinyoka, izilwane eziququdayo kanye nezinyoni uma angakwazi. Cishe zonke izilwane ezizingelwa yilawa makati zincane kakhulu kunawo.
translations.hypothesis: I-ocelot ithanda ukudla izilwane ezincane. Ingagxumela amakhosi, izinzipho, izilwane ezincane nezinyoni uma kungukuthi ingenza lokho. Cishe zonke izilwane ezikhunjulwe yi-ocelot zincane kakhulu kuleyo.

translations.source: Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground.
translations.reference: Ososayensi bakholelwa ukuthi ama-ocelots alandelela futhi athola izilwane zokuzidla (izilwane ezizingelwayo) ngokunuka, efufuza lapho bezikhona phansi.
translations.hypothesis: Osazi imfundo bacabanga ukuthi izinja zama-ocelot zilandela futhi zithola izilwane ezidla (izinto zokudla) ngokusebenzisa ukukhishwa kwempilo, zibheka ngesiphozi lapho lezi zilwane zabe zikhona phansi.

translations.source: They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.
translations.reference: Ayakwazi ukubona kahle kakhulu ebumnyameni ngekhono lokubona ebusuku, abuye ahambe ngesinyenyela esikhulu, futhi. Ama-ocelot azingela izisulu zawo ngokuzifanisa nendawo akuyo bese agxumela izisulu zawo.
translations.hypothesis: Bangabona kahle kakhulu endaweni edumile ngobuchwepheshe bokubona kwebusuku, futhi bayakwazi ukuhamba ngobunquku. Izilwane ezihlanganiswe ne-ocelot zifuna izilwane zazo ngokuzifihla endaweni abazo, bese zizithinta.

translations.source: When a small group of living things (a small population) gets separated from the main population that they came from (like if they move over a mountain range or a river, or if they move to a new island so that they can't easily move back) they will often find themselves in a different environment than they were in before.
translations.reference: Lapho iqembu elincane lezinto eziphilayo (inani elincane) lihlukana eqenjini elikhulu elisuka kulo (cishe lapho liya ngaphesheya kokhahlamba lwentaba noma umfula, noma uma liya esiqhingini esisha kangangokuba lingakwazi ukubuyela emuva kalula) ngokuvamile lizozithola endaweni ehlukile kunaleyo ebezikuyo ngaphambili.
translations.hypothesis: Uma iqembu elincane zezinto ezimpilayo (ububanzi obuncane) kuhlukaniswa kwiqembu elikhulu ngqo kokuvame ukufika kulo (ngokwesibonelo, uma zuyiswa ngaphezu kwezintaba noma ngaphansi komfula, noma uma zuyiswa kwi-akhwane entsha ngakho-ke kungaba nzima ukuba zibuyele), zivame ukuthola ukuthi zikhona endaweni ehlukene kakhulu kunaleyo abayikhona ngaphambilini.

translations.source: This new environment has different resources and different competitors, so the new population will need different features or adaptations to be a strong competitor than what they had needed before.
translations.reference: Le ndawo entsha inezinsizakusebenza ezihlukile nabancintisani abahlukene, ngakho-ke umphakathi omusha uzodinga izici ezihlukile noma ukuzivumelanisa nezimo ukuze ube ngabancintisani abaqinile kunalokho ababekudinga ngaphambilini.
translations.hypothesis: Le ndawo entsha inezinsiza ezihlukile kanye nabalingani bokuncintisana ezihlukile, ngakho umphakathi omusha uzodinga izici ezihlukile noma ukulungiswa ukuze abe ngumncintisane oqinile kunalokho okudingekile ngaphambilini.

translations.source: The original population hasn't changed at all, they still need the same adaptations as before.
translations.reference: Izidalwa ezazikhona zasekuqaleni azikashintshi, zisadinga indlela yokuphila efana neyangaphambili.
translations.hypothesis: Uphinde-phinde, ububanzi bomphakathi obuqale ngaleso sikhathi buyiwo nalokho, futhi badinga ukulungiswa okufanayo njengaphambilini.

translations.source: Over time, as the new population begins to adapt to their new environment, they start to look less and less like the other population.
translations.reference: Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, njengoba iqembu elisha liqala ukujwayela indawo yalo entsha, liqala ukuya libukeka lingafani neqembu elinye.
translations.hypothesis: Kudlule isikhathi, njengoba abantu abasha beqala ukuzivumelanisa nendawo entsha abaphila kuyo, baqala ukubukeka kakhulu kakhulu kunezinye izinhlobo zabantu.

translations.source: Eventually, after thousands or even millions of years, the two populations will look so different that they can't be called the same species.
translations.reference: Ekugcineni, ngemva kweminyaka eyizinkulungwane noma ngisho eyizigidi, amaqembu amabili azobukeka ehlukile kangangokuba angeke abizwe ngokuthi uhlobo olulodwa.
translations.hypothesis: Kugcine, ngemuva kweminyaka eyinkulungwane noma yezigidi, lezi zinhlanganisela ezimbili zizoba ngamazinga ahlukile kangangokuthi ngeke zilinganiswe njengezinhlobo ezifanayo.

translations.source: We call this process speciation, which just means the formation of new species. Speciation is an unavoidable consequence and a very important part of evolution.
translations.reference: Le nqubo siyibiza nge-speciation, okushe nje ukwakhekha kwezinhlobo ezintsha. Lokhu kwakheka umphumela ongakwemeki kanye nengxenye ebaluleke kakhulu yokuziphendukela kwemvelo.
translations.hypothesis: Siyibiza le nqubo ngokuthi "ukwakhiwa kwezinhlobo ezintsha," okusho ukuthi ukukhiqizwa kwezinhlobo ezintsha. Ukwakhiwa kwezinhlobo ezintsha kuyimbangela engahleleki futhi kuyingxenye ebalulekile kakhulu yokuguquka.

translations.source: Plants make oxygen which humans breathe, and they take in carbon-dioxide which humans exhale (that is, breathe out).
translations.reference: Izitshalo zenza i-oxygen leyo ephefumulwa abantu, futhi zithatha i-carbon-dioxide leyo ekhishwa abantu (okungukuthi, ukuphefumula ukhiphe umoya).
translations.hypothesis: Izitshalo zikhiqiza oksijena okuthi abantu bayophuza, futhi zithatha ikhabhoni diyoksayidi okuthi abantu bayaphuthuma (okungukuthi, bayaphunga).

translations.source: Plants make their food from the sun by photosynthesis. They also provide shade.
translations.reference: Izitshalo zenza ukudla kwazo nge-photosynthesis. Zibuye zenze nomthunzi.
translations.hypothesis: Izitshalo zenza ukudla kwawo kusukela elanga ngokusetshenziswa kwenqubo yokuphothosinthesisi. Futhi, zihlinzeka ngomthunzi.

translations.source: We make our houses from plants and make clothes from plants. Most foods that we eat are plants. Without plants, animals could not survive.
translations.reference: Senza izindlu zethu ngezitshalo futhi senza nezingubo ngezitshalo. Ukudla okuningi esikudlayo izitshalo. Ngaphandle kwezitshalo, izilwane angeke ziqhubeke ziphila.
translations.hypothesis: Senza izindlu zethu ezivela ezitshalweni, futhi senza izingubo ezivela ezitshalweni. Kakhulu ukudla esidlile kuyizitshalo. Ngaphandle kwezitshalo, izilwane ngeke ziphile.

translations.source: Mosasaurus was the apex predator of its time, so it feared nothing, except other mosasaurs.
translations.reference: I-mosasaurus bekuyisilwane esizingelayo esiyinhloko ngesikhathi sayo, ngakho-ke yayingesabi lutho, ngaphandle kwama-mosasaurus amanye.
translations.hypothesis: UMosasaurus wayengumdlalo omkhulu ngaleso sikhathi, ngakho-ke wayengabazeki, ngaphandle kwamanye amosasaurus.

translations.source: Its long jaws were studded with more than 70 razor-sharp teeth, along with an extra set in the roof of its mouth, meaning that there was no escape for anything that crossed its path.
translations.reference: Imihlathi yayo emide eyayihlome ngamazinyo acijise okwensingo angaphezu kuka-70, kanye namanye engeziwe phezu komlomo wayo, okusho ukuthi kwakungekho lutho esondela eduze kwayo eyayingaphunyuka.
translations.hypothesis: I-guba layo elide belinamazinyo angaphezu kuka-70, ayoqinile kakhulu, kanye nosengaphansi komlomo wayo, okusho ukuthi akukho lutho olungaphunyuka uma lingenile endleleni yalo.

translations.source: We don't know for sure, but it may have had a forked tongue. Its diet included turtles, large fish, other mosasaurs, and it may even have been a cannibal.
translations.reference: Asazi ngokuqinisekile, kodwa kungenzeka ukuthi yayinolimi olusamfoloko. Ukudla eyayikudla kuhlanganisa izimfudu, izinhlanzi ezinkulu, ama-mosasaurus amanye, futhi kungenzeka nokuthi yayiyizimu.
translations.hypothesis: Asiyazi ngokungaqondile, kodwa kungase kube nomuthi omude ohlukaniswe. Ukudla kwalo kufake izintontolo, izinhlanzi ezinkulu, ezinye izilwane ezifana ne-mosasaur, futhi kungase kube yinto eyayidla izilwane ezifana nayo.

translations.source: It also attacked anything that entered the water; even a giant dinosaur such as T. rex would be no match for it.
translations.reference: Yayibuye ihlasele noma yini engena emanzini; ngisho ne-dinosaur enkulu njenge-T.rex yayingeke ikwazi ukumelana nayo.
translations.hypothesis: Nalo lutho elingena emanzini, ngisho neliphakanyiswe kakhulu njenge-T. rex, belingakwazi ukulwa nalelo lutho.

translations.source: While most of their food would be familiar to us, Romans did have their share of strange or unusual feast items, including wild boar, peacock, snails, and a type of rodent called a dormouse
translations.reference: Ngenkathi iningi lokukudla kwabo kungaba okujwayelekile kuthina, amaRoma eyenesabelo sabo sezinto zemikhosi ezingajwayelekile, kubandakanya izingulube zasendle, ipigogo, iminenke, nohlobo lwegundane olubizwa nge-dormouse
translations.hypothesis: Nakuba okuningi kokudla kwabo bekuyinto ejwayelekile, Abantu baseRoma babenokudla okuningi okuyahlukile noma okungajwayelekile, okubalwa phakathi kwayo izinkomo zasendle, amapheyi, izintuthu, kanye nohlobo oluthile lwezilwane ezincane ezibizwa nge-"dormouse."

translations.source: Another difference was that while the poor people and the woman ate their food while sitting in chairs, the rich men liked to have banquets together where they would lounge on their sides while they ate their meals.
translations.reference: Omunye umehluko kwakuwukuthi nakuba abantu abampofu kanye nabesifazane babedla ukudla kwabo babe behlezi ezihlalweni, amadoda acebile ayethanda ukuba namadili ndawonye lapho ayehlala khona ngezinhlangothi kuyilapho edla ukudla kwawo.
translations.hypothesis: Enye mehluko kwakuyokuthi, kanti abantu abampofu kanye nomfazi badla ukudla kwabo ngathi bahlele izinyanga, kodwa amadoda amadala ayathanda ukuba nezinkomishi ndawonye lapho bahlala ngogesi ngesikhathi badla ukudla kwabo.

translations.source: Ancient Roman meals couldn't have included foods that came to Europe from America or from Asia in later centuries.
translations.reference: Ukudla kwaseRoma yamandulo kwakungeke kuhlanganise ukudla okufike eYurophu kuvela eMelika noma kuvela e-Asia emakhulwini eminyaka alandelayo.
translations.hypothesis: Ukudla kwaseRoma kodwa okwedlule akukwenzeke ukuthi kufake izinto zokudla ezazivela eMelika noma e-Asia, ezifike eYurophu eminyakeni embalwa kamuva.

translations.source: For instance, they didn't have corn, nor tomatoes, nor potatoes, nor cocoa, and no ancient Roman ever tasted a turkey.
translations.reference: Ngokwesibonelo, babengenawo ummbila, noma otamatisi, noma amazambane, noma i-cocoa, futhi akekho umuntu waseRoma yamandulo oke wanambitha ikalikuni.
translations.hypothesis: Ngokwesibonelo, abazinayo ukudla okunjenge-umfino, ama-tomato, amaphuphu, noma ukaka, futhi akukho muntu waseRoma wasendulo owake wahlanganisa nomfane.

translations.source: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god.
translations.reference: AbaseBhabhiloni bakhela izithixo zabo ngazinye ithempeli eliyinhloko elalibhekwa njengekhaya lesithixo.
translations.hypothesis: Abantu baseBabiloni bakakha iziqhingi ezinkulu ngalinye yenzelwe unkulunkulu ngamunye, ezaziwa njengezindlu zalawo mikulu.

translations.source: People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals.
translations.reference: Abantu abaletha imihlatshelo konkulunkulu nakubaphristi bazozama ukunika onkulunkulu izidingo zabo ngemigidi nemikhosi.
translations.hypothesis: Abantu babeluleka izinto kubo abathandi, futhi abapristi babazama ukunakekela izidingo zabathandi ngemikhuba nemikhosi.

translations.source: Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter.
translations.reference: Ithempeli ngalinye lalinegceke elivulekile lethempeli kanye nendawo engcwele ephakathi lapho kwakungena khona umphristi kuphela.
translations.hypothesis: Wonke ithempeli belinendawo evulekile phambi kwalo, bese ngemuva kwalo kwakukhona indawo engaphakathi lapho kuphela abapristi abangangena khona.

translations.source: Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples.
translations.reference: Ngezinye izikhathi imibhoshongo ekhethekile engunxa-ntathu, ebizwa ngokuthi ama-ziggurat, yayakhiwe ukuze ibe ingxenye yamathempeli.
translations.hypothesis: Ngezikhathi ezithile, amathempeli ayoqinisekiswa ngamathawula akhethekile anobude obufana nomuphimbo wamaphiramidi, ayaziwa ngokuthi "ziggurats."

translations.source: The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.
translations.reference: Isiqongo sombhoshongo kwakuyindawo engcwele ekhethekile yesithixo.
translations.hypothesis: Ingxenye ephezulu yentowe yayiyindawo ekhethekile lapho kuhlala khona uNkulunkulu.

translations.source: In the warm climate of the Middle East, the house was not so important.
translations.reference: Esimweni sezulu esifudumele saseMpumalanga ePhakathi, indlu beyingabalulekanga kakhulu.
translations.hypothesis: Kule ndawo yaseMpumalanga Ephakathi, lapho imikhathi ingamafushane, indlu ayikaze ibalwe kakhulu.

translations.source: Most of the life of the Hebrew family happened in the open air.
translations.reference: Isikhathi esiningi impilo yemindeni yamaHebheru yenzeka endaweni evulekile.
translations.hypothesis: Iningi yempilo yomndeni wasamaHebhere yenzeka ngaphandle, emoya omoya.

translations.source: Women did the cooking in the yard; stores were just open counters looking into the street. Stone was used for building houses.
translations.reference: Owesifazane wayepheka egcekeni, izitolo kwakungamatafula avulwayo abheke emgwaqweni. Amatshe ayesetshenziselwa ukwakha izindlu.
translations.hypothesis: Abesifazane babhekana nokupheka emgodini; izitolo zazingumaphakheji nje aphakanyisiwe abubonakala emgwaqweni. Idoti yayisetshenziswa ekwakhiweni kwezindlu.

translations.source: There were no large forests in the land of Canaan, so wood was extremely expensive.
translations.reference: Ayengekho amahlathi amakhulu ezweni laseKhanani, ngakho izingodo zazibiza kakhulu.
translations.hypothesis: Akukho izinkomo ezinkulu ezweni lase-Kanaani, ngakho ukudlala kwakuyinto ebiza kakhulu.

translations.source: Greenland was settled sparsely. In the Norse sagas they say that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder, and when travelling further west, found Greenland and named it Greenland.
translations.reference: I-Greenland yayihlelwe kancane. E-Norse Segas bathi u-Erik the Red waboshwa e-Iceland ngenxa yokubulala, futhi lapho ehambela eNtshonalanga, wathola i-Greenland wase eyibiza ngokuthi i-Greenland.
translations.hypothesis: I-Greenland yayogcwaliswa kancane. Kulezincwadi zama-Norse, kushiwo ukuthi u-Erik i-Red wahlosiwe e-Iceland ngobulawa, futhi ngesikhathi ehamba kakhulu eshashalazini, wathola i-Greenland wayiyena owayibiza nge-Greenland.

translations.source: But regardless of his discovery, Eskimo tribes were already living there at the time.
translations.reference: Kodwa naphezu kokuba etholakele, isizwe sama-Eskiro besilokhu sihlala lapho ngaleso sikhathi.
translations.hypothesis: Kodwa, kungakhathaliseki ukutholakala kwakhe, izizwe zama-Eskimo bezivele bezuhlala kuleyo ndawo ngaleso sikhathi.

translations.source: Though each country was 'Scandinavian', there were many differences between the people, kings, customs and history of Denmark, Sweden, Norway and Iceland.
translations.reference: Nakuba izwe ngalinye beliyi-‘Scandinavian’, bekunokungefani okuningi phakathi kwabantu, amakhosi, amasiko, kanye nomlando wase-Denmark, e-Sweden, e-Norway kanye nase-Iceland.
translations.hypothesis: Nakuba wonke amazwe ayo "i-Scandinavian," kwakunezinto eziningi ezihlukile phakathi kwabantu, amakhosi, amasiko kanye nomlando waseDenmark, eSweden, eNorway naseIceland.

translations.source: If you have watched the movie National Treasure, you may think a treasure map was written on the back of the Declaration of Independence.
translations.reference: Uma wake wayibuka imovie i-National Treasure, ungafunga ukuthi ibalazwe lomcebo lalibhalwe ngemuva kweSimemezelo Sokuzimela.
translations.hypothesis: Uma ubonile i-movie ethi "National Treasure," mhlawumbe ucabanga ukuthi uhlobo lwemaphu elikhombisayo lwalubhaliwe ngemuva kwephaphostashi yokuqala yezizwe zaseMelika.

translations.source: However, that is not true. Although there is something written on the back of the document, it is not a treasure map.
translations.reference: Noma kunjalo, lokho akulona iqiniso. Noma kunokuthile okubhalwe ngemuva kwencwadi, akuyona imephu eyigugu.
translations.hypothesis: Kodwa-ke, lokho akuyona iqiniso. Nakuba kunento ebhalwe ngemuva kwalesi dogumenti, akuyona imephu yezimpahla.

translations.source: Written on the back of the Declaration of Independence were the words "Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776". The text appears on the bottom of the document, upside down.
translations.reference: Okubhalwe ngemuva eNcazelweni Yokuzimela bekungamazwi “ENcazelo Yokuqala Yokuzimela yangomhlaka-4 kuNtulikazi 1776”. Umbhalo ovela ekugcineni kwencwadi, obheke phansi.
translations.hypothesis: Kuleli phuzu elingemuva lephaphostini elithi "Umuthi Wokuzimela Wokuqala, odwetshwe ngomhla ka-4 Julayi ka-1776," kwakukhona amazwi athi "Original Declaration of Independence dated 4th July 1776". Leli gama liyavela ngaphansi kwegeyini, futhi lishiwo ngendlela ephakanyisiwe.

translations.source: While no one knows for certain who wrote it, it is known that early in its life, the large parchment document (it measures 29¾ inches by 24½ inches) was rolled up for storage.
translations.reference: Yize kungekho owaziyo ngokuqinisekile ukuthi ngubani oyibhalile, kuyaziwa ukuthi ekuqaleni kokuphila kwayo, idokhumenti enkulu yesikhumba (ilinganisa ama-intshi angu-29¾ ngamayintshi angu-24½) yayigoqwe ukuze igcinwe.
translations.hypothesis: Nakuba akukho muntu owayazi ngokuqinile ukuthi ngubani owayibhala, kuyaziwa ukuthi ngesikhathi esiqalayo, leli dogumenti elikhulu elibhaliwe (elilingana namamitha angama-29¾ ngamagama angama-24½) yayigayiwe ukuze igcinwe.

translations.source: So, it is likely that the notation was added simply as a label.
translations.reference: Ngakho-ke, cishe umcabango wafakwa njengophawu kalula.
translations.hypothesis: Ngakho, kungase kube ukuthi leli phawu lishiyelwe nje njengophawu lokubonisa.

translations.source: The D-Day landings and the following battles had freed the north of France, but the south still wasn't free.
translations.reference: Ukufika kwe-D-Day nezimpi ezilandelayo kwakukhulule inyakatho yeFrance, kodwa eningizimu kwakungakakhululeki.
translations.hypothesis: Ukungena kwamasebhukeni ngosuku oluyi-D kanye nempi ezalandelayo kwavuselela ingxenye ye-France enyakatho, kodwa ingxenye yase-France eseningizimu yayisasekhisimwini.

translations.source: It was ruled by the "Vichy" French. These were French people who had made peace with the Germans in 1940 and worked with the invaders instead of fighting them.
translations.reference: Yayibuswa amaFulentshi ase-“Vinchy”. Laba bekungabantu baseFulansi ababenze ukuthula neJalimane ngo-1940 futhi besebenzisana nabaphangi esikhundleni sokuthi balwe nabo.
translations.hypothesis: Leli dolobha lalibushelwa ngamaFrance "eVichy." Lezi yizikhulu zaseFrance ezazithathe isinqumo sokuxhumana namaJalimane ngonyaka ka-1940, futhi ezasebenzisana nabaqhamukile esikhundleni sokulwa nabo.

translations.source: On 15 August 1940, the Allies invaded southern France, the invasion was called "Operation Dragoon".
translations.reference: Ngezi-15 kuNcwaba 1940, Izivunani zahlasela iningizimu France, futhi ukuhlasela kwabizwa “Umsebenzi Dragoon”.
translations.hypothesis: Ngomhla ka-15 Agasti ka-1940, ama-Allies ahlaselwe eMpumalanga yeFrance, kanti le nhloso yalo mkhankaso yayibizwa ngokuthi "Operation Dragoon".

translations.source: In just two weeks the Americans and Free French forces had liberated southern France and were turning towards Germany.
translations.reference: Ngamasonto amabili nje amasosha ase-Melika kanye nawase-French Ekhululekile akhiphe iningizimu France ezingxoxweni zokuhweba futhi asephendukela eJalimane
translations.hypothesis: Kwami nje kwamaviki amabili, amabutho amaMelika kanye namafalanethi aseFrance ayazibambela eMpumalanga yeFrance futhi yaqala ukuhamba eya eJalimane.

translations.source: A civilization is a singular culture shared by a significant large group of people who live and work co-operatively, a society.
translations.reference: Umphakathi wesintu isiko elilodwa elihlanganyelwa iqembu elikhulu labantu abahla futhi basebenze ndawonye, umphakathi.
translations.hypothesis: Inkolo yobuntu yindlela yokuphila eyodwa ehlanganyelwe yiqembu elikhulu labantu abaningi abaphila futhi basebenzisana ndawonye, okuyi-zinhlangano.

translations.source: The word civilization comes from the Latin civilis, meaning civil, related to the Latin civis, meaning citizen, and civitas, meaning city or city-state, and that also somehow defines the size of the society.
translations.reference: Igama elithi civilization lisuka egameni lesiLatin elithi civilis, okusho impucuko, elihlobene nelesiLatin elithi civis, elisho isakhamuzi, kanye nelithi civitas, elisho idolobha noma isifundazwe, futhi lokho ngenye indlela kubuye kuchaze ubukhulu bomphakathi.
translations.hypothesis: Igama "civilization" livela ngesiLatini "civilis", okusho ukuthi "obunobukhulu," elihlobene negama lesiLatini "civis", okusho "umhlali," kanye negama "civitas", okusho "idolobha" noma "izwe elikhulu," futhi lokhu ngamafuphi kuchaza ukukhulu komphakathi.

translations.source: City-states are the precursors of nations. A civilizational culture implies the passing on of knowledge across several generations, a lingering cultural footprint and fair dissemination.
translations.reference: Izifundazwe zandulela izizwe. Isiko lomphakathi lisho ukudlulisela ulwaze ezizukulwaneni eziningana, umkhondo ongokwesiko ohlala ukhona kanye nokusakazwa okuhle kokwaziswa.
translations.hypothesis: Amadolobha amakhulu ngamaphuzu okuqala ezizwe. Inkolo yobuntu ibonisa ukudluliselwa kwolwazi ezizukulwaneni eziningi, umthelela oqhubekayo wesiko kanye nokusatshalaliswa okuhle.

translations.source: Minor cultures often vanish without leaving relevant historic evidence and fail to be recognized as proper civilizations.
translations.reference: Amasiko amancane ngokuvamile ayanyamalala ngaphandle kokushiya ubufakazi obungokomlando futhi ayahluleka ukuqashelwa njengemiphakathi yangempela.
translations.hypothesis: Amalimi amancane futhi amasiko amancane amaningi avele alahlekelwe ngemikhakha yabo yomlando ngaphandle kokushiyela ubufakazi obubalulekile, futhi awazwakali njengamasiko amakhulu.

translations.source: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation.
translations.reference: Phakathi neMpi Yezinguqugo, izifunda eziyishumi nantathu zaqala zakha uhulumeni obuthakathaka—uKhongolose kuyisici sawo sodwa—ngaphansi kwe-Articles of Confederation.
translations.hypothesis: Ngaleso sikhathi somuzi wasenkululeko, izifundazwe ezintathu nenhlanu zakuqala ukwakha uhulumeni omkhulu ongomelele—okuthi iCongress yayingumengameli kuphela—ngaphansi kwemibhalo yama-Articles of Confederation.

translations.source: Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts.
translations.reference: Ukhongolose wabe engenawo amandla okubeka intela, futhi, ngenxa yokuthi bokungekho sigungu sezwe noma noma isigungu sokwahlulela, uncike ezikhulwini zombuso, ezazingabambisani izikhathi ezingi, ukuphoqelela yonke imithetho yawo.
translations.hypothesis: IKongiresi ayinalo amandla alokhu okwenza izinkokhelo zentela, futhi, ngoba kwakungenayo inkampani yezokuphatha kanye nomthethosazi esizweni sonke, yayithembele ezikhungweni zombuso ezifundazweni, ezazivame ukungafuni ukusiza, ukuze zisebenzise yonke imithetho yayo.

translations.source: It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states.
translations.reference: Yayingenalo futhi igunya lokweqa imithetho yentela nokuthelisa ngempahla phakathi kwezifunda.
translations.hypothesis: Nakho, ayinalo igunya lokulawula noma ukushintsha imithetho yentela kanye nezintengo phakathi kwezizwe.

translations.source: The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
translations.reference: Imithetho beyidinga ukuba zonke izifunda zivume ngaphambi kokuba ilungiswe futhi izifunda zithathe uhulumeni omkhulu njengongabalulekile kakhulu kangangokuba abameleli bazo babehlala bangekho.
translations.hypothesis: Izibuyekezo zombuzo zidinge ukumvuma kwabazonke izifundazwe ngaphambi kokuthi zishintshwe, futhi izifundazwe zazinamane zibheke uhulumeni omkhulu, ngakho izikhulu zazo zazinomsoco kakhulu.

translations.source: Italy's national football, along with German national football team is the second most successful team in the world and were the FIFA World Cup champions in 2006.
translations.reference: Ibhola lezinyawo lezwe laseNtaliyane, kanye neqembu lebhola lezinyawo lezwe laseJalimane iqembu lesibili eliphumelele kakhulu emhlabeni futhi bekuyizingqwele zeNdebe yoMhlaba yeFIFA ngo-2006.
translations.hypothesis: Iqembu lebhola lesizwe lase-Italy, kanye neqembu lebhola lesizwe laseJalimane, yizinguqembu ezimbili ezibaluleke kakhulu emhlabeni, futhi waqhamuka njengoqembu olunompumelelo kakhulu kwi-FIFA World Cup ngonyaka ka-2006.

translations.source: Popular sports include football, basketball, volleyball, water-polo, fencing, rugby, cycling, ice hockey, roller hockey and F1 motor racing.
translations.reference: Imidlalo ethandwayo ihlanganisa ibhola lezinyawo, i-basketball, i-volleyball, ibhola lasemanzini, umngcweko, iragbhi, ukugibela amabhayisikili, ihoki yaseqhweni, ihoki evamile kanye nomncintiswano wezimoto zeF1.
translations.hypothesis: Ezimilo ezithandwa kakhulu zihlanganisa ibhola, ibhasikethe, ibhola legrosa, ibhola yamanzi, ukulwa ngamathunga, i-rugbi, ukugijima ngamabhayisikili, i-ice hockey, i-roller hockey kanye nomjaho wemoto we-F1.

translations.source: Winter sports are most popular in the Northern regions, with Italians competing in international games and Olympic events.
translations.reference: Imidlalo yasebusika ithandwa kakhulu ezindaweni eziseNyakatho, lapho amaNtaliyane encintisana khona emidlalweni yamazwe onke kanye nasemidlalweni yama-Olimpiki.
translations.hypothesis: Imidlalo yezinga eliphakeme yasebusika iyathandwa kakhulu ezindaweni zasenyakatho, lapho abantu base-Italy abambulela kwiMidlalo Yasemhlabeni kanye nemincintiswano ye-Olympic.

translations.source: Japans holds nearly 7,000 islands (the biggest being Honshu), making Japan the 7th largest island in the world!
translations.reference: IJapani ineziqhingi ezicishe zibe ngu-7000 (esikhulu kunazo zonke iHonshu), okwenza iJapani isiqhingi sesi-7 esikhulu kunazo zonke emhlabeni!
translations.hypothesis: IJapani inezizinda ezimalunga ne-7,000 (efinyelela ukuthi i-Honshu ingumzila omkhulu kakhulu), okwenza iJapani ibe yisizinda esikhulu lesi-7 emhlabeni!

translations.source: Due to the cluster/group of islands Japan has, Japan is often referred to, on a geographical stance, as an "archipelago"
translations.reference: Ngenxa yenqwaba/iqembu leziqhingi iJapani enazo, iJapani ivame ukubizwa ngokuthi, ngenxa yendawo ekuyo, njenge-"archipelago"
translations.hypothesis: Ngenxa yezigaba zezizinda eziningi ezikhona eJapan, eJapan kuvame ukuthiwa, ngokuya ngobuciko bendawo, "iqoqo lezizinda."

translations.source: Taiwan beginning start way back in 15th century where European sailors passing by record the island’s name as Ilha Formosa, or beautiful island.
translations.reference: Ukusungulwa kweTaiwan kuqala kudala ngekhulu lama-15 leminyaka lapho amatilosi aseYurophu edlula ebhala igama lesiqhingi ngokuthi i-Ilha formosa, noma isiqhingi esihle.
translations.hypothesis: I-Taiwan iqale kakhulu ngomhlaba wonke ngomkhakha we-15, lapho osafundi baseYurophu abangena ngaphansi kwayo bathola umhlaba futhi bayibiza ngokuthi "Ilha Formosa," okusho ukuthi "umhlaba omuhle."

translations.source: In 1624,Dutch East India Company establishes a base in southwestern Taiwan, initiating a transformation in aboriginal grain production practices and employing Chinese laborers to work on its rice and sugar plantations.
translations.reference: Ngo-1624, i-Dutch East India Company yamisa isikhungo eningizimu ntshonalanga Taiwan, iqalisa ukushintshwa kokukhiqizwa kokusanhlamvu komdabu futhi iqasha izisebenzi zaseShayina ukuba zisebenze emasimini welayisi noshukela.
translations.hypothesis: Ngo-1624, inkampani yaseHolland eyayibizwa nge-Dutch East India Company yasungula indawo yokusebenza ebulongwe zaseningathi ye-Taiwan, okwakhuthaza ushintsho ezindleleni zokukhiqiza ukudla ezazisetshenziswa ngabantu bendawo, futhi yasebenzisa abasebenzi baseChina ukuthi basebenze ezinkundleni zayo zokukhiqiza irisi kanye neshukela.

translations.source: In 1683, Qing dynasty (1644-1912) forces take control of Taiwan’s western and northern coastal areas and declared Taiwan as a province of the Qing Empire in 1885.
translations.reference: Ngo-1683, amabutho obukhosi buka-Qing (1644-1912) athatha izindawo ezingasogwini ezisentshonalanga nasenyakatho ne-Taiwan futhi amisa i-Taiwan njengesifundazwe sombuso ka-Qing ngo-1885.
translations.hypothesis: Ngo-1683, amabutho ase-Qing dynasty (1644-1912) agquze ukulawula izindawo zolwandle zasentshonalanga nezempumalanga zase-Taiwan, futhi ngo-1885, i-Taiwan yashiyelwa ukuba yingxenye ye-Qing Empire.

translations.source: In 1895, after defeat in the First Sino-Japanese War (1894-1895), the Qing government signs the Treaty of Shimonoseki, by which it cedes sovereignty over Taiwan to Japan, which rules the island until 1945.
translations.reference: Ngo-1895, ngemva kokuhlulwa eMpini Yokuqala yamaJapani yase—ino (1894-1895), uhulumeni wase-Qing usayina Isivumelwano se-Simonoseki, ngaso edlulisela iTaiwan eJapani, ebusa isiqhingi kuze kube ngu-1945.
translations.hypothesis: Ngo-1895, ngemuva kokunqotshwa kwiMpi yokuqala yase-Sino-Japanese (1894-1895), uhulumeni wase-Qing usayine iSivumelwano sase-Shimonoseki, ngokusho kwalokho uhlanga ukulawula i-Taiwan eJapan, eyayilawula leli ziko kuze kube ngu-1945.

translations.source: Machu Picchu consist of three main structures, namely Intihuatana, the Temple of the Sun, and the Room of the Three Windows.
translations.reference: IMachu Picchu yenziwa izakhiwo ezintathu eziyinhloko, okungukuthi i-Intihuatana, i-Temple of the Sun, kanye ne-Room of the Three Windows.
translations.hypothesis: I-Machu Picchu iqukethe izakhiwo ezintathu ezinkulu, okuyi-Intihuatana, ithempeli yelanga, kanye negumbi elinezikhukhula ezintathu.

translations.source: Most of the buildings on the edges of the complex have been rebuilt in order to give tourists a better idea of how they originally appeared.
translations.reference: Izakhiwo eziningi onqenqemeni lwendawo yokuhlala zakhiwe kabusha ukuzi zinikeze izivakashi umqondo ongcono wendlela ezazibukeka ngayo ekuqaleni.
translations.hypothesis: Iningi zalakhi ezintungamuxweni yalesi ndawo zakhiwe kabusha ukuze kuboniswe kubavakashi ukuthi zingabonakala kanjani ngaleso sikhathi.

translations.source: By 1976, thirty percent of Machu Picchu had been restored and restoration continues till today.
translations.reference: Ngo-1976, amaphesenti angamashumi amathathu weMachu Picchu ayebuyiselwe esimweni sasekuqaleni futhi ukubuyiselwa kusaqhubeka kuze kube namuhla.
translations.hypothesis: Ngo-1976, amaphesenti athathi-30 e-Machu Picchu ayisetshenzisiwe futhi ukulungiswa kulo ndawo luyaqhubeka kuze kube namuhla.

translations.source: For example, the most common still image photography format in the world is 35mm, which was the dominant film size at the close of the analog film era.
translations.reference: Ngokwesibonelo, indlela evamile kakhulu yohlobo lwesithombe emhlabeni ingu-35mm, ewubukhulu obufanayo nobefilimu ekupheleni kwesiqephu senkathi yamafilimu.
translations.hypothesis: Ngokwesibonelo, uhlobo oludume kakhulu lwemifanekiso ehlala njengefulembo emhlabeni wonke yi-35mm, okuyiyo ukusetshenziswa okuyinhloko kwefilimu ngesikhathi esiphelele lesikhathi sefilimu yangaphambilini.

translations.source: It is still produced today, but more importantly its aspect ratio has been inherited by digital camera image sensor formats.
translations.reference: Isenziwa nanamuhla, kodwa okubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi ubudlelwane bayo bobude nobukhulu buthathwe izimo zokuthungatha isithombe zekhamera yedijithali.
translations.hypothesis: Nakuba kuseyilwa namuhla, okubaluleke kakhulu ukuthi ubukhulu bayo bendabuko ususetshenziswa ezinhlelweni zama-sensor ezithwebula izithombe kakamera yedijithali.

translations.source: The 35mm format is actually, somewhat confusingly, 36mm in width by 24mm in height.
translations.reference: Ifomethi ka-35mm empeleni, ngodidayo ngokunye, ingu-36mm ububanzi kuphindwe ngo-24mm ubude.
translations.hypothesis: Ifomethi ye-35mm, ngempela, iyindlela ethule kancane, enebubanzi be-36mm kanye nendawo ephezulu engu-24mm.

translations.source: The aspect ratio of this format (dividing by twelve to obtain the simplest whole-number ratio) is therefore said to be 3:2.
translations.reference: Isilinganiso sobubanzi ebudeni salefomethi (ukudivayida ngeshumi nambili ukuze uthole isilinganiso senombolo ephelele elula) ngakho-ke kuthiwa singu-3:2.
translations.hypothesis: Ubukhulu bendawo yalesi fomethi (okutholwe ngokwabelana ngokusuka ku-12 ukuze uthole ubukhulu obuqondile obungenazinkinga) kushiwo ukuthi ngu-3:2.

translations.source: Many common formats (APS family of formats, for example) are equal to or closely approximate this aspect ratio.
translations.reference: Amafomethi amaningi avamile (iqoqo lamafomethi le-APS, ngokwesibonelo) ayalingana noma acishe alingane nalesi silinganiso sobubanzi ebudeni.
translations.hypothesis: Izinhlobo eziningi ezivamile (ngokwesibonelo, uhla lwezinhlobo ze-APS) zifana noma ziseduze kakhulu naleli lobo loluphawu.

translations.source: The much-abused and often-ridiculed rule of thirds is a simple guideline creating dynamism while keeping a measure of order in an image.
translations.reference: Lomthetho wezingxenye ezintathu esetshenziswa kabi kakhulu nonganakwa ngokuvamile isiqondiso esilula sokwenza ubuhle ube ugcina izinga lokuhleleka esithombeni.
translations.hypothesis: Lo mthetho wama-athathu, ofaniswa kakhulu futhi ngasekuphileni wahlukaniswa, uyisikhombiso esilula esidalula ukuguquguquka kuyilapho kugcinwa ukuhleleka okuthile esithombeni.

translations.source: It states that the most effective place for the main subject is at the intersection of lines dividing the image into thirds vertically and horizontally (see example).
translations.reference: Ithi indawo ephumelela kakhulu ngesihloko esikhulu ilapho imigqa ihlangana khona ukuze ihlukanise isithombe kathathu ngokuqondile nangokuvundlile (bheka isibonelo).
translations.hypothesis: Kucacisiwe ukuthi indawo efanele kakhulu yento ebalulekile kukhona lapho imigqa ehlukanisa isithombe ngama-thethini amane, kokubili ngqo kanye ngokhuphayo, ihlangana (bheka isibonelo).

translations.source: During this period of European history, the Catholic Church, which had become rich and powerful, came under scrutiny.
translations.reference: Phakathi nalenkathi yomlando waseYurophu, iSonto lamaKatolika, elalicebile futhi linamandla, lahlolisiswa.
translations.hypothesis: Ngalesi sikhathi yezindaba zamaYurophu, iBandla LamaKatolika, elilokhu liyathuthuka futhi luyazwakala, latholakala lithi kumele luhloliswe.

translations.source: For over a thousand years the Christian religion had bound European states together despite differences in language and customs. I
translations.reference: Ngaphezu kweminyaka eyinkulungwane inkolo yobuKhristu yahlanganisa amazwe waseYurophu ndawonye ngaphezu kokuhluka kwezilimi namasiko.
translations.hypothesis: Ngaphezu kuka-1000 anyaka, ubudumiso bukaKristu ubuhlanganise izizwe zaseYurophu, ngaphandle kokuthi kube khona umehluko ngolimi nezindlela zempilo.

translations.source: Its all-pervading power affected everyone from king to commoner.
translations.reference: Amandla waso akuyo yonke indawo athinta wonke umuntu kusukela enkosini kuya emuntwini ovamile.
translations.hypothesis: Amandla ayo, ayeyisikhathi sonke futhi ayeyaphakathi kuso sonke, ayethinta wonke umuntu, kusukela kumfeli kuya kumuntwini ongumuntwini.

translations.source: One of the main Christian tenets is that wealth should be used to alleviate suffering and poverty and that the monetary funds of the church are there specifically for that reason.
translations.reference: Enye yemigomo eyinhloko yobuKristu ukuthi ingcebo kufanele isetshenziselwe ukudambisa ukuhlupheka nobuphofu nokuthi imali yebandla ilapho ngenxa yaleso sizathu.
translations.hypothesis: Enye yezinto ezibalulekile zamaKristu ukuthi impahla kufanele isetshenziswe ukunciphisa ukulimala kanye nokubuthakathaka, futhi imali yentsha kufanele isetshenziswe ngalokho kuphela.

translations.source: The central authority of the church had been in Rome for over a thousand years and this concentration of power and money led many to question whether this tenet was being met.
translations.reference: Abaphathi abakhulu besonto babeseRoma iminyaka engaphezu kwenkulungwane futhi lokhu kuqoqana kwamandla nemali kwaholela abaningi ekusoleni ukuthi lomgomo wemfundiso uyafinyelelwa yini.
translations.hypothesis: Ubulungu obukhulu bendawo yomphakathi wamaKristu ubungaseRoma iminyaka engama-1000, futhi lokhu kukhona kwamandla kanye nemali kwenza abaningi bacimbe ukuthi le mithetho yayilandelwa yini.

translations.source: Soon after the outbreak of hostilities, Britain initiated a naval blockade of Germany.
translations.reference: Ngokushesha ngemva kobutha, iBrithani yaqala ukuvimbezela iJalimane ngemikhumbi.
translations.hypothesis: Ngokulandelana okuthile ngemuva kokuqala kwezimpi, iBhritane iqalise ukuvinjelwa kwamabhadi ezilwandle eJalimane.

translations.source: The strategy proved effective, cutting off vital military and civilian supplies, although this blockade violated generally accepted international law codified by several international agreements of the past two centuries.
translations.reference: Isu libonakale lisebenza, ukususwa kwezinto ezidingwa ibutho lamasosha nabantu abavamile, nakuba lokhu kuvimbela kuphule imithetho yamazwe wonke elungiswe izivumelwano zamazwe amaningana wamakhulu amabili eminyaka adlule.
translations.hypothesis: Le ndlela eyayihlelwe yabo ibonise ukuthi yayisebenza, ngoba yanquma ukutholakala kwezinto ezibalulekile zama-militari kanye nezinto ezidingekayo abantu, nakuba leli nqubo yahluleka ukuhambisana nomthetho kazwelonke osemthethweni, okuyinto eyayixutshwa ngemibandela eminingi kazwelonke eyayikhona kule minyaka embalwa eyedlule.

translations.source: Britain mined international waters to prevent any ships from entering entire sections of ocean, causing danger to even neutral ships.
translations.reference: I-Britain imba amanzi ezwekazi ukuze ivimbele imikhumbi ukuthi ingene kuyo yonke ingxenye yolwandle, okubangela izingozi ngisho nasemikhunjini evamile.
translations.hypothesis: I-Bhritani yasetshezi ezindaweni zamaholwa kazwelonke ukuze kuvinjelwe noma yiliphi iloyisi ukungena ezindaweni ezithile zolwandle, okubangele ingozi ngisho nezinkampani ezisengxenyeni.

translations.source: Since there was limited response to this tactic, Germany expected a similar response to its unrestricted submarine warfare.
translations.reference: Njengoba bekunokusabela okulinganiselwe kulendlela, iJalimane beyilindele ukusabela okufanayo empini yayo engavinjelwe yemikhumbi yangaphansi kwamanzi.
translations.hypothesis: Ngokuba bekukhona ukuphenduka okuncane kulolu hlelo, iJalimane yalindela ukuthi kuzoba nomphumela ofanayo ngomkhankaso wayo wokulwa ngamabhungane ngaphandle kwemingcele.

translations.source: During the 1920s, the prevailing attitudes of most citizens and nations was that of pacifism and isolation.
translations.reference: Ngezikhathi zawo-1920, izimo zengqondo zezakhamuzi eziningi kanye nezizwe bezikholwa ukuzonda impi nokulwa kanye nokuzihlukanisa.
translations.hypothesis: Ngaleso sikhathi, ngasekupheleni kuka-1920, imibono evamile yabantu abaningi kanye nezizwe yayiyona yokuziphonsela phansi nokuzihlanganisa.

translations.source: After seeing the horrors and atrocities of war during World War I, nations desired to avoid such a situation again in the future.
translations.reference: Ngemva kokubona izenzo zonya nezishaqisayo zempi phakathi neMpi Yezwe I, izizwe zafisa ukugwema isimo esinjalo futhi esikhathini esizayo.
translations.hypothesis: Ngemuva kokubona ukubulawa nokungcweti okukhulu ngesikhathi sompi yempi yokuqala yomhlaba, amazwe afisa ukugwema ukuthi isimo esinjalo ngabe kukhona futhi esikhathini esizayo.

translations.source: In 1884, Tesla moved to the United States of America to accept a job with the Edison Company in New York City.
translations.reference: Ngo-1884 uTesla wathuthela eMelika ukwamukela umsebenzi neNkampani ka-Edison eDolobheni lase-New York.
translations.hypothesis: Ngo-1884, uTesla wathuthela e-United States of America ukuze athole umsebenzi kwi-Edison Company e-New York City.

translations.source: He arrived in the US with 4 cents to his name, a book of poetry, and a letter of recommendation from Charles Batchelor (his manager in his previous job) to Thomas Edison.
translations.reference: Ufike eMelika enamasenti angu-4 egameni lakhe, incwadi yezinkondlo, kanye nencwadi yokutusa evela ku-Charles Batchelor (umphathi wakhe wasemsebenzini wakhe wangaphambili) iya kuThomas Edison.
translations.hypothesis: Ufike e-Amerika enento eyi-4 cents kuphela, incwadi yezinkondlo, kanye negama elihle elalifakwe kulethili elalithunyelwe uCharles Batchelor (owayeyiphini lakhe emsebenzini wakhe wangaphambilini) kuThomas Edison.

translations.source: Ancient China had a unique way of showing different time periods; each stage of China or each family that was in power was a distinctive dynasty.
translations.reference: IShayina yamandulo yayinendlela ehlukile yokuveza izinkathi ezihlukile; isigaba ngasinye seShayina noma umndeni ngamunye owawubusa wawuwubukhosi obuhlukile.
translations.hypothesis: EChina yasekuseni yayinohlela izikhathi ezihlukene ngendlela eyodwa, ngoba ngamanye amathuba, ngisho nefamilini ethile eyayiphakathi ekubandleni, yayibizwa ngokuthi "ubuduma" obuhlukile.

translations.source: Also between each dynasty was an unstable age of divided provinces. The best-known of these periods was the Three Kingdoms epoch taking place for 60 years between the Han and the Jin Dynasty.
translations.reference: Futhi phakathi kobukhosi ngabunye kwakuyiminyaka engazinzile yezifundazwe ezihlukene. Inkathi eyaziwa kakhulu kulezi kwakuyinkathi yemibuso emithathu eyenzeka iminyaka engama-60 phakathi koMbusokaHan noJin.
translations.hypothesis: Ngaphezu kwalokho, phakathi kwazo zonke izizukulwane, kwakukhona izikhathi ezinganqatshwayo zombango obanzi, lapho izifundazwe zabe zihlukaniswe. Enye yalezi zikhathi ezaziwayo kakhulu kwakuyi-"Three Kingdoms epoch," eyenzekile iminyaka engama-60 phakathi kwezizukulwane ze-Han ne-Jin.

translations.source: During these periods fierce warfare took place between many nobles fighting for the throne.
translations.reference: Phakathi nalesi sikhathi kwakuba nezimpi ezinodlame phakathi kwababusi belwela ubukhosi.
translations.hypothesis: Ngezikhathi zalezi, kwenzeka ukulwa okukhulu phakathi kwabafundisi abaningi abalwisana ngendawo yombuso.

translations.source: The Three Kingdoms was one of the bloodiest eras in Ancient China’s history thousands of people died fighting to sit in the highest seat in the grand palace at Xi’an.
translations.reference: IMibuso Emithathu kwakungenye yenkathi yegazi eliningi kunazo zonke emlandweni waseShayina yakuDala, izinkulungwane zabantu zafa zilwela ukuhlala esihlalweni esiphakeme kakhulu esigodlweni esihle e-Xi’an.
translations.hypothesis: I-Three Kingdoms kwakuyinyanga eyodwa emincane kakhulu emlandweni wase-China wasendulo, lapho izinkulungwane zabantu zifele khona ngesikhathi ziqhuba ukuze zithole indawo ephakeme kakhulu endaweni enkulu yendlu yangasese e-Xi'an.

translations.source: There are a lot of social and political effects such as the use of metric system, a shift from absolutism to republicanism, nationalism and the belief the country belongs to the people not to one sole ruler.
translations.reference: Kunemiphumela eminingi yezenhlalo neyezepolitiki efana nokusetshenziswa kohlelo lokulinganisa ngamamitha, ukusuka ekukholelweni ezimisweni eziphelele kuya ekusekeleni izimiso zoburiphabhuliki, ubuzwe kanye nenkolelo yokuthi izwe elabantu hhayi umbusi oyedwa.
translations.hypothesis: Kunezinto eziningi ezithinta ezombuso kanye nezombangazwe, njengokusebenziswa kwefomula yezinhlanzeko, ukuguquka okusuka ekubandlululweni ukuya kwezombangazwe, ukuzimisela kwesizwe, kanye nomqondo wokuthi izwe liyona abantu, hhayi umholi omdala.

translations.source: Also after the Revolution occupations were open to all male applicants allowing the most ambitious and successful to succeed.
translations.reference: Futhi ngemva kweNguquko izikhundla zazivulekele bonke abesilisa abafake izicelo okwavumela ukuthi abafuna ukuvelela kakhulu nokubahambela kahle baphumelele.
translations.hypothesis: Ngaphandle kwalokho, ngemuva kwebhuloho, yonke imisebenzi yayivulekile kubo bonke abafundi besilisa, okwenza ukuthi labo abanentholo enkulu kanye nalabo abaphumelele kakhulu bakwazi ukufezeka.

translations.source: Same goes for the military because instead of army rankings being based on class they were now based on cailaber.
translations.reference: Lokhu kufana nalokhu okwenzeka kumabutho amasosha kunokuba babheke inhlanga yakho bona bakhetha ukubeka i-cailaber ukuze banike amasosha ama-ratings.
translations.hypothesis: Okufanayo kukhona emaqenjini ezempi, ngoba esikhathini esidlule, amabanga ezempi ayenzelwe ngokuya ngamakilasi, kodwa manje ayenzelwa ngokuya ngobubanzi bomsebenzi.

translations.source: The French Revolution also inspired many other repressed working class people of other country's to began their own revolutions.
translations.reference: INguquko kwaseFulansi kugqugquzele abanye abantu abasebenzayo abacindezelwe bakwamanye abazwe ukuthi baqale ukuvukela kwabo.
translations.hypothesis: UMbutho waseFrance ubonise abanye abantu abaningi ababezwelwe, ababezilayelwe ezweni elinye, ukuthi baqale izimpi zabo.

translations.source: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation.
translations.reference: UMuhammad wayenesithakazelo esijulile ezindabeni zokuphila ezingaphathelene nezinto zalomhlaba. Wayevame ukuya emhumeni owaziwa ngokuthi “iHira” eNtabeni “yeNoor” (ukukhanya) ukuze ayozindla.
translations.hypothesis: UMuhammad wayenentshisekelo enkulu ezindabeni ezingaphezu kohlulekile lwaphakathi. Vamile ukungena endaweni eyayaziwa ngokuthi "i-Hira'" endlovini e-"Noor" (ukukhanya), lapho ayengakhathazwa khona.

translations.source: he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations.
translations.reference: Umhume ngokwawo, obekhona kuze kube manje, unikeza isithombe esicacile sokuthambekela okungokomoya kukaMuhammad.
translations.hypothesis: Le cave ngokuyisikhathi, eyagcina ukuhlala, inikeza isithombe esiqinile kakhulu mayelana nokuzimisela kukaMuhammad kwezinto ezinhle.

translations.source: Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world.
translations.reference: Umhume ohlezi phezu kwenye yezintaba zasenyakatho yase-Mecca, ukude kakhulu nomhlaba wonke.
translations.hypothesis: Le cave, etholakala phezulu kwelinye lamagquma asempumalanga ye-Mecca, ihlukaniswe ngokuphelele kunoma yiluphi olunye indawo emhlabeni.

translations.source: In fact, it is not easy to find at all even if one knew it existed. Once inside the cave, it is a total isolation.
translations.reference: Eqinisweni, akulula ukuyithola ngisho noma wazi ukuthi ikhona. Uma isingaphakathi emhumeni isuke isihlukaniswe ngokuphelele.
translations.hypothesis: Empeleni, kunzima kakhulu ukuthola indawo ethi, ngisho noma umuntu azi ukuthi iyikhona. Uma ngemuva kwegeja, uyazwa ukuthi ukhululiwe ngokuphelele.

translations.source: Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.
translations.reference: Akukho okubonakalayo phezulu ngaphandle kwesibhakabhaka esibalele, esihle kanye nezintaba eziningi ezizungezile. Kuncane kakhulu okwalelizwe okubonakalayo noma okuzwakalayo uma uphakathi emgedeni.
translations.hypothesis: Akukho lutho ongabona ngaphandle kwalolu lwazi, elihle, elilapha phezulu, kanye nezintaba eziningi ezizungezile. Kuncane kakhulu lokhu okungabonwa noma kulalwe ngaphakathi kwendawo.

translations.source: The Great Pyramid at Giza is the only one of the seven wonders that is still standing today.
translations.reference: I-Great Pyramid yase-Giza iyokuphela kwizimangaliso eziyisikhombisa esamile nanamuhla.
translations.hypothesis: I-Pyramid enkulu e-Giza yiyona kuphela phakathi kwezinto ezimbili ezimangalisayo eziyisikhombisa ezisafakelwa namuhla.

translations.source: Built by the Egyptians in the third century BCE, the Great Pyramid is one of many large pyramid structures built to honor dead Pharaoh.
translations.reference: Yakhiwe ngabaseGibhithe ngekhulu lesithathu leminyaka BCE, I-Great Pyramide, ngelinye lezakhiwo zamaphiramidi ezakhelwe ukuhlonipha uFaro oshonile.
translations.hypothesis: I-Great Pyramid yakhiwa ngamaGibhithe ngesikhathi esingu-3 BCE, futhi ingelinye lamakhuphoni amakhulu alakhiwe ukuze uhlonishwe iziphathi zaseGibhithe ezife.

translations.source: The Giza Plateau, or "Giza Necropolis" in the Egyptian Valley of the Dead contains several pyramids (of which the great pyramid is the largest), several small tombs, several temples, and the great Sphinx.
translations.reference: I-Giza Plateau, noma "i-Giza Necropolis" eSigodini sabaFile saseGibhithe linemibhoshongo emingxa-ntathu eminingana (leyo umbhoshongo omkhulu kuyiwo omkhulu kakhulu), amathuna amaningana amancane, amathempeli amaningana, kanye ne-Sphinx enkulu.
translations.hypothesis: Iphakethe le-Giza, noma "i-Giza Necropolis" ekuHlathi Lokufa laseGibhithe, iqukethe amaphiramidi amaningi (okuthi ephiramidi enkulu kakhulu yikhulu phakathi kwawo), izindlu zokugcina izinkukhumo ezincane eziningi, izitabha eziningi, kanye ne-Sphinx enkulu.

translations.source: The great pyramid was created to honor the Pharaoh Khufu, and many of the smaller pyramids, tombs, and temples were built to honor Khufu's wives and family members.
