translations.reference: Umbhoshongo omkhulu ongunxa-ntathu wakhelwa ukuhlonipha uFaro uKhufu, futhi neminye imibhoshongo engunxa-ntathu emincanyana, amathuna, kanye namathempeli akhelwe ukuhlonipha inkosikazi kaKhufu kanye namalungu omndeni.
translations.hypothesis: Leli phiramidi enkulu lakhiwa ukuze kukhonziwe uPharaoh uKhufu, futhi eziningi zamaphiramidi amancane, izigodlo, kanye namathempeli zakhiwe ukuze kukhonziwe abafazi kaKhufu kanye namalungu omndeni wakhe.

translations.source: The "up bow" mark looks like a V and the "down bow mark" like a staple or a square missing its bottom side.
translations.reference: Uphawu "lomnsalo ophezulu" olubukeka njengo-V kanti "uphawu lomnsalo ophansi" lubukeka njengesigaxa noma isikwele esishoda ngohlangothi lwaso olungaphansi.
translations.hypothesis: I-phawu "yokuphakamisa" ibukeka njenge-V, kanti i-phawu "yokuphonsa" ibukeka njengento efana nomshini wokubhala noma umugqa oyi-square kodwa engenalo ingxenye yaphansi.

translations.source: Up means you should start at the tip and push the bow, and down means you should start at the frog (which is where your hand is holding the bow) and pull the bow.
translations.reference: Phezulu kusho ukuthi kumelwe uqale ekugcineni bese uphusha umnsalo, kanti phansi kusho ukuthi kumelwe uqale exoxweni (okusho ukuthi lapho ubambe khona umnsalo) bese ugobisa umcibisholo.
translations.hypothesis: Uma ubheke phezulu, kusho ukuthi kufanele uqale ngesigqi esiphezulu bese udonsa umuthi. Uma ubheke phansi, kusho ukuthi kufanele uqale endaweni lapho isandla sakho libamba umuthi (eyayilwa) bese udonsa umuthi.

translations.source: An up-bow usually generates a softer sound, while a down-bow is stronger and more assertive.
translations.reference: Umnsalo ophezulu ujwayele ukwenza umsindo opholile, kanti umnsalo ophansi wenza umsindo onamandla noqinile kakhudlwana.
translations.hypothesis: Ukudlala ngesigqi esiphakamiswe kuvame ukukhiqiza umsindo obuthukile, kanti ukudlala ngesigqi esiphansi kubukhulu futhi kunamandla amaningi.

translations.source: Feel free to pencil in your own marks, but remember the printed bowing marks are there for a musical reason, so they should usually be respected.
translations.reference: Zizwe ukhululekile ukubhala izimpawu zakho ngepensela, kepha khumbula izimpawu eziphrintiwe ezehlayo zikhona ngesizathu esingokomculo, ngakho-ke kufanele zihlonishwe.
translations.hypothesis: Zizwe ukuthi ungabhala izimpawu zakho, kodwa khumbula ukuthi izimpawu ezibhalwe zikhona ngenhloso yomculo, ngakho-ke kufanele zihlale zihlonishwa.

translations.source: The terrified King Louis XVI, Queen Marie Antoinette their two young children (11 year old Marie Therese and four year old Louis-Charles) and the King's sister, Madam Elizabeth, on the 6th October 1789 were forced back to Paris from Versailles by a mob of market women.
translations.reference: Inkosi uLouis XVI ethukile, iNdlovukazi uMarie Antoinette kanye nezingane zabo ezincane ezimbili (uMarie Therese oneminyaka engu-11 ubudala kanye noLouis-Charles eneminyaka emine ubudala) kanye nodadewabo weNkosi, iNkosazana u-Elizabeth, ngomhla ka-6 kuMfumfu 1789 baphoqelelwa ukubuyela eParis besuka eVersailles uquqaba lwabesifazane basemakethe.
translations.hypothesis: UMfeli uKing Louis XVI, uMkhosi uMarie Antoinette, izingane zabo ezimbili ezincane (uMarie Therese oneminyaka eyishumi nanye noLouis-Charles oneminyaka emine), kanye nomfowabo kaMkhosi, uMadam Elizabeth, ngo-Okthoba 6, 1789, babuyiswe eParis kusukela eVersailles yiqembu lamabhodlela ezitolo.

translations.source: In a carriage, they traveled back to Paris surrounded by a mob of people screaming and shouting threats against the King and Queen.
translations.reference: Besenkalishini, babuyela emuva ePherisi bezungezwe uquqaba lwabantu oluklabalasa kanye nokumemeza izinsongo ngokumelene neNkosi kanye neNdlovukazi.
translations.hypothesis: Ngogesi, bahamba ngobuyele eParis, bezizungezwe abantu abaningi ababheke, abasho ngalokhu futhi abaxwayisa uMuzi kanye noMkhosi.

translations.source: The mob of people forced the King And Queen to have their carriage windows wide open.
translations.reference: Isixuku sabantu siphoqelele iNkosi kanye neNdlovukazi ukuba bavule kakhulu amafasitela esithuthi sabo.
translations.hypothesis: Isiqembu labantu belimane nabaMeli kanye Nomfazi kaMeli ukuthi afake amakhwincha ezimoto zabo avuleke kakhulu.

translations.source: At one point a member of the mob waved the head of a royal guard killed at Versailles in front of the terrified Queen.
translations.reference: Kunesikhathi lapho ilungu loquqaba lalifuna ukunqathuzisa ikhanda lonogada wasebukhosini obulawe eVersailles phambi kweNdlovukazi ethukile.
translations.hypothesis: Ngesikhathi esisodwa, ilungu leqembu labantu belashaya umuntu elihluphile likakhulumela ikhanda lomphathi omkhulu wasezikhungweni zombuso owaye ubulawa eVersailles, elibonisa ikhanda kulenkosi ethukile.

translations.source: The war expenditures of U.S. imperialism in the conquest of the Philippines were paid for by the Filipino people themselves.
translations.reference: Izindleko zempi zobukhosi baseMelika lapho inqoba iPhilippines zakhokhelwa abantu basePhilippines ngokwabo.
translations.hypothesis: Izindleko zomuzi womkhonto wase-US ezasetshenziswa ekunqobeni kwePhilippines zikhokhwa ngabantu base-Philippines ngokwabo.

translations.source: They were compelled to pay taxes to the U.S. colonial regime to defray a major part of the expenditures and the interest on bonds floated in the name of the Philippine government through the Wall Street banking houses.
translations.reference: Baphoqelelwa ukukhokhela intela umbuso wobukoloni waseMelika ukukhokha ingxenye enkulu yezindleko futhi inzalo yamabhondi yabekwa egameni likahulumeni wasePhilippines ngezindlu zasebhange zeWall Street.
translations.hypothesis: Baxoshiwe ukuthi babefanele bakhokhe intela kumphakathi waseMelika owayeyiphalamende ukuze akhokhe ingxenye enkulu yezindleko kanye nomzuzo wezikhwama zentambo ezathweswa ngigama lebhanca likahulumeni wase-Philippine ngamabhange ase-Wall Street.

translations.source: Of course, the superprofits derived from the protracted exploitation of the Filipino people would constitute the basic gains of U.S. imperialism.
translations.reference: Kusobala, izinzuzo ezinkulu ezitholwe ngokuxhaphazwa okungapheli kwabantu baseFilipino benza izinzuzo eziyisisekelo zobukhosi baseMelika.
translations.hypothesis: Ngokungangazi, inzuzo enkulu etholwe ngokusebenzisa abantu base-Filipino kakhulu ingaba yifuzu eyisisekelo ye-imperialismu yase-United States.

translations.source: To understand the Templars one must understand the context that prompted the creation of the order.
translations.reference: Ukuze uqonde amaTemplar umuntu kufanele aqonde umcabango owadala le nhlangano.
translations.hypothesis: Ukuze siqonde i-Templars, kufanele siqonde isimo esayidalula ukusungulwa kwalo mqulu.

translations.source: The age where the events took place is commonly referred as the High Middle Ages the period of European history in the 11th, 12th, and 13th centuries (AD 1000–1300).
translations.reference: Inkathi lapho kube nesehlakalo khona ivame ukubhekiselwa ngokuthi Inkathi Ephakathi Ephezulu inkathi yomlando waseYurophu ngekhulu lama-11, lama-12, kanye nelama-13 leminyaka (AD 1000–1300).
translations.hypothesis: Isikhathi lapho lezi zenzakalo zenzekile kuhlanganiswa ngokuthi "Isikhathi Esikhulu Sempophoma," okuyisikhathi esibalulekile emlandweni waseYurophu, ngasekuqaleni kuka-11 kuya ku-13, kusukela ngo-1000 kuya ku-1300 AD.

translations.source: The High Middle Ages were preceded by the Early Middle Ages and followed by the Late Middle Ages, which by convention ends around 1500.
translations.reference: IHigh Middle Ages yandulelwa i-Early Middle Ages futhi yase ilandelwa iLate Middle Ages, ngokwenjwayelo iphela ngabo ends around 1500.
translations.hypothesis: Izikhathi ezithile ezibizwa ngokuthi "Izikhathi Ezinde Zokuqala" zalandela "Izikhathi Ezinde Ezisemhlabeni," futhi ngemuva kazo zayo "Izikhathi Ezinde Zakugcina," ezokuqeda ngokuphathelene cishe ngo-1500.

translations.source: Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology.
translations.reference: Inkolelo yokumiselwa okungokwezobuchwepheshe igama elihlanganisa imibono eminingi esebenzayo, kusukela ekusebenziseni ezobuchwepheshe ezikhona noma ekutheni ezobuchwepheshe ziyadingeka kuya emuzweni oqinile wokuthi ukumiselwa kwesintu kuholwa umcabango ojulile ohlobene nemithetho yesayensi nokubonakala kwayo kwezobuchwepheshe.
translations.hypothesis: Ukungathwa kwezobuchwepheshe kuyindlebe efaka phakathi izindlela eziningi zengqondo nokusebenza, kusukela ekubekeni phambili kobuchwepheshe noma "ukuyalelwa" ngobuchwepheshe, kuya ekubekeni kwesimo eliqinile sokuthi ukulingana komuntu kunelwa ngomthetho osemthethweni ohlobene nemithetho yezemfundo kanye nokubonakala kwalo emikhakheni yobuchwepheshe.

translations.source: Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has "effects" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned.
translations.reference: Izincazelo eziningi zenkolelo yokumiselwa okungokwezobuchwepheshe buhlanganyela imibono emibili evamile: ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe ngokwakho kulandela indlela engaphezu kwethonya lesiko noma lepolotiki kakhulu, kanye nokuthi ezobuchwepheshe nazo "nemithelela" emiphakathini ezuzwayo ngokwemvelo, kunangezimo zenhlalo.
translations.hypothesis: Nakuba zihluke kakhulu, imibono eminingi mayelana nokuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe yabelana ngemibono emibili: ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe ngokwayo kulandela indlela engakhululekile kakhulu ezimweni zamasiko noma zezombusazwe, futhi ukuthi ubuchwepheshe, ngakho, bunomthelela "emiphakathini" engokwemvelo, kunokuthi kuthuthukiswe ngomphakathi.

translations.source: For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads.
translations.reference: Ngokwesibonelo, othile angathi imoto iholela ekwakhiweni kwemigwaqo.
translations.hypothesis: Ngokwesibonelo, umuntu angase uthi imoto kufanele ihilele ukuthuthukiswa kwamaphathi.

translations.source: However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership.
translations.reference: Nokho, imigwaqo exhumanisa izwe lonke ayizuzisi ngokomnotho ezimotweni ezimbalwa nje kuphela, ngakho izindlela ezintsha zokukhiqiza ziyenziwa ukunciphisa inani lokuba nemoto.
translations.hypothesis: Nokho, ukwakhiwa kwenethiwekhi enkulu yomgwaqo kulo lonke izwe akuyona into engabhekwa ngokuthi kuncono uma kukhona imoto embalwa nje, ngakho-ke kufakazwa izindlela ezintsha zokukhiqiza ukuze kuncishiswe izindleko zokuba nomoto.

translations.source: Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies.
translations.reference: Ukuba nezimoto kwabantu abaningi nakho kuholela ezigamekweni eziphakeme zezingozi emigwaqweni, okuholela ekusungulweni kwezindlela ezintsha kwezempilo zokulungisa imizimba elimele.
translations.hypothesis: Ukuthi abantu abaningi banemoto futhi kuholela ekwenyeni kwezishayizolo eziningi emigwaqweni, okubangela ukuthi kuthuthukiswe izindlela ezintsha zokunakekelwa kwezempilo ukuze kulungiswe imilomo eyonakekile.

translations.source: Romanticism had a large element of cultural determinism, drawn from writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel.
translations.reference: I-Romanticism  yabanomthelela omkhulu ezinkolelweni zokuziphatha zamasiko, okuthathelwa kubabhali abanjengoGoethe, uFichte, kanye noSchlegel.
translations.hypothesis: Ukukhuthazwa kwamaRomantiki kwaba nomthelela omkhulu wezinto eziqukethwe ngobudlelwano bomphakathi, okutholwe kubabhali abafana noGoethe, uFichte, noSchlegel.

translations.source: In the context of Romanticism, the geography molded individuals, and over time customs and culture related to that geography arose, and these, being in harmony with the place of the society, were better than arbitrarily imposed laws.
translations.reference: Esizindeni seRomanticism, indawo ibumba abantu ngabanye, futhi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi imikhuba nesiko ehlobene naleyo ndawo yavela, futhi lena, ivumelana nendawo yomphakathi, yayingcono kunemithetho emiswe ngokunganaki.
translations.hypothesis: Kule ndaba yobuhle bendawo, indawo yangomlando yayilungisa abantu, futhi kakhulu kakhulu, amakhava nezindlela zempilo ezihlobene nale ndawo zavezwa, futhi lezi zinto, njengoba zihambisana nomuzwa nomphakathi, zazingcono kunomthetho ovamile ohlanganiswe ngaphandle kokucabangela.

translations.source: In the manner that Paris is known as the fashion capital of the contemporary world, Constantinople was regarded as the fashion capital of feudal Europe.
translations.reference: Ngendlela iParis eyaziwa ngayo njengenhlokodolobha yezwe lamanje, iConstantinople yayibhekwa njengenhlokodolobha yezikhonzi zaseYurophu.
translations.hypothesis: Njengoba i-Paris eyaziwa njengegugu lezifashini kulo mhlaba wamanje, i-Constantinople yayibukwa njengegugu lezifashini e-Yurophu yasekuqaleni.

translations.source: Its renown for being an epicenter of luxury began in about 400 A.D. and lasted up until about 1100 A.D.
translations.reference: Yaziwa ngokuba yindawo yalapho kwaqala khona izinto zikanokusho cishe ngo-400 A.D. futhi yahlala cishe kwaze kaba u-1100 A.D.
translations.hypothesis: Idumela layo njengendawo ebaluleke kakhulu yobuhle begani ngama-400 A.D. futhi lakuqhubeka kuze kube ngama-1100 A.D.

translations.source: Its status declined during the twelfth century mainly due to the fact that Crusaders had returned bearing gifts such as silks and spices that were valued more than what Byzantine markets offered.
translations.reference: Isimo sayo sawohloka phakathi nekhulu leminyaka leshumi nambili ngokuyinhloko ngenxa yokuthi Abalweli Benkolo babebuye bephethe izipho ezinjengosilika nezinongo ezaziyigugu kunalezo imakethe yaseByzantium eyayinazo.
translations.hypothesis: Isimo sayo sasilamandla kakhulu ngesikhathi sesikhathi sesigama lesibili, kodwa sathe sanyamelana ngobubanzi ngenxa yokuthi abaxhasi bethu babuya ngemikhiqizo efana nezingubo ezinhle kanye nezitshalo ezitholakalayo, okwatholakala ukuthi zibaluleke kakhulu kunalokho okwakutholakala ezimakethe zaseByzantine.

translations.source: It was at this time that the transfer of the title of Fashion Capital from Constantinople to Paris was made.
translations.reference: Kwakungalesi sikhathi lapho ukudluliselwa kwesiqu seNhlokodolobha yeMfashini kusuka eKhonstantinopheli kuya ePherisi kwenziwa.
translations.hypothesis: Ngaleso sikhathi, ukuguqulwa kwegama "idolobha elikhulu emfashini" esuka e-Constantinople eya eParis kwenzeke.

translations.source: Gothic style peaked in the period between the 10th - 11th centuries and the 14th century.
translations.reference: Isitayela se-Gothic safinyelela umvuthwandaba enkathini ephakathi kwekhulu le-10 - 11 nekhulu le-14.
translations.hypothesis: Isitayela saseGothic saba sesikhulu kakhulu ngesikhathi esaphakathi kwezigaba zama-10 kuya kuma-11 kanye nama-14.

translations.source: At the beginning dress was heavily influenced by the Byzantine culture in the east.
translations.reference: Ekuqaleni ukwembatha kwakuthonywe kakhulu isiko laseByzantium empumalanga.
translations.hypothesis: Ekuqaleni, izimpahla zazinwetshwa kakhulu ngobunye obuhle bendawo yase-Byzantine eningizimu.

translations.source: However, due to the slow communication channels, styles in the west could lag behind by 25 to 30 year.
translations.reference: Noma kunjalo, ngenxa yokungabi khona kwezindlela zokuxhumana, izitayela zasentshonalanga zingasalela emuva ngeminyaka ewu-25 ukuya kwengu-30.
translations.hypothesis: Nokho, ngenxa yezindlela zokuxhumana ezilamile, izitayela ezivela e-West zingase zibe ngemuva ngeminyaka engama-25 kuya kwama-30.

translations.source: towards the end of the Middle Ages western Europe began to develop their own style. one of the biggest developments of the time as a result of the crusades people began to use buttons to fasten clothing.
translations.reference: Ngasekupheleni kweNkathi Ephakathi intshonalanga Yurophu yaqala ukuthuthukisa isitayela sayo. Enye yentuthuko enkulu kakhulu yaleso sikhathi ngenxa yabalweli benkolo abantu baqala ukusebenzisa izinkinobho ukubopha izimpahla zokugqoka.
translations.hypothesis: Ngenkathi yama-Middle Ages esondela ekugcwini, iYurophu yaseNtshonalanga yaqala ukuthuthukisa indlela yayo yezinto. Enye yezinto ezibalulekile ezathuthuka ngaleso sikhathi, ngenxa yomkhankaso, abantu baqala ukusebenzisa izibanti ukuvala izingubo.

translations.source: Subsistence agriculture is agriculture carried out for the production of enough food to meet just the needs of the agriculturalist and his/her family.
translations.reference: Ukulimela ukuziphilisa ukulima okwenzelwa ukukhiqiza ukudla okwanele ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomlimi kanye nomdeni wakhe kuphela.
translations.hypothesis: Ukulima lokudlula ukulima okwenziwa ukuze kukhishwe ukudla okwanele ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zomnikazi wefama nomndeni wakhe kuphela.

translations.source: Subsistence agriculture is a simple, often organic, system using saved seed native to the ecoregion combined with crop rotation or other relatively simple techniques to maximize yield.
translations.reference: Ukulimela ukuziphilisa indlela elula, ngovamile okususelwe ezintweni eziphilayo, kusetshenziswa imbewu egciniwe yasendaweni enezici ezingokwemvelo kuhlanganiswe nokushintshashintsha izilimo noma ezinye izindlela ezilula zokwenza umkhiqizo ube mningi.
translations.hypothesis: Ukulima okukhulu ukudla komndeni kuyindlela elula, evamise ukuba ngendlela yemvelo, esebenzisa imithi yezitshalo egcinwe kanye nezakulo mendulo, kanye nokuguqulwa kwezitshalo noma ezinye izindlela ezilula ukuze kukhuliswe ukukhiqizwa okukhulu.

translations.source: Historically most farmers were engaged in subsistence agriculture and this is still the case in many developing nations.
translations.reference: Ngokomlando abalimi abaningi babelimela ukuziphilisa futhi kusenjalo emazweni amaningi athuthukayo.
translations.hypothesis: Kwakudala, abafundi abaningi babenza ukulima ukuze bahlanganise ukudla kwabo, futhi lokhu kusasenzeka ezweni eziningi ezithuthukayo namuhla.

translations.source: Subcultures bring together like-minded individuals who feel neglected by societal standards and allow them to develop a sense of identity.
translations.reference: Amaqembu ahlukile ahlanganisa abantu abazizwa benganakiwe yizimiso zomphakathi futhi abavumela ukwakha umuzwa wobuntu babo.
translations.hypothesis: Amalungelo amancane ahlanganisa abantu abanomuzwa ofanayo abazizwa bengabhekelwa phansi ngamazinga omphakathi, futhi kubanika ithuba lokuthuthukisa umuzwa wokuziqhenya.

translations.source: Subcultures can be distinctive because of the age, ethnicity, class, location, and/or gender of the members.
translations.reference: Amasiko angaba ahlukanisayo ngenxa yeminyaka, uhlanga, isizinda, indawo, kanye/noma ubulili bamalungu.
translations.hypothesis: Amagugu angaphakathi komphakathi angaba ngohlobonhlobo ngenxa yobudala, ukuhlanga, isigaba, indawo, kanye/noma igama lesigadi lamalungu.

translations.source: The qualities that determine a subculture as distinct may be linguistic, aesthetic, religious, political, sexual, geographical, or a combination of factors.
translations.reference: Izici eziveza iqembu elinyingxenye yesiko njengelihlukile kungaba ulimi, ubuhle, inkolo, ipolotiki, ubulili, indawo, noma inhlanganisela yezici.
translations.hypothesis: Izinto ezifanekisela ukuthi umphakathi ongaphakathi uyahlukile zingaba izimpawu zolimi, zobuhle, zombhalo, zombusho, ezihlobene nokuziphatha, zendawo, noma uhlu lwezinye izinto.

translations.source: Members of a subculture often signal their membership through a distinctive and symbolic use of style, which includes fashions, mannerisms, and argot.
translations.reference: Amalungu weqembu eliyingxenye yesiko avamise ukubonakalisa ubulungu bawo ngokusebenzisa isitayela esihlukile nesimelela okuthile, esihlanganisa imfashini, ukuziphatha, kanye nendlela yokukhuluma.
translations.hypothesis: Amalungu enkampani yamasiko evamise ukubonisa ukuthi bangayona ngempela ngokusebenzisa indlela ehlukile neyisibonakaliso, okubalwa kulo izindlela zokufashona, izindlela zokuziphatha, kanye nolimi olukhethwe ngabo.

translations.source: One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up.
translations.reference: Enye yezindlela eziningi kwezivamile ezisentshenziswa ukuchaza ukubaluleka kokuhlalisana nabanye ukusondelana nabambalwa ezinganeni, okwathi ngokunganakwa, ngeshwa, noma ngokuhlukunyezwa ngamabomu, bangajwayelaniswa nabantu abadala ngesikhathi besakhula.
translations.hypothesis: Enye yezindlela ezivamile ezisetshenziselwa ukukhombisa ukubaluleka kokuxhumana nomphakathi ukusebenzisa izimo ezimbalwa ezimbi zezingane ezazikhulile ngaphandle kokuxhumana nabantu abadala, ngoba bezilahlwe, ziboshwe yizinto ezimbi, noma zihlushwa ngamandla.

translations.source: Such children are called "feral" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment.
translations.reference: Izingane ezinjalo zibizwa ngokuthi “zinobulwane” noma ezasendle. Ezinye izingane ezinobulwane zigcinwe abanye abantu (ngokuvamile abazali bazo); kwezinye izimo lokhu kulahlwa kwezingane kwakungenxa yokungamukeli komzali ukukhubazeka okukhulu ngokwengqondo noma ngokomzimba kwengane.
translations.hypothesis: Lezingane ezifana nalolu hlobo zibizwa "ngamazinyane" noma "ezingcolile." Ezinye lezingane ezazingcolile ziboshwe ngabantu (ngokuvamile ngabazali bayo); kwezinye zazo, ukushiywa kwalesi sikhathi kwaba ngububengwa ngabazali ngenxa yokuthi le ntokazi yayinomthelela omkhulu empilweni yayo, ngoko kube nokukhukhulelwa okukhulu empilweni yayo ngomzwelo noma ngomzimba.

translations.source: Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away.
translations.reference: Izingane ezinobulwane kungenzeka ukuthi zihlangabezane nokuhlukunyezwa kwezingane okubi noma ukucindezeleka ngaphambi kokulahlwa noma ukubaleka.
translations.hypothesis: Izingane ezihlala emvelo yangakho, kungase kube sebezibekwe yizinto ezimbi kakhulu noma zabanzi ngobuhlungu ngaphambi kokuthi zishiyele noma ziphume ngazo.

translations.source: Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own.
translations.reference: Ezinye kuthiwa zikhuliswe izilwane; ezinye kuthiwa zihlale endle zizodwa.
translations.hypothesis: Abanye kubalwa ukuthi babuye babuyiselwe ngamahlalakhubo; kukhona abanye okuthiwa bahlale ezindaweni zasendle ngaphandle kokuba nobudlelwano.

translations.source: When completely brought up by non-human animals, the feral child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) almost entirely like those of the particular care-animal, such as its fear of or indifference to humans.
translations.reference: Lapho ikhuliswe ngokuphelele isilwane ekungesona umuntu, ingane enobulwane iveza ukuziphatha (ngokulinganiselwa okungokoqobo) cishe okufana ngokuphele nokwesilwane ebesiyinakekela, njengokusaba noma ukungabi nandaba nabantu.
translations.hypothesis: Uma ingane eyakhuliswa ngokuphelele ngamanye izilwane, le ngane ibonisa ukuziphatha (ngaphakathi kwamakhambi omzimba) kufana kakhulu nalokho leso silwane esiyikhulisa, njengokwesaba abantu noma ukungakhathaleli abantu.

translations.source: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond.
translations.reference: Nakuba ukufunda okusekelwe kuyiphrojekthi kumelwe kwenze ukufunda kube lula futhi kuthakazelise kakhudlwana, izibhaxa zenza okwengeziwe.
translations.hypothesis: Nakuba ukufunda ngokusebenzisa amaphrojekthi kufanele kwenze ukufunda kube lula futhi kukhange, ukusebenzisa izindlela zokwesekwa kuyinto eyengeziwe.

translations.source: Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project.
translations.reference: I-scaffolding akuyona indlela yokufunda kodwa kunalokho insiza enikeza usizo kubantu ngabanye abafunda okusha njengokusebenzisa uhlelo olusha lwekhompyutha noma ukuqala iphrojekthi entsha.
translations.hypothesis: Ukusebenzisa izinsiza zokufundisa akuyona indlela yokufunda, kodwa kungumsizi onikeza ukwesekwa kubantu abafundayo into entsha, njengokusebenzisa uhlelo olusha lwekhompyutha noma ukuqala iphrojekthi entsha.

translations.source: Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office.
translations.reference: Ama-Scaffolds angaba wekhompyutha futhi abe ngokoqobo, ngamanye amagama, uthisha uwuhlobo lwe-scaffold kodwa kunjalo nangomuntu omncane wocingo lokuhlanganisa amaphepha kuyi-Microsoft Office.
translations.hypothesis: Izikhungo zokufundisa zingaba zombili, ezingokwenyama kanye nezinto eziyingcweti, ngamanye amazwi, umfundisi uyindlela yokufundisa, kodwa futhi i-icon encane yomuntu eyikhliphi ekupharethini le-Microsoft Office nayo iyindlela yokufundisa.

translations.source: Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.
translations.reference: Izibhaxa zekhompyutha zifakwe phakathi kohlelo lokusebenza futhi zenzelwe ukubuza, ukushukumisa, kanye nokuchaza izinqubo okungenzeka ukuthi bekunzima ukuthi abafundi basebenze ngazo bebodwa.
translations.hypothesis: Izakhiwo zokufundisa eziboniswayo zifakwe ngaphakathi kwasoftware futhi zenzelwe ukubuza, ukukhuthaza, nokuholela ngokuqondile ezindleleni zokwenza izinto ezangase zibe nzima kakhulu kuthina lomfundi ukuzibhekana nazo ngedlule.

translations.source: Children are placed in Foster Care for a wide variety of reasons that range from neglect, to abuse, and even to extortion.
translations.reference: Izingane zigcinwa emakhaya anakekela abantwana ngezizathu eziningi njengokukhishwa inyumbazane, ukuhlukunyezwa kanye nokuphamba.
translations.hypothesis: Izingane zifakwa ezikhungweni zokunakekelwa eziningi ngezizathu ezahlukene, kusukela ekungabathathi hlangothi, ekuhlukunyezweni, kanye nokubalulekisi.

translations.source: No child should ever have to grow up in an environment that is not nurturing, caring, and educational, but they do.
translations.reference: Kayikho ingane okufanele ikhule endaweni engalungile, engenalo uthando, engenankathalo kanye nemfundo, kodwa kuyenzeka.
translations.hypothesis: Akukho ingane okufanele ukuthi ikhule endaweni engahlezi, engazinakekile, futhi engafundisi. Kodwa, kungenxa yalezo zimo eziningi, lokho kuyenzeka.

translations.source: We perceive the Foster Care System to be a safety zone for these children.
translations.reference: Sibona i-Foster Care System iyindawo yokuphepha yalezi zingane.
translations.hypothesis: Siyabona ukuthi uhlelo lokunakekelwa kwezingane luyindawo evikelayo kulaba bantwana.

translations.source: Our foster care system is supposed to provide safe homes, loving caregivers, stable education, and reliable health care.
translations.reference: Inqubo yethu yokuthola abantwana abangenabazali kumelwe ihlinzeke ngamakhaya aphephile, abanakekeli abanothando, imfundo ezinzile, kanye nezokwelapha ezinokwethenjelwa.
translations.hypothesis: Uhlelo lwethu lokunakekelwa kwezingane ezikhulisiwe kufanele uhlinzeke ngemikhaya ephephile, abanakekeli abanothando, imfundo eqinile, kanye nokunakekelwa kwezempilo okunethezekile.

translations.source: Foster care is supposed to provide all the necessities that were lacking in the home they were previously taken from.
translations.reference: Ikhaya lezintandane kumelwe lihlinzeke ngezidingo ezazingatholakali ekhaya abathathwe kulo ngaphambili.
translations.hypothesis: Ukunakekelwa kwezingane ezisafufusa kumelelwe ukuhlinzeka ngazo zonke izinto ezibalulekile ezengengatholakali emzini abaphuma kuwo ngaphambilini.

translations.source: The Internet combines elements of both mass and interpersonal communication.
translations.reference: I-Inthanethi ihlanganisa izici zokukhulumisana kweningi nokokusebenzelana nabanye.
translations.hypothesis: I-Intanethi ihlanganisa izici zombili zokuxhumana nomphakathi kanye nokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu.

translations.source: The distinct characteristics of the Internet lead to additional dimensions in terms of the uses and gratifications approach.
translations.reference: Izici ezihlukile ze-Inthanethi zaholela ebubanzini obengeziwe uma kukhulunywa ngendlela yokusebenzisa nokwaneliseka.
translations.hypothesis: Izici ezikhethekile ze-Intanethi ziveza izimo eziningi kakhulu mayelana nokusetshenziswa kanye nemiphumela yayo.

translations.source: For example, “learning” and “socialization” are suggested as important motivations for Internet use (James et al., 1995).
translations.reference: Ngokwesibonelo, "ukufunda" kanye "nokuzihlanganisa nomphakathi" kusikiselwa njengezisusa ezibalulekile zokusebenzisa i-Inthanethi (James et al., 1995).
translations.hypothesis: Ngokwesibonelo, "ukufunda" kanye "nokuxhumana nomphakathi" kubalulwe njengombuso obalulekile wokusebenzisa i-Intanethi (James nozakwabo, 1995).

translations.source: “Personal involvement” and “continuing relationships” were also identified as new motivation aspects by Eighmey and McCord (1998) when they investigated audience reactions to websites.
translations.reference: “Ukuzibandakanya komuntu siqu” kanye “nobudlelwano obuqhubekayo” kubuywe kwavezwa njengezici ezintsha zokugqugquzela ngu-Eighmey noMcCord (1998) lapho behlola indlela yokusabela yababukele amawebhusayithi.
translations.hypothesis: "Ubudlelwano bomuntu ngamunye" kanye "nezibopho eziqhubekayo" ziphenywe futhi ziboniswe njengezinto ezintsha ezikhuthazayo ngu-Eighmey no-McCord (1998) ngesikhathi bephaphe indlela abantu abaphaphe ngayo amawebhusayithi.

translations.source: The use of video recording has led to important discoveries in the interpretation of micro-expressions, facial movements which last a few milliseconds.
translations.reference: Ukusetshenziswa kohlelo lwevidiyo kuholele kukwazisa okubalulekile ekuchazweni kokuziveza okuncane kakhulu, ukunyakaza kobuso okuthatha imizuzwana.
translations.hypothesis: Ukusebenzisa ividiyo ukurekhoda kukhishwe izinto ezibalulekile ekuhlalisekeni kwezinkomba ezincane, okungukuthi ukuguquka kwebuso okugcina amamili-sekondi ambalwa.

translations.source: In particular, it is claimed that one can detect whether a person is lying by interpreting micro-expressions correctly.
translations.reference: Ikakhulu, kuthiwa umuntu angabona ukuthi umuntu uqamba amanga ngokuchachisa izibonakaliso zobuso ezincane ngokunembile.
translations.hypothesis: Ngokukodwa, kushiwo ukuthi kungenzeka ukuthola ukuthi umuntu uyalala yini ngokuhumusha kahle izinkomba ezincane zombuso.

translations.source: Oliver Sacks, in his paper The President's Speech, indicated how people who are unable to understand speech because of brain damage are nevertheless able to assess sincerity accurately.
translations.reference: U-Oliver Sack ephepheni lakhe lNkulumo kaMongameli, ubonise ukuthi abantu abangakwazi ukuqonda inkulumo ngenxa yokulimala engqondweni bayakwazi ukubona ubuqotho ngokunembile.
translations.hypothesis: U-Oliver Sacks, encwajeni yakhe ethi "Inkulumo kaMongameli," ubonise ukuthi abantu abangakwazi ukuqonda inkulumo ngenxa yomonakalo emqondlweni wabo, nakuba kunjalo, bayakwazi ukwahlulela ukuthi umuntu uthembekile yini noma cha.

translations.source: He even suggests that such abilities in interpreting human behavior may be shared by animals such as domestic dogs.
translations.reference: Futhi usikisele nokuthi amakhono anjalo wokuchaza indlela yokuziphatha komuntu angahlanganyelwa nezilwane ezinjengezinja ezifuywayo.
translations.hypothesis: Uphinde wathi kungase kube nokuthi izikhumba ezifana nezilwane ezifuywayo, njengezinja, zifune nazo le khono lokuhumusha ukuziphatha kwabantu.

translations.source: Twentieth century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed.
translations.reference: Ucwaningo lwangekhulu lamashumi amabili leminyaka libonise ukuthi kunezigaba ezimbili zokuhlukana kofuzo: okufihliwe nokuveziwe.
translations.hypothesis: Ucwaningo lweminyaka engamashumi ayishumi edlule ubukakile ukuthi kunezinhlobo ezimbili zokuguquguquka kwezinto zombili: ezifihliwe kanye nezibonakalisiwe.

translations.source: Mutation adds new genetic variation, and selection removes it from the pool of expressed variation.
translations.reference: Ukuguquka kwenza ukwahluka kwezakhi zofuzo okusha, futhi ukukhetha kuzisusa emehlukweni oveziwe.
translations.hypothesis: Ukuguquka kungenisa ukuhlukahluka okusha kwezinsiza zombili, kodwa ukukhethwa kususela lelo kuhlukahluka kulokho okubonakalayo.

translations.source: Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
translations.reference: Ukwehluka kokuhlukaniswa nokuhlanganiswa kwehla kwenyuke phakathi kwezigaba ezimbli ngesizukulwane ngasinye.
translations.hypothesis: Ukuhlukana nokuhlanganiswa kuguqula ukuguquka phakathi kwezikhathi ezimbili ngakunye kwekhanda.

translations.source: Out on the savanna, it is hard for a primate with a digestive system like that of humans to satisfy its amino-acid requirements from available plant resources.
translations.reference: Ngaphandle emahlathini, kunzima ngesilwane esinesimiso sokugaya ukudla esifana nesabantu ukwanelisa imfuneko yaso yama-amino-acid ngezitshalo ezikhona.
translations.hypothesis: Ngaphandle, endaweni yase-savanna, kunzima kakhulu ukuthi umphisi onomgomo wokugaya ofana nalowo lwabantu ukuthola izidingo zayo zama-amino-acid kusukela ezimpandeni ezitholakalayo.

translations.source: Moreover, failure to do so has serious consequences: growth depression, malnutrition, and ultimately death.
translations.reference: Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuhluleka ukwenza kanjalo kunemiphumela emibi kakhulu: ukungakhuli kahle, ukungondleki, futhi ekugcineni ukufa.
translations.hypothesis: Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukwephulela lokhu kunezimphumela ezinkulu: ukunciphisa ukukhula, ukuntuleka kwempilo, kanye ekugcineni, ukufa.

translations.source: The most readily accessible plant resources would have been the proteins accessible in leaves and legumes, but these are hard for primates like us to digest unless they are cooked.
translations.reference: Imithombo yezitshalo etholakala kalula ngabe ngamaprotheni atholakala emaqabungeni nasezindimeni, kepha lezi zilukhuni kohlobo lokuqala njengathi ukugaya ngaphandle kokuthi luphekwe.
translations.hypothesis: Izinsiza zemvelo ezitholakala kalula kakhulu kwakuyi-iphrotheni etholakala emaqadini kanye nezitshalo ezifakelwe imbewu, kodwa lezi zinto kunzima kakhulu kubantu abafana nathi ukuzidla ngaphandle kokuthi zishiwise.

translations.source: In contrast, animal foods (ants, termites, eggs) not only are easily digestible, but they provide high-quantity proteins that contain all the essential amino acids.
translations.reference: Ngokuphambene, ukudla kwezilwane (izintuthwane, umuhlwa, amaqanda) akugayeki kalula nje kuphela, kodwa kunikeza amaphrotheni asezingeni eliphezulu anama-amino acid adingekayo.
translations.hypothesis: Ngokulandelana, ukudla kwezilwane (amathambeka, amabhu, amaqanda) akwazi ukudliwa kalula, kodwa kufakelwe amaprotheni amaningi awo afana ne-amino acid yonke edingekayo.

translations.source: All things considered, we should not be surprised if our own ancestors solved their "protein problem" in somewhat the same way that chimps on the savanna do today.
translations.reference: Lapho zonke izinto sezicatshangelwe, akumele simangale uma okhokho bethu bazixazululela bona “inkinga yamaphrotheni“ ngendlela ecishe ifane neyezimfene ethafeni namuhla.
translations.hypothesis: Ngokubaluleke kakhulu, akufanele sithule uma sizwa ukuthi izizukulwane zethu zangaphambilini zingakhombisile ukuthi zixazulule "inkinga yabo yamanani" ngendlela efanayo naleyo abayithusa ngayo izimpophoma ezihlala emaphandleni namuhla.

translations.source: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes).
translations.reference: Ukuphazamiseka kokulala inqubo yokuvuka ngenhloso phakathi nesikhathi sakho sokulala esivamile nokuzumeka futhi ngokushesha ngemva kwalokho (imizuzu engu-10–60).
translations.hypothesis: Ukuhlazwa kwesikhathi sokulala kukuprosesi yokuvamile ukuvuka ngesikhathi esijwayelekile sokulala, bese kushaywa umdlalo wokulala ngemuva kwesikhashana (emizuzu eyi-10 kuya kweyi-60).

translations.source: This can be easily done by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without fully waking you.
translations.reference: Lokhu kungenziwa kalula ngokusebenzisa iwashi elikhalayo elikhalela phansi uma kulinganiswa ukuze likusangulukise ngaphandle kokukuphaphamisa ngokugcwele.
translations.hypothesis: Lokhu kungenziwa kalula ngokusebenzisa uhlelo lokukhumbuza oliphuzi kakhulu olizokukusiza uvuke ngaphandle kokukuvamisa ngokuphelele.

translations.source: If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off.
translations.reference: Uma uzithola usetha kabusha iwashi ube ulele lapho uphethwe ubuthongo, lingabekwa kolunye uhlangothi lwekamelo, okukuphoqa ukuba uphume embhedeni ukuze ulicime.
translations.hypothesis: Uma uthola ukuthi uqeda ukusetha ihora ngesikhathi solala, ungayibeka ngakolunye uhlangothi lwegumbi, okuyokukufisa ukuthi uphume ebhedini ukuze uyiyeke.

translations.source: Other biorhythm-based options involve drinking lots of fluid (particularly water or tea, a known diuretic) prior to sleep, forcing one to get up to urinate.
translations.reference: Ezinye izindlela ezisekelwe emjikelezweni ongokwemvelo zihlanganisa ukuphuza uketshezi oluningi (ikakhulukazi amanzi noma itiye, umuthi ochamisayo owaziwayo) ngaphambi kokulala, okuphoqa umuntu ukuba avuke ayochama.
translations.hypothesis: Enye indlela yokulungisa izindlela zempilo ezihlobene ne-biorhythm, ukuthi uphuze amanzi amaningi (ikakhulukazi amanzi noma itiye, okuyinto eyaziwa ukuthi iyenza umuntu afise ukuhlaziywa), ngaphambi kokulala, okwenza umuntu afise ukulala ukuze ahleze.

translations.source: The amount of inner peace a person possesses correlates oppositely to the amount of tension in one’s body and spirit.
translations.reference: Inani lokuthula kwangaphakathi umuntu akutholayo lihlangana ngokuhlukene nenani lokucindezeleka emzimbeni womuntu kanye nasemoyeni.
translations.hypothesis: Ububanzi bokuthula komuntu ngamunye buxhumene ngokuphindaphindiwe nomlingo wokungqubuzana emzimbeni nempilako yalo muntu.

translations.source: The lower the tension, the more positive the life force present. Every person has the potential to find absolute peace and contentment.
translations.reference: Lapho ukucindezeleka kuphansi, kuyilapho amandla okuphila akhona eba mahle kakhulu. Wonke umuntu angakwazi ukuthola ukuthula okuphelele kanye nokwaneliseka.
translations.hypothesis: Uma ukukhulu kakhulu ukucindezela, ngaleyo ndlela, kukhona amandla amakhulu okukhuthazwa empileni. Wonke umuntu unokwazi ukuthola ukuthula okuphelele kanye nokwaneliseka.

translations.source: Everyone can achieve enlightenment. The only thing standing in the way of this goal is our own tension and negativity.
translations.reference: Wonke umuntu angazuza ukukhanyiselwa. Okuwukuphela kwento ema endleleni yokufinyelela lo mgomo isimo sethusenqondo kanye nokuzenyeza.
translations.hypothesis: Wonke umuntu angakwazi ukufinyelela ukukhanya. Okuyinto eyenza kube nzima ukufinyelela lo msebenzi yikukhathazeka nokungabubula kwethu.

translations.source: The Tibetan Buddhism is based on the teachings of Buddha, but were extended by the mahayana path of love and by a lot of techniques from Indian Yoga.
translations.reference: I-Tibetan Buddhism isekelwe  ezimfundisweni zikaBhuda, kodwa zandiswa indlela yothando yobu-mahayana nayizinqubo eziningi ezisuka kuyiYoga yaseNdiya.
translations.hypothesis: UBuddhism wase-Tibetha ususelwa ezimfundisweni zikaBuddha, kodwa wanda ngenkuthalo yomkhuba wase-Mahayana kanye nezindlela eziningi ezivela e-Yoga yaseNdiya.

translations.source: In principle the Tibetan Buddhism is very simple. It consists of Kundalini Yoga, meditation and the path of all-embracing love.
translations.reference: Ngokuyisisekelo ubuBuddha baseTibet bulula kakhulu. Buhlanganisa iKundalini Yoga, ukuzindla kanye nendlela yothando olwamukela konke.
translations.hypothesis: Ngokombono, uBuddhalism wase-Tibetha ulula kakhulu. Uqukethe i-Kundalini Yoga, ukuzindla kanye nomzila wothando olubanzi.

translations.source: With Kundalini Yoga the Kundalini energy (enlightenment energy) is awakened through yoga postures, breathing exercises, mantras and visualizations.
translations.reference: Nge-Kundali Yoga amandla e-Kundali (amandla okukhanyisa) avuselelwa ngokuzivocavoca ngohlobo lwe-yoga, ukuzivocavoca kokuphefumula, amazwi aphindwaphindwayo kanye nokubona ngeso lengqondo.
translations.hypothesis: Nge-Kundalini Yoga, amandla e-Kundalini (amandla okukhanyiselwa) afudwa ngokuphindaphindiwe kwezindlela zayo, ukuzilengisa kokuphefumula, amantsha kanye nokubona kwezinto engqondo.

translations.source: The center of Tibetan meditation is the Deity Yoga. Through the visualization of various deities the energy channels are cleaned, the chakras are activated and the enlightenment consciousness is created.
translations.reference: Isikhungo sokuzindla kweTibet yi-Deity Yoga. Ngokubona ngeso lengqondo izithixo ezahlukahlukene imizila yamandla iba ehlanzekile, ama-chakra enziwa ukuthi asebenze futhi ukukhanya kokubakhona kuyakhiwa.
translations.hypothesis: Ikhathi elikhulu yokuqeqeshwa kwezindlela zokucabanga zamaTibetan yi-Deity Yoga. Ngokubona ngengqondo izithixo ezahlukene, amagumbi omoya ahlanziwe, amachakra agqunywe, futhi ukwaziswa kwengqondo kudalwe.

translations.source: Germany was a common enemy in World War 2, leading to cooperation between the USSR and USA. With the end of the war the clashes of system, process and culture led to the countries falling out.
translations.reference: Ijalimane bekuyisitha esivamile eMpini Yezwe 2, okwaholela ekusebenzisaneni phakathi kwe-USSR kanye neMelika. Ngokuphela kwempi ukungqubuzana kwezimiso, izinqubo kanye namasiko kwaholela ekubeni amazwe axabane.
translations.hypothesis: I-Jalimane yayiyi-mpikiswano ebanzi ngesikhathi sompi yeMpi Yomhlaba ka-2, okubangela ukuthi i-USSR ne-USA zisebenzisane. Ngemuva kokuphothulwa kwempi, ukungqubuzana kwezindlela, izinqubo kanye namasiko kwaholela ekuntwini phakathi kwezizwe.

translations.source: With two years of the end of the war, the former allies were now enemies and the Cold War began.
translations.reference: Ngemva kweminyaka emibili yempi, ababeyimifela ndawonye empini manje sebeyizitha futhi sebeqalise Impi Ebandayo.
translations.hypothesis: Ngemuva kweminyaka emibili yokuphela komuzi, abafowabo abangaphambilini manje babe yizitha, futhi umuzi waseNingizimu neNyakatho waqala.

translations.source: It was to last for the next 40 years and would be fought for real, by proxy armies, on battlefields from Africa to Asia, in Afghanistan, Cuba and many other places.
translations.reference: Kwakufanele ihlale iminyaka engu-40 elandelayo futhi kulwe kuyo ngokoqobo, amabutho abambele, ezinkundleni zempi kusukela e-Afrika kuya e-Asia, e-Afghanistan, eCuba kanye nakwezinye izindawo eziningi.
translations.hypothesis: Lolu mkhakha ube uqhubeka iminyaka engama-40 elandelayo, futhi ube nomzanto wangempela, ngamabhuloho ezempi, ezindlebeni ezahlukene ezivela e-Afrika kuya e-Asia, e-Afghanistan, e-Cuba kanye kwamanye amavulandlela amaningi.

translations.source: By September 17, 1939, the Polish defense was already broken, and the only hope was to retreat and reorganise along the Romanian bridgehead.
translations.reference: NgoMandulo 17, 1939, amabutho avikelayo wasePoland wayehlaselwe kakade, futhi ukuphela kwethemba kwakuwukuhlehla nokuhlela kabusha eceleni kwesihloko saseRomaniya.
translations.hypothesis: Ngomhlaka 17 kuMandulo ka-1939, ukungqubuzana kwePoland bekuyisikhathi eside selulahlwe, futhi okuyinto eyodwa okungenzeka kwakuyokubuyela emuva nokuhlela kabusha endaweni edumile eRomania.

translations.source: However, these plans were rendered obsolete nearly overnight, when over 800,000 soldiers from the Soviet's Union Red Army entered and created the Belarussian and Ukrainian fronts after invading the eastern regions of Poland in violation of the Riga Peace Treaty, the Soviet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, and other international treaties, both bilateral and multilateral.
translations.reference: Nokho, lezi zinhlelo zaphelelwa yisikhathi cishe ngobusuku obubodwa, lapho amasosha angaphezu kuka-800,000 asuka eSoviet's Union Red Army angena futhi akha amabutho waseBelarussia kanye ne-Ukraine ngemva kokuhlasela izindawo ezingasempumalanga zasePoland ephula Isivumelwano Sokuthula seRiga, i-Soveiet-Polish Non-Aggression Pact, kanye nezinye izivumelwane zamazwe onke zokuthula, kokubili zezizwe ezinxa-mbili kanye neziningi.
translations.hypothesis: Kodwa-ke, lezi zinhlelo zaba yizingozi esikhathini esifushane, ngoba ngaphezu kuka-800,000 amasole avela ebandla laseSoviet Union elithi "Red Army" wangena futhi wadala izimbuyiselo zaseBelarus kanye ne-Ukraine ngemuva kokuhlasela izindawo zaseningeni zasePoland, okokuphila umthetho wezakhamisa waseRiga, isivumelwano sokungahlukunyezwa phakathi kweSoviet Union kanye nePoland, kanye namanye amakontileka kazwelonke, ngokusho kokubambisana kanye nokubambisana okukhulu.

translations.source: Using ships to transport goods is by far the most efficient way to move large amounts of people and goods across oceans.
translations.reference: Ukusebenzisa imikhumbi ukuthutha impahla yindlela ephumelela kakhulu yokuthutha abantu abaningi kanye nempahla ngaphesheya kwezilwandle.
translations.hypothesis: Ukusebenzisa izikebhe ukuthutha impahla kuyindlela efanelekile kakhulu yokudlala izinto ezinkulu kanye nabantu kulo lonke ubukhulu bezilwandle.

translations.source: The job of navies has traditionally been to ensure that your country maintains the ability to move your people and goods, while at the same time, interfering with your enemy's ability to move his people and goods.
translations.reference: Umsebenzi wamatilosi ngokujwayelekile kwakungukuqinisekisa ukuthi izwe lakho ligcina ikhono lokuhambisa abantu bakho nempahla, kuyilapho ngesikhathi esifanayo, ephazamisa ikhono lesitha sakho lokuhambisa abantu baso nempahla.
translations.hypothesis: Umsebenzi wamabhungane kakhulu ukuthi baqiniseke ukuthi izwe lakho ligcine ikhono lokuthutha abantu kanye nezimpahla, kuyilapho ngesikhathi esifanayo, bayaphazamisa ikhono lendawo yakho yokulwa ukuthi ithuthe abantu kanye nezimpahla zayo.

translations.source: One of the most noteworthy recent examples of this was the North Atlantic campaign of WWII. The Americans were trying to move men and materials across the Atlantic Ocean to help Britain.
translations.reference: Esinye sezibonelo sakamuva esiphawuleka kakhulu salokhu bekuwumkhankaso waseNyakatho Atlantic weWWII. AmaMelika ayezama ukuyisa abantu nezimpahla ngaphesheya koLwandlekazi i-Atlanti ukusiza iBhrithani.
translations.hypothesis: Enye yezibonelo ezibalulekile kakhulu ezake zenzeka ngaleso sikhathi kwakuyi-kampeni yaseNyakatho Atlantiki ngesikhathi somuzi wase-II. Abantu baseMelika babazama ukuthutha abantu nezinto ezidwetshwayo ngokuphakathi kwe-Atlantic ukuze basize i-Britain.

translations.source: At the same time, the German navy, using mainly U-boats, was trying to stop this traffic.
translations.reference: Ngesikhathi esifanayo, ibutho lemikhumbi laseJalimane, lisebenzisa ama-U-boat ngokuyinhloko, belizama ukuvimbela lokhu kuhamba.
translations.hypothesis: Ngesikhathi esifanayo, umbutho wamabhathi wasiJalimane, obusebenzisa ikakhulukazi amabhathi amancane (U-boats), uzama ukuyeka lokhu kukhokhelwa.

translations.source: Had the Allies failed, Germany probably would have been able to conquer Britain as it had the rest of Europe.
translations.reference: Ukube ama-Allies ehlulekile, iJalimane cishe ibizokwazi ukunqoba iBhrithani njengoba lenze okufanayo ngeYurophu yonke.
translations.hypothesis: Uma amaqembu abambe iqhaza empikisweni ayengaphumeleli, kungenzeka ukuthi iJalimane ingabe ikwazi ukunqoba iBhritane, njengoba yayinenqobo yomhlaba wonke waseYurophu.

translations.source: Goats seem to have been first domesticated roughly 10,000 years ago in the Zagros Mountains of Iran.
translations.reference: Izimbuzi kubonakala sengathi zenziwa izilwane ezifuywayo okokuqala ngokwesilinganiso eminyakeni engu-10,000 endlule eziNtabeni zase-Zagros e-Iran.
translations.hypothesis: Kubonakala sengathi izinkomo zaba yizilwane ezokuqala zokulima cishe ngamawaka ayishumi ezinkulungwane kuleli, ezintwini zamaZagros e-Iran.

translations.source: Ancient cultures and tribes began to keep them for easy access to milk, hair, meat, and skins.
translations.reference: Amasiko nezizwana zasemandulo zaqala ukuzigcina njengendlela elula yokuthola ubisi, izinwele, inyama, kanye nesikhumba.
translations.hypothesis: Izinhlanga kanye nemiphakathi yendulo ziqalile ukugcina izilwane ezahlukahlukene ukuze zifake kalula ukudla okufana nomucu, izinwele, inyama kanye nezikhumba.

translations.source: Domestic goats were generally kept in herds that wandered on hills or other grazing areas, often tended by goatherds who were frequently children or adolescents, similar to the more widely known shepherd. These methods of herding are still used today.
translations.reference: Izimbuzi ezifuywayo ngokuvamile zazigcinwa nomhlambi owawuhamba emagqumeni noma ezindaweni zamadlelo, ngokuphindaphindiwe zazeluswa abelusi ngokuvamile okwakuba izingane noma abasebasha, okungabelusi abafanayo nabaziwayo. Lezi zindlela sokwalusa sisasentshenziswa nanamuhla.
translations.hypothesis: Izilwane zasendlini ezihlanganiswe ngamakhambi zivame ukugcinwa ndawonye, zidlula emawundlwini noma ezindaweni ezifanele ukudla, futhi zihlanganiswe ngabantu abanakekelayo, abanye abantu abakhulu noma abasha, njengoba kunjalo nabaxhasi bezilwane ezinkulu. Leziindlela zokuhlanganisa izilwane zisasetshenziswa namuhla.

translations.source: Wagonways were built in England as early as the 16th Century.
translations.reference: Imizila yezinqola yakhiwa eNgilandi kusukela ngeKhulu lama-16 leminyaka.
translations.hypothesis: Izindlela zethilamu zakhishwa e-Ingilandi kusukela ngomkhakha we-16.

translations.source: Although wagonways merely consisted of parallel planks of wood, they allowed horses pulling them to achieve greater speeds and pull larger loads than on the slightly more rough roads of the day.
translations.reference: Nakuba imizila yezinqola beyenziwa izingodo ezugudlene, bezivumela amahhashi azidonsayo ukufinyelela izivinini ezinkulu nokudonsa umthwalo okhudlwana kunasemigwaqweni emibi kancane yangosuku.
translations.hypothesis: Nakuba izindlela zokuthutha ngamathilomu zibe yizicubu ezimbili zokhakhayi ezihambisana, lezi zindlela zivumela izihhashi ezithuthayo ukuthi zifinyelele amagijima amakhulu futhi zithuthe imithwalo enkulu kunaleyo eyathuthwa ezindleleni ezincane nezikhukhumi zaleso sikhathi.

translations.source: Crossties were introduced fairly early to hold the tracks in place. Gradually, however, it was realised that tracks would be more efficient if they had a stip of iron on the top.
translations.reference: Amapulangi kajantshi cishe enzelwa ukuhlanganisa ujantshi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, nokho, kwabonakala ukuthi ujantshi ungasebenza kangcono uma ungaba nommombo wensimbi ngaphezulu.
translations.hypothesis: Amabhathi ayasetshenziswa kusukela esikhathini eside ukuze agcine izindlela zitholakale endaweni efanele. Kodwa, kancane kancane, kwakubonakala ukuthi izindlela zizoba ngcono uma zibe nomucono wegqi phezu kwazo.

translations.source: This became common practice, but the iron caused more wear on the wooden wheels of the wagons.
translations.reference: Lokhu kwaba inqubo evamile, kodwa insimbi yayihlikihla amasondo okhuni wezinqola.
translations.hypothesis: Lokhu kwaba yinto evamile, kodwa insimbi yadalula ukugqoka okwengeziwe ezandleni zama-wijoni.

translations.source: Eventually, wooden wheels were replaced by iron wheels. In 1767, the first full-iron rails were introduced.
translations.reference: Ekugcineni, amasondo okhuni athathelwa indawo amasondo ensimbi. Ngo-1767, ujantshi wokuqala wensimbi ophelele waqala ukusetshenziswa.
translations.hypothesis: Kugcine, amagoli omuthi ayathathelwa indawo ngamagoli ensimbi. Nango-1767, kwafakwa okokuqala izintambo ezakhiwe ngensimbi ngokugcwele.

translations.source: The first known transportation was walking, humans began walking upright two million years ago with the emergence of Homo Erectus (meaning upright man).
translations.reference: Indlela yokuqala yokuthatha uhambo eyaziwayo ukuhamba ngezinyawo, abantu baqala ukuhamba beqondile eminyakeni eyizigidi ezimbili edlule ngokuvela kwe-Homo Erectus (okusho umuntu ome waqonda).
translations.hypothesis: Ukuhamba kwakuyindlela yokuphutha yokuqala yokuhamba, futhi abantu baqala ukuhamba uma bemi ngqo eminyakeni emibili edlule kakhulu, ngesikhathi uHomo Erectus (okusho ukuthi "umuntu omi ngqo") wasungulwa.

translations.source: Their predecessors, the Australopithecus did not walk upright as habitually.
translations.reference: Ababalandela esikhundleni, ama-Australopithecus bawangahambi ngendlela yokuma aqonde ngokujwayelekile.
translations.hypothesis: Abaphambilana babo, i-Australopithecus, abayihambi ngendlela eqonde ngokuphumelele njengamanje.

translations.source: Bipedal specializations are found in Australopithecus fossils from 4.2-3.9 million years ago, although Sahelanthropus may have walked on two legs as early as seven million years ago.
translations.reference: Okuchwepheshe ngokuba nyawo-mbili kutholakala emathanjeni aguquke itshe we-Australopithecus kusukela eminyakeni eyizigidi ezingu-4.2-3.9 edlule, nakuba ama-Sahelanthropus kungenzeka ayehamba ngezinyawo ezimbili ngaphambili kakhulu eminyakeni eyizigidi eziyisikhombisa edlule.
translations.hypothesis: Izimpawu ezikhethekile zokuhamba ngemilenze zitholakala ezifini zama-Australopithecus ezisetshenzisiwe kusukela eminyakeni engu-4.2 kuya ku-3.9 edlule, nakuba kungenzeka ukuthi i-Sahelanthropus ihambile ngemilenze kusukela eminyakeni engu-7 edlule.

translations.source: We can start living more friendly to the environment, we can join to the environmental movement, and we can even be activists in order to reduce the future suffering in some degree.
translations.reference: Singaqala ukuphila ngobungane kakhulu nemvelo, singajoyina inhlangano yezemvelo, futhi singaba ngisho izishoshovu ukuze sinciphise ukuhlupheka okuzayo ngezinga elithile.
translations.hypothesis: Singakwazi ukuqala ukuphila ngendlela engcono kakhulu empilweni yendalo, singahlanganisa nomzamo wokulondoloza imvelo, futhi singaba ngabaxhasayo ukuze sinciphise ukulimala okuzayo, ngendlela ethile.

translations.source: This is just like symptomatic treatment in many cases. However, if we do not only want a temporary solution, then we should find the root of the problems, and we should deactivate them.
translations.reference: Kufana nekhambi nje lokwelapha izimpawu zokugula ezimweni eziningi. Nokho, uma singafuni isisombululo sesikhashana, kumele sithole umsuka wenkinga bese sinqanda wona.
translations.hypothesis: Lokhu kufana nokwelashwa kwezimpawu eziningi. Kodwa, uma singafuni nje ukuxazulula ngempumelelo esheshayo, khona-ke kufanele sifune imbangela yalezi zinkinga, futhi kufanele sizivimbele.

translations.source: It is obvious enough that the world has changed much because of humankind's scientific and technological advancements, and problems have become greater because of overpopulation and mankind's extravagant lifestyle.
translations.reference: Kusobala ngokwanele ukuthi umhlaba ushintshe kakhulu ngenxa yokuthuthuka kwabantu kwezesayensi nezobuchwepheshe, futhi izinkinga zibe zinkulu ngenxa yokugcwala kwabantu kanye nempilo yesintu nokuphila kwesintu okuwubukhazikhazi.
translations.hypothesis: Kuyacaca ukuthi umhlaba ushintshile kakhulu ngenxa yobuhlakani kanye nobuchwepheshe bomuntu, futhi izinkinga zikhulile ngenxa yokuphakama kakhulu kwabantu kanye nendlela yokuphila engenamsebenzi yomuntu.

translations.source: After its adoption by Congress on July 4, a handwritten draft signed by the President of Congress John Hancock and the Secretary Charles Thomson was then sent a few blocks away to the printing shop of John Dunlap.
translations.reference: Ngemva kokwamukelwa uKhongolose ngoNtulikazi 4, isiphakamiso esibhalwe ngesandla sasayinwa uMongameli kaKhongolose uJohn Hancock futhi noNobhala uCharles Thompson wathunyelwa esitolo esiseduzane sokuphrinta sikaJohn Dunlap.
translations.hypothesis: Ngemuva kokuthi iCongress yayamukela umbhalo ngomhla ka-4 Julayi, uhlu olubhaliwe ngesandla, olusayine yiPhrezidenti yeCongress uJohn Hancock kanye noMhloli uCharles Thomson, lathunyelwa emabhokisini ambalwa kude, esitolo sokubh printi likaJohn Dunlap.

translations.source: Through the night between 150 and 200 copies were made, now known as "Dunlap broadsides".
translations.reference: Phakathi nobusuku kwenziwa amakhophi aphakathi kuka-150 no-200, manje aziwa ngokuthi “iDunlap broadsides”.
translations.hypothesis: Ngobusuku obubodwa, amakhophi ayi-150 kuya ku-200 ayenziwa, futhi manje ayaziwa ngokuthi "ama-broadside e-Dunlap".

translations.source: The first public reading of the document was by John Nixon in the yard of Independence Hall on July 8.
translations.reference: Ukufundwa kwedokhumenti kokuqala kwenziwa uJohn Nixon enkundleni ye-Independence Hall ngoNtulikazi 8.
translations.hypothesis: Ukufundwa kokuqala kwalo mbhalo phambi kwabantu kwenziwe ngu-John Nixon ngasekhini le-Independence Hall ngomhla ka-Julayi 8.

translations.source: One was sent to George Washington on July 6, who had it read to his troops in New York on July 9. A copy reached London on August 10.
translations.reference: Eyodwa yathunyelwa kuGeorge Washington ngoNtulikazi 6, owenza ukuba ifundwelwe amabutho akhe eNew York ngoNtulikazi 9. Ikhophi yafika eLondon ngoNcwaba 10.
translations.hypothesis: Okwakodwa kwathunyelwa kuGeorge Washington ngomhlaka 6 kuJulayi, futhi kwafundiswa kubasoludali bakhe eNew York ngomhlaka 9 kuJulayi. Ikophi elinye lifike eLondon ngomhlaka 10 kuAgasti.

translations.source: The 25 Dunlap broadsides still known to exist are the oldest surviving copies of the document. The original handwritten copy has not survived.
translations.reference: Ububanzi be-Dunlap 25 okwaziwa ukuthi kukhona amakhophi wedokhumenti akhona amadala kunawo wonke. Ikhophi yasekuqaleni ebhalwe ngesandla ayisekho.
translations.hypothesis: Izikhathi ezingu-25 zephaphostshi ze-Dunlap ezaziwa ukuthi zisafanelwe yizincwadi ezindala kakhulu zalo mbhalo. Ikopi eyisisekelo eyabhaliwe ngesandla ayisafanelwe.

translations.source: Many paleontologists today believe that one group of dinosaurs survived and is alive today. We call them birds.
translations.reference: Izazi eziningi zesayensi yemivubukulo namuhla zikholelwa ukuthi iqembu elilodwa lama-dinosaur laqhubeka liphila futhi lisaphila namuhla. Siwabiza ngezinyoni.
translations.hypothesis: Abaningi bezazi bezilwane zasendulo namuhla bakholelwa ukuthi kukhona ikhefu lezilo ezazihlala ngaphambilini ezihlale ziphilile futhi zikhona namuhla. Siyibiza ngamazinyane.

translations.source: Many people don't think about them as dinosaurs because they have feathers and can fly.
translations.reference: Abantu abaningi abazithathi njengama-dinosaur ngoba zinezimpaphe futhi ziyakwazi ukundiza.
translations.hypothesis: Abantu abaningi ababacingi ngazo njengezilo zendulo ngoba zinezinyawo ezincane futhi zikwazi ukundiza.

translations.source: But there are a lot of things about birds that still look like a dinosaur.
translations.reference: Kodwa kunezinto eziningi ngezinyoni ezisafana ne-dinosaur.
translations.hypothesis: Kodwa kukhona izinto eziningi mayelana nezinyoni ezisakaze zifana nezilwane ezikhulu ezaziwa njenge-dinosaurs.

translations.source: They have feet with scales and claws, they lay eggs, and they walk on their two back legs like a T-Rex.
translations.reference: Zinezinyawo ezinocwecwe nezinzipho, zibekela amaqanda, futhi zihamba ngezinyawo zazo ezimbili zasemuva njengeT-Rex.
translations.hypothesis: Banemilenze enamaqemba kanye namathambo, bayawawasha, futhi bahamba ngemilenze yabo emibili ngemuva njengendawo eyayizwakwa njenge-T-Rex.

translations.source: Virtually all computers in use today are based on the manipulation of information which is coded in the form of binary numbers.
translations.reference: Cishe wonke amakhompyutha asetshenziswayo namuhla asekelwe ekusebenziseni ukwaziswa okufakwayo endaweni ngezinombolo ezibhangqiwe.
translations.hypothesis: Amakhompyutha amaningi kakhulu asetshenziswa namuhla basekelwe ekulungisweni kolwazi olubhaliwe ngendlela efana nenombolo ezimbili (izinto ezimbili).

translations.source: A binary number can have only one of two values, i.e. 0 or 1, and these numbers are referred to as binary digits - or bits, to use computer jargon.
translations.reference: Inombolo enziwe ngeziqu ezimbili ingaba nenani elilodwa kuphela kulawa amabili, okungukuthi u-0 noma u-1, futhi kubhekiselwa kulezinombolo ngokuthi amadijithi aneziqu ezimbili - noma ama-bit, ukusebenzisa ijagoni yekhompyutha.
translations.hypothesis: Inombolo yebhayinali ingaba nenani elilodwa kuphela phakathi kwezimbili, okungukuthi i-0 noma i-1, futhi lezi zinombolo zibizwa ngokuthi "izindidi zombhalo zombili" - noma "ama-bits," njengoba kusetshenziswa ngolimi lwekhompyutha.

translations.source: Internal poisoning may not be immediately apparent. Symptoms, such as vomiting are sufficiently general that an immediate diagnosis cannot be made.
translations.reference: Ubuthi bangaphakathi kungezeka bungabonakali ngokushesha. Izimpawu, njengokuhlanza zanele ngokuvamile kangangokuthi umhlahlo wokushesha angeke wenziwe.
translations.hypothesis: Ukutolwa ngaphakathi kungase kungabonakali ngokushesha. Izimpawu, ezifana nokugula, zivamile kakhulu kangangokuthi ukuxilongwa okusheshayo akunakwenziwa.

translations.source: The best indication of internal poisoning may be the presence of an open container of medication or toxic household chemicals.
translations.reference: Isibonakaliso esihle kakhulu soshevu ovela ngaphakathi kungaba ukuba khona kwezitsha zemithi ezivulekile noma amakhemikhali wasendlini anobuthi.
translations.hypothesis: Ukubona ukuthi kunokuba yinkinga yokutolwa ngaphakathi, kungase kube ukuthi kukhona ikhithi evuliwe yezimpilo noma imikhiqizo yasekhaya eyingozi.

translations.source: Check the label for specific first aid instructions for that specific poison.
translations.reference: Bheka ilebula ukuze ubone iziqondiso soziso lokuqala zalowo shevu.
translations.hypothesis: Hlola ilebula ukuze uthole imiyalelo ethile mayelana nokunakekelwa okokuqala okudingekile ngalolo phunga ethile.

translations.source: The term bug is used by entomologists in a formal sense for this group of insects.
translations.reference: Igama elithi isilwanyakazane lisetshenziswa izazi zezinambuzane ngendlela esemthethweni yaleli qembu lezi zinambuzane.
translations.hypothesis: Igama "bug" lisetshenziswa ngabafundi bezilwane (entomologists) ngendlela ehlanganisiwe ukuchaza leli qembu lezilwane ezincane.

translations.source: This term derives from ancient familiarity with Bed-bugs, which are insects highly adapted to parasitize humans.
translations.reference: Leli gama lidabuka ekujwayelaneni kwakudala neziMbungulu, okuyizilwanyana ezizifanelisela ngokuphila ngokudla emzimbeni wabantu.
translations.hypothesis: Lo mbhalo ufika kusukela ekulandelweni kakhulu kwasendulo kwezinduku ezihlala ezindlwini, eziyizindlu ezifanele kakhulu ukuzidla ngabantu.

translations.source: Both Assassin-bugs and Bed-bugs are nidicolous, adapted to living in nest or housing of their host.
translations.reference: Zombili iZimbungulu eziphila ngezinye izinambuzane neZimbungulu ezivamile zihlala esidlekeni, zifanelekele ukuhlala esidlekeni noma ezindlini zabasingathi bazo.
translations.hypothesis: Kokubili, izimbungulu ezihlala ezindaweni ezithile kanye nezimbungulu ezihlala ezindlwini, zihlala ezindaweni zokuhlala noma ezindaweni zokungcebeleka zento ezihlala kuzo.

translations.source: Across the United States of America, there are approximately 400,000 known cases of Multiple Sclerosis (MS), leaving it as the leading neurological disease in younger and middle aged adults.
translations.reference: EMelika yonke kunesilinganiso sabantu abawu-400,000 okubikwe ukuthi bane-Multiple Sclerosis(MS), okusishiya njengesifo esihamba phambili semizwa kubantu abadala abasebasha naphakathi.
translations.hypothesis: Kulo lonke i-United States of America, kulinganiselwa ku-400,000 izifo ezaziwa zokugula ngama-Multiple Sclerosis (MS), okwenza leli sifo libe yisifo esikhulu kakhulu esithinta izimpilo zezinso ezidlulile kanye nalabo abakhulile.

translations.source: MS is a disease that affects the central nervous system, which is made up of the brain, the spinal cord and the optic nerve.
translations.reference: I-MS isifo esithinta uhlelo lwezinzwa, olwenziwa ubuchopho, umfunkulu kanye nenzwa yokubona.
translations.hypothesis: I-MS yigciwane elithinta uhlelo lobuluntu, oluhlanganisa ingqondo, intambo yezinsipho kanye nomgebhe wamehlo.

translations.source: Research has found that females are two times more likely to have MS then males.
translations.reference: Ucwaningo lubonise ukuthi abesifazane banamathuba akabili okuba neMS kunabesilisa.
translations.hypothesis: Ucwaningo ubonise ukuthi abesifazane banenkani yokuba ne-MS (Multiple Sclerosis) kabili kunabafana.

translations.source: A couple may decide it is not in their best interest, or in the interest of their child, to raise a baby.
translations.reference: Abantu ababili abathandanayo bangabona kungenakubasiza, noma kusize ingane yawo, ukukhulisa ingane.
translations.hypothesis: Abantu abashadile bangase bathole ukuthi akulungile, noma akufanele, ukukhulisa ingane, nakuba kungakhathaliseka kangcono nabo kanye nomntwana wabo.

translations.source: These couples may choose to make an adoption plan for their baby.
translations.reference: Le mibhangqwana ingakhetha ukwenza uhlelo lokuthi ingane yabo itholwe abanye.
translations.hypothesis: Lezi zinkulumo zangakhetha ukuhlela ukutholwa yomntwana wabo.

translations.source: In an adoption, the birth parents terminate their parental rights so that another couple may parent the child.
translations.reference: Endabeni yokutholwa, abazali abazizalayo banqamula amalungelo abo okuba abazali ukuze omunye umbhangqwana ube umzali wengane.
translations.hypothesis: Ekukhulumeni ngokufakelwa, abazali abazalelayo bayeka amalungelo abo obazali ukuze omunye umshado angene endaweni yabo ukuze bakwazi ukunakekela ingane.

translations.source: Science’s main goal is to figure out the way the world works through the scientific method. This method in fact guides most scientific research.
translations.reference: Umngomo oyinhloko wesayensi ukuthola indlela izwe elisebenza ngayo uma lisebenzisa indlela yesayensi. Le ndlela eqinisweni iqondisa oluningi ucwaningo lwesayensi.
translations.hypothesis: Umkhakha wesayensi unohluleko olukhulu lokuthola ukuthi indawo yonke iyasebenza kanjani, ngokusetshenziswa yindlela yesayensi. Le ndlela, eqinisweni, iholisa kucabango oluningi kwasayensi.

translations.source: It isn’t alone though, experimentation, and an experiment is a test that is used to eliminate one or more of the possible hypotheses, asking questions, and making observations also guide scientific research.
translations.reference: Akukodwa nokho, ukulinga, futhi isilingo isivivinyo esisetshenziselwa ukususa ukucabangela okuhle okukodwa noma okwengeziwe, ukubuza imibuzo, nokwenza ukuphawula kanye nokuqondisa ucwaningo olungokwesayensi.
translations.hypothesis: Akuyona into eyodwa kuphela, kodwa ukuhlola, futhi ukuhlola kuyindlela yokuhlola esetshenziselwa ukukhipha ezinye noma ezinye zezinketho ezidingekayo, ukubuza imibuzo, kanye nokubheka izinto, nayo kuyindlela ebusa ucwaningo lwesayensi.

translations.source: Naturalists and philosophers focused on classical texts and, in particular, on the Bible in Latin.
translations.reference: Izazi zemvelo kanye nezefilosofi zigxile emibhalweni yamandulo futhi, ngokukhethekile, eBhayibhelini ngesiLatin.
translations.hypothesis: Abafundi bezinto yangempela kanye nabafilosofi bagxile ezincwajini zendulo, futhi ikakhulukazi, eBhayibhelini ngolimi lwamaLatini.

translations.source: Accepted were Aristotle's views on all matters of science, including psychology.
translations.reference: Imibono ka-Aristotle yesayensi yamukelwa yonke, kuhlanganise nesayikholoji.
translations.hypothesis: Kwamukelwa imibono ka-Aristotle kuzo zonke izici zesayensi, okubalwa nakho izifundo zezengqondo.

translations.source: As knowledge of Greek declined, the West found itself cut off from its Greek philosophical and scientific roots.
translations.reference: Njengoba ulwazi lwaseGrisi lwaluncipha, iNtshonalanga yazithola isuka ezimpandeni zayo zefilosofi nesayensi zobuGriki.
translations.hypothesis: Njengoba ulwazi mayelana nolimi lwama-Greki luyedlule, iNtshonalanga yazithola ihlukaniswe ezindabeni zobufilosofi kanye nezibalo ezazisukela emvelweni wayo wase-Greki.

translations.source: Many observed rhythms in physiology and behavior often crucially depend on the presence of endogenous cycles and their production through biological clocks.
translations.reference: Iningi lokuphindaphinda kuyifiziyoloji nasekuziphatheni okubonwayo ngokuvamile kuxhomeke ngokuyinhloko ekubeni khona kwemijikelezo evela phakathi kanye nokwenziwa kwako ngamawashi emvelo.
translations.hypothesis: Izindlela eziningi ezibonakalayo zokusebenza emzimbeni kanye nomdlalo wabantu zivamise kakhulu ukuxhomekeka ekubeni kukhona izikhathi zangaphakathi kanye nokukhiqizwa kwawo ngamakhlocki ezibiotikhi.

translations.source: Periodic rhythms, which are not simply responses to external periodic cues, have been documented for most living beings, including bacteria, fungi, plants, and animals.
translations.reference: Izigqi zezikhathi ezithile, okungekhona ukusabela nje kwezinkomba ezingaphandle, kubikiwe ezidalweni eziningi eziphilayo, kuhlanganise amabhakithiliya, isikhunta, izitshalo, kanye nezilwane.
translations.hypothesis: Izimo zokuguquka ezijwayelekile, ezinto ezilawulwa yizinto zangaphandle eziguquka ngendlela ejwayelekile, zibonwe ezinto ezimpilweni eziningi, okubalwa izithwane, izifo, izitshalo, nezilwane.

translations.source: Biological clocks are self sustaining oscillators which will continue a period of free-running cycling even in the absence of external cues.
translations.reference: Amawashi endalo azivuselela amandla azoqhubeka esebenza emjikelwezweni okhululekile ngisho noma enkathini ongeke ukwazi ukuyicabanga.
translations.hypothesis: Amaklocki omhlaba wonke yizinto ezizindizele ngokuzimele ezihlala ziqhubeka nokuzula ngendlela ethile ngisho nakumaqenjini lapho kungekho zimpawu zangaphandle ezizibenzela.

translations.source: The Hershey and Chase experiment was one of the leading suggestions that DNA was a genetic material.
translations.reference: Ukuhlolwa kuka-Hershey no-Chase bekungokunye kokusikisela okuhamba phampili kokuthi iDNA isakhi sofuzo.
translations.hypothesis: Ubuchwepheshe buka-Hershey no-Chase belingenye yezindlela ezibalulekile ezibonisa ukuthi i-DNA iyinto ebalulekile kwezobuthakathzi.

translations.source: Hershey and Chase used phages, or viruses, to implant their own DNA into a bacterium.
translations.reference: UHershey noChase basebenzisa ama-phages, noma amagciwane, ukuze bafake i-DNA yabo ku-bacterium.
translations.hypothesis: U-Hershey no-Chase basebenzise ama-phage, noma amagciwane, ukuze afake i-DNA yabo ngaphakathi kwebhakthiriya.

translations.source: They did two experiments marking either the DNA in the phage with a radioactive phosphorus or the protein of the phage with radioactive sulfur.
translations.reference: Benze ukuhlola ezimbili ngokwenza i-DNA nge-phage besebenzisa iphosphorus ye-radioactive noma amaprotheni e-phage nge-sulfur ye-radioactive.
translations.hypothesis: Benza izivivinyo ezimbili, ngalinye lalo liyobe luphawula i-DNA yale phage ngempisipha yangempilo noma iphrotheni yale phage ngempisipha yangempilo.

translations.source: Mutations can have a variety of different effects depending on the type of mutation, the significance of the piece of genetic material affected and whether the cells affected are germ-line cells.
translations.reference: Ukuguquka kungaba namathonya ahlukile angafani kuye ngohlobo lokuguquka, ukubaluleka kocezu lwesakhi sofuzo oluthintekile kanye nokuthi amangqamuzana athintekile amangqamuzana esidoda neqanda yini.
translations.hypothesis: Ukuguquka kwe-DNA kungaba nemiphumela ehlukahlukene, kuye ngohlobo lokuguquko, ukubaluleka kwengxenye yezinto zombili ezithintekile, nokuthi ama-seli athintekile ngabe yi-seli zombili yini.

translations.source: Only mutations in germ-line cells can be passed on to children, while mutations elsewhere can cause cell-death or cancer.
translations.reference: Ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo emagqamuzaneni wamagciwane kuphela okungadluliselwa ezinganeni, nakuba ukuguquka kwenye indawo kungabangela ukufa kwamangqamuzana noma umdlavuza.
translations.hypothesis: Kuphela ukuguquka kwezeselula ezitholakalayo (germ-line cells) okungadluliselwa kubantwana, kanti ukuguquka kwezinye izindawo kungaholela ekululeni kwezeselula noma ekanseri.

translations.source: Nature-based tourism attracts people interested in visiting natural areas for the purpose of enjoying the scenery, including plant and animal wildlife.
translations.reference: Izindawo zokuvakasha ezingokwemvelo zikhanga abantu abathanda ukuvakashela izindawo ezingokwemvelo ngenhloso yokujabulela ukubuka indawo, kuhlanganise izitshalo nezilwane zasendle.
translations.hypothesis: Ukuhamba ezindaweni zasendle kukhuthaza abantu abanentshisekelo yokuvakashela izindawo zasendle ukuze bajabulele ubuhle bendawo, okubalwa phakathi kwalo izitshalo nezilwane ezihlala kulezo zindawo.

translations.source: Examples of on-site activities include hunting, fishing, photography, bird watching, and visiting parks and studying information about the ecosystem.
translations.reference: Izibonelo zemisebenzi eyenziwa endaweni zihlanganisa ukuzingela, ukudoba, ukuthatha izithombe, ukubuka izinyoni, kanye nokuvakashela amapaki nokufunda ukwaziswa okumayelana nezinto eziphilayo.
translations.hypothesis: Izibonelo zamasevisi okunwetshwa kulo ndawo zifaka ukuhlenga, ukudoba, ukuthwebula izithombe, ukubuka izinyoni, kanye nokuvakashela amapaki kanye nokufunda ngolwazi mayelana nohlelo bomhlaba.

translations.source: An example is visiting, photographing, and learning about organgatuangs in Borneo.
translations.reference: Isibonelo ukuvakasha, ukuthatha izithombe, kanye nokufunda ngama-orangatan eBorneo.
translations.hypothesis: Isibonelo, ukuhamba ukuze ubukele, uthwebule izithombe, futhi ufunde ngama-orangutan e-Borneo.

translations.source: Every morning, people leave small country towns in cars to go their workplace and are passed by others whose work destination is the place they have just left.
translations.reference: Njalo ekuseni, abantu bashiya amadolobha amancane wasemaphandleni ngezimoto ukuze baye ezindaweni zabo zokusebenzela futhi badlulwa abanye indawo yabo yokusebenzela elapho basanda kusuka khona.
translations.hypothesis: Kusihlwa ngakunye, abantu bashiya amadolobha amancane ngamathayi ukuya emsebenzini wabo, kanti abanye abantu, abasebenza endaweni abantu labo besishiye, badlula ngabona.

translations.source: In this dynamic transport shuttle everyone is somehow connected with, and supporting, a transport system based on private cars.
translations.reference: Kuloluhlobo lwesithuthi olunamandla wonke umuntu ngandlelathile uxhumene, futhi usekela uhlelo lokuthutha olusekelwe ezimotweni ezincane.
translations.hypothesis: Kulolu hlelo lokuhamba olusha, wonke umuntu uxhumene ngandlela ethile, futhi uyisekela, uhlelo lokuhamba olusekelwe emithweni yomphakathi.

translations.source: Science now indicates that this massive carbon economy has dislodged the biosphere from one of its stable states that has supported human evolution for the past two million years.
translations.reference: Isayensi manje ikhomba ukuthi lokhu kubakhona kwe-carbon kucekele phansi imvelo kusuka kwesinye sezimo sayo esizinzile kakhulu esisekele ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kwabantu eminyakeni eyizigidi ezimbili edlule.
translations.hypothesis: Imfundo yezenscience manje ibonisa ukuthi le nkolo enkulu yamakhabhoni manje isiphahlisile uhlelo lobuntu ezindaweni eziningi, kanti lezi zindawo zibe yizikhungo ezibalulekile ekukhuliseni ukuhlaliswa kwabantu kule minyaka eyikhulu lamashumi amabili.

translations.source: Everyone participates in society and uses transportation systems. Almost everyone complains about transportation systems.
translations.reference: Wonke umuntu uyahlanganyela emphakathini futhi usebenzisa uhlelo lokuthutha. Cishe wonke umuntu uyakhalaza ngohlelo lokuthutha.
translations.hypothesis: Wonke umuntu ubamba iqhaza emphakathini futhi usebenzisa izinhlelo zokuhamba. Cishe bonke abantu badumaza izinhlelo zokuhamba.

translations.source: In developed countries you seldom hear similar levels of complaints about water quality or bridges falling down.
translations.reference: Emazweni athuthukile uyethukela uzwa amazinga afanayo okukhalaza ngekhwalithi yamanzi noma amabhuloho awayo.
translations.hypothesis: Ezweni elithuthukile, kungenjalo ukuzwa izikhalazo ezifanayo mayelana nokukhululeka komphilo noma izithimba ezilayishi.

translations.source: Why do transportation systems engender such complaints, why do they fail on a daily basis? Are transportation engineers just incompetent? Or is something more fundamental going on?
translations.reference: Kungani izinhlelo zokuthutha zibanga ukukhalaza okunjalo, kungani zihluleka zinsuku zonke? Ingabe onjiniyela bezinto zokuthutha abafaneleki? Noma kunokuthile okubaluleke kakhudlwana okwenzekayo yini?
translations.hypothesis: Kungani izinhlelo zokuhamba zibanga izikhalazo eziningi, futhi kungani zeqa njalo? Ingabe abongisi bezokuhamba bayimbi kuphela? Noma kukhona okuthile okubaluleke kakhulu okwenzeka?

translations.source: Traffic Flow is the study of the movement of individual drivers and vehicles between two points and the interactions they make with one another.
