translations.hypothesis: Ngenkathi kwenzeka ukulwela ukuzimela okuhleliwe yi-mhuthuzelo ye-Mau, umhlangano obuthakathaka edolobheni uholele ekubeni umholi omkhulu uTupua Tamasese Lealofi III agculwe.

translations.source: There are many beaches, due to Auckland's straddling of two harbours. The most popular ones are in three areas.
translations.reference: Kunezingu eziningi, ngenxa yokuthi i-Auckland ingapha nangapha kwamatheku amabili. Ezithandwa kakhulu zisezindaweni ezintathu.
translations.hypothesis: Kunezindawo eziningi zama-bhishi, ngenxa yokuthi i-Auckland itholakala phakathi kwezindawo ezimbili zama-harbour. Izindawo ezithandwa kakhulu zitholakala ezindaweni ezintathu.

translations.source: North Shore beaches (in North Harbour district) are on the Pacific Ocean and stretch from Long Bay in the north to Devonport in the south.
translations.reference: Amabhisi wasoGwini oluseNyakatho (esifundeni seTheku eliseNyakatho) asoLwandlekazini lwePhasifiki futhi asuka e-Long Bay ngasenyakatho kuya e-Devonport eningizimu.
translations.hypothesis: Izindawo zokubhambatha ezisendaweni yaseNorth Shore (efunda yaseNorth Harbour) zitholakala eLwandle lasePacific futhi ziba phakathi kukaLong Bay enyakatho kanye neDevonport eningizimu.

translations.source: They are almost all sandy beaches with safe swimming, and most have shade provided by pohutukawa trees.
translations.reference: Kucishe kube izingu ezinesihlabathi eziyindawo ephephile yokubhukuda, kanti kugcwele nemithunzi eyenziwa izihlahla ze-pohutukawa.
translations.hypothesis: Lawula zonke lezi zilwandle zineziluhlaza zensimbi, futhi zikhipha izingozi, futhi eziningi zinezithombe zamaqhawe aphansi ezihlinzekwa ngamakhasi amakhulu athile.

translations.source: Tamaki Drive beaches are on the Waitemata Harbour, in the upmarket suburbs of Mission Bay and St Heliers in Central Auckland.
translations.reference: Amabhishi ase-Tamaki Drive ase-Harbour yase-Waitemata, edolobheni labadla izambane likapondo e-Mission Bay naseSt Heliers e–Auckland eMaphakathi.
translations.hypothesis: Amabhishi e-Tamaki Drive ase-Waitemata Harbour, ezindaweni ezitholakalayo ezihlala kuyo abantu abaqakathekile ezihlala e-Mission Bay nase-St Heliers, e-Central Auckland.

translations.source: These are sometimes-crowded family beaches with a good range of shops lining the shore. Swimming is safe.
translations.reference: Lawa amabhishi wemindeni aba nabantu abaningi ngezinye izikhathi anezitolo ezihlukahlukene ezigcwele ogwini. Ukubhukuda kuphephile.
translations.hypothesis: Lezi zindawo zokubhathiswa zangakini ezikhulu, ezihlala zinezakhamuzi eziningi, futhi zinezitolo eziningi eziseduze komugwa. Ukubhathiswa kuyokuphepha.

translations.source: The main local beer is 'Number One', it is not a complex beer, but pleasant and refreshing. The other local beer is called "Manta".
translations.reference: Ubhiya oyinhloko wasekhaya ‘Uhamba Phambili’, awuwona ubhiya oyinkimbinkimbi, kodwa umnandi futhi uyaqabula. Omunye ubhiya wasekhaya ubizwa ngokuthi “i-Manta”.
translations.hypothesis: I-bhili eliyindaba enkulu kule ndawo yi-'Number One', ayiyona ibhilini eliyinkimbinkimbi, kodwa iyajabulisa futhi inempilo. Ibhili elinye eliyisakazwe kule ndawo kubizwa nge-"Manta".

translations.source: There are many French wines to be had, but the New Zealand and Australian wines might travel better.
translations.reference: Kunamawayini amaningi waseFulansi okuphuzwa, kodwa amawayini waseNyuzilandi kanye nase-Australia angahamba kangcono.
translations.hypothesis: Kunezinhlobo eziningi zewayini yaseFrance ezitholakalayo, kodwa ingabe iwayini yaseNew Zealand kanye yase-Australia ingaba ilungele ukuthuthelwa kalula.

translations.source: The local tap water is perfectly safe to drink, but bottled water is easy to find if you are fearful.
translations.reference: Amanzi asempompini yomphakathi aphephe ngokuphelele ukuthi aphuzwe, kodwa amanzi athengwayo atholakala kalula uma unokwesaba.
translations.hypothesis: Manzi yomphahla esitholakala endaweni yangakini iphephile kakhulu ukuswelwa, kodwa kukhona amanzi agodliwe athathekayo uma unokwesaba.

translations.source: For Australians, the idea of 'flat white' coffee is foreign. A short black is 'espresso', cappuccino comes heaped high with cream (not froth), and tea is served without milk.
translations.reference: Kubantu base-Australia, umcabango wekhofi 'elinobisi oluthunqiswe ngomusi' awujwayelekile. Inkomishi encane 'yi-espresso', i-cappuccino iza igcwele ukhilimu ophezulu (hhayi ugwebu), futhi itiye liphuzwa ngaphandle kobisi.
translations.hypothesis: Kubantu base-Australia, umqulu wokuthi "flat white" uyinto engajwayelekile. Ithayi elincane elimnyama kubizwa "espresso", i-cappuccino ifakwe ngobisi omningi (hhayi ukukhiliphithi), futhi ithayi ihlinzekwa ngaphandle kobisi.

translations.source: The hot chocolate is up to Belgian standards. Fruit juices are pricey but excellent.
translations.reference: Isiphuzo sikashokoledi esishisayo sisemazingeni waseBelgium. Iziphuzo ezenziwe ngezithelo ziyabiza kodwa zikahle kakhulu.
translations.hypothesis: I-chocolate ehlaziywe ihlangabezana nezindinganiso zamaBelgi. Amaju awoyini athule kakhulu kodwa anomkhakha kakhulu.

translations.source: Many trips to the reef are made all year around, and injuries due to any of these causes on the reef are rare.
translations.reference: Uhambo oluningi lokuya emkhombeni wekholali (reef) lwenziwa unyaka wonke, futhi izingozi ngenxa yanoma iziphi yalezi zimbangela zasemkhombeni azivamile.
translations.hypothesis: Ezinyangeni eziningi zonyaka, abantu bahamba kakhulu ezindaweni zamafushane, futhi ukulimala okubangelwa yizinto ezahlukene ezitholwe kulezo zindawo kuyinto engajwayelekile.

translations.source: Still, take advice from authorities, obey all signs, and pay close attention to safety warnings.
translations.reference: Noma kunjalo, thatha iseluleko seziphathimandla, ulandele zonke izinkomba futhi unakisise izixwayiso sokuphepha.
translations.hypothesis: Noma kunjalo, thathela izeluleko ezivela kubaphathi, landela yonke imikhombandlela, futhi gibheke ngokucophelela izexwayiso zokuphepha.

translations.source: Box jellyfish occur near beaches and near river estuaries from October to April north of 1770. They can occasionally be found outside these times.
translations.reference: Ama-jellyfish asabhokisi abakhona eduze namabhishi naseduze nezizalo zemifula kusukela ngoMfumfu kuya kuMbasa enyakatho ye-1770. Angatholakala ngezinye izikhathi ngaphandle kwalezi zikhathi.
translations.hypothesis: Izikhunta ezinkulu ezihlanganiswe zitholakala eduze kwamabhishi kanye nezindawo lapho amanzi omfula ahlangana nomugwa, kusukela ngo-Okthoba kuya ku-Ephreli, enyakatho yendawo eyi-1770. Ngokwengxenye, zingatholakala nangaphandle kwalesi sikhathi.

translations.source: Sharks do exist, however they rarely attack humans. Most sharks are scared of humans and would swim away.
translations.reference: Oshaka abekho, nokho abavamisile ukuhlasela abantu. Oshaka abaningi besaba abantu futhi bazobhukuda babaleke.
translations.hypothesis: Izikhunta zikhona, kodwa zivame kakhulu ukuthi zingahlaseli abantu. Izikhunta eziningi zombule abantu futhi zihlale zibuya.

translations.source: Saltwater Crocodiles do not actively live in the ocean, their primary habitat is in river estuaries north from Rockhampton.
translations.reference: Izingwenya zamanzi anosawoti azihlali ngokukhululeka olwandle, indawo yazo yokuhlala eyinhloko kusezizalweni zomfula enyakatho kusuka e-Rockhampton.
translations.hypothesis: Izinkomo zombili azihlali ngokuqondile olwandle, kodwa indawo yazo eyinhloko yikhaya ezindaweni ezisondela kumaphakathi namabhuloho ezilwandle, kakhulu ezempumalanga yeRockhampton.

translations.source: Booking in advance gives the traveller peace of mind that they will have somewhere to sleep once they arrive at their destination.
translations.reference: Ukubhukha kusenesikhathi kunikeza isihambi ukuthula kwengqondo kokuthi sizoba nendawo yokulala kuyo lapho sifika endaweni esiya kuyo.
translations.hypothesis: Ukubhuka ngaphambili kunika umhambi ukuqiniseka kokuthi bazoba nezindawo zokulala uma befika endaweni abayiyodlala kuyo.

translations.source: Travel agents often have deals with specific hotels, although you may find it possible to book other forms of accommodation, like camping grounds, through a travel agent.
translations.reference: Izinkampani ezihlela uhambo kaningi ziba nezaphulelo namahhotela athile, nakuba ungakwazi ukubhukha ezinye izinhlobo zokuhlala, njengendawo yamakamu, ngenkampani ehlela uhambo.
translations.hypothesis: Ozakubambisana nezinkampani zokuhamba bazivamise ukuba nezivumelwano nehotela ezithile, nakuba kungase kube nokuthi ungathola ukuthi ungabhalisa ngezindlela zokuhlala eziningi, njengezindawo zokukhempa, ngomuntu osebenza kuleyo nkampani.

translations.source: Travel agents usually offer packages that include breakfast, transportation arrangements to/from the airport or even combined flight and hotel packages.
translations.reference: Izinkampani ezihlela uhambo zinikeza inhlanganisela yezinto ezihlanganisa ibhulakufesi, amalungiselelo wezinto zokuthutha zokuya/zokusuka esikhumulweni sezindiza noma isethi ehlangene yendiza kanye nehhotela.
translations.hypothesis: Ozakubambisana nabasebenzi bezokuhamba abanye bahlinzeka ngamaphakheji aqobo ukudla ekuseni, ukuhlehlisa ezindleleni ukuya noma evela edolobheni, noma ngisho namaphakheji ahlanganisa uhambo nokuhlala ehhotela.

translations.source: They can also hold the reservation for you if you need time to think about the offer or procure other documents for your destination (e.g. visa).
translations.reference: Bayakwazi ukukugcinela indawo uma wena usadinga isikhathi sokucabanga noma usafisa ukulungisa izinto ezithinta uhambo lwakho (isb., i-visa).
translations.hypothesis: Bangakwazi futhi ukugcina ukubhukisho lakho uma udinga isikhathi sokucabanga ngalesi sipho noma ukuthola eminye imibhalo edingekayo endaweni oyihambayo (isb. ivisithi).

translations.source: Any amendments or requests though should be coursed through the travel agent first and not directly with the hotel.
translations.reference: Noma iziphi izinguquko noma izicelo nokho kumelwe zidluliselwe enkampanini ehlela uhambo kuqala futhi hhayi nehhotela ngokuqondile.
translations.hypothesis: Noma yiziphi izinguquko noma izicelo, kufanele zithunyelwe ku-ejenti yolwazi lokuhamba kuqala, hhayi ngqo ehhotela.

translations.source: For some festivals, the vast majority of the attendants to music festivals decide to camp on site, and most attendants consider it a vital part of the experience.
translations.reference: Kweminye imikhosi, iningi lababakhona emkhosini womculo linquma ukukanisa kuleyo ndawo, futhi ababakhona abaningi bakubona kuyingxenye edingekayo yokuhlanganyela.
translations.hypothesis: Kwezinye izinkomishi, abaningi kakhulu ababamba iqhaza ezinkomishi zomculo bathanda ukuhlala phansi endaweni yomcimbi, futhi abaningi kubo bacabanga ukuthi lokhu kuyingxenye ebalulekile yalo mkhuba.

translations.source: If you want to be close to the action you're going to have to get in early to get a camping site close to the music.
translations.reference: Uma ufuna ukubona okwenzekayo useduze kuzomelwe ufike masinya ukuze uthole indawo yokukamisa eduze nomculo.
translations.hypothesis: Uma ufuna ukuba eduze kakhulu kwento okwenzeka, kuzodingeka ufiwe ngokushesha ukuze uthole indawo yokulala ngaphandle eduze nomculo.

translations.source: Remember that even though music on the main stages may have finished, there may be sections of the festival that will keep playing music until late into the night.
translations.reference: Khumbula ukuthi nakuba umculo osesiteji esiyinhloko ungaphela, kungaba nezingxenye zomkhosi ezizoqhubeka zidlala umculo kuze kube sebusuku kakhulu.
translations.hypothesis: Khumbula ukuthi nakuba umculo ezinkundleni ezinkulu kungase uqediwe, kungase kube namanye amagumbi komkhosi aqhubeke nokudlala umculo kuze kube late ebusuku.

translations.source: Some festivals have special camping areas for families with young children.
translations.reference: Eminye imikhosi inezindawo zokukanisa ezikhethekile zemindeni enezingane ezincane.
translations.hypothesis: Eminye yamakhonsi inendawo ekhethekile yokuhlala lapho izindlu zokuhlala zikhona, ezenzelwe imikhaya enezingane ezincane.

translations.source: If crossing the Northern Baltic in winter, check the cabin location, as going through ice causes quite horrible noise for those most affected.
translations.reference: Uma unqamula iNyakatho Baltic ebusika, bheka ukuthi ikuphi indawo yokusandlwana okwakhiwe ngezingodo, njengoba ukuhamba eqhweni kubangela ukungaphatheki kahle emakhaleni kulaba abathinteke kakhulu.
translations.hypothesis: Uma niyohamba ngaphansi kwamanzi aseNyakatho Baltic ngesikhathi sendlwini, hlola ukuthi igumbi liyodlala kanjani, ngoba ukudlula ngaphansi kwephunga kubanga umsindo omubi kakhulu kulabo abathintekile kakhulu.

translations.source: Saint Petersburg cruises include time in town. Cruise passengers are exempted from visa requirements (check the terms).
translations.reference: Uhambo lomkhumbi lwaseSaint Petersburg luhlanganisa idolobha. Kulindelwe ukuthi abahamba ngomkhumbi bahlangabezane nezimfuneko ze-visa (hlola imigomo)
translations.hypothesis: Izinkundla zokuhamba ngamabhasi e-Saint Petersburg zihlanganisa isikhathi esitholakalayo edolobheni. Abagibeli bezinkundla zokuhamba abanalo udlulelwa yizidingo zezivisi (bheka imigomo).

translations.source: Casinos typically make many efforts to maximize time and money spent by guests. Windows and clocks are usually absent, and exits can be hard to find.
translations.reference: Amahhlo okugembula ngokujwayelekile enza imizamo yokuba izivakashi zichithe isikhathi nemali eningi ngangokunokwenzeka. Amafasitela namakilogo ngokuvamile awekho, futhi kungaba nzima ukuthola izindawo zokuphuma.
translations.hypothesis: Imigwaqo yezindlebe ivamise ukuzama kanjani ukwandisa isikhathi kanye nemali abayikhokha izivakashi. Imifanekiso yefenisha kanye namaklocki ivamise ukungabi khona, futhi kungase kube nzima ukuthola indlela yokuphuma.

translations.source: They usually have special food, drink and entertainment offers, to keep guests in a good mood, and keep them at the premise.
translations.reference: Ngokuvamile banokudla okukhethekile, iziphuzo kanye nokuzijabulisa, ukuze bagcine izivakashi zithokozile, futhi bazigcine ziphakathi kwawo.
translations.hypothesis: Ngokuvamile, bahlinzeka ngokudla okukhethekile, iziphuzo kanye nokuzijabulisa, ukuze bagcine izivakashi zijabule futhi bazihlale lapho.

translations.source: Some venues offer alcoholic beverages on the house. However, drunkenness impairs judgement, and all good gamblers know the importance of staying sober.
translations.reference: Ezinye izindawo zihlinzeka ngotshwala ezindlini. Nokho, ukudakwa kudunga ingqondo, bonke abantu abagembulayo abahle bayakwazi ukubaluleka kokuhlala usangulukile.
translations.hypothesis: Eminye yezindawo zikhonza iziphuzo ezinezilwane mahhala. Kodwa, ukutshwala kukhubaza ukwenza izinqumo, futhi wonke umdlali omuhle uyazi ukubaluleka kokuhlala enempilo.

translations.source: Anyone who's going to drive at high latitudes or over mountain passes should consider the possibility of snow, ice, or freezing temperatures.
translations.reference: Noma ubani ozoshayela ezindaweni eziphakeme noma ngaphezu kwezintuba zezintaba kumelwe alindele ukuba khona kwesithwathwa, iqhwa, noma amakhaza ashubisa umkantsha.
translations.hypothesis: Noma ngubani ozojoyisa ezindaweni eziphezulu noma ezintabeni, kufanele acabange ngengxenye yokuthi kungase kube nomfula, ugesi, noma izinga lokushisa eliphansi kakhulu.

translations.source: On icy and snowy roadways, friction is low and you cannot drive as if you were on bare asphalt.
translations.reference: Emigwaqweni eneqhwa kanye nomkhithiko, ukuhamba kuyabambezeleka futhi angeke ukwazi ukushayela njengalapho uhamba otiyeleni.
translations.hypothesis: Ezindleleni ezinezindluphu nezintambo, ukuxosha kuncane, futhi akufanele ushayele njengoba ushayela endleleni engenantambo.

translations.source: During blizzards, enough snow to get you stuck can fall in very little time.
translations.reference: Uma kunomoya ohambisana neqhwa, kungawa iqhwa elanele elingakwenza ubhajwe ngesikhashana nje.
translations.hypothesis: Ngesikhathi sezindlu zintuli, ukukhona okungenxa yokuthi ungahlala uphinde ukuthi ukhona kungafika ngesikhathi esifushane kakhulu.

translations.source: Visibility may also be restricted by falling or blowing snow or by condensation or ice on vehicle windows.
translations.reference: Ukubonakala kungavinjelwa ukuwa noma ukufuthwa kweqhwa noma noma ngomswakama noma iqhwa efasiteleni lemoto.
translations.hypothesis: Ukubukeka kungase kushoniswe futhi ngamanzi ahlome noma umoya okhulu, noma ngokusakazeka noma yisiqhwa emigqeni yamathilomu.

translations.source: On the other hand, icy and snowy conditions are normal in many countries, and traffic goes on mostly uninterrupted all year round.
translations.reference: Ngakolunye uhlangothi, izimo zeqhwa noma zesithwathwa zivamile emazweni amaningi, futhi izimoto zihamba ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka cishe unyaka wonke.
translations.hypothesis: Ngenye yilelo, izimo ezibandayo nezinezintambo ziwukokubanzi ezweni eziningi, futhi ukuhamba komzila kuqhubeka ngaphandle kokuvikelwa kakhulu ngalo nyanga yonke.

translations.source: Safaris are perhaps the greatest tourism draw in Africa and the highlight for many visitors.
translations.reference: Amasafari mhlawumbe yinto enkulu kunazo zonke edonsa izivakashi e-Afrika futhi yinto ethandwa yizivakashi eziningi.
translations.hypothesis: Izinkundla zempela zingaba yinto enhle kakhulu ekukhangiseni ezivakashini e-Afrika, futhi ziba yinto ebalulekile nakakhulu kubavakashi abaningi.

translations.source: The term safari in popular use refers to overland travel to view the stunning African wildlife, particularly on savanna.
translations.reference: Igama elithi safari ngokuvamile lisetshenziselwa ukubhekisela ohambweni lokunqamula izwe ukuze ubone izilwane zasendle ezihlaba umxhwele zase-Afrika, ikakhulukazi emathafeni.
translations.hypothesis: Igama "safari," njengoba lisetshenziswa kakhulu, lisho uhambo olwenziwa ngendlela yangaphandle ukuze kubonwe izilwane ezinhle zase-Afrika, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni zama-savanna.

translations.source: Some animals, such as elephants and giraffes, tend to approach closely to cars and standard equipment will allow good viewing.
translations.reference: Ezinye izilwane, njengezindlovu kanye nezindlulamithi, zithanda ukusondela ezimotweni futhi izinto zokubuka ezisezingeni elikahle zizokuvumela ukuthi uzibuke kahle.
translations.hypothesis: Ezinye izilwane, njengezinkomo nezinkomo ezinde, zivame ukungene eduze zamamoyimoto, futhi okuyisibalo esijwayelekile kuzokuvumela ukuthi uzibone kahle.

translations.source: Lions, cheetahs and leopards are sometimes shy and you will see them better with binoculars.
translations.reference: Amabhubesi, izingulule kanye nezingwe ziyexwaya futhi uzozibona kangcono ngezingilazi zokubuka kude.
translations.hypothesis: Amaliona, amakati kanye neziphalaza zangasese kakhulu, futhi kuzoba ngcono ukuzibona ngendlela engcono kakhulu ngamakhishi.

translations.source: A walking safari (also called a "bush walk", "hiking safari", or going "footing") consists of hiking, either for a few hours or several days.
translations.reference: Uhambo lokunqamula izwe lwezinyawo (ebizwa nangokuthi "i-bush walk", "hiking safari", noma "footing") luhlanganisa uhambo olude lwezinyawo, kungaba amahora ambalwa noma izinsuku eziningana.
translations.hypothesis: Ukuhamba ngezinyawo ezindaweni zasendle (okuthiwa futhi "ukuhamba endlini," "uhambo lokuhamba ngezinyawo," noma "ukuhamba ngezinyawo") kuhlanganisa ukuhamba ngezinyawo, kungaba amahora ambalwa noma izinsuku eziningi.

translations.source: The Paralympics will take place from 24 August to 5 September 2021. Some events will be held in other locations throughout Japan.
translations.reference: Ama-Paralympic azokwenzeka kusukela ngomhla ka-24 kuNcwaba kuya ku-5 kuMandulo 2021. Ezinye izehlakalo zizobanjelwa kwezinye izindawo eJapani yonke.
translations.hypothesis: I-Paralympics izoqala ngomhlaka ka-24 Agasti kuze kube ngomhlaka ka-5 Septhemba ka-2021. Ezinye imidlalo zizoba kwabezindaweni ezahlukene kulo wonke uJapani.

translations.source: Tokyo will be the only Asian city to have hosted two summer Olympics, having hosted the games in 1964.
translations.reference: ITokyo kuzoba ilona kuphela idolobha lase-Asia eliphathe imidlalo yama-Olimpiki wasehlobo emibili, eliyiphathe ngo-1964.
translations.hypothesis: I-Tokyo izoba yidolobha eliyodwa lase-Asia elibe ngumphathi kazwelonke we-Olimpic kabili, ngemuva kokuba yiphathi yalo mnotho ngango-1964.

translations.source: If you booked your flights and accommodation for 2020 before the postponement was announced, you may have a tricky situation.
translations.reference: Uma ubhukhe indiza kanye nendawo yokulala ngo-2020 ngaphambi kokuthi kumenyezelwe ukuhlehliswa, ungase ube sesimweni esinzima.
translations.hypothesis: Uma ucele amathikithi ezindiza kanye nezindawo zokuhlala ngonyaka ka-2020 ngaphambi kokuthi kudalwe umbuzo mayelana nokubuyiselwa kwalo mqembu, kungase kube khona izinkinga.

translations.source: Cancellation policies vary, but as of late March most coronavirus-based cancellation policies don't extend to July 2020, when the Olympics had been scheduled.
translations.reference: Izinkambiso zokukhansela ziyahluka, kodwa kusukela ngasekupheleni kukaNdasa izinkampiso eziningi zokukhansela ngenxa ye-coronavirus azifiki kuNtulikazi 2020, ngenkathi okwakuhlelwe ngayo ama-Olimpiki.
translations.hypothesis: Imigomo yokukhansela iyahlukahluka, kodwa kusukela ngasekupheleni kukaMashi, imigomo eminingi yokukhansela ehlobene ne-coronavirus ayenzi ukuthi ukukhansela kufanele kwenzeke kuze kube ngoJulayi ka-2020, lapho kwakuhlelelwe khona i-Olympics.

translations.source: It's expected that most event tickets will cost between ¥2,500 and ¥130,000, with typical tickets costing around ¥7,000.
translations.reference: Kulindeleke ukuthi amathikithi amaningi womcimbi azobiza phakathi kuka-¥2,500 no-¥130,000, futhi amathikithi avamile abiza u-¥7,000.
translations.hypothesis: Kulindeleke ukuthi amanani amakhulu amanye amatikiti ezimemezelo azoba phakathi kuka-¥2,500 no-¥130,000, kanti amanani amakhulu amanye amatikiti azoba cishe ama-¥7,000.

translations.source: Ironing damp clothes can help them dry. Many hotels have an iron and ironing board available for loan, even if one is not present in the room.
translations.reference: Uku-ayina izingubo ezimanzi kungazisiza zome. Amahhotela amaningi ane-ayini nebhodi yoku-ayina etholakalayo ngokubolekwa, noma ngabe eyodwa ingekho egumbini.
translations.hypothesis: Ukushaya izingubo ezimanzi kungasiza ukuthi zome. Amahhotela amaningi anama-ayoni kanye nezikhunta zokushaya izingubo ezitholakalela ukubuyiselwa, ngisho noma kungabi nakho okunjalo egumbini.

translations.source: If an iron isn't available, or if you don't fancy wearing ironed socks, then you can try using a hairdryer, if available.
translations.reference: Uma i-ayina ingekho, noma uma ungagqoki amasokisi abizayo a-ayiniwe, ungazama ukusebenzisa umshini wokomisa izinwele, uma ukhona.
translations.hypothesis: Uma uketshezi lingatholakali, noma uma ungathandi ukugqoka amakhefu agcwele, ungazama ukusebenzisa umshini wokomisa izinwele, uma ungumncane.

translations.source: Be careful not to allow fabric to become too hot (which can cause shrinkage, or in extreme cases, scorch).
translations.reference: Qaphela ukuba ungavumeli indwangu ukuba ishise kakhulu (okungayenza ukuthi ishwaqe, noma ezimweni ezidlulele, ihamuke).
translations.hypothesis: Qaphela ukungavumeli izingubo zishise kakhulu (ngoba lokho kungaholela ekuncipeni usayizi, noma ezimeni ezithile, ekulahlekeni).

translations.source: There are different ways of purifying water, some more effective against specific threats.
translations.reference: Kunezindlela eziningi zokuhlanza amanzi, ezinye ezisebenza kakhulu ngaphansi kwezimo ezithile eziwusongo.
translations.hypothesis: Kunezindlela ezahlukene zokuhlanzisa amanzi, kukhona ezinye ezisebenza kangcono ekulwileni izinkinga ezithile.

translations.source: In some areas boiling water for a minute is enough, in others several minutes are needed.
translations.reference: Kwezinye izindawo ukubilisa amanzi umzuzu kwanele, kwezinye kudingeka imizuzu eminingana.
translations.hypothesis: Kunezindawana ezithile lapho ukushisa amanzi ngeminithi eyodwa kube nokwanele, kodwa kwezinye izindawo kudingeka ukushisa amanzi imizuzu eminingi.

translations.source: Filters vary in effectiveness, and should you have a concern, then you should consider buying your water in a sealed bottle from a reputable company.
translations.reference: Izihlungi ziyahluka ngempumelelo, uma ungaba nokukhathazeka, kumelwe ucabangele ukuthenga amanzi wakho ebhodleni elivaliwe enkampanini ethenjwayo.
translations.hypothesis: Izihlungi zihluka-hlukile ngamandla azo, futhi uma uneminye ingxenye engakhathazayo, kufanele ucabangele ukuthenga amanzi akho ezibhodleni ezivaliwe ezivela enkampanini ethembekile.

translations.source: Travellers may encounter animal pests that they are not familiar with in their home regions.
translations.reference: Izihambi zingahlangabezana nezifo zezilwane ezingazijwaleyanga ezindaweni zangakuzo.
translations.hypothesis: Abahambi bangase bahlangane nezilwane ezilimele ezangempela abazazi ngazo ezindaweni abavela kuzo.

translations.source: Pests can spoil food, cause irritation, or in a worse case cause allergic reactions, spread venom, or transmit infections.
translations.reference: Izilokazane zingakonakalisa ukudla, zicasule, noma okubi nakakhulu zenze kusigulise, zisakaze ubuthi, noma zisakaze izifo.
translations.hypothesis: Izilwanyana ezilimele zingaphatha ukudla, zibangele ukukhunguzwa, noma, okubi kakhulu, zibangele ukushushumbiswa, ukusasazwa kwezinto ezibulalayo, noma ukusasazwa kwezifo.

translations.source: Infectious diseases themselves, or dangerous animals that can injure or kill people by force, do not usually qualify as pests.
translations.reference: Izifo ezithelelwanayo ngokwazo, noma izilwane eziyingozi ezingalimaza noma zibulale umuntu ngamandla, azivamile ukufaneleka njengezilwane ezifuywayo.
translations.hypothesis: Izifo ezisabalalayo kanye nezilwane eyingozi ezikwazi ukulimaza noma ukubulala abantu ngamandla, ngokuvamile azifani nezinto ezibulalayo.

translations.source: Duty free shopping is the opportunity to buy goods exempted from taxes and excises at certain locations.
translations.reference: Ukuthenga izimpahla ezingakhokhiswa intela kuyithuba lokuthenga izimpahla ezikhishwe izintela kanye nentela yezimpahla ezindaweni ezithile.
translations.hypothesis: Ukuthenga ngaphandle kwamakhambi kuyithuba lokuthenga impahla engaxhashiwe ngamaxhashe kanye nezintela ezithile ezindaweni ezithile.

translations.source: Travellers bound for countries with heavy taxation can sometimes save a considerable amount of money, especially on products such as alcoholic beverages and tobacco.
translations.reference: Izihambi eziya emazweni akhokhisa intela ephezulu kwesinye isikhathi zingonga imali eningi, ikakhulukazi emikhiqizweni efana neziphuzo ezidakayo nogwayi.
translations.hypothesis: Abahambi abaya ezweni ezinezintela ezinkulu bangase bazibe imali eningi, ikakhulukazi emikhiqizweni efana neziphuzo ezinezilwane kanye nomugwa.

translations.source: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain.
translations.reference: Indawo ephakathi kwe-Point Marion ne-Fairmont yenza izimo zokushayela ezinzima kakhulu eMgwaqweni omkhulu wase-Buffalo-Pittsburgh, odlula njalo ezindaweni ezingenabantu zasemahlathini.
translations.hypothesis: Indawo phakathi kukaPoint Marion kanye neFairmont iyi-endawo enezimo zokushayela ezinzulu kakhulu endleleni ye-Buffalo-Pittsburgh, njengoba idlula njalo ezindaweni ezihlanzekile nezihlathi ezinkulu.

translations.source: If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate.
translations.reference: Uma ungajwayele ukushayela emigwaqweni yasemaphandleni, hlala uphapheme: izindawo eziyimiqansa kakhulu, izindlela eziwungcingo, kanye namajika amabi agcwele.
translations.hypothesis: Uma ungavami ukushayela emigwaqweni yasezifundazweni, qaphela: kunezindlela ezinde nezinde, izindlela ezincane, kanye namagumbi amakhulu.

translations.source: Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise.
translations.reference: Ukulinganiselwa kwesivinini okusemabhodini kuphansi ngokuphawulekayo kunasezingxenyeni zangaphambili nezilandelayo — ngokuvamile u-35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — futhi ukukunakisisa kubalulekile nakakhulu kunokungakunakisisi.
translations.hypothesis: Amagagasi ezimoto aboniswa kuleli gumbi aphansi kakhulu kunezigaba ezidlule kanye nezinto ezalandelayo — ngempumelelo amakhilomitha ayi-56-64 (amayela angu-35-40) — futhi ukulandela lawa magagasi ngokuqinile kubaluleke kakhulu kunakuwo wonye umkhakha.

translations.source: Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.
translations.reference: Ngokumangazayo, nokho, insiza yefoni ephathekayo inamandla kakhulu lapha kunezindlela eziningi eziningi zomzila, isb. ePennsylvania Wilds.
translations.hypothesis: Ngokuhle, nakuba kunjalo, isevisi yefoni ephathwayo isamandla kakhulu lapha kunezinye izindawo eziningi endleleni, njengendawo yasePennsylvania Wilds.

translations.source: German pastries are quite good, and in Bavaria, are quite rich and varied, similar to those of their southern neighbor, Austria.
translations.reference: Ukudla kwaseJalimane okubhakwayo kuhle empeleni, futhi eBavaria, kunothile futhi kuhlukile, kuyafana nalokho kwasendaweni engumakhelwane engaseningizimu, i-Austria.
translations.hypothesis: Izinkukhu zamaJalimane zinhle kakhulu, futhi eBavaria, zinezinhlobo eziningi futhi zinezinto eziningi, njengazo ezifana nazo zase-Austria, elikakhulukazi ezempumalanga yabo.

translations.source: Fruit pastries are common, with apples cooked into pastries year round, and cherries and plums making their appearances during the summer.
translations.reference: Ukudla okubhakwayo kwezithelo kuvamile, okunama-apula aphekwayo afakwa ezintweni ezibhakwayo unyaka wonke, kanye nama-cherry namapulamu evela ngehlobo.
translations.hypothesis: Izinkhukhi zokudla ezinezithelo ziyinto evamile, kanti ama-apula asolwa kulo zonke izikhathi bese afakwa ezinkhukheni. Ngaphakathi konyaka, izithelo ezifana nama-cherry kanye namaplumu zifakwa kulezi nkukhi ngesikhathi sezihla.

translations.source: Many German baked goods also feature almonds, hazelnuts, and other tree nuts. Popular cakes often pair particularly well with a cup of strong coffee.
translations.reference: Okuningi kokudla kwaseJalimane okubhakiwe kubuye kube nama-almondi, izindlubu zomhezela, kanye nezinye izindlubu zemithi. Amakhekhe athandwayo avame ukuhambisana kahle kakhulu nenkomishi yekhofi enamandla.
translations.hypothesis: Imikhiqizo eminingi yezindlela zokupheka zaseJalimane ihlanganisa ama-almond, ama-hazelnut, kanye nezinye izitshalo zamaqanda. Amakhekhi athandwa kakhulu avamise ukuhambisana kahle nomkhuba wokudla ikhofi eqinile.

translations.source: If you want some small though rich pastries, try what depending on region are called Berliner, Pfannkuchen or Krapfen.
translations.reference: Uma ufuna uphayi omncane kodwa onothile, zama lokho okubizwa kuye ngendawo ngokuthi iBerliner, iPfannkuchen noma iKrapfen.
translations.hypothesis: Uma ufuna amakhukhi amancane kodwa anombala omuhle, zama lokho okuthi, ngokuya ngendawo, kubizwa nge-Berliner, i-Pfannkuchen noma i-Krapfen.

translations.source: A curry is a dish based on herbs and spices, together with either meat or vegetables.
translations.reference: Ukhari yisidlo esisuselwa kumakhambi nezinongo, kuhlanganiswe ndawonye mhlawumbe nenyama noma imifino.
translations.hypothesis: I-curry iyidishini esenziwe ngezimpiko nezitshalo, kanye nomuthi noma imifino.

translations.source: A curry can be either "dry" or "wet" depending on the amount of liquid.
translations.reference: Ukhari ungaba “manzi” noma “wome” kuya ngesikali samanzi.
translations.hypothesis: Ukudla okuthiwa "curry" kungaba "omile" noma "manzi," kuye ngobuningi begesi alikhithi.

translations.source: In inland regions of Northern India and Pakistan, yogurt is commonly used in curries; in Southern India and some other coastal regions of the subcontinent, coconut milk is commonly used.
translations.reference: Izindawo ezimaphakathi nezwe zaseNyakatho yeNdiya nePakistan, iyogathi ivamise ukusetshenziswa ezitshuliwni; eNingizimu neNdiya kanye nasezindaweni ezinye ezisogwini zezwekazi, ubisi lukakhukhunathi luvamise ukusetshenziswa.
translations.hypothesis: Ezindaweni zasemlandwini zaseNyakatho yase-India nasePakistan, i-yogathi isetshenziswa kakhulu ezitshawini; eNingizimu ye-India kanye nezinye izindawo ezinkulu ezifane, ubisi lwe-coconut busetshenziswa kakhulu.

translations.source: With 17,000 islands to choose from, Indonesian food is an umbrella term covering a vast variety of regional cuisines found across the nation.
translations.reference: Ngeziqhingi ezingu-17,000 ongakhetha kuzo, ukudla kwase-Indonesia igama elihlanganisa izinhlobo eziningi zokudlwa kwendawo okutholakala ezweni lonke.
translations.hypothesis: Ngokuba kunama-17,000 amanzi ayindalo, ukudla kwase-Indonesia kuyindlela ebanzi echaza izinhlobonhlobo eziningi zokudla ezifana nezendawo ezitholakala kulo lonke izwe.

translations.source: But, if used without further qualifiers, the term tends to mean the food originally from the central and eastern parts of the main island Java.
translations.reference: Kodwa, uma lisetshenziswa ngaphandle kwenye incazelo, igama livame ukusho ukudla ekuqaleni okusuka ezingxenyeni ezimaphakathi kanye nezisempumalanga yesiqhingi esiyinhloko iJava.
translations.hypothesis: Kodwa, uma lesi gama lisetshenziswa ngaphandle kokuchazwa ngeminye imigomo, livame ukusho ukudla okubhekwe njengekusuka ezindaweni zasemthonjeni nasemhlanganweni wase-Java, eyisiphulo esikhulu.

translations.source: Now widely available throughout the archipelago, Javanese cuisine features an array of simply seasoned dishes, the predominant flavorings the Javanese favor being peanuts, chillies, sugar (especially Javanese coconut sugar) and various aromatic spices.
translations.reference: Manje okutholakala kabanzi eqoqweni leziqhingi lonke, ukudla kwaseJava kuhlanganisa izinhlobonhlobo zokudla okunongwe kalula, lapho isinongo esivelele kubantu baseJava kungamantongomane, upelepele, ushukela (ikakhulukazi ushukela waseJava kakhukhunathi) kanye nezinye izinongo ezinamakha.
translations.hypothesis: Manje, ukudla kwaseJava kufinyeleleka kakhulu kulo lonke leli ziko lezi. Ukudla kwalo kuhlanganisa izitsha eziningi ezilula, lapho okuyisihloko kakhulu kwezinto ezisetshenziswa ukunambitha kuzona yi-arachidi, ama-chili, ushukela (ikakhulukazi ushukela wamakhukhamba waseJava) kanye nezinhlobonhlobo zezitofu ezinezimpawu ezihle.

translations.source: Stirrups are supports for the rider's feet that hang down on either side of the saddle.
translations.reference: Izitibili izinto zokusekela izinyawo zomgibeli ezilenga ezingxenyeni zonke zesihlalo sehhashi.
translations.hypothesis: Izintambo zinguqulo ezisetshenziselwa ukubamba amaphuzu omgibeli, futhi zithungelwe ngakwesokudla nasokunobumba kagesi.

translations.source: They provide greater stability for the rider but can have safety concerns due to the potential for a rider's feet to get stuck in them.
translations.reference: Zinikeza ukuzinza emgibelini kodwa zingaba nezinkinga zokuphepha ngenxa yamathuba okuba izinyawo zomgibeli zibhajwe kuzo.
translations.hypothesis: Zinikeza ukuzinzile okukhulu kumshayeli, kodwa zingaba nezinkinga zokuphepha ngenxa yokuthi imilenze yomshayeli ingase zithule ngaphakathi kwazo.

translations.source: If a rider is thrown from a horse but has a foot caught in the stirrup, they could be dragged if the horse runs away. To minimize this risk, a number of safety precautions can be taken.
translations.reference: Uma umgibeli ewiswa yihashi kodwa unyawo lwakhe lubambeke esitibilini, angahuduleka uma ihhashi libaleka. Ukunciphisa lengozi, izinyathelo ezimbalwa zokuphepha zingathathwa.
translations.hypothesis: Uma umuntu ogibela impisi egayweni ewa phansi, kodwa inyawo yakhe igxumela kwi-stirrup, angase udonswe uma impisi yagaya. Ukunciphisa lo nguyawayo, kunezinto eziningi zokuphepha ezifanele zenziwe.

translations.source: First, most riders wear riding boots with a heel and a smooth, quite narrow, sole.
translations.reference: Okokuqala, abagibeli abaningi bagqoka amabhuzi okugibela anesithende kanye nesoli ebushelelezi, elincane kakhulu.
translations.hypothesis: Okokuqala, abaningi abagibeli badonsa izicathulo zokugibela ezinezinyawo ezinde kanye nesakhiwo esibushelelezi, esincane kakhulu.

translations.source: Next, some saddles, particularly English saddles, have safety bars that allow a stirrup leather to fall off the saddle if pulled backwards by a falling rider.
translations.reference: Okulandelayo, ezinye izihlalo zehhashi, ngokukhethekile izihlalo zamaNgisi, zinezinsimbi zokuphepha ezivumela isikhumba sesitibili ukuba siwe esihlalweni lapho isihlalo sidonswelwa emuva umgibeli owayo.
translations.hypothesis: Okulandelayo, ezinye izikhwama, ikakhulukazi izikhwama zamaNgisi, zinezivalo zokuphepha ezivumela isikhwama sesikhumba esisetshenziswa kwi-stirrup ukuthi siwele ngaphandle kwesikhwama uma umuntu ophuma esikhwameni umiswa ngemuva.

translations.source: Cochamó Valley - Chile's premier climbing destination, known as the Yosemite of South America, with a variety of granite big walls and crags.
translations.reference: I-Cochamo Valley – indawo eyinhloko abaqhwali abafuna ukufika kuyo e-Chile, yaziwa nangokuthi i-Yosemite yaseNingizimu Melika, enezinhlobo ezihlukahlukene zezindonga ezinkulu ezakhiwe nge-granite kanye nemisele.
translations.hypothesis: Idolobha lase Cochamó - indawo eyinhloko yokuphusha eChile, eyaziwa njenge-Yosemite yaseNingizimu Melika, enezindonga ezinkulu zefani kanye nezindlu zokuhlala eziningi.

translations.source: Summits include breath-taking views from peaks. Climbers from all parts of the world are continually establishing new routes amongst its endless potential of walls.
translations.reference: Iziqongo zihlanganisa izindawo zokubona izindawo ezinhle kakhulu ezihlokweni. Abagibeli abavela kuzo zonke izingxenye zomhlaba bayaqhubeka ngokuthola imizila emisha phakathi kwezindawo ezingapheli ezingaba izindonga.
translations.hypothesis: Izintaba ezinde zinezibani ezimangalisayo ezivela ezintabeni. Abagibeli bezintaba abavela ezweni lonke bahlala befunda izindlela ezintsha phakathi kwezindlu ezinkulu ezikhona kulezi zintaba.

translations.source: Downhill snowsports, which include skiing and snowboarding, are popular sports involving sliding down snow-covered terrain with skis or a snowboard attached to your feet.
translations.reference: Imidlalo yeqhwa ekwehleni, ehlanganisa ukushushuluza eqhweni ne-snowboarding, imidlalo edumile ehlanganisa ukuslayida phansi endaweni embozwe yiqhwa ngama-skis noma ibhodi leqhwa elinamathiselwe ezinyaweni zakho.
translations.hypothesis: Ezindlala zomsindo ezidlulisa phansi, ezifaka ukushayela ngama-skis kanye nokushayela ngama-snowboard, ziyindlela zemidlalo ethandwa kakhulu ezihlanganisa ukuhamba ngesivinini phansi kwendawo egcwele umsindo, ngenkathi usebenzisa ama-skis noma i-snowboard ekhunjulwe emilenze yakho.

translations.source: Skiing is a major travelling activity with many enthusiasts, occasionally known as "ski bums," planning entire vacations around skiing at a particular location.
translations.reference: Ukushushuluza eqhweni umsebenzi omkhulu wokuhamba onabashisekeli abaningi, kwezinye izikhathi abaziwa ngokuthi ama-"ski bums," abahlela ukuvakasha konke ukuze bashushuluze eqhweni endaweni ethile.
translations.hypothesis: Ukugibela ngama-ski kuyinto yomdlalo eziningi abantu abayithandayo, kanti abanye, abaziwa njenge-"ski bums," bahlela izivakashi zabo zikanokusho ngokuqhamuka ekugibeleneni ngama-ski endaweni ethile.

translations.source: The idea of skiing is very old — cave paintings depicting skiers date back as far as 5000 BC!
translations.reference: Umcabango wokushushuluza eqhweni owakudala kakhulu — imidwebo yasemihumeni eveza abashushuluzi baseqhweni ihlehlela emuva ku-5000 BC!
translations.hypothesis: Umqondo wokugijima ngama-skis udala kakhulu—izithombe ezitholwe ezindaweni zokuhlala ezindaweni ezifihliwe ezibonisa abantu begijima ngama-skis zivela kusikhathi esikhudlwana kakhulu, okuyi-5000 BC!

translations.source: Downhill skiing as a sport goes back to at least the 17th century, and in 1861 the first recreational ski club was opened by Norwegians in Australia.
translations.reference: Ukushushuluza eqhweni wehla entabeni njengomhlalo kuhlehlela emuva okungenani ekhulwini lama-17 leminyaka, futhi ngo-1861 iqembu lokushushuluza eqhweni kokuzilibazisa lavulwa abantu baseNorway e-Australia.
translations.hypothesis: Ukushayela izintambo phansi kwasolwandle njengomdlalo uya kusuka kakhulu kuwo wonke ubu-17, futhi ngonyaka ka-1861, iqembu labashayeli izintambo eliyokuqala elenzelwe ukuzijabulisa sivaliwe ngabantu baseNorway e-Australia.

translations.source: Backpacking by ski: This activity is also called backcountry ski, ski touring or ski hiking.
translations.reference: Ukushushuluza eqhweni ngesikhwama: Lokhu kubuye kubizwe ngokuthi ukushushuluza eqhweni emaphandleni, ukubona indawo ngokushushulaza eqhweni kanye nokushushuluza eqhweni kokuqwala izintaba.
translations.hypothesis: Ukuhamba ngezintambo zokugijima: Le ndlela yokuphusha yaziwa nangokuthi "backcountry skiing," "ski touring," noma "ski hiking."

translations.source: It is related to but usually not involving alpine style ski touring or mountaineering, the latter ones done in steep terrain and requiring much stiffer skis and boots.
translations.reference: Kuhlobene kodwa akuhlanganisi isitayela se-alpine sokuvakasha noma ukuqwala izintaba, okwenziwe abanye kamuva ezindaweni ezingamawa futhi ezidinga izinduku zokuhamba eqhweni eziqinile kakhudlwana kanye namabhuthi.
translations.hypothesis: Kuhlobene nokuhamba ngezimoto zokugijima ezintabeni (alpine skiing) noma ukuhamba ezintabeni (mountaineering), kodwa ngokuvamile akubandakanyi lezi zinto. Ukuhamba ezintabeni, ngakho, kwenziwa ezindaweni ezintelezi kakhulu futhi kudinga izimoto zokugijima nezinyawo ezibanzi kakhulu.

translations.source: Think of the skiing route as of a similar hiking route.
translations.reference: Cabanga ngendlela yokushushuluza eqhweni njengendlela efanayo yokuqwala izintaba.
translations.hypothesis: Cabanga ngendlela yokugijima ngama-skis njengendlela yokuhamba ngezinyawo efanayo.

translations.source: In good conditions you will be able to cover somewhat greater distances than walking – but only very seldom you will get the speeds of cross country skiing without a heavy backpack in groomed tracks.
translations.reference: Ezimweni ezinhle uzokwazi ukuhamba cishe ibanga elide kunokuhamba ngezinyawo – kodwa ngokwethukela okukhulu kuphela ungathola isivinini sokushushuluza eqhweni ezindaweni ezingajwayelekile ngaphandle kwesikhwama esisindayo emizileni elungisiwe.
translations.hypothesis: Ngaphansi kwezimo ezihle, ngingakwazi ukuhamba ibanga elikhulu kakhulu kunalokho engingakwenza ngendlela, kodwa kakhulu nje ngingafinyelela amaphuzu aphakeme afana nalokho okufakelwa ngama-ski, ngaphandle kokuba ngiphakhe isikhwama esikhulu, futhi ngibambe umzila ohlanzekile.

translations.source: Europe is a continent that is relatively small but with many independent countries. Under normal circumstances, travelling through multiple countries would mean having to go through visa applications and passport control multiple times.
translations.reference: IYurophu izwekali elincane ngokwesilinganiso kodwa elinamazwe amaningi azimele. Ngaphansi kwezimo ezivamile, ukuthatha uhambo emazweni amaningana kungasho ukubhalisela i-visa kanye nokudlula lapho kuhlolwa khona amaphasiphoti kaningana.
translations.hypothesis: I-Yurophu iyigama leli zwe elincane kakhulu, kodwa elinezizwe eziningi ezizimele. Ngaphansi kwezimo ezivamile, ukuhamba ezweni eliningana kungathinta ukuthi kufanele ufake izicelo zezivayiso futhi uhlolwe ngamaphasa pothile ezikhathi eziningi.

translations.source: The Schengen zone, however, works somewhat like one country in this respect.
translations.reference: Indawo yaseSchengen, nokho, isebenza ngandlelathile njengezwe elilodwa kulokhu.
translations.hypothesis: Ikhabhulo yase-Schengen, nokho, iyasebenza ngendlela efanayo nokwezinye izizwe kulokhu.

translations.source: As long as you stay in this zone, you can generally cross borders without going through passport control checkpoints again.
translations.reference: Uma nje uhlala kulendawo, ngokuvamile ungeqa imingcele ngaphandle kokuba kuhlolwe iphasiphothi yakho futhi.
translations.hypothesis: Uma uhlala kule ndawo, ngokuvamile ungakwazi ukudlula imingcele ngaphandle kokudlulela ezikhungweni zokuhlola amaphasa futhi.

translations.source: Similarly, by having a Schengen visa, you do not need to apply for visas to each of the Schengen member countries separately, hence saving time, money and paperwork.
translations.reference: Ngokufanayo, ngokuba ne-visa ye-Schengen, awudingi ukubhalisela i-visa yezwe ngalinye ngokuhlukile kulawo angamalungu e-Shengen, okonga isikhathi, imali kanye nomsebenzi wokugcwalisa amafomu.
translations.hypothesis: Ngokufanayo, uma unevisithi ye-Schengen, awudingi ukufaka izicelo zevisithi ezihlukene ezweni ngalinye elilungu le-Schengen, ngaleyo ndlela ugcine isikhathi, imali kanye namaphepha.

translations.source: There is no universal definition for which manufactured items are antiques. Some tax agencies define goods older than 100 years as antiques.
translations.reference: Ayikho neze incazelo ekhona yokuthi lemikhiqizo eyenziwe kwabe kungeyakudala. Izinhlangano zentela zichaza izinto esezidlulelwe yiminyaka engu-100 njengama gugu.
translations.hypothesis: Akukho umthetho oqinile onochazayo ukuthi yiziphi izinto ezakhiwe ezibizwa ngokuthi "izinto zendulo." Ezinye izinhlangano zama-tax zichaza ukuthi izinto ezindala kakhulu kuka-100 anyanga njengezinto zendulo.

translations.source: The definition has geographic variations, where the age limit might be shorter in places such as North America than in Europe.
translations.reference: Incazelo inokwehluka kwendawo, lapho isilinganiso sobudala singaba sifishane ezindaweni ezinjengaseNyakatho Melika kunaseYurophu.
translations.hypothesis: Ukuchazwa kwalo mthetho kuhluka ngokuya ngezindawo, lapho umkhakha weminyaka ongaphansi komthetho kungaba mufushane ezindaweni ezifana neNyakatho Melika kunesiYurophu.

translations.source: Handicraft products might be defined as antiques, though they are younger than similar mass-produced goods.
translations.reference: Imikhiqizo yezandla ingahle ichazwe njengezinto zakudala, nakuba imincane kunempahla efanaya ekhiqizwa ngobuningi.
translations.hypothesis: Imikhiqizo yezinto ezidaliwe ngesandla ingase ibalwe njengezinto ezindala, nakuba zisha kakhulu kunezinye izinto ezifanayo ezakhiwe ngobubanzi.

translations.source: Reindeer husbandry is an important livelihood among the Sámi and the culture surrounding the trade is important also for many with other professions.
translations.reference: Ukufuya ama-reindeer indlela ebalulekile yokuziphilisa phakathi kwamaSámi futhi isiko elizungeze lomsebenzi libalulekile futhi nakwabanye abaneminye imisebenzi.
translations.hypothesis: Ukulondoloza nezilwane ezibizwa nge-reindeer kubalulekile kakhulu kubantu base-Sámi, futhi ubudlelwano bamandla nobuhle bomhlaba obuhambisana nalolu hlobo lwebhizinisi bunentshisekelo nakwabanye abantu abasebenzela ezimweni ezahlukene.

translations.source: Even traditionally, though, not all Sámi have been involved in big scale reindeer husbandry, but lived from fishing, hunting and similar, having reindeer mostly as draft animals.
translations.reference: Ngisho nangokwesiko, nokho, akuwona wonke amaSámi ayehlanganyele ngokugcwele ekufuyeni izinyamazane, kodwa ayephila ngokudoba, ukuzingela nokufanayo, besebenzisa izinyamazane njengezilwane eziboshelwayo.
translations.hypothesis: Nakuba ngendlela yendulo, akubonani bonke abantu baseSámi ababezibandakanya ekulimeni ezinkomo ezinkulu, kodwa babephila ngokudoba, ukuhlenga, kanye nezinye izinto ezifana nalezo, bezisebenzisa izinkomo kakhulu njengezilo zokudonsa.

translations.source: Today many Sámi work in modern trades. Tourism is an important income in Sápmi, the Sámi area.
translations.reference: Namuhla abaningi abantu bama-Sámi abasebenza kwezohwebo zesimanje. Ezokuvakasha ngumholo obalulekile e-Sápmi, endaweni yama-Sámi.
translations.hypothesis: Namuhla, abaningi baseSámi basebenza emisebenzini yanamuhla. Ukuhamba nezivakashi kubalulekile ekunikezeni imali eSápmi, endaweni yamaSámi.

translations.source: Though it is widely used, especially among non-Romani, the word "Gypsy" is often considered offensive because of its associations with negative stereotypes and inaccurate perceptions of Romani people.
translations.reference: Nakuba lisetshenziswa kabanzi, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abangewona amaRomany, igama elithi "Gypsy" kaningi lithathwa njengelokwedelela ngenxa yokuhlanganiswa kwalo nezinto ezimbi eziyiphutha ezishiwo abanye kanye nemibono enganembile ngabantu bamaRomany.
translations.hypothesis: Nakuba leli gama elithi "Gypsy" lisetshenziswa kakhulu, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abangabantu baseRomani, lalinganiselwa njengegama eliyingozi ngenxa yobudlelwano bayo namahlakazano amabi kanye nokubonakala okungalungile ngabantu baseRomani.

translations.source: If the country you will be visiting becomes subject to a travel advisory, your travel health insurance or your trip cancellation insurance may be affected.
translations.reference: Uma izwe ozolivakashela lithola izixwayiso zokuphepha ezingokomthetho, umshwalense wakho wohambo wempilo noma umshwalense wakho wokukhansela uhambo ungathinteka.
translations.hypothesis: Uma izwe ongihambela kulo liyathulelwa ukwaziswa mayelana nokuhamba, ukubophezelwa kwakho kwezempilo ngesikhathi sohambo noma umshuwalense wakho wokukhansela uhambo kungase uthathwe njengenhloso.

translations.source: You may also wish to consult the advice of governments other than your own, but their advice is designed for their citizens.
translations.reference: Ungafisa nokuhlola izeluleko zohulumeni ngaphandle kowakho, kodwa izeluleko ziklanyelwe izakhamuzi zawo.
translations.hypothesis: Ungase futhi uthande ukufunda izeluleko ezivela ezikhumulweni zezizwe eziningi, kodwa lezo zeluleko zenzelwe abantu basezizweni zazo.

translations.source: As one example, American citizens in the Middle East might face different situations from Europeans or Arabs.
translations.reference: Ngengesibonelo esisodwa, izakhamuzi zaseMelika eMpumalanga Ephakathi zingabhekana nezimo ezihlukile kunalezo zaseYurophu noma e-Arabiya.
translations.hypothesis: Ngokwesibonelo, izakhamuzi zaseMelika eziseMpumalanga Ephakathi zingase zibhekane nezimo ezihlukile kunezakhamuzi zaseYurophu noma zase-Arabhiya.

translations.source: Advisories are merely a brief summary of the political situation in one country.
translations.reference: Izeluleko zimane ziyisifinyezo esifishane sesimo sezepolotiki ezweni elilodwa.
translations.hypothesis: Izaziso zikhonza nje njengencazelo emfushane mayelana nezimo zombusazwe ezweni elithile.

translations.source: The views presented are often cursory, general and oversimplified compared to the more detailed information available elsewhere.
translations.reference: Imibono eveziwe ngokuvamile eyokudlulisa amahlo, evamile kanye nelula kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nokwaziswa okuningiliziwe okutholakala kwezinye izindawo.
translations.hypothesis: Imibono ebekwa lapha ivamise ukuba yimibono esheshayo, ejwayelekile futhi ehlanganisiwe kangcono kunezinye izindaba ezithule ezitholakala kwenye indawo.

translations.source: Severe weather is the generic term for any dangerous weather phenomenon with the potential to cause damage, serious social disruption, or loss of human life.
translations.reference: Isimo sezulu esibi kumane kuyigama elilula elisho isimo sezulu esiyingozi esinamandla okudala umonakalo, ukuphazamiseka kwangempela kwenhlalakahle, noma ukufa kwabantu.
translations.hypothesis: Izimo zezulu eyingozi yigama elichazwayo noma yiluphi uhlobo lwemphiwo yezulu engomekile enokubangela umonakalo, ukuphazamiseka okukhulu kwephuliso, noma ukulahlekelwa kwempilo yabantu.

translations.source: Severe weather can occur anywhere in the world, and there are different types of it, which can depend on geography, topography, and atmospheric conditions.
translations.reference: Isimo sezulu esibi kakhulu singenzeka noma kuphi emhlabeni, futhi kunezinhlobo ezihlukile zaso, ezingaxhomeka ekumeni kwezwe, esimweni sendawo, kanye nezimo emkhathini.
translations.hypothesis: Imikhuba yezulu emibi ingaqala kuphi emhlabeni, futhi kunezinhlobo ezahlukene zayo, okungase kuxhomekane endaweni, ukuma komhlaba, kanye nezimo zangasese.

translations.source: High winds, hail, excessive precipitation, and wildfires are forms and effects of severe weather, as are thunderstorms, tornadoes, waterspouts, and cyclones.
translations.reference: Imimoya ephakeme, isangqotho, isimo sezulu esidlulele, kanye nemililo yasendle ziwuhlobo nomphumela wesimo sezulu esibi kakhulu, kanjalo neziphepho, izivunguvungu, izishomo zamanzi amuncwa yisivunguvungu, kanye nezihlwithi.
translations.hypothesis: Imifane emikhulu, amanzi ahlaziyiwe, imvula eminingi, kanye nomlilo ongcolile yizindlela nemiphumela yezimo ezimbi zezulu, njengoba kunjalo namabhungane, ama-tornado, ama-waterspout, kanye nama-cyclone.

translations.source: Regional and seasonal severe weather phenomena include blizzards, snowstorms, ice storms, and dust storms.
translations.reference: Izimo zezulu ezimbi zasendaweni nezenkathi ethile zihlanganisa iziphepho ezinkulu zeqhwa, izivunguvungu zeqhwa, isichotho, kanye nezivunguvungu ezinothuli.
translations.hypothesis: Izimo ezimelaphi zezulu ezinkulu ezibangelwa yindawo kanye nesikhathi zihlanganisa izindluphu zezintaba, izivunguvungu zensimbi, izivunguvungu zolwazi, kanye nezivunguvungu zothuli.

translations.source: Travellers are strongly advised to be aware of any risk of severe weather affecting their area as they may affect any travel plans.
translations.reference: Izihambi ziyalulekwa ngokuqinile ukuthi ziqaphele noma iyiphi ingozi yesimo sezulu esibi kakhulu esithinta indawo yazo njengoba singathinta noma yiziphi izinhlelo zohambo.
translations.hypothesis: Abahambi kufanele baqaphele kakhulu nganoma yimiphi imingcwabo yezimo ezimelulekile engase yethule endaweni abahamba kuyo, ngoba lezi zimo zingase zithinte izinhlelo zabo zohambo.

translations.source: Anyone planning a visit to a country that could be considered a war zone should get professional training.
translations.reference: Noma ubani ohlela ukuvakashela izwe elizobhekwa njengesizinda sempi kumelwe athole ukuqeqeshwa okukhethekile.
translations.hypothesis: Noma ngubani ohlanganisa ukuhamba ezweni engase ibhekwe njengegadi lokulwa kufanele athole ukuqeqeshwa okuphakeme.

translations.source: A search of the Internet for 'Hostile environment course' will probably provide the address of a local company.
translations.reference: Usesho kuyi-inthanethi 'kwezifundo zemvelo enobuth'" cishe luzonikeza ikheli lenkampani yasendaweni.
translations.hypothesis: Ukusesha nge-Intanethi ngamagama "ufundo wokulwa nezimo eziyinqaba" kungenzeka ukuthi kuzokunikeza ikheli lenkampani yangakini.

translations.source: A course will normally cover all the issues discussed here in far greater detail, usually with practical experience.
translations.reference: Isifundo ngokuvamile sizohlanganisa zonke izindaba okuxoxwe ngazo lapha ngokujulile, ngokuvamile ngendlela yokukusebenzisa engokoqobo.
translations.hypothesis: Ukufundiswa kuzocubungula yonke imikhakha echazwe lapha ngemininingwane eminingi, futhi ngokuvezwa kokuzwa, ngokuvamile.

translations.source: A course will normally be from 2-5 days and will involve role play, a lot of first aid and sometimes weapons training.
translations.reference: Inkambo izohamba ngokujwayelekile kusukela ezinsukwini ezingu-2-5 futhi izobandakanya imidlalo yokulingisa, insiza yezimo eziphuthumayo eningi futhi kwesinye isikhathi ukuqeqeshwa ekusebenziseni izikhali ..
translations.hypothesis: Ukufundiswa kuzovamise ukuba kusuka izinsuku ezimbili kuya kwezinhlanu, futhi kuzofaka ukudlala izindima, ukufundiswa okuningi kwezokunakekelwa kwempilo, kanye ngamanye amathuba, ukufundiswa ngezikhali.

translations.source: Books and magazines dealing with wilderness survival are common, but publications dealing with war zones are few.
translations.reference: Izincwadi nomagazini abakhuluma ngokuphila endle zivamile, kodwa izincwadi ezikhuluma ngezindawo zezimpi zimbalwa.
translations.hypothesis: Izincwadi nezincwadi zombhalo ezikhuluma ngendlela yokuhlala ebandleni yinto evamile, kodwa izincwadi ezikhuluma ngamachibi nomthelela wempi aziningi.

translations.source: Voyagers planning sex reassignment surgery abroad must ensure they're carrying valid documents for the return trip.
translations.reference: Izihambi ezihamba ngemikhumbi ezihlele ukushintsha ubulili bazo ngokuhlinzwa phesheya kwezilwandle kumelwe ziqinisekise ukuthi ziphethe amaphepha afanele ohambo lokubuya.
translations.hypothesis: Abantu abahlela ukuyophathwa ngomuthi ukuze ashintshele ngeminye indlela yobulili ngaphandle kwezwe kufanele baqiniseke ukuthi bayoba nezimpaphostsha ezifanele zohambo lokubuyela ekhaya.

translations.source: The willingness of governments to issue passports with gender not stated (X) or documents updated to match a desired name and gender varies.
translations.reference: Ukuvuma kohulumeni ukuthi anikeze abantu amaphasiphothi angavezi ubulili (X) noma amaphepha abuyekeziwe ukuthi afane negama elithandwayo kanye nokuhluka kobulili.
translations.hypothesis: Ukuthanda kwamahulumeni okuhlinzeka ngamaphasa lapho ubudakwazi abushiwo (X) noma amadokhumenti aguqulwe ukuze afane negama kanye nobudakwazi ofiswe, kuhluka kakhulu.

translations.source: Willingness of foreign governments to honour these documents is just as widely variable.
translations.reference: Ukuzimisela kohulumeni bangaphandle ukuhlonipha lamaphepha kungokuguquguqukayo.
translations.hypothesis: Ukuthanda kwamahulumeni angaphandle okuhlonipha lezi zicelo kuyahluka kakhulu.

translations.source: Searches at security checkpoints have also become far more intrusive in the post-September 11, 2001 era.
translations.reference: Ukusesha ezindaweni zokuhlola sekube okuxhantelayo kakhulu enkathini yangemva kuka-2001, NgoMandulo 11.
translations.hypothesis: Ukuhlolwa kwabantu ezikhungweni zokuphepha kuye kwaba ngcono kakhulu futhi kukhuthazayo kakhulu ngemuva kuka-September 11, 2001.

translations.source: Pre-operative transgender people should not expect to pass through the scanners with their privacy and dignity intact.
translations.reference: Abantu abazohlinzwa ukuze bashintshe ubulili babo akufanele balindele ukuthi bazodlula kumasikena ngobumfihlo babo nangesithunzi sabo sisaqinile.
translations.hypothesis: Abantu abathando abazophela ukushisayo (transgender) akufanele kulindele ukuthi bazophuma ngaphansi kwezikhawu zokuhlola ngaphandle kokuba kubulale ubuntu babo kanye nokuhlonipheka kwabo.

translations.source: Rip currents are the returning flow from waves breaking off the beach, often at a reef or similar.
translations.reference: Imisinga yokuqhuma kungukugeleza okubuyayo okuvela emagagasini aqhamuka olwandle, ngokuvamile emadwaleni noma kokuthi akufane.
translations.hypothesis: Izicnthuli zama-rip ziyinkinga yokugudula kwamanzi abandayo avela emaweni lapho izimpelasonto ziphuka khona, njengasemaphandleni noma ezindaweni ezifanayo.

translations.source: Due to the underwater topology the return flow is concentrated at a few deeper sections, and a fast current to deep water may form there.
translations.reference: Ngenxa yethopholoji yangaphansi kwamanzi ukugeleza okubuyayo kugxile ezingxenyeni ezimbalwa ezijulile, futhi umsinga osheshayo emanzini ajulile ungakheka lapho.
translations.hypothesis: Ngenxa yobukaka bendawo yangaphansi kwamanzi, ukuhamba komhlambi wamanzi kubandakanywa ezindaweni ezimbalwa ezinkulu, futhi ukugeleza okusheshayo kuye ezindaweni ezinkulu kungakha khona.

translations.source: Most deaths happen as result of fatigue trying to swim back against the current, which may be impossible.
translations.reference: Ukufa okuningi kwenzeka ngenxa yokukhathala kokuzama ukubhukuda uya emuva ngokuphambene nomsinga, okungaba yinto engenakwenzeka.
translations.hypothesis: Kuningi kwezifo ezifezwa ngempela kungenxa yokukhathazeka okukhulu ngesikhathi umuntu ezama ukubhukuda ngemuva komkhulu wamanzi, okungenzeka ukuthi kungaba nzima kakhulu.

translations.source: As soon as you get out of the current, swimming back is no more difficult than normally.
translations.reference: Ngokushesha ngemva kokuba uphuma emsingeni wamanzi, ukubhukudela emuva akusabi nzima ngokuvamile.
translations.hypothesis: Ngokushesha nje lapho uphuma khona emanzini agijima, ukubhukuda ngemuva akuyona into eyinkimbinkimbi kakhulu njengokujwayelekile.

translations.source: Try aiming somewhere where you are not caught again or, depending on your skills and on whether you have been noticed, you might want to wait for rescue.
translations.reference: Zama ukuqonda lapho ungabambekile khona futhi noma, kuye ngamakhono akho nokuthi uphawuliwe yini, ungathanda ukulinda ukutakulwa.
translations.hypothesis: Zama ukufika endaweni ongagibiswanga kuyo futhi, ngokuya ngamakhono akho kanye nokuthi ububonakala yini, kungase kube ukuthi udinga ukulinda usizo.

translations.source: Re-entry shock comes on sooner than culture shock (there's less of a honeymoon phase), lasts longer, and can be more severe.
translations.reference: Ukuthuka ngoba usekhaya kuza kuqala kunalokho kuthuka okwenzeka uma uvakashele endaweni ongayazi (kunesigaba esincane se-honeymoon), kuthathe isikhathi, futhi kungaya ngokuya kwande.
translations.hypothesis: Ukungqubuzana ngemuva kokubuyela ekhaya kungaqala ngokushesha kunokungqubuzana ngamasiko (kukhona isikhathi esifushane sokujabulela), kugcina isikhathi eside, futhi kungaba nzulu kakhulu.

translations.source: Travellers who had an easy time adjusting to the new culture sometimes have a particularly hard time readjusting to their native culture.
translations.reference: Izihambi ezikuthole kulula ukujwayela isiko elisha kwesinye isikhathi zikuthola kunzima ukujwayela isiko lazo lendabuko futhi.
translations.hypothesis: Abahambi abathole ukuhlaziywa okulula ekulandeleni amasiko amasha, ngezinye izikhathi bathola ukuthi kunzima kakhulu ukubuyela emasikweni abo endaweni yabo yasekhaya.

translations.source: When returning home after living abroad, you've adapted to the new culture and lost some of your habits from your home culture.
translations.reference: Lapho ubuyela ekhaya usuka phesheya, kuzodingeka ujwayele isiko elisha neminye yemikhuba yakho oyilahlile kusukela ezweni lakini.
translations.hypothesis: Uma uswele ekhaya ngemuva kokuhlala ngaphandle kwezwe, usufundile ngomculo waso leso zwe futhi ulishonile ezinye zamakhava akho avela esiko lakho lasekhaya.

translations.source: When you went abroad at first, people were probably patient and understanding, knowing that travellers in a new country need to adapt.
translations.reference: Lapho uya phesheya okokuqala, abantu kungenzeka ukuthi babebekezela futhi beqonda, bazi ukuthi izivakashi uma zifika ezweni elisha zidinga ukujwayela.
translations.hypothesis: Ngesikhathi uya kwamanye amazwe okokuqala, abantu babanga beqinile futhi bajabule, ngoba bayazi ukuthi abahambi ezweni elisha badinga ukuzivumelanisa.

translations.source: People may not anticipate that patience and understanding are also necessary for travellers returning home.
translations.reference: Abantu kungezeka bangalindeli ukuthi ukulinda kanye nokuqonda nakho kubalulekile ezivakashini ezibuyela ekhaya.
translations.hypothesis: Abantu bangase bangalindele ukuthi ukubekezela nokuzwelisisa kubaluleke futhi kubo labo ababuyela ekhaya ngemva kokuhamba.

translations.source: The pyramid sound and light show is one of the most interesting things in the area for kids.
translations.reference: Umbukiso onxa-ntathu womsindo nokukhanya ungenye yezinto ezithakazelisayo endaweni yezingane.
translations.hypothesis: Umbukiso womsindo kanye nokukhanya ohlwini lwe-pyramid ungokuthokoza okukhulu kule ndawo, ikakhulukazi kubantfwana.

translations.source: You can see the pyramids in the dark and you can see them in silence before the show begins.
translations.reference: Ungabona imibhoshongo enxa-ntathu ebumnyameni futhi ungawabona lapho kuthulile ngaphambi kokuqala kombukiso.
translations.hypothesis: Ungabona amaphiramidi emnyakazolo, futhi ungababonakala kakhulu uma kuthule ngaphambi kokuba umbukiso uqale.

translations.source: Usually you always here the sound of tourists and vendors. The story of the sound and light is just like a story book.
translations.reference: Ngokuvamile njalo lapha umsindo izivakashi kanye nabathengisi. Indaba yomsindo nokukhanya ifana nencwadi yezindaba.
translations.hypothesis: Ngokuvamile, uzwa njalo umsindo wabagibeli kanye nabathengisi. Indaba yalesi sitatimende kanye nokukhanya ifana nombhalo wesifundo.

translations.source: The Sphinx is set as the backdrop and the narrator of a long story.
translations.reference: ISphinx isethwe njengesigcawu nomlandisi wendaba ende.
translations.hypothesis: I-Sphinx isetshenziswa njengesizinda kanye nomdlali omkhulu othembisa indaba ende.

translations.source: The scenes are displayed on the pyramids and the different pyramids are lit up.
translations.reference: Izigcawu zikhonjiswa kumaphiramidi kanti amaphiramidi ahlukahlukene akhanyisiwe.
translations.hypothesis: Izithombe ziboniswa ezindaweni ezibizwa ngezindlu zikanokusho, futhi ezindlu zikanokusho ezahlukene zikhanyisiwe.

translations.source: South Shetland Islands, discovered in 1819, are claimed by several nations and have the most bases, with sixteen active in 2020.
translations.reference: Iziqhingi zaseSouth Shetland, ezitholwe ngo-1819, zinezizwe eziningi ezithi ziwela kuzo futhi zinezikhungo eziningi, eziyishumi nesishiyagalolunye ezisebenzayo ngo-2020.
translations.hypothesis: Amanzi waseSouth Shetland, athelwe ngo-1819, afunwa yimazwe amaningi futhi anezikhungo eziningi, okuyizikhungo eziyishumi nanhlanu ezisebenza ngonyaka ka-2020.

translations.source: The archipelago lies 120 km north of the Peninsula. The largest is King George Island with the settlement of Villa Las Estrellas.
translations.reference: I-archipelago isendaweni eqhele ngamakhilomitha angu-120 enyakatho yeNhlonhlo. Enkulu kuwo i-King George enendawo e-Villa Las Estrellas.
translations.hypothesis: Leli qembu lamakhosi liyodwa elingama-kilomitha angu-120 enyakatho yePeninsula. Okukhulu kulo wonke ngukuKing George Island, lapho kukhona indawo yezindlu ezihlala kuzo abantu, eyithi Villa Las Estrellas.

translations.source: Others include Livingston Island, and Deception where the flooded caldera of a still-active volcano provides a spectacular natural harbour.
translations.reference: Okunye kuhlanganisa isiqhingi seLivingston, kanye neDeception lapho imbobo enkulu egcwele udaka lwentabamlilo esaphuquka umlilo yenza itheku elimangalisayo elingokwemvelo.
translations.hypothesis: Enye izindawo ezibaluleke zifaka i-Livingston Island kanye ne-Deception, lapho umhlambi omkhulu ogcwele amanzi, osendaweni yendlovukazi yomvulane osasemnandwini, unikeza indawo enhle kakhulu yokungena nezikebhe.

translations.source: Ellsworth Land is the region south of the Peninsula, bounded by the Bellingshausen Sea.
translations.reference: IZwe lase-Ellsworth liyindawo eseningizimu neNhlonhlo, likhawuliswe uLwandle iBellingshausen.
translations.hypothesis: I-Ellsworth Land yindawo enendawo engena ngemuva kwe-Peninsula, futhi ingagxilwe yelwandle i-Bellingshausen.

translations.source: The mountains of the Peninsula here merge into the plateau, then re-emerge to form the 360 km chain of the Ellsworth Mountains, bisected by the Minnesota Glacier.
translations.reference: Izintaba zeNhlonhlo lapha zihlangana ethafeni, bese ziphinde ziqhamuke ukuze zenze uchungechunge lwe-360 km lwezintaba zase-Ellsworth, ezihlukaniswe kabili yi-Minnesota Glacier.
translations.hypothesis: Izintaba zale ndawo zihlanganisana lapha zibe yindawo ethe, bese zibuya futhi zidalula ukuze zakhe umugqa omude wezintaba waseEllsworth, onemikhulu engama-360 km, owahlukaniswe yiphakethe lelihlathi laseMinnesota.

translations.source: The northern part or Sentinel Range has Antarctica's highest mountains, the Vinson Massif, peaking at 4892 m Mount Vinson.
translations.reference: Ingxenye engasenyakatho noma iSentinel Range inezintaba eziphakeme kunazo zonke zase-Antarctica, iVinson Massif, ephakeme yaba ngu-4892 m Mount Vinson.
translations.hypothesis: Ingxenye enyakaziyona noma i-Sentinel Range inamagqubu amakhulu kakhulu e-Antarctica, okuyi-Vinson Massif, enamagqubu amadodeni afika ku-4892 m, okuyi-Mount Vinson.

translations.source: In remote locations, without cell phone coverage, a satellite phone may be your only option.
translations.reference: Ezindaweni ezikude, ngaphandle kwenethiwekhi yefoni esebenzayo, ucingo lwesathelayithi lungaba yiyo kuphela into ongayisebenzisa.
translations.hypothesis: Ezindaweni ezikude, lapho kungekho ukufinyelela kwefoni yeselula, ifoni yesathelayithi ingaba yindlela yakho kuphela yokuxhumana.

translations.source: A satellite phone is not generally a replacement for a mobile phone, as you have to be outdoors with clear line of sight to the satellite to make a phone call.
translations.reference: Ucingo lwesathelayithi ngokuvamile ayithatheli ifoni ephathwayo indawo, njengoba kudingeka ube ngaphandle uqondene nesiphuphutheki ukuze ushaye ucingo.
translations.hypothesis: Ibhhayisethi yocingo ayijwayi ukufakwa endaweni yocingo lweselula, ngoba kufanele ube ngaphandle futhi ube nombono omuhle webhhayisethi ukuze ukwazi ukushaya ucingo.

translations.source: The service is frequently used by shipping, including pleasure craft, as well as expeditions who have remote data and voice needs.
translations.reference: Isevisi isetshenziswa kaningi yimikhumbi, kubandakanya umsebenzi wobungcweti, kanye nohambo olunezidingo zedatha nezwi elikude.
translations.hypothesis: Lolu hlelo lusetshenziswa njalo yizinkampani zokuthutha, okubalwa nezikebhe zokuzijabulisa, kanye nezinkampani ezihamba ezindaweni ezikude ezidinga ukudluliselwa kwedatha kanye nokukhulunywa.

translations.source: Your local telephone service provider should be able to give more information about connecting to this service.
translations.reference: Inkampani yezingcingo yangakini kumelwe ikwazi ukukunikeza imininingwane engeziwe mayelana nokuxhuma kulolu hlelo.
translations.hypothesis: Umhlinzeki wesevisi yefoni yakho endaweni yakho kungenzeka ukuthi anikeze ulwazi olwengeziwe mayelana nokuxhumana nalolu hlobo lwesevisi.

translations.source: An increasingly more popular option for those planning a gap-year is to travel and learn.
translations.reference: Indlela ethandwayo ekhulayo yalabo abahlela ukuthatha unyaka wokuphumula ekufundeni ukuthatha uhambo nokufunda.
translations.hypothesis: Enye yezindlela ezithandwa kakhulu yabo abahlela ukuthatha isikhathi esingakapheli emuva kokufunda, ukuhamba futhi kufundwe.

translations.source: This is especially popular with school leavers, allowing them to take a year out before university, without compromising their education.
translations.reference: Lokhu kuthandwa kakhulu abaqeda isikole, okubavumela ukuthi bathathe unyaka ngaphambi kwenyuvesi, ngaphandle kokuyekethisa imfundo yabo.
translations.hypothesis: Lokhu kuthandwa kakhulu ngabafundi abaphumelela esikoleni, ngoba kubanika ithuba lokuthatha unyaka owodwa ngaphambi kokufunda kwasemikhakheni, ngaphandle kokuthi kube nomthelela omubi emfundweni yabo.

translations.source: In many cases, enrolling on a gap-year course abroad can actually improve your chances of moving into higher education back in your home country.
translations.reference: Ezimweni eziningi, ukubhalisa esifundweni sonyaka wokuphumula ngemva kwesikole kwelinye izwe empeleni kuthuthukisa amathuba akho okuya emfundweni ephakeme emuva ezweni lakini.
translations.hypothesis: Kuningi izimo, ukubhalisa ekuhlelweni kokufundela ngaphandle kwezwe ngesikhathi esingakapheli kungathuthukisa amathuba akho okungena ezifundweni eziphezulu ezweni lakho.

translations.source: Typically there will be a tuition fee to enroll in these educational programs.
translations.reference: Ngokujwayelekile kuzoba nemali yokukhokhela izifundo yokubhalisa kulezi zinhelo zemfundo.
translations.hypothesis: Ngokuvamile, kuzoba nomkhokelo ofakelo ukuze ujoyine lezi zinhlelo zemfundo.

translations.source: Finland is a great boating destination. The "Land of a thousand lakes" has thousands of islands too, in the lakes and in the coastal archipelagos.
translations.reference: IFinland indawo ekahle yokuhamba ngesikebhe. "iLake of a thousand lakes" ineziqhingi eziyizinkulungwane futhi, emachibini kanye nasemaqoqweni eziqhingi ezingasogwini.
translations.hypothesis: IFinland iyindawo enhle kakhulu yokuhamba ngamabhodi. "Izwe lezinkundla ezinkulungwane," njengoba eyaziwa, inenqwaba yezinkundla, kokubili ezinkundleni zamanzi kanye nasezindaweni ezinde imikhulu yamanzi kanye nezindawo ezifudumele.

translations.source: In the archipelagos and lakes you do not necessarily need a yacht.
translations.reference: Edlanzaneni leziqhingi nasemachibini awudingi isikebhe.
translations.hypothesis: Ezindaweni eziningi ezinkulu zama-akhipelago kanye namadamu, akudingeki ngempela ukuthi ube nomkhumbi omkhulu.

translations.source: Although the coastal archipelagos and the biggest lakes are indeed big enough for any yacht, smaller boats or even a kayak offer a different experience.
translations.reference: Yize iziqhingi ezingasogwini kanye namachibi amakhulu kunawo wonke emakhulu ngokwanele ukuthwala noma imuphi umkhumbi kanokusho, izikebhe ezincane noma ngisho ne-kayak inikeza okwenzekayo okuhlukile.
translations.hypothesis: Nakuba iziqhingi ezisendaweni yenhlanzi kanye namadamu amakhulu ngempela anokubamba izikebhe ezinkulu, kodwa amabhodi amancane noma ngisho ne-kayak anikeza okuhlangenwe nakho okuhlukile.

translations.source: Boating is a national pastime in Finland, with a boat to every seven or eight people.
translations.reference: Ukuhamba ngezikebhe indlela yokuzilibazisa yezwe eFinland, ngesikebhe kubantu abayisikhombisa noma abayisishiyagalombili.
translations.hypothesis: Ukugibela ngamabhodi kuyinto ejwayelekile kakhulu e-Finland, lapho kukhona ibhodi ngabantu abayisikhombisa noma abayisishiyagalombili.

translations.source: This is matched by Norway, Sweden and New Zealand, but otherwise quite unique (e.g. in the Netherlands the figure is one to forty).
translations.reference: Lokhu kufana ne-Norway, i-Sweden kanye neNyuzilandi, kodwa ngaphandle kwalokho kuhlukile ngempela (isib. eNetherlands isibalo okukodwa kuya kwezingamashumi amane).
translations.hypothesis: Lokhu kufana nemazingeni emazweni afana neNorway, Sweden, kanye neNew Zealand, kodwa ngaphandle kwalokho, kuyinto eyinguqulo (isibonelo, eHolland, inani liyodwa ku-mashumi ayi-ne).

translations.source: Most of the distinct Baltic Cruises feature an extended stay in St. Petersburg, Russia.
translations.reference: Iningi lweMikhumbi yokuVakasha yase-Baltic ehlukile ihlanganisa ukuhlala isikhathi eside e-St. Petersburg, e-Russia.
translations.hypothesis: Kakhulu ezindlethini zokuhamba ngolwandle ezifushane ezisendaweni yaseBaltic, zihlanganisa isikhathi eside kakhulu esidalwe edolobheni laseSt. Petersburg, eRussia.

translations.source: This means you can visit the historic city for a couple of full days while returning and sleeping on the ship at night.
translations.reference: Lokhu kusho ukuthi ungavakashela idolobha elingokomlando izinsuku ezimbalwa ezigcwele ube ubuyela futhi ulala emkhumbini ebusuku.
translations.hypothesis: Lokhu kusho ukuthi ningahlala edolobheni lasendulo izinsuku ezimbili ezintsha, ngenkathi nibuyela esikebheni kusihlwa futhi nilale lapho.

translations.source: If you only go ashore using shipboard excursions you will not need a separate visa (as of 2009).
translations.reference: Uma uya ogwini kuphela usebenzisa uhambo lomkhumbi olufishane angeke udinge i-visa ehlukile (kusukela ngo-2009).
translations.hypothesis: Uma ngabe uya ebhhayini kuphela ngamakhambi ahlanganiswe ngolwandle, ngeke udinge ivisithi ehlukene (kusukela ngonyaka ka-2009).

translations.source: Some cruises feature Berlin, Germany in the brochures. As you can see from the map above Berlin is no where near the sea and a visit to the city is not included in the price of the cruise.
translations.reference: Eminye imikhumbi yokuvakasha iveza i-Berlin, eseJalimane ezincwajaneni zayo. Njengoba ubona ebalazweni ngenhla i-Berlin ikude kakhulu nolwandle futhi ukuvakashela idolobha akuhlanganisiwe enanini lomkhumbi wokuvakasha.
translations.hypothesis: Ezinye zohambo oluhamba ngolwandle zifaka i-Berlin, eJalimane, ezindatshana zokukhangisa. Njengoba kungabonakala kuleli dolobha elingenhla, i-Berlin ayikaze ibe kufuze olwandle, futhi ukuvakashelwa kule dolobha akufakiwe ngentengo yohambo oluhamba ngolwandle.

translations.source: Travelling by plane can be a scary experience for people of all ages and backgrounds, particularly if they've not flown before or have experienced a traumatic event.
translations.reference: Ukuhamba ngendiza kungaba isenzakalo esithusayo kubantu beminyaka yonke nezizinda zonke, ikakhulukazi uma bengakahambi ngendiza ngaphambili noma uma behlangabezane nesenzakalo esishaqisayo.
translations.hypothesis: Ukuhamba ngendiza kungaba yinto engakhukhumiya abantu basekhulwini lonke kanye nezizinda ezahlukene, ikakhulukazi uma abantu abangawo abahambile ngendiza ngaphambilini noma sebezwa okuthile okukhulu okubuhlungu.

translations.source: It is not something to be ashamed of: it is no different from the personal fears and dislikes of other things that very many people have.
translations.reference: Akuyona into yokuba namahloni ngayo: ayihlukile ekwesabeni komuntu siqu nokungathandwa kwezinye izinto abantu abaningi abanakho
translations.hypothesis: Akuyona into okufanele ukuba uyisiphazama ngayo: ayihlukile kakhulu kulezinto ezombusho kanye nokungathandeki kwezinye izinto okuningi abantu abanayo.

translations.source: For some, understanding something about how aircraft work and what happens during a flight may help to overcome a fear which is based on the unknown or on not being in control.
translations.reference: Kwabanye, ukuzwisisa okuthile kokuthi indiza isebenza kanjani nokuthi kwenzekani phakathi nokundiza kungabasiza ukuthi banqobe ukwesaba okusekelwe ezintweni ezingaziwa noma ukungaphathi izintambo.
