translations.hypothesis: Kuthile, ukufunda okuthile mayelana nokuthi izindiza zisebenza kanjani kanye nokuthi yini okwenzeka ngesikhathi sokundiza kungasiza ukunqoba ukwesaba okubangelwa ukungazi noma ukungabi nakho ukulawula.

translations.source: Courier companies are well paid for delivering things quickly. Frequently, time is very important with business documents, merchandise or spare parts for an urgent repair.
translations.reference: Izinkampani ezithutha impahla zikhokhelwa kahle ngokuthumela impahla ngokushehsa. Ngokuvamile, isikhathi sibalulekile ngamaphepha ebhizinisi, impahla ethengwayo ukuze idayiswe noma enye impahla edingekayo ukuze kwenziwe ukulungisa okusheshayo.
translations.hypothesis: Izinkampani zokuthumela zithola imali enhle ngokuletha izinto ngokushesha. Okuvamile, isikhathi kubaluleke kakhulu uma kukhulunywa ngemibhalo yebhizinisi, impahla, noma izingxenye zokulungisa okubalulekile.

translations.source: On some routes, the larger companies have their own planes, but for other routes and smaller firms there was a problem.
translations.reference: Kwezinye izindlela, izinkampani ezinkudlwana zinezindiza zazo, kodwa kwezinye izindlela nezinkampani ezincane bekunezinkinga.
translations.hypothesis: Kwezinye zindlela, izinkampani ezinkulu zinezindiza zazo, kodwa kwezinye izindlela kanye nezinkampani ezincane, kwakukhona inkinga.

translations.source: If they sent things by air freight, on some routes it may have taken days to get through unloading and customs.
translations.reference: Uma bebathumele zonke izinto ngebhanoyi, kwezinye izindlela bekuzothatha izinsuku ukwehlisa imithwalo nokudlula kwabahlola amaphepha.
translations.hypothesis: Uma bezithumela izinto ngendlela yezindiza, ezindleleni ezithile kungenzeka kuthathe izinsuku eziningi ukuze zifakwe phansi futhi zihloliswe ngama-customs.

translations.source: The only way to get it through faster was to send it as checked luggage. Airline regulations will not allow them to send luggage without a passenger, which is where you come in.
translations.reference: Indlela elula yokuyingenisa ngokushesha ukuthi uyithumele njengomthwalo ohloliwe. Imithetho yezinkampani zezindiza angeke ibavumele ukuthumela umthwalo ngaphandle komgibeli, okuyilapho ungena khona.
translations.hypothesis: Indlela eyodwa nje yokuthumela into ngokushesha kakhudlwana kwakuyokuyithumela njengempahla ethunyelwe. Imithetho yezindiza ayivumeli ukuthunyelwa kwempahla ngaphandle komgxuzi, ngakho-ke yilapho uza khona wena.

translations.source: The obvious way of flying in first or business class is to fork out a thick wad of money for the privilege (or, better yet, get your company to do it for you).
translations.reference: Indlela esobala yokugibela egumbini lendiza elibizayo noma labebhizinisi ukukhipha imali eningi yalelo lungelo (noma, okugcono, wenze inkampani yakho ikwenzele lokho).
translations.hypothesis: Indlela evamile yokuhamba ngendiza kwi-first class noma kwe-business class ukukhokha imali eningi ukuze uthole lolu hlonipho (noma, okungcono, ucele inkampani yakho ukuthi yenze lokho ngakho).

translations.source: However, this does not come cheap: as rough rules of thumb, you can expect to pay up to four times the normal economy fare for business, and eleven times for first class!
translations.reference: Noma kunjalo, lokhu akufiki kalula: njengomthetho obekiwe, ungalindela ukukhokha izikhathi eziphindwe kane kunenani elivamile lomnotho webhizinisi, kanye nezikhathi eziyishumi nanye ezingeni lokuqala!
translations.hypothesis: Nokho, lokhu akufani nokuthenga okungabizi: njengemithetho elula, ungase ulindele ukukhokha kufikile ezinkathini ezine ngaphezu kombuzo ojwayelekile wezindiza, futhi ezinkathini eziyishumi nanye uma uthatha indiza yohambo lokuqala!

translations.source: Generally speaking, there is no point in even looking for discounts for business or first-class seats on direct flights from A to B.
translations.reference: Ngokuvamile, akusizi ngisho nokufuna izaphulelo ezihlalweni zabebhizinisi noma ezinethezekile ohabweni lwendiza oluqondile olusuka ku-A luye ku-B.
translations.hypothesis: Ngokuvamile, akukho lutho olufanele ukuthi ufune ukuthi kube khona izaphulelo ezamabhizinisi noma ezamathikithi eklasi eliphezulu ezindizeni ezithatha indlela eqondile kusukela endaweni A kuya endaweni B.

translations.source: Airlines know well that there is a certain core group of flyers who are willing to pay top dollar for the privilege of getting somewhere fast and in comfort, and charge accordingly.
translations.reference: Izinkampani zezindiza zazi kahle ukuthi kuneqembu elithile eliyisisekelo labagibeli bezindiza abazimisele ukukhokha ama-dollar aphezulu ukuze bathole ilungelo lofika endaweni ethile ngokushesha futhi ngokunethezeka, futhi babakhokhisa ngokufanele.
translations.hypothesis: Izinkampani zokuhamba ngendiza ziyazi kahle ukuthi kukhona ikhefu labantu abathile abazimisele ukukhokha imali engenakuqhathaniswa ukuze bathole ukuhamba okusheshayo futhi okunethezeka, futhi ngaleyo ndlela zikhokhisa ngentengo efanele.

translations.source: The capital of Moldova is Chişinău. The local language is Romanian, but Russian is widely used.
translations.reference: Inhlokodolobha yaseMoldova yiChișinău. Ulimi lwendawo isiRomaniya, kodwa isiRashiya sisetshenziswa kabanzi.
translations.hypothesis: Idolobha elikhulu leMoldova yi-Chișinău. Ulimi lendawo yi-Romanian, kodwa isiRussia sasetshenziswa kakhulu.

translations.source: Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has suffered from ethnic conflict.
translations.reference: I-Moldova iriphabhuliki yezinhlanga eziningi ehlushwe imibango yobuhlanga.
translations.hypothesis: I-Moldova iyisiqembu sezizwe eziningi futhi ibhekane nezinkinga ezihlobene nezizwe ezihlukene.

translations.source: In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-proclaimed Transnistria Republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognised by any UN member country.
translations.reference: Ngo-1994, lombango waholela ekumenyezelweni kweRiphabhuliki yokuzimisa yaseTransnistria empumalanga Moldova, enohulumeni wayo nohlobo lwemali kodwa engaqashelwa yinoma yiliphi izwe eliyilungu le-UN.
translations.hypothesis: Ngo-1994, leli nkinga yaphumela ekusungulweni kweRiphabhlikhi yase-Transnistria, eyazibiza ngokwayo, eMpumalanga ye-Moldova. Le riphabhlikhi inenkulumo-ndaba yayo kanye nemali yayo, kodwa ayiqinisekiswa yiwo wonke amazwe angamalungu eNhlangano Yamazwe Angaphakathi (UN).

translations.source: Economic links have been re-established between these two parts of Moldova despite the failure in political negotiations.
translations.reference: Izixhumanisi zezomnotho zenziwe kabusha phakathi kwalezi zingxenye ezimbili zaseMoldova yize behlulekile ezinxoxweni zepolitiki.
translations.hypothesis: Ubuhlobo bezomnotho buyaphindwe phakathi kwalezi zindawo ezimbili zase Moldova, naphezu kokwehluleka kwezinkundla zombusomthetho.

translations.source: The major religion in Moldova is Orthodox Christian.
translations.reference: Inkolo enkulu eMoldova ngamaKristu angama-Orthodox.
translations.hypothesis: Izenzo ezinkulu zokukhuleka eMoldova yi-Orthodox Christian.

translations.source: İzmir is the third largest city in Turkey with a population of around 3.7 million, the second biggest port after Istanbul, and a very good transport hub.
translations.reference: I-İzmir iyidolobha lesithathu ngobukhulu e-Turkey elinabantu abangaba izigidi ezingu-3.7, isikhungo esikhulu sesibili ngemva kwe-Istanbul, okuyindawo enezokuthutha ezikahle.
translations.hypothesis: I-Izmir yidolobha lesithathu elikhulu kakhulu eTurkey, elinomphakathi onemiliona engu-3.7, kanye nesikhungo somoya esikhulu sesibili ngemuva kwe-Istanbul, futhi siyindawo enhle kakhulu yokuhamba.

translations.source: Once the ancient city of Smyrna, it is now a modern, developed, and busy commercial center, set around a huge bay and surrounded by mountains.
translations.reference: Kuqala okwakuyidolobha laseSmirna, manje kuyisikhungo sokuhweba sesimanje, esithuthukile, kanye nesiphithizelayo, esisethekwini elikhulu futhi nesizungezwe izintaba.
translations.hypothesis: NgesiSikhathi esedlule, leli dolobha lalaziwa ngokuthi i-Smyrna, kodwa manje liyindawo yezobuciko yanamuhla, ethuthukisiwe, futhi enobungcweti obukhulu, etholakala eduze kwendawo enkulu yamanzi futhi yizungezwe amaphahla amakhulu.

translations.source: The broad boulevards, glass-fronted buildings and modern shopping centers are dotted with traditional red-tiled roofs, the 18th century market, and old mosques and churches, although the city has an atmosphere more of Mediterranean Europe than traditional Turkey.
translations.reference: Umgwaqo obanzi okakwe izihlahla, izakhiwe ezinezingilazi ezinkulu kanye nendawo nezikhungo zezitolo zinophahla olungokwesiko olubomvu, imakethe yangekhulu lama-18 leminyaka, kanye namathempeli namasonto, nakuba idolobha linomoya omningi weYurophu yaseMedithera kunaseTheki engokwesiko.
translations.hypothesis: Amagagasi amakhulu, izakhiwo ezinezikhathi zengilazi kanye nezindawo zokuthengisa ezisamuva zinezindlu ezinezindlu ezincane ezibomvu, umarike waseminyakeni eyi-18, kanye namasikotela nama-churches amadala, nakuba le dolobha inobunzima obufana ne-Mediterranean yaseYurophu kunokuba ifana ne-Turkey edadewile.

translations.source: The village of Haldarsvík offer views of the nearby island Eysturoy and has an unusual octagonal church.
translations.reference: Umuzi waseHaldarsvík unezindlela zokubona isiqhingi esiseduze sase-Eysturoy futhi unesonto elingavamile elinezinhlangothi eziyisishiyagalombili.
translations.hypothesis: Idolobha lase-Haldarsvík linikeza umbukiso weziqhingi eziseduze, ikakhulukazi i-Eysturoy, futhi linentshwalongokuthi eyodwa egama layo eliyingqangamizi.

translations.source: In the churchyard, there are interesting marble sculptures of doves over some tombs.
translations.reference: Egcekeni lesonto, kunemifanekiso yemabula ethakazelisayo yamajuba phezu kwamathuna amanye.
translations.hypothesis: Endaweni yomuzi webandla, kukhona izithombe ezinhle ezibekiwe ngamabhuloho ezinkundleni, ezibonisa izinyoni ezibizwa ngokuthi "amaphuphu."

translations.source: It's worth half an hour to stroll about the intriguing village.
translations.reference: Kuyifanele ingxenye yehora ukuhambahamba emzaneni othakazelisayo.
translations.hypothesis: Kufanele uchithe imizuzu engu-khulu emibili uhamba phakathi kwalesi dolobha elithakazelisayo.

translations.source: To the north and within easy reach is the romantic and fascinating town of Sintra and which was made famous to foreigners after a glowing account of its splendours recorded by Lord Byron.
translations.reference: Ngasenyakatho futhi efinyeleleka kalula idolobha elinezabathandanayo nelithakazelisayo laseSintra elenziwa laduma ebantwini bakwamanye amazwe ngemva komlando walo okuhle wobukhazikhazi balo obhalwe iNkosi uByron.
translations.hypothesis: Enyakatho, eduze futhi kulula ukufinyelela kuyo, kukhona idolobha elimnandi nelithakazelisayo i-Sintra, elidlule udumo phakathi kwamanye amazwe ngemuva kokubhalwa kwencazelo enhle mayelana nobuhle bayo nguLord Byron.

translations.source: Scotturb Bus 403 travels regularly to Sintra, stopping at Cabo da Roca.
translations.reference: Ibhasi le-Scotturb 403 liya eSintra njalo, ime e-Cabo da Roca.
translations.hypothesis: Ibhasi le-Scotturb enomnomo owu-403 ihamba njalo eSintra, futhi iyayeka endaweni edlulelwe ngokuthi i-Cabo da Roca.

translations.source: Also to the north visit the great Sanctuary of Our Lady of Fatima (Shrine), a place of worldwide famous Marian apparitions.
translations.reference: Futhi ngasenyakatho vakashela Indawo Engcwele enkulu yeNkosazane Yethu uFatima (indawo yokukhulekela), indawo yemifanekiso kaMariya edumile emhlabeni jikelele.
translations.hypothesis: Futhi, ezempumalanga, vakashela indawo enkulu yento engcwele yamaMama kaFatima (i-Shrine), indawo edume emhlabeni jikelele ngenxa yezibonakaliso zamaMama.

translations.source: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave site, as well as a site that has an almost incalculable meaning to a significant portion of the world's population.
translations.reference: Siza ukhumbule ukuthi empeleni uvakashela ithuna okungcwatshwe kulo abantu abaningi, kanye nendawo ebaluleke kakhulu kubantu abaningi basemhlabeni.
translations.hypothesis: Ngicela nikhumbule ukuthi niyovakashela indawo yokugcwaliswa kwamakala amaningi, kanye nendawo enento esikhulu kakhulu kubantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele.

translations.source: There are still many men and women alive who survived their time here, and many more who had loved ones who were murdered or worked to death there, Jews and non-Jews alike.
translations.reference: Kusenabesilisa kanye nabesifazane abaningi abaphilayo abahlala lapha, kanye nabaningi abanabathandekayo babo ababulewe noma abasebenze baze bafela lapha, amaJuda kanye nokungebona amaJuda ngokufanayo.
translations.hypothesis: Kusafani namaningi amadoda kanye nabesifazane abaphilayo okuhlala kule ndawo, kanye nabaningi abanye ababebalimi ababengabafowabo, abafowabo, noma abantwana ababulawa noma abasebenza kuze bathule kule ndawo, ngabantu baseJuda kanye nabanye abantu, ngababili.

translations.source: Please treat the site with all of the dignity, solemnity and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis.
translations.reference: Siza uphathe le ngosi ngaso sonke isithunzi, isizotha kanye nenhlonipho eyifanele. Ungenzi amahlaya ngokuQothulwa kwesizwe noma amaNazi.
translations.hypothesis: Ngicela nithathe lesi site ngokunenzela, ukukhuleka kanye nokuhlonipha okufanele. Ungenzi amaphuzu okuhlekisa ngomlando we-Holocaust noma ngama-Nazis.

translations.source: Do not deface the site by marking or scratching graffiti into structures.
translations.reference: Musa ukungcolisa isiza ngokuphawula noma ukwenza imifanekiso esodongeni ezakhiweni.
translations.hypothesis: Ungalokothi udale umonakalo endaweni ngokubhala noma ukugqamisa izinto ngamakhambi noma ngamathangi.

translations.source: Barcelona's official languages are Catalan and Spanish. About a half prefer to speak Catalan, a vast majority understands it, and virtually everyone knows Spanish.
translations.reference: Izilimi ezisemthethweni zaseBarcelona isiCatalan neSpanishi. Cishe ingxenye ithanda ukukhuluma isiCatalan, iningi liyasizwisisa, futhi cishe wonke umuntu uyasazi iSpanishi.
translations.hypothesis: Izilimi ezisemthethweni zaseBarcelona yi-Catalan kanye nesiSpanish. Cishe ingxenye yabo bayathanda ukukhuluma i-Catalan, iningi elikhulu kakhulu kuyayiqonda, futhi cishe bonke bayazi isiSpanish.

translations.source: However, most signs are indicated only in Catalan because it is established by law as the first official language.
translations.reference: Nokho, izimpawu eziningi ziboniswe kuphela ngesi-Catalan ngoba simiswe ngokomthetho njengolimi lokuqala olungokomthetho.
translations.hypothesis: Kodwa, cishe zonke izimpawu zibhalwe kuphela ngesiCatalan ngoba umthetho uyawumisa njengezilimi ezisemthethweni ezinhle kakhulu.

translations.source: Yet, Spanish is also widely used in public transport and other facilities.
translations.reference: Nokho, iSpanishi sibuye sisetshenziswe kabanzi ezithuthini zomphakathi kanye nakwezinye izindawo.
translations.hypothesis: Kodwa-ke, isiSpanishi siphinde sasetshenziswa kakhulu ezindleleni zokuhamba zomphakathi nezinye izindawo.

translations.source: Regular announcements in the Metro are made only in Catalan, but unplanned disruptions are announced by an automated system in a wide variety of languages including Spanish, English, French, Arabic and Japanese.
translations.reference: Izaziso ezivamile eDolobheni Elikhulu zenziwa ngesi-Catalan kuphela, kodwa iziphazamiso ezingahleliwe zimenyezelwa ngohlelo lomshini ngezilimi eziningi ukuhlanganisa isi-Speyini, isiNgisi, isiFulentshi, isi-Arabhiya kanye nesiJapani.
translations.hypothesis: Izaziso ezivamile ezikhishwa kwi-Metro zikhishwa kuphela ngesi-Catalan, kodwa ukuguquka okungahleliwe kuxasuswa ngenhlanganisela ezisebenza ngokuzenzakalelayo ezikhulumisa ngezilimi eziningi, okubalwa uSpanish, isiNgisi, isiFulentshi, isi-Arabhu kanye nesiJapane.

translations.source: Parisians have a reputation for being egocentric, rude and arrogant.
translations.reference: Abantu basePherisi banedumela lokuqhosha, ukuba luhlaza kanye nokuzidla.
translations.hypothesis: Abantu baseParis banolwazi lokuthi bathathelwa yabo, bengabakhululekile futhi bangabakhulu.

translations.source: While this is often only an inaccurate stereotype, the best way to get along in Paris still is to be on your best behavior, acting like someone who is "bien élevé" (well brought up). It will make getting about considerably easier.
translations.reference: Nakuba lokhu kaningi kuyinto eshiwo abanye enganembile, indlela enhle yokuphila eParis kusase ukuziphatha kahle, uziphathe njengomuntu o-"bien élevé" (okhuliswe kahle). Kuzokwenza ukuphila kube lula kakhulu.
translations.hypothesis: Nakuba lokhu kwakuyinto evamile engokungafanele, indlela engcono kakhulu yokuhlala kahle eParis ukuba nobuchule, ukuziphatha njengomuntu "ohlezi kahle" (owafundiswa kangcono). Lokhu kuzenza ukuhamba kube lula kakhulu.

translations.source: Parisians' abrupt exteriors will rapidly evaporate if you display some basic courtesies.
translations.reference: Ingaphandle eliluhlaza labantu baseParis lizonyamalala ngokushesha uma uveza imikhuba emihle eyisisekelo.
translations.hypothesis: Abantu baseParis bayikhathi bathukuthele, kodwa lokhu kungahlaziywa uma nibanika ukuhlonipha okuyisisekelo.

translations.source: The Plitvice Lakes national park is heavily forested, mainly with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation.
translations.reference: Ipaki lezwe lePlitvice Lakes ligcwele izihlahla kakhulu, ngokuyinhloko line-beech, i-spruce, kanye nezihlahla ze-fir, futhi inenhlanganisela yezimila zase-Alps kanye naseMedithera.
translations.hypothesis: Ipaki kazwelonke yama-Plitvice Lakes igcwele izitshalo, ikakhulukazi izihlahla ezinhlobonhlobo ezifana ne-beech, spruce, kanye ne-fir, futhi inomucono wokusatshalwa kwezitshalo ezihlukene ezifana nalokho okutholakala ezintabeni zase-Alps kanye nase-Mediterranean.

translations.source: It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude.
translations.reference: Inezinhlobo eziningi eziphawulekayo zemiphakathi yezitshalo, ngenxa yokwahluka kwesimo sezilu sayo esikahle, umhlabathi ongafani kanye namazinga okuphakama ahlukile.
translations.hypothesis: Lolu daba unohlobo olukhulu kakhulu lwezindawo zezitshalo, ngenxa yobubanzi bomkhuba wemvelo, izinhlobo zezindlu zaso, kanye namazinga ahlukene obude.

translations.source: The area is also home to an extremely wide variety of animal and bird species.
translations.reference: Lendawo ibuye ibe yikhaya lezinhlobo ezingi zezilwane kanye nezinyoni.
translations.hypothesis: Le ndawo futhi iyikhaya kwezinhlobo eziningi kakhulu zempuku nezinyoni.

translations.source: Rare fauna such as the European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, wild cat and capercaillie can be found there, along with many more common species
translations.reference: Izilwane eziyivelakancane ezinjengebhere elinsundu laseYurophu, impisi efana nenketshane, ukhozi, isikhova, indabushe, ikati lasendle kanye ne-capercaillie zingatholakala lapho, kanye nezinye izinhlobo ezivamile.
translations.hypothesis: Izilwane eziningi ezihlukile, ezifana nebhulo yaseYurophu, inyoka, intaba, intshontsha, ilinki, ingwe yendlovu kanye ne-capercaillie, zingatholakala lapho, kanye nezinhlobo eziningi ezivamile.

translations.source: While visiting the monasteries, women are required to wear skirts covering the knees and have their shoulders covered, too.
translations.reference: Lapho bevakashela amamonasteli, abesifazane kudingeka bagqoke iziketi ezemboza amadolo futhi bamboze namahlombe wabo.
translations.hypothesis: Ngesikhathi zivakashela amakhaya, abesifazane kufanele bagqoke izinwele ezifihla izinyembezi futhi kufanele futhi zifihle amandla abo.

translations.source: Most of the monasteries do provide wraps for women who come unprepared, but if you bring your own, especially one with bright colors, you'll get a smile from the monk or nun at the entrance.
translations.reference: Amamonasteli amaningi anezembozo zabesifazane abeza bangalungile, kodwa uma uza nesakho, ikakhulukazi esinemibala ekhanyayo, ungamomothekelwa indela lowesilisa noma elesifazane esangeweni.
translations.hypothesis: Kuningi kwezibonde zihlinzeka ngama-shawl ezinkandleni zamafemu abafike bengalungile, kodwa uma ulethe lakho, ikakhulukazi elinombala omkhulu, uzothola ukumukeleka kuka-monk noma ka-nun eyingeni.

translations.source: Along the same line, men are required to wear trousers covering the knees.
translations.reference: Ngokufanayo, abesilisa kumelwe bagqoke amabhulukwe azombhoza amadolo abo.
translations.hypothesis: Ngokufanayo, amadoda kufanele agqoke izimpahla ezifakelwe ezifihla izinwele.

translations.source: This too can be borrowed from the stock at the entrance but that clothing isn't washed after every user so you may not feel comfortable wearing these skirts. One size fits all for men!
translations.reference: Lokhu futhi kungabolekwa ezimpahleni ezisendaweni yokungena kodwa leyo mpahla ayihlanzwa ngemva komsebenzisi ngamunye ngakho kungenzeka ungazizwa ukhululekile ukugqoka lesi siketi. Usayizi owodwa olingana amadoda onke!
translations.hypothesis: Lokhu nakho kungatholakala ukulokhuza kusukela ezinto ezitholakala ngaphambi kendawo, kodwa izingubo azihlanzwa ngemuva kokusetshenziswa ngumuntu ngamunye, ngakho-ke kungase ungazizwa ukhululekile ukugqoka lezi ziphansi. Kukhona usayizi owodwa kuphela, ofanelebonke amadoda!

translations.source: Majorcan cuisine, like that of similar zones in the Mediterranean, is based on bread, vegetables and meat (specially pork), and uses olive oil throughout.
translations.reference: I-Majorcan cuisine, njengaleyo yezindawo ezifanayo eMedithera, isekelwe esinkwa, imifino kanye nenyama(ingulube ikakhulukazi), futhi isebenzisa amafutha omnqumo kuyo yonke indawo.
translations.hypothesis: Ukudla kwaseMajorca, njengokudla kwezindawo ezifanayo e-Mediterranean, kususelwe embile, izitshalo kanye nomuthi (ikakhulukazi inyama yengulube), futhi kusebenzisa uwoyela wama-olives kuzo zonke izindlela zokupheka.

translations.source: A simple popular dinner, especially during the summer, is the Pa amb Oli: Bread with olive oil, tomato, and any available condiments such as cheese, tunafish, etc.
translations.reference: Idina elilula elithandwayo, ikhakhulukazi phakathi nehlobo, yiPa amb Oli: Isinkwa namafutha omnqumo, utamatisi, kanye nanoma yiziphi izinongo ezikhona njengoshizi, inhlanzi ye-tuna, njalo njalo.
translations.hypothesis: Ukudla elula futhi ethandwa kakhulu, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi sezikhathi ezishisayo, yi-"Pa amb Oli": ubisi oluhlosiwe, olunenhlanganisela yamafutha e-olives, itamatisi, kanye nanoma yimiphi imikhiqizo eyengeziwe efaneleka, njenge-chizi, uthuna, njll.

translations.source: All nouns, alongside the word Sie for you, always begin with a capital letter, even in the middle of a sentence.
translations.reference: Wonke amabizo, kanye negama elithi Sie kuwe, ahlala aqala ngosonhlamvukazi, ngisho noma ephakathi komusho.
translations.hypothesis: Wonke amagama afana, kanye negama elithi "Sie" elisho "wena," ayiqala ngenguqulo enkulu, ngisho nakumaPhrasa.

translations.source: This is an important way to distinguish between some verbs and objects.
translations.reference: Lena indlela enhle yokuhlukanisa phakathi kwezenzo ezinye kanye nezinto.
translations.hypothesis: Lena indlela ebalulekile yokuhlukanisa phakathi kwezinto ezithile ezisetshenziswa njengezilimi kanye nezinto ezisetshenziswa.

translations.source: It also arguably makes reading easier, though writing is somewhat complicated by the need to find out whether a verb or adjective is used in a substantivized form.
translations.reference: Ngokobufakazi obukhona kwenza ukufunda kube lula, nakuba ukubhala ngandlelathile kwenziwa inkimbinkimbi ngenxa yesidingo sokuthola ukuthi isenzo noma isiphawulo sisetshenziswa ngohlobo oluphathelene nosobizo.
translations.hypothesis: Nakuba kungase kube ngempela ukuthi kwenza ukufundwa kube lula, kodwa ukubhala kungaba yinto eyinkimbinkimbi ngenxa yokuthi kudingeka ukuthola ukuthi ngabe isenzi noma isivimvamlilo sisebenzisa ngabe ngohlobo lwesihloko.

translations.source: Pronunciation is relatively easy in Italian since most words are pronounced exactly how they are written
translations.reference: Ukuphimisela cishe kulula ngesiNtaliyane njengoba amagama amaningi aphinyiselwa ngedlela efanayo nabhalwe ngayo
translations.hypothesis: Ukukhuluma isi-Italiani kulula kakhulu ngoba amaningi amagama akhulunywa ngendlela abhalwe ngayo.

translations.source: The main letters to watch out for are c and g, since their pronunciation varies based on the following vowel.
translations.reference: Izinhlamvu eziyinhloko okumelwe uziqaphele u-c no-g, njengoba ukuziphimisela kuhluka ngokusekelwe kunkamisa olandelayo.
translations.hypothesis: Izinhlamvu ezibalulekile okufanele unakekelele ngazo yi-'c' ne-'g', ngoba ukufundwa kwazo kuhluka kuye ngophawu lwegama elilandelayo.

translations.source: Also, make sure to pronounce r and rr differently: caro means dear, whereas carro means chariot.
translations.reference: Qiniseka ukuthi ubiza uhlamvu u-r kanye nezinhlamvu u-rr ngokuhlukile: u-caro usho ukuthi othandekayo, kuyilapho u-carro esho inqola.
translations.hypothesis: Futhi, qaphela ukuthi kufanele ukhulume izwi "r" kanye "rr" ngendlela ehlukene: "caro" kusho "mbhali," kanti "carro" kusho "imoto."

translations.source: Persian has a relatively easy and mostly regular grammar.
translations.reference: IsiPheresiya sinohlelo lolimi olulula futhi oluvamile kakhulu.
translations.hypothesis: ISilishi inomthetho olula futhi ohlanganisiwe kakhulu.

translations.source: Therefore, reading this grammar primer would help you learn much about Persian grammar and understand phrases better.
translations.reference: Ngakho-ke, ukufunda lencwadi yokusiza ukufunda uhlelo lolimi kungakusiza ufunde okuningi ngohlelo lolimi lwesiPheresiya futhi uqonde imisho kangcono.
translations.hypothesis: Ngakho-ke, ukufunda leli bhuku eliyisiqondiso mayelana nolimi, kuzokusiza ukufunda kakhulu ngolimi lwama-Persia futhi uqonde ngcono amazwi.

translations.source: Needless to say, if you know a Romance language, it will be easier for you to learn Portuguese.
translations.reference: Akungabazeki ukuthi, uma wazi ulimi loThando, kuyoba lula ngawe ukufunda isiPutukezi.
translations.hypothesis: Akufanele kuthiwa, uma uyazi olunye ulwimi lweRomance, kuzoba kulula kuwe ukufunda isiPutukezi.

translations.source: However, people who know a little Spanish may hastily conclude that Portuguese is close enough that it need not be studied separately.
translations.reference: Nokho, abantu abasazi kancane iSpanishi bangase baphethe ngokushesha ngokuthi isiPutukezi siseduze kakhulu kangangokuthi akudingeki ukusifunda ngokuhlukile.
translations.hypothesis: Kodwa, abantu abazi kancane isiSpanishi bangase bathole ukuthi isiPutugali sifane kakhulu kangangokuthi akudingeki kufundwe ngokuhlukile.

translations.source: Pre-modern observatories are usually obsolete today, and remain as museums, or sites of education.
translations.reference: Izinto zangaphambi kwenkathi yamanje ngokuvamile azisasetshenziswa namuhla, futhi zihlala kumamyuziyamu, noma izindawo zokufundisa.
translations.hypothesis: Izikhungo zokubukisa ezadala ngaphambi kakhisimende zivame ukuthi zingasetshenzisi namuhla, futhi zihlala njengezikhungo zochwepheshe (amajini) noma izindawo zemfundo.

translations.source: As light pollution in their heyday was not the kind of problem it is today, they are usually located in cities or at campuses, easier to reach than those built in modern times.
translations.reference: Njengoba ukuphazamisa kokukhanya ngesikhathi sokudlondlobala kwazo kwakungeyona inkinga okuyiyona namuhla, ngokuvamile zitholakala emadolobheni noma ezikoleni, zitholakala kalula kunalezo ezakhiwe ngezikhathi zanamuhla.
translations.hypothesis: Ngenxa yokuthi ukukhanya okungenantengo kwakungeyona inkinga enkulu ngaleso sikhathi, kanti manje kunjalo, kulo lwazi olukhulu, zivame ukuthi zitholakale ezikhungweni zedolobha noma ezikampasini, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kuzo uma kuqhathaniswa nalazo ezakhiwe ngalesikhathi samanje.

translations.source: Most modern research telescopes are enormous facilities in remote areas with favorable atmospheric conditions.
translations.reference: Izindawo eziningo ezaziwayo zesibonakude ziyizindawo ezingaziwa ezindaweni ezinesimo esithandekayo.
translations.hypothesis: Imithombo yobuciko yamanje eminingi iyizikhungo ezinkulu ezitholakala ezindaweni ezikude, lapho imingcwama yomoya ibungcono khona.

translations.source: Cherry blossom viewing, known as hanami, has been a part of Japanese culture since the 8th century.
translations.reference: Ukubuka ama-cherry eqhakaza, okwaziwa ngokuthi i-hanami, kube ingxenye yesiko laseJapani kusukela ngekhulu lama-8 leminyaka.
translations.hypothesis: Ukubukwa kwemifaniswa yama-cherry, okuyi-"hanami," kuyingxenye yamasiko aseJapane kusukela ngomkhathi we-8.

translations.source: The concept came from China where plum blossoms were the flower of choice.
translations.reference: Umcabango uvela eShayina lapho izimbali zepulamu kwakuyimbali ethandwayo.
translations.hypothesis: Le ngxenye yomqondo yaphuma eChina, lapho izimbali zama-plum zazingumphumela othembekile.

translations.source: In Japan, the first cherry blossom parties were hosted by the emperor only for himself and other members of the aristocracy around the Imperial Court.
translations.reference: EJapani, imicimbi yokuqala yokuqhakaza kwama-cherry yabungazwa umbusi eyibungazela yena kuphela kanye namanye amalungu ohlobo lobukhosi lwasezweni Esigodlweni saseBukhosini.
translations.hypothesis: EJapan, imikhosi yokucomisa izitini zama-cherry yokuqala yayibanjwa ngumbusi kuphela, kanye namanye amalungu omphakathi ophezulu abathintekayo ngombuso.

translations.source: Plants look their best when in a natural environment, so resist the temptation to remove even "just one" specimen.
translations.reference: Izitshalo zibukeka kahle kakhulu lapho zisendaweni yazo engokwemvelo, ngakho gwema isilingo sokususa nesifanekiso “esisodwa nje”.
translations.hypothesis: Izitshalo zibukeka ngendlela engcono kakhulu uma zikhona endaweni yendalo, ngakho yiba nesibindi ukungasusi, ngisho "ngesinye nje" isibonelo.

translations.source: If visiting a formally arranged garden, collecting "specimens" is also going to get you ejected, without discussion.
translations.reference: Uma ukuvakashela ingadi ehlelwe ngokomthetho, ukuqoqa "izifanekiso" kuzobuye kukwenze ukhishwe, ngaphandle kwengxoxo.
translations.hypothesis: Uma uvakashela indawo yezitshalo eyakhiwe ngendlela efanele, ukuhlanganisa "izinto ezithile" kuzokubangela ukuthi ukhipheke, ngaphandle kokuxoxwa.

translations.source: Singapore is generally an extremely safe place to be and very easy to navigate, and you can buy almost anything after arriving.
translations.reference: I-Singapore ngokuvamile iyindawo ephephile kakhulu ukuba kuyo kanye nokulula ukuhamba kuyo, futhi ungakwazi ukuthenga cishe noma yini ngemva kokufika.
translations.hypothesis: I-Singapore ngokuvamile iyindawo ephephile kakhulu futhi elula kakhulu ukuyifunda, futhi ungathenga cishe noma yini ngemuva kokufika.

translations.source: But being placed in the "high tropics" just a few degrees north of equator you will need to deal with both heat (always) and strong sun (when the sky is clear, more rarely).
translations.reference: Uma ubekwe “emazweni aphezulu anokushisa okukhulu” amadigiliyi ambalwa nje enyakatho nenkabazwe kuzodingeka ubhekane nokushisa (njalo) kanye nelanga elishisa kakhulu (lapho libalele, okungavamisanga ukwenzeka).
translations.hypothesis: Kodwa ukuthi ufakwa endaweni "eyamakhaya amakhulu," eduze nje kwegeyini, kuzodingeka ukuthi ubhekane nombani (njalo) kanye nelanga eliqinile (lapho isibhakabhaka sikhanya, kodwa kakhulu).

translations.source: There are also a few buses going north to Hebron, the traditional burial place of the Biblical patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and their wives.
translations.reference: Kubuye kube namabhasi ambalwa aya enyakatho eHebroni, indawo engokwesiko yokungcwaba izinzalamizi zaseBhayibhelini u-Abrahamu, u-Isaka, u-Jakobe, kanye namakhosikazi wabo.
translations.hypothesis: Kukhona nezikhathi ezimbalwa zamabhasi ezidlula enyakatho eya kwa-Hebron, okuyi-goli elidumile lapho abafowabo bendawo abayisikhathi ababizwa ngama-Abraham, u-Isaka, u-Jakobe, kanye nabafazi babo bayahlalelwa khona.

translations.source: Check that the bus you are thinking of taking goes into Hebron and not just to the nearby Jewish settlement of Kiryat Arba.
translations.reference: Hlola ukuthi ibhasi ocabanga ukuligibela liya eHebroni yini futhi hhayi indawo yamaJuda eseduze yaseKiryat Arba.
translations.hypothesis: Qinisekisa ukuthi ibhasi olucabangayo ukuyithatha iya eHebron, futhi ayi nje e-Kiryat Arba, eliyindawo yamaJuda edolobheni eliseduze.

translations.source: Inland waterways can be a good theme to base a holiday around.
translations.reference: Imisele yamanzi emaphakathi nezwe kungaba umbono omuhle wokusekela iholide kuwo.
translations.hypothesis: Amagqubu amanzi angaphakathi kwezwe angaba yinto enhle ongayisebenzisa njengesihloko somholidi wakho.

translations.source: For example visiting castles in the Loire Valley, the Rhine valley or taking a cruise to interesting cites on the Danube or boating along the Erie Canal.
translations.reference: Ngokwesibonelo ukuvakashela izigodlo eSigodini saseLoire, isigodi saseRhine noma ukuthatha uhambo ngomkhumbi oluya emadolobheni athakazelisayo kuyiDanube noma ukuhamba ngesikebhe kuyi-Erie Canal.
translations.hypothesis: Ngokwesibonelo, ungavakashela amakhaseli eDolini yaseLoire, eDolini yaseRhine, noma ungene esithimbeni ukuya ezikhumulweni ezithakazelisayo eDolini yaseDanube, noma uphinde uhambe ngesikebhe endleleni ye-Erie Canal.

translations.source: They also define routes for popular hiking and cycling trails.
translations.reference: Babuye basho nezindlela zemizila yokuqwala izintaba nokuhamba ngamabhisikili.
translations.hypothesis: Baphinde futhi bathwetshule izindlela ezisetshenziswa kakhulu yizihambi kanye nabadlali bezimoto.

translations.source: Christmas is one of the most important holidays of Christianity, and is celebrated as the birthday of Jesus.
translations.reference: UKhisimusi elinye lamaholide abalulekile ebuKristwini, futhi ligujwa njengosuku lokuzalwa kukaJesu.
translations.hypothesis: IKristimasi ngelinye lamaholide amakhulu kakhulu ebandamini likaJesu, futhi igujwa njengosuku lokuzalwa kaJesu.

translations.source: Many of the traditions surrounding the holiday have been adopted also by non-believers in Christian countries and non-Christians around the world.
translations.reference: Amasiko amaningi ahlobene namaholide amukelwe abantu abangewona amakholwa emazweni obuKristu nabangewona amaKristu emhlabeni jikelele.
translations.hypothesis: Ezinyamazana eziningi ezihlobene naleli holidi zasetshenziswa futhi ngabantu abangakholwa kweKristu ezweni leli kanye nabantu abangamaKristu emhlabeni wonke.

translations.source: There's a tradition to pass the Easter night awake at some exposed point to see the sunrise.
translations.reference: Kukhona isiko lokuhlala ungalali kuze kuhlwe ngobusuku bePhasika endaweni ethile ukuze ubone ukuphuma kwelanga.
translations.hypothesis: Kukhona indlela esetshenziswa ngabantu emva kwebusuku bukaPhasika, lapho bahlala beqhamuka endaweni ethile lapho bangabukela khona ukusika kwelanga.

translations.source: There are of course Christian theological explanations for this tradition, but it may well be a pre-Christian Spring and Fertility ritual.
translations.reference: Ngokuqinisekile kunezincazelo ezingokwenkolo yobuKrestu zaleli siko, kodwa kungenzeka kube isiko langaphambi kobuKrestu laseNtwasahlobo nesiko Lokuzala..
translations.hypothesis: Kukhona izincazelo zombusozulu zaseKristu zaleli nqubekela, kodwa kungase kube yisiko elidlule ngaphambi kukaKristu, elihlobene nobusomnyama kanye nokukhula.

translations.source: More traditional churches often hold an Easter Vigil on Saturday night during the Easter weekend, with the congregations often breaking into celebration at the stroke of midnight to celebrate Christ's resurrection.
translations.reference: Amaningi amasonto akudala asazibamba Izinkonzo zePhasika njalo ngoMgqibelo ebusuku ngesikhathi sempelasonto yePhasika, nebandla nalo libungaze ngokuhlanganyela ezinzulwini zobusuku kubungazwa ukuvuka kukaKrestu.
translations.hypothesis: Izinkolo ezivamile eziningi zibamba umcimbi wokugubha ubusuku bukaPhasika ngobusuku ngoMgqibelo ngesikhathi sendlanga kaPhasika, lapho abalandeli abaningi begubha kakhulu uma kusanda kuba ubusuku, ukuze bamemukele ukuvuka kukaKristu.

translations.source: All animals that originally arrived in the islands came here either by swimming, flying or floating.
translations.reference: Izilwane ezafika eziqhingini ekuqaleni zafika lapha ngokubhukuda, ngokundiza noma ngokuntanta.
translations.hypothesis: Wonke izilwane ezifika kuqala ezikuluhlu lweziqhingi zifike lapha ngendlela ezintathu: ngokuwukubhukuda, ngokuwundiza, noma ngokuwukuzithuthisa emanzini.

translations.source: Due to the long distance from the continent mammals were unable to make the journey making the giant tortoise the primary grazing animal in the Galapagos.
translations.reference: Ngenxa yebanga elide kusuka ezwekazini izilwane ezincelisayo bezingakwazi ukuthatha uhambo okwenza ukuba izimfudu ezinkulu kakhulu zibe yizilwane eziklabayo eziyinhloko kumaGalapagos.
translations.hypothesis: Ngenxa yebanga elide kakhulu phakathi nalesi ndawo kanye nekhondlo, izilwane ezinkulu azikwazanga ukuhamba kuleli hlelo, ngakho-ke i-tortoise enkulu yaba yisilwane esikhulu esidlala ukudla kuleli ziko i-Galapagos.

translations.source: Since the arrival of man to the Galapagos, many mammals have been introduced including goats, horses, cows, rats, cats and dogs.
translations.reference: Kusukela ekufikeni komuntu eGalapagos, izilwane ezincelisayo eziningi zalethwa kuhlanganise nezimbuzi, amahhashi, izinkomo, amagundane, amakati kanye nezinja.
translations.hypothesis: Kusukela abantu befika eGalapagos, izilwane eziningi eziluhlaza zingeniswe, okubalwa izinkomo, izihlahla, imfene, izinkukhu, amakati kanye nezinkomoni.

translations.source: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic areas in the winter you will experience the polar night, which means that the sun doesn't rise above the horizon.
translations.reference: Uma uvakashela izindawo zase-Arctic noma e-Aantarctic ebusika ungabona ubusuku obuthatha amahora angaphezu kuka-24, okusho ukuthi ilanga alisi ngaphezu komkhathizwe.
translations.hypothesis: Uma uvakashela izindawo zase-Arctic noma zase-Antarctic ngentwasahlobo, uzobhekana "nelanga eliphansi," okusho ukuthi ilanga alikwazi ukukhumeka ngaphezu komugqa ophethwe yiyo.

translations.source: This offers a good opportunity to see the Aurora borealis, as the sky will be dark more or less around the clock.
translations.reference: Lokhu kunikeza ithuba elihle lokubona i-Aurora borealis, njengoba isibhakabhaka sizoba mnyama kakhulu noma ngaphansi phakathi newashi.
translations.hypothesis: Lokhu kunikeza ithuba elihle lokubona i-Aurora borealis, ngoba isibhakabhaka sizoba mnyama cishe ngaso sonke isikhathi.

translations.source: As the areas are sparsely populated, and light pollution therefore often not a problem, you will also be able to enjoy the stars.
translations.reference: Njengoba izindawo zingahlali abantu abaningi, nokuphazamisa kokukhanya kungavamanga ukuba inkinga, uzokwazi futhi ukujabulela izinkanyezi.
translations.hypothesis: Ngoba lezi zindawo azinabantu abaningi, ngakho ukukhanya okudabukisa (ukukhanya okungenxa yomphakathi) kuvamise ukungabi yinkinga, futhi ngaleyo ndlela, nina nazo nizonakhelwa ukubuka izinkanyezi.

translations.source: Japanese work culture is more hierarchical and formal that what Westerners may be used to.
translations.reference: Isiko lokusebenza laseJapani lilandelana kakhulu futhi lihlelekile kunalokho labo abahlala emazweni aseNtshonalanga okungenzeka ukuthi bakujwayele.
translations.hypothesis: Inkulturwane yomsebenzi yaseJapan ihleleke kakhulu futhi inomthetho ngendlela engangase abantu baseNtshonalanga bangajwayeleni nayo.

translations.source: Suits are standard business attire, and coworkers call each other by their family names or by job titles.
translations.reference: Amasudi ayindlela yokugqoka evamile ebhizinisini, futhi abasebenza ndawonye babizana ngezibongo zabo noma ngohlobo lomsebenzi.
translations.hypothesis: Izimpahla zokugqoka ezifanele ziyingxenye ejwayelekile yempahla yezabasebenzi, futhi abasebenzi badlula ngamakhosana abo noma ngamazwi afanele umsebenzi abawenzayo.

translations.source: Workplace harmony is crucial, emphasizing group effort rather than praising individual accomplishments.
translations.reference: Ukusebenza ngokubambisana endaweni yokusebenzela kubalulekile, ukugcizelela ukusebenza njengeqembu kunokutusa umuntu ofeze okuthile.
translations.hypothesis: Ukuthuthuka kwendlela yokusebenza kubalulekile, kanti kukhuthazwa ukusebenzisana njengoba kuyisikhathi eside kunokugcizelela izimpumelelo zabaningi.

translations.source: Workers must often get their superiors' approval for any decisions they make, and are expected to obey their superiors' instructions without question.
translations.reference: Abasebenzi kumele kaningi bathole imvume yabaphathi babo nganoma yiziphi izinqumo ebazenzayo, futhi kulindeleke ukuthi balalele imiyalo yabaphathi babo ngale kokuthini.
translations.hypothesis: Abasebenzi kufanele bavumele abaphakathi abaphezulu babo ngazinye izinqumo azenzayo, futhi kulindeleke ukuthi alandele imiyalelo yabo abaphakathi abaphezulu ngaphandle kokubuzwa.
